name: ae_restrict_le_codiscreteWithin
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_le_codiscreteWithin
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [TopologicalSpace α] [SecondCountableTopology α]
    {μ : Measure α} [NullSingletonClass μ] {U : Set α} (hU : MeasurableSet U) :
    ae (μ.restrict U) ≤ codiscreteWithin U
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  have : DiscreteTopology ↑(sᶜ ∩ U) := isDiscrete_iff_discreteTopology.mp
    <| isDiscrete_of_codiscreteWithin ((compl_compl s).symm ▸ hs)
  rw [mem_ae_iff, Measure.restrict_apply' hU]
  apply Set.Countable.measure_zero (TopologicalSpace.separableSpace_iff_countable.1 inferInstance)

name: univ_mem
statement: theorem univ_mem (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜) : univ ∈ 𝒜
proof:
:=
  compl_empty ▸ h𝒜.compl_mem h𝒜.empty_mem

name: inter_mem
statement:
theorem inter_mem (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜) (s_mem : s ∈ 𝒜) (t_mem : t ∈ 𝒜) :
    s ∩ t ∈ 𝒜
proof:
:=
  inter_eq_compl_compl_union_compl .. ▸
    h𝒜.compl_mem (h𝒜.union_mem (h𝒜.compl_mem s_mem) (h𝒜.compl_mem t_mem))

name: sdiff_mem
statement:
theorem sdiff_mem (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜) (s_mem : s ∈ 𝒜) (t_mem : t ∈ 𝒜) :
    s \ t ∈ 𝒜
proof: := h𝒜.inter_mem s_mem (h𝒜.compl_mem t_mem)

name: isSetRing
statement:
theorem isSetRing (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜) : IsSetRing 𝒜 where
  empty_mem
proof:
:= h𝒜.empty_mem
  union_mem := h𝒜.union_mem
  sdiff_mem := fun _ _ ↦ h𝒜.sdiff_mem

name: biUnion_mem
statement:
theorem biUnion_mem {ι : Type*} (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜) {s : ι → Set α} (S : Finset ι)
    (hs : ∀ i ∈ S, s i ∈ 𝒜) : ⋃ i ∈ S, s i ∈ 𝒜
proof: := h𝒜.isSetRing.biUnion_mem S hs

name: biInter_mem
statement:
theorem biInter_mem {ι : Type*} (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜) {s : ι → Set α} (S : Finset ι)
    (hs : ∀ i ∈ S, s i ∈ 𝒜) : ⋂ i ∈ S, s i ∈ 𝒜
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : S = ∅
  · rw [h, ← Finset.set_biInter_coe, Finset.coe_empty, biInter_empty]
    exact h𝒜.univ_mem
  · exact h𝒜.isSetRing.biInter_mem S h hs

name: isSetAlgebra_generateSetAlgebra
statement:
theorem isSetAlgebra_generateSetAlgebra :
    IsSetAlgebra (generateSetAlgebra 𝒜) where
  empty_mem
proof:
:= .empty
  compl_mem := .compl
  union_mem := .union

name: self_subset_generateSetAlgebra
statement: theorem self_subset_generateSetAlgebra : 𝒜 ⊆ generateSetAlgebra 𝒜
proof: := .base

name: generateSetAlgebra_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma generateSetAlgebra_induction {motive : ∀ s, s ∈ generateSetAlgebra 𝒜 → Prop}
    (base : ∀ (u) (hu : u ∈ 𝒜), motive u (self_subset_generateSetAlgebra hu))
    (empty : motive ∅ isSetAlgebra_generateSetAlgebra.empty_mem)
    (compl : ∀ u hu, motive u hu → motive uᶜ (isSetAlgebra_generateSetAlgebra.compl_mem hu))
    (union : ∀ u v hu hv, motive u hu → motive v hv →
      motive (u ∪ v) (isSetAlgebra_generateSetAlgebra.union_mem hu hv))
    (hs : s ∈ generateSetAlgebra 𝒜) : motive s hs
proof:
:= by
  induction hs with
  | base _ hu => exact base _ hu
  | empty => exact empty
  | compl _ _ ih => exact compl _ _ ih
  | union _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact union _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂

name: IsSetAlgebra.generateSetAlgebra_subset
statement:
lemma IsSetAlgebra.generateSetAlgebra_subset {ℬ : Set (Set α)} (h : 𝒜 ⊆ ℬ)
    (hℬ : IsSetAlgebra ℬ) : generateSetAlgebra 𝒜 ⊆ ℬ
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  induction hs using generateSetAlgebra_induction with
  | base t t_mem => exact h t_mem
  | empty => exact hℬ.empty_mem
  | compl t _ t_mem => exact hℬ.compl_mem t_mem
  | union t u _ _ t_mem u_mem => exact hℬ.union_mem t_mem u_mem

name: generateFrom_generateSetAlgebra_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem generateFrom_generateSetAlgebra_eq :
    generateFrom (generateSetAlgebra 𝒜) = generateFrom 𝒜
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun s ms ↦ ?_) (generateFrom_mono self_subset_generateSetAlgebra)
  induction s, ms using generateFrom_induction with
  | hC t ht h =>
    clear h
    induction ht using generateSetAlgebra_induction with
    | base u u_mem => exact measurableSet_generateFrom u_mem
    | empty => exact @MeasurableSet.empty _ (generateFrom 𝒜)
    | compl u _ mu => exact mu.compl
    | union u v _ _ mu mv => exact MeasurableSet.union mu mv
  | empty => exact MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_empty _
  | compl t _ ht => exact ht.compl
  | iUnion t _ ht => exact .iUnion ht

name: generateSetAlgebra_mono
statement:
theorem generateSetAlgebra_mono {ℬ : Set (Set α)} (h : 𝒜 ⊆ ℬ) :
    generateSetAlgebra 𝒜 ⊆ generateSetAlgebra ℬ
proof:
:=
  isSetAlgebra_generateSetAlgebra.generateSetAlgebra_subset (h.trans self_subset_generateSetAlgebra)

name: generateSetAlgebra_subset_self
statement:
theorem generateSetAlgebra_subset_self (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜) :
    generateSetAlgebra 𝒜 ⊆ 𝒜
proof: := generateSetAlgebra_subset subset_rfl h𝒜

name: generateSetAlgebra_eq
statement: theorem generateSetAlgebra_eq (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜) : generateSetAlgebra 𝒜 = 𝒜
proof:
:=
  Subset.antisymm h𝒜.generateSetAlgebra_subset_self self_subset_generateSetAlgebra

name: mem_generateSetAlgebra_elim
statement:
theorem mem_generateSetAlgebra_elim (s_mem : s ∈ generateSetAlgebra 𝒜) :
    ∃ A : Set (Set (Set α)), A.Finite ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, a.Finite) ∧
    (∀ᵉ (a ∈ A) (t ∈ a), t ∈ 𝒜 ∨ tᶜ ∈ 𝒜) ∧ s = ⋃ a ∈ A, ⋂ t ∈ a, t
proof:
:= by
  induction s_mem using generateSetAlgebra_induction with
  | base u u_mem =>
    refine ⟨{{u}}, finite_singleton {u},
      fun a ha ↦ eq_of_mem_singleton ha ▸ finite_singleton u,
      fun a ha t ht ↦ ?_, by simp⟩
    rw [eq_of_mem_singleton ha, ha, eq_of_mem_singleton ht, ht] at *
    exact Or.inl u_mem
  | empty => exact ⟨∅, finite_empty, fun _ h ↦ (notMem_empty _ h).elim,
    fun _ ha _ _ ↦ (notMem_empty _ ha).elim, by simp⟩
  | compl u _ u_ind =>
    rcases u_ind with ⟨A, A_fin, mem_A, hA, u_eq⟩
    have := finite_coe_iff.2 A_fin
    have := fun a : A ↦ finite_coe_iff.2 <| mem_A a.1 a.2
    refine ⟨{{(f a).1ᶜ | a : A} | f : (Π a : A, ↑a)}, finite_coe_iff.1 inferInstance,
      fun a ⟨f, hf⟩ ↦ hf ▸ finite_coe_iff.1 inferInstance, fun a ha t ht ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases ha with ⟨f, rfl⟩
      rcases ht with ⟨a, rfl⟩
      rw [compl_compl, or_comm]
      exact hA a.1 a.2 (f a).1 (f a).2
    · ext x
      simp only [u_eq, compl_iUnion, compl_iInter, mem_iInter, mem_iUnion, mem_compl_iff,
        exists_prop, Subtype.exists, mem_ofPred_eq, iUnion_exists, iUnion_iUnion_eq',
        iInter_exists]
      constructor <;> intro hx
      · choose f hf using hx
        exact ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨f a ha, (hf a ha).1⟩, fun _ a ha h ↦ by rw [← h]; exact (hf a ha).2⟩
      · rcases hx with ⟨f, hf⟩
        exact fun a ha ↦ ⟨f ⟨a, ha⟩, (f ⟨a, ha⟩).2, hf (f ⟨a, ha⟩)ᶜ a ha rfl⟩
  | union u v _ _ u_ind v_ind =>
    rcases u_ind with ⟨Au, Au_fin, mem_Au, hAu, u_eq⟩
    rcases v_ind with ⟨Av, Av_fin, mem_Av, hAv, v_eq⟩
    refine ⟨Au ∪ Av, Au_fin.union Av_fin, ?_, ?_, by rw [u_eq, v_eq, ← biUnion_union]⟩
    · rintro a (ha | ha)
      · exact mem_Au a ha
      · exact mem_Av a ha
    · rintro a (ha | ha) t ht
      · exact hAu a ha t ht
      · exact hAv a ha t ht

name: countable_generateSetAlgebra
statement:
theorem countable_generateSetAlgebra (h : 𝒜.Countable) :
    (generateSetAlgebra 𝒜).Countable
proof:
:= by
  let ℬ := {s | s ∈ 𝒜} ∪ {s | sᶜ ∈ 𝒜}
  have count_ℬ : ℬ.Countable := by
    apply h.union
    have : compl '' 𝒜 = {s | sᶜ ∈ 𝒜} := by
      ext s
      simpa using ⟨fun ⟨x, x_mem, hx⟩ ↦ by simp [← hx, x_mem], fun hs ↦ ⟨sᶜ, hs, by simp⟩⟩
    exact this ▸ h.image compl
  let f : Set (Set (Set α)) → Set α := fun A ↦ ⋃ a ∈ A, ⋂ t ∈ a, t
  let 𝒞 := {a | a.Finite ∧ a ⊆ ℬ}
  have count_𝒞 : 𝒞.Countable := countable_ofPred_finite_subset (countable_coe_iff.1 count_ℬ)
  let 𝒟 := {A | A.Finite ∧ A ⊆ 𝒞}
  have count_𝒟 : 𝒟.Countable := countable_ofPred_finite_subset (countable_coe_iff.1 count_𝒞)
  have : generateSetAlgebra 𝒜 ⊆ f '' 𝒟 := by
    intro s s_mem
    rcases mem_generateSetAlgebra_elim s_mem with ⟨A, A_fin, mem_A, hA, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨A, ⟨A_fin, fun a ha ↦ ⟨mem_A a ha, hA a ha⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  exact (count_𝒟.image f).mono this

name: isPiSystem_measurableSet
statement:
theorem isPiSystem_measurableSet {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] :
    IsPiSystem { s : Set α | MeasurableSet s }
proof: := fun _ hs _ ht _ => hs.inter ht

name: IsPiSystem.singleton
statement: theorem IsPiSystem.singleton (S : Set α) : IsPiSystem ({S} : Set (Set α))
proof:
:= by
  intro s h_s t h_t _
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 h_s, Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 h_t, Set.inter_self,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff]

name: IsPiSystem.insert_empty
statement:
theorem IsPiSystem.insert_empty {S : Set (Set α)} (h_pi : IsPiSystem S) :
    IsPiSystem (insert ∅ S)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs t ht hst
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · simp [hs]
  · rcases ht with ht | ht
    · simp [ht]
    · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (h_pi s hs t ht hst)

name: IsPiSystem.insert_univ
statement:
theorem IsPiSystem.insert_univ {S : Set (Set α)} (h_pi : IsPiSystem S) :
    IsPiSystem (insert Set.univ S)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs t ht hst
  rcases hs with hs | hs
  · rcases ht with ht | ht <;> simp [hs, ht]
  · rcases ht with ht | ht
    · simp [hs, ht]
    · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (h_pi s hs t ht hst)

name: IsPiSystem.comap
statement:
theorem IsPiSystem.comap {α β} {S : Set (Set β)} (h_pi : IsPiSystem S) (f : α → β) :
    IsPiSystem { s : Set α | ∃ t ∈ S, f ⁻¹' t = s }
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨s, hs_mem, rfl⟩ _ ⟨t, ht_mem, rfl⟩ hst
  rw [← Set.preimage_inter] at hst ⊢
  exact ⟨s ∩ t, h_pi s hs_mem t ht_mem (nonempty_of_nonempty_preimage hst), rfl⟩

name: IsPiSystem.dissipate_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using h 0
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [dissipate_succ] at h' ⊢
    exact hC (dissipate s n) (hn h'.left) (s (n + 1)) (h (n + 1)) h'

name: isPiSystem_iUnion_of_directed_le
statement:
theorem isPiSystem_iUnion_of_directed_le {α ι} (p : ι → Set (Set α))
    (hp_pi : ∀ n, IsPiSystem (p n)) (hp_directed : Directed (· ≤ ·) p) :
    IsPiSystem (⋃ n, p n)
proof:
:= by
  intro t1 ht1 t2 ht2 h
  rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at ht1 ht2 ⊢
  obtain ⟨n, ht1⟩ := ht1
  obtain ⟨m, ht2⟩ := ht2
  obtain ⟨k, hpnk, hpmk⟩ : ∃ k, p n ≤ p k ∧ p m ≤ p k := hp_directed n m
  exact ⟨k, hp_pi k t1 (hpnk ht1) t2 (hpmk ht2) h⟩

name: isPiSystem_iUnion_of_monotone
statement:
theorem isPiSystem_iUnion_of_monotone {α ι} [SemilatticeSup ι] (p : ι → Set (Set α))
    (hp_pi : ∀ n, IsPiSystem (p n)) (hp_mono : Monotone p) : IsPiSystem (⋃ n, p n)
proof:
:=
  isPiSystem_iUnion_of_directed_le p hp_pi (Monotone.directed_le hp_mono)

name: IsPiSystem.prod
statement:
lemma IsPiSystem.prod {C : Set (Set α)} {D : Set (Set β)} (hC : IsPiSystem C) (hD : IsPiSystem D) :
    IsPiSystem (image2 (· ×ˢ ·) C D)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨s₁, hs₁, t₁, ht₁, rfl⟩ _ ⟨s₂, hs₂, t₂, ht₂, rfl⟩ hst
  rw [prod_inter_prod] at hst ⊢; rw [prod_nonempty_iff] at hst
  exact mem_image2_of_mem (hC _ hs₁ _ hs₂ hst.1) (hD _ ht₁ _ ht₂ hst.2)

name: IsPiSystem.biInter_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction t_ne using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton a => simpa using ht
  | cons a t hat t_ne ih =>
    simp only [Finset.cons_eq_insert, Finset.mem_insert, iInter_iInter_eq_or_left] at h' ht ⊢
    refine h_pi _ (ht a (Or.inl rfl)) _ ?_ h'
    refine ih (fun s hs ↦ ?_) h'.right
    exact ht s (Or.inr hs)

name: isPiSystem_generatePiSystem
statement: theorem isPiSystem_generatePiSystem (S : Set (Set α)) : IsPiSystem (generatePiSystem S)
proof:
:=
  fun _ h_s _ h_t h_nonempty => .inter h_s h_t h_nonempty

name: subset_generatePiSystem_self
statement: theorem subset_generatePiSystem_self (S : Set (Set α)) : S ⊆ generatePiSystem S
proof:
:= fun _ =>
  .base

name: generatePiSystem_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma generatePiSystem_induction {S : Set (Set α)}
    {motive : ∀ s, s ∈ generatePiSystem S → Prop}
    (base : ∀ (s) (hs : s ∈ S), motive s (subset_generatePiSystem_self S hs))
    (inter : ∀ u v hu hv (huv : (u ∩ v).Nonempty), motive u hu → motive v hv →
      motive (u ∩ v) (isPiSystem_generatePiSystem S u hu v hv huv))
    {s : Set α} (hs : s ∈ generatePiSystem S) : motive s hs
proof:
:= by
  induction hs with
  | base hs => exact base _ hs
  | inter _ _ huv ih₁ ih₂ => exact inter _ _ _ _ huv ih₁ ih₂

name: generatePiSystem_min
statement:
lemma generatePiSystem_min {S T : Set (Set α)} (hST : S ⊆ T) (hT : IsPiSystem T) :
    generatePiSystem S ⊆ T
proof:
:= fun s hs => by
  induction hs using generatePiSystem_induction with
  | base _ hs => exact hST hs
  | inter _ _ _ _ huv ihu ihv => exact hT _ ihu _ ihv huv

name: generatePiSystem_subset_self
statement:
theorem generatePiSystem_subset_self {S : Set (Set α)} (h_S : IsPiSystem S) :
    generatePiSystem S ⊆ S
proof: := generatePiSystem_min subset_rfl h_S

name: generatePiSystem_eq
statement: theorem generatePiSystem_eq {S : Set (Set α)} (h_pi : IsPiSystem S) : generatePiSystem S = S
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (generatePiSystem_subset_self h_pi) (subset_generatePiSystem_self S)

name: generatePiSystem_mono
statement:
theorem generatePiSystem_mono {S T : Set (Set α)} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    generatePiSystem S ⊆ generatePiSystem T
proof:
:=
  generatePiSystem_min (hST.trans (subset_generatePiSystem_self T))
    (isPiSystem_generatePiSystem T)

name: generatePiSystem_measurableSet
proof:
:= by
  induction h_in_pi using generatePiSystem_induction with
  | base _ h_s => exact h_meas_S _ h_s
  | inter _ _ _ _ _ h_s h_u => exact h_s.inter h_u

name: generateFrom_measurableSet_of_generatePiSystem
statement:
theorem generateFrom_measurableSet_of_generatePiSystem {g : Set (Set α)} (t : Set α)
    (ht : t ∈ generatePiSystem g) : MeasurableSet[generateFrom g] t

name: generateFrom_generatePiSystem_eq
statement:
theorem generateFrom_generatePiSystem_eq {g : Set (Set α)} :
    generateFrom (generatePiSystem g) = generateFrom g
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm <;> apply generateFrom_le
  · exact fun t h_t => generateFrom_measurableSet_of_generatePiSystem t h_t
  · exact fun t h_t => measurableSet_generateFrom (subset_generatePiSystem_self _ h_t)

name: mem_generatePiSystem_iUnion_elim
statement:
theorem mem_generatePiSystem_iUnion_elim {α β} {g : β → Set (Set α)} (h_pi : ∀ b, IsPiSystem (g b))
    (t : Set α) (h_t : t ∈ generatePiSystem (⋃ b, g b)) :
    ∃ (T : Finset β) (f : β → Set α), (t = ⋂ b ∈ T, f b) ∧ ∀ b ∈ T, f b ∈ g b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction h_t using generatePiSystem_induction with
  | base s h_s =>
    rcases h_s with ⟨t', ⟨⟨b, rfl⟩, h_s_in_t'⟩⟩
    refine ⟨{b}, fun _ => s, ?_⟩
    simpa using h_s_in_t'
  | inter _ _ h_gen_s h_gen_t' h_nonempty h_s h_t' =>
    rcases h_t' with ⟨T_t', ⟨f_t', ⟨rfl, h_t'⟩⟩⟩
    rcases h_s with ⟨T_s, ⟨f_s, ⟨rfl, h_s⟩⟩⟩
    use T_s ∪ T_t', fun b : β =>
      if b ∈ T_s then if b ∈ T_t' then f_s b ∩ f_t' b else f_s b
      else if b ∈ T_t' then f_t' b else (∅ : Set α)
    constructor
    · ext a
      simp_rw [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Finset.mem_union]
      grind
    intro b h_b
    split_ifs with hbs hbt hbt
    · refine h_pi b (f_s b) (h_s b hbs) (f_t' b) (h_t' b hbt) (Set.Nonempty.mono ?_ h_nonempty)
      exact Set.inter_subset_inter (Set.biInter_subset_of_mem hbs) (Set.biInter_subset_of_mem hbt)
    · exact h_s b hbs
    · exact h_t' b hbt
    · rw [Finset.mem_union] at h_b
      apply False.elim (h_b.elim hbs hbt)

name: mem_generatePiSystem_iUnion_elim'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : t ∈ generatePiSystem (⋃ b : s, (g ∘ Subtype.val) b) := by
    suffices h1 : ⋃ b : s, (g ∘ Subtype.val) b = ⋃ b ∈ s, g b by rwa [h1]
    ext x
    simp only [exists_prop, Set.mem_iUnion, Function.comp_apply, Subtype.exists]
  rcases @mem_generatePiSystem_iUnion_elim α s (g ∘ Subtype.val)
      (fun b => h_pi b.val b.property) t this with
    ⟨T, ⟨f, ⟨rfl, h_t'⟩⟩⟩
  refine
    ⟨T.image (fun x : s => (x : β)),
      Function.extend (fun x : s => (x : β)) f fun _ : β => (∅ : Set α), by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext a
    constructor <;>
      · simp -proj only
          [Set.mem_iInter, Subtype.forall, Finset.set_biInter_finset_image]
        intro h1 b h_b h_b_in_T
        have h2 := h1 b h_b h_b_in_T
        revert h2
        rw [Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply]
        apply id
  · intro b h_b
    simp_rw [Finset.mem_image, Subtype.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right]
      at h_b
    obtain ⟨h_b_w, h_b_h⟩ := h_b
    have h_b_alt : b = (Subtype.mk b h_b_w).val := rfl
    rw [h_b_alt, Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply]
    apply h_t'
    apply h_b_h

name: piiUnionInter_singleton
statement:
theorem piiUnionInter_singleton (π : ι → Set (Set α)) (i : ι) :
    piiUnionInter π {i} = π i ∪ {univ}
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s
  simp only [piiUnionInter, exists_prop, mem_union]
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, hti, f, hfπ, rfl⟩
    simp only [subset_singleton_iff, Finset.mem_coe] at hti
    by_cases hi : i ∈ t
    · have ht_eq_i : t = {i} := by
        ext1 x
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
        exact ⟨fun h => hti x h, fun h => h.symm ▸ hi⟩
      simp only [ht_eq_i, Finset.mem_singleton, iInter_iInter_eq_left]
      exact Or.inl (hfπ i hi)
    · have ht_empty : t = ∅ := by
        ext1 x
        simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false]
        exact fun hx => hi (hti x hx ▸ hx)
      simp [ht_empty, iInter_univ, Set.mem_singleton univ]
  · rcases h with hs | hs
    · refine ⟨{i}, ?_, fun _ => s, ⟨fun x hx => ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [Finset.coe_singleton]
      · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
        rwa [hx]
      · simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, iInter_iInter_eq_left]
    · refine ⟨∅, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Finset.coe_empty, subset_singleton_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, IsEmpty.forall_iff,
        imp_true_iff, Finset.notMem_empty, iInter_false, iInter_univ, true_and,
        exists_const] using! hs

name: piiUnionInter_singleton_left
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s'
  simp_rw [piiUnionInter, Set.mem_singleton_iff, exists_prop, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨t, htS, h_eq⟩ => ⟨t, htS, s, fun _ _ => rfl, h_eq⟩⟩
  grind

name: generateFrom_piiUnionInter_singleton_left
statement:
theorem generateFrom_piiUnionInter_singleton_left (s : ι → Set α) (S : Set ι) :
    generateFrom (piiUnionInter (fun k => {s k}) S) = generateFrom { t | ∃ k ∈ S, s k = t }
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (generateFrom_le ?_) (generateFrom_mono ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨I, hI, f, hf, rfl⟩
    refine Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun m hm => measurableSet_generateFrom ?_
    exact ⟨m, hI hm, (hf m hm).symm⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨{k}, fun m hm => ?_, s, fun i _ => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
      rwa [hm]
    · exact Set.mem_singleton _
    · simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, Set.iInter_iInter_eq_left]

name: isPiSystem_piiUnionInter
statement:
theorem isPiSystem_piiUnionInter (π : ι → Set (Set α)) (hpi : ∀ x, IsPiSystem (π x)) (S : Set ι) :
    IsPiSystem (piiUnionInter π S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro t1 ⟨p1, hp1S, f1, hf1m, ht1_eq⟩ t2 ⟨p2, hp2S, f2, hf2m, ht2_eq⟩ h_nonempty
  simp_rw [piiUnionInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  let g n := ite (n ∈ p1) (f1 n) Set.univ ∩ ite (n ∈ p2) (f2 n) Set.univ
  have hp_union_ss : ↑(p1 ∪ p2) ⊆ S := by
    simp only [hp1S, hp2S, Finset.coe_union, union_subset_iff, and_self_iff]
  use p1 ∪ p2, hp_union_ss, g
  have h_inter_eq : t1 ∩ t2 = ⋂ i ∈ p1 ∪ p2, g i := by
    rw [ht1_eq, ht2_eq]
    simp_rw [← Set.inf_eq_inter]
    ext1 x
    simp only [inf_eq_inter, mem_inter_iff, mem_iInter]
    grind
  refine ⟨fun n hn => ?_, h_inter_eq⟩
  simp only [g]
  split_ifs with hn1 hn2 h
  · refine hpi n (f1 n) (hf1m n hn1) (f2 n) (hf2m n hn2) (Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun h => ?_)
    rw [h_inter_eq] at h_nonempty
    suffices h_empty : ⋂ i ∈ p1 ∪ p2, g i = ∅ from
      (Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mpr h_empty) h_nonempty
    refine le_antisymm (Set.iInter_subset_of_subset n ?_) (Set.empty_subset _)
    refine Set.iInter_subset_of_subset hn ?_
    grind
  · simp [hf1m n hn1]
  · simp [hf2m n h]
  · exact absurd hn (by simp [hn1, h])

name: piiUnionInter_mono_left
statement:
theorem piiUnionInter_mono_left {π π' : ι → Set (Set α)} (h_le : ∀ i, π i ⊆ π' i) (S : Set ι) :
    piiUnionInter π S ⊆ piiUnionInter π' S
proof:
:= fun _ ⟨t, ht_mem, ft, hft_mem_pi, h_eq⟩ =>
  ⟨t, ht_mem, ft, fun x hxt => h_le x (hft_mem_pi x hxt), h_eq⟩

name: piiUnionInter_mono_right
statement:
theorem piiUnionInter_mono_right {π : ι → Set (Set α)} {S T : Set ι} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    piiUnionInter π S ⊆ piiUnionInter π T
proof:
:= fun _ ⟨t, ht_mem, ft, hft_mem_pi, h_eq⟩ =>
  ⟨t, ht_mem.trans hST, ft, hft_mem_pi, h_eq⟩

name: generateFrom_piiUnionInter_le
statement:
theorem generateFrom_piiUnionInter_le {m : MeasurableSpace α} (π : ι → Set (Set α))
    (h : ∀ n, generateFrom (π n) ≤ m) (S : Set ι) : generateFrom (piiUnionInter π S) ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  refine generateFrom_le ?_
  rintro t ⟨ht_p, _, ft, hft_mem_pi, rfl⟩
  refine Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun x hx_mem => (h x) _ ?_
  exact measurableSet_generateFrom (hft_mem_pi x hx_mem)

name: subset_piiUnionInter
statement:
theorem subset_piiUnionInter {π : ι → Set (Set α)} {S : Set ι} {i : ι} (his : i ∈ S) :
    π i ⊆ piiUnionInter π S
proof:
:= by
  have h_ss : {i} ⊆ S := by
    intro j hj
    rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hj
    rwa [hj]
  refine Subset.trans ?_ (piiUnionInter_mono_right h_ss)
  rw [piiUnionInter_singleton]
  exact subset_union_left

name: mem_piiUnionInter_of_measurableSet
proof:
:=
  subset_piiUnionInter hiS hs

name: le_generateFrom_piiUnionInter
statement:
theorem le_generateFrom_piiUnionInter {π : ι → Set (Set α)} (S : Set ι) {x : ι} (hxS : x ∈ S) :
    generateFrom (π x) ≤ generateFrom (piiUnionInter π S)
proof:
:=
  generateFrom_mono (subset_piiUnionInter hxS)

name: measurableSet_iSup_of_mem_piiUnionInter
statement:
theorem measurableSet_iSup_of_mem_piiUnionInter (m : ι → MeasurableSpace α) (S : Set ι) (t : Set α)
    (ht : t ∈ piiUnionInter (fun n => { s | MeasurableSet[m n] s }) S) :
    MeasurableSet[⨆ i ∈ S, m i] t
proof:
:= by
  rcases ht with ⟨pt, hpt, ft, ht_m, rfl⟩
  refine pt.measurableSet_biInter fun i hi => ?_
  suffices h_le : m i ≤ ⨆ i ∈ S, m i from h_le (ft i) (ht_m i hi)
  have hi' : i ∈ S := hpt hi
  exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun i (_ : i ∈ S) => m i) i hi'

name: generateFrom_piiUnionInter_measurableSet
statement:
theorem generateFrom_piiUnionInter_measurableSet (m : ι → MeasurableSpace α) (S : Set ι) :
    generateFrom (piiUnionInter (fun n => { s | MeasurableSet[m n] s }) S) = ⨆ i ∈ S, m i
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [← @generateFrom_measurableSet α (⨆ i ∈ S, m i)]
    exact generateFrom_mono (measurableSet_iSup_of_mem_piiUnionInter m S)
  · refine iSup₂_le fun i hi => ?_
    rw [← @generateFrom_measurableSet α (m i)]
    exact generateFrom_mono (mem_piiUnionInter_of_measurableSet m hi)

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext : ∀ {d₁ d₂ : DynkinSystem α}, (∀ s : Set α, d₁.Has s ↔ d₂.Has s) → d₁ = d₂
  | ⟨s₁, _, _, _⟩, ⟨s₂, _, _, _⟩, h => by
    have : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= funext fun x => propext <| h x
    subst this
    rfl

name: has_compl_iff
statement: theorem has_compl_iff {a} : d.Has aᶜ ↔ d.Has a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using d.has_compl h, fun h => d.has_compl h⟩

name: has_univ
statement: theorem has_univ : d.Has univ
proof: := by simpa using d.has_compl d.has_empty

name: has_iUnion
statement:
theorem has_iUnion {β} [Countable β] {f : β → Set α} (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on f))
    (h : ∀ i, d.Has (f i)) : d.Has (⋃ i, f i)
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_encodable β
  rw [← Encodable.iUnion_decode₂]
  exact
    d.has_iUnion_nat (Encodable.iUnion_decode₂_disjoint_on hd) fun n =>
      Encodable.iUnion_decode₂_cases d.has_empty h

name: has_union
statement:
theorem has_union {s₁ s₂ : Set α} (h₁ : d.Has s₁) (h₂ : d.Has s₂) (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) :
    d.Has (s₁ ∪ s₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [union_eq_iUnion]
  exact d.has_iUnion (pairwise_disjoint_on_bool.2 h) (Bool.forall_bool.2 ⟨h₂, h₁⟩)

name: has_sdiff
statement:
theorem has_sdiff {s₁ s₂ : Set α} (h₁ : d.Has s₁) (h₂ : d.Has s₂) (h : s₂ ⊆ s₁) :
    d.Has (s₁ \ s₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply d.has_compl_iff.1
  simp only [sdiff_eq, compl_inter, compl_compl]
  exact d.has_union (d.has_compl h₁) h₂ (disjoint_compl_left.mono_right h)

name: le_def
statement: theorem le_def {a b : DynkinSystem α} : a ≤ b ↔ a.Has ≤ b.Has
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ofMeasurableSpace_le_ofMeasurableSpace_iff
statement:
theorem ofMeasurableSpace_le_ofMeasurableSpace_iff {m₁ m₂ : MeasurableSpace α} :
    ofMeasurableSpace m₁ ≤ ofMeasurableSpace m₂ ↔ m₁ ≤ m₂
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: generateHas_compl
statement: theorem generateHas_compl {C : Set (Set α)} {s : Set α} : GenerateHas C sᶜ ↔ GenerateHas C s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, GenerateHas.compl⟩
  intro h
  convert! GenerateHas.compl h
  simp

name: generateHas_def
statement: theorem generateHas_def {C : Set (Set α)} : (generate C).Has = GenerateHas C
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ofMeasurableSpace_toMeasurableSpace
statement:
theorem ofMeasurableSpace_toMeasurableSpace
    (h_inter : ∀ s₁ s₂, d.Has s₁ → d.Has s₂ → d.Has (s₁ ∩ s₂)) :
    ofMeasurableSpace (d.toMeasurableSpace h_inter) = d
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ => Iff.rfl

name: generate_le
statement: theorem generate_le {s : Set (Set α)} (h : ∀ t ∈ s, d.Has t) : generate s ≤ d
proof:
:= fun _ ht =>
  ht.recOn h d.has_empty (fun {_} _ h => d.has_compl h) fun {_} hd _ hf => d.has_iUnion hd hf

name: generate_has_subset_generate_measurable
statement:
theorem generate_has_subset_generate_measurable {C : Set (Set α)} {s : Set α}
    (hs : (generate C).Has s) : MeasurableSet[generateFrom C] s
proof:
:=
  generate_le (ofMeasurableSpace (generateFrom C)) (fun _ => measurableSet_generateFrom) s hs

name: generate_inter
statement:
theorem generate_inter {s : Set (Set α)} (hs : IsPiSystem s) {t₁ t₂ : Set α}
    (ht₁ : (generate s).Has t₁) (ht₂ : (generate s).Has t₂) : (generate s).Has (t₁ ∩ t₂)
proof:
:=
  have : generate s ≤ (generate s).restrictOn ht₂ :=
    generate_le _ fun s₁ hs₁ =>
      have : (generate s).Has s₁ := GenerateHas.basic s₁ hs₁
      have : generate s ≤ (generate s).restrictOn this :=
        generate_le _ fun s₂ hs₂ =>
          show (generate s).Has (s₂ ∩ s₁) from
            (s₂ ∩ s₁).eq_empty_or_nonempty.elim (fun h => h.symm ▸ GenerateHas.empty) fun h =>
              GenerateHas.basic _ <| hs _ hs₂ _ hs₁ h
      have : (generate s).Has (t₂ ∩ s₁) := this _ ht₂
      show (generate s).Has (s₁ ∩ t₂) by rwa [inter_comm]
  this _ ht₁

name: generateFrom_eq
statement:
theorem generateFrom_eq {s : Set (Set α)} (hs : IsPiSystem s) :
    generateFrom s = (generate s).toMeasurableSpace fun _ _ => generate_inter hs
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (generateFrom_le fun t ht => GenerateHas.basic t ht)
    (ofMeasurableSpace_le_ofMeasurableSpace_iff.mp <| by
      rw [ofMeasurableSpace_toMeasurableSpace]
      exact generate_le _ fun t ht => measurableSet_generateFrom ht)

name: induction_on_inter
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on_inter {m : MeasurableSpace α} {C : ∀ s : Set α, MeasurableSet s → Prop}
    {s : Set (Set α)} (h_eq : m = generateFrom s) (h_inter : IsPiSystem s)
    (empty : C ∅ .empty) (basic : ∀ t (ht : t ∈ s), C t <| h_eq ▸ .basic t ht)
    (compl : ∀ t (htm : MeasurableSet t), C t htm → C tᶜ htm.compl)
    (iUnion : ∀ (f : ℕ → Set α), Pairwise (Disjoint on f) → ∀ (hfm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (f i)),
      (∀ i, C (f i) (hfm i)) → C (⋃ i, f i) (.iUnion hfm)) :
    ∀ t (ht : MeasurableSet t), C t ht
proof:
:= by
  have eq : MeasurableSet = DynkinSystem.GenerateHas s := by
    rw [h_eq, DynkinSystem.generateFrom_eq h_inter]
    rfl
  suffices ∀ t (ht : DynkinSystem.GenerateHas s t), C t (eq ▸ ht) from
    fun t ht ↦ this t (eq ▸ ht)
  intro t ht
  induction ht with
  | basic u hu => exact basic u hu
  | empty => exact empty
  | @compl u hu ihu => exact compl _ (eq ▸ hu) ihu
  | @iUnion f hfd hf ihf => exact iUnion f hfd (eq ▸ hf) ihf

name: inter_mem
statement: lemma inter_mem (hC : IsSetRing C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) : s ∩ t ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sdiff_sdiff_right_self]; exact hC.sdiff_mem hs (hC.sdiff_mem hs ht)

name: isSetSemiring
statement:
lemma isSetSemiring (hC : IsSetRing C) : IsSetSemiring C where
  empty_mem
proof:
:= hC.empty_mem
  inter_mem := fun _ hs _ ht => hC.inter_mem hs ht
  sdiff_eq_sUnion' := by
    refine fun s hs t ht => ⟨{s \ t}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [coe_singleton, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hC.sdiff_mem hs ht
    · simp only [coe_singleton, pairwiseDisjoint_singleton]
    · simp only [coe_singleton, sUnion_singleton]

name: biUnion_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [hC.empty_mem]
  | insert i S _ h =>
    simp_rw [← Finset.mem_coe, Finset.coe_insert, Set.biUnion_insert]
    refine hC.union_mem (hs i (mem_insert_self i S)) ?_
    exact h (fun n hnS ↦ hs n (mem_insert_of_mem hnS))

name: biInter_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hS using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton => simpa using hs
  | cons i S hiS _ h =>
    simp_rw [← Finset.mem_coe, Finset.coe_cons, Set.biInter_insert]
    simp only [cons_eq_insert, Finset.mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp] at hs
    refine hC.inter_mem hs.1 ?_
    exact h (fun n hnS ↦ hs.2 n hnS)

name: finsetSup_mem
proof:
:= by
  simpa using biUnion_mem hC _ hs

name: partialSups_mem
statement:
lemma partialSups_mem {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot ι]
    (hC : IsSetRing C) {s : ι → Set α} (hs : ∀ n, s n ∈ C) (n : ι) :
    partialSups s n ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [partialSups_apply, sup'_eq_sup] using hC.finsetSup_mem (fun i hi ↦ hs i)

name: disjointed_mem
statement:
lemma disjointed_mem {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot ι]
    (hC : IsSetRing C) {s : ι → Set α} (hs : ∀ j, s j ∈ C) (i : ι) :
    disjointed s i ∈ C
proof:
:=
  disjointedRec (fun _ j ht ↦ hC.sdiff_mem ht <| hs j) (hs i)

name: iUnion_le_mem
statement:
theorem iUnion_le_mem (hC : IsSetRing C) {s : ℕ → Set α} (hs : ∀ n, s n ∈ C) (n : ℕ) :
    (⋃ i ≤ n, s i) ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hs 0]
  | succ n hn => rw [biUnion_le_succ]; exact hC.union_mem hn (hs _)

name: iInter_le_mem
statement:
theorem iInter_le_mem (hC : IsSetRing C) {s : ℕ → Set α} (hs : ∀ n, s n ∈ C) (n : ℕ) :
    (⋂ i ≤ n, s i) ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hs 0]
  | succ n hn => rw [biInter_le_succ]; exact hC.inter_mem hn (hs _)

name: accumulate_mem
statement:
theorem accumulate_mem (hC : IsSetRing C) {s : ℕ → Set α} (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ C) (n : ℕ) :
    accumulate s n ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hs 0]
  | succ n hn => rw [accumulate_succ]; exact hC.union_mem hn (hs _)

name: isPiSystem
statement: lemma isPiSystem (hC : IsSetSemiring C) : IsPiSystem C
proof: := fun s hs t ht _ ↦ hC.inter_mem s hs t ht

name: exists_finpartition_sdiff
statement:
theorem exists_finpartition_sdiff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) :
    ∃ P : Finpartition (s \ t), ↑P.parts ⊆ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hIC, hI, hst⟩ := hC.sdiff_eq_sUnion' s hs t ht
  refine ⟨.ofErase I (supIndep_iff_pairwiseDisjoint.mpr hI) ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [sup_id_eq_sSup, sSup_eq_sUnion, hst]
  · grw [Finpartition.ofErase_parts, Finset.erase_subset, hIC]

name: mem_supClosure_iff
statement:
theorem mem_supClosure_iff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) :
    s ∈ supClosure C ↔ ∃ P : Finpartition s, ↑P.parts ⊆ C where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    rintro ⟨S, hS, hSC, rfl⟩
    rw [sup'_eq_sup]
    clear hS
    induction S using Finset.induction with
    | empty =>
      rw [sup_empty]
      exact ⟨.empty _, hSC⟩
    | insert s S _ ih =>
      rw [coe_insert, insert_subset_iff] at hSC
      obtain ⟨hsC, hSC⟩ := hSC
      obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := ih hSC
      rw [sup_insert, sup_comm, id]
      rcases eq_or_ne s ⊥ with rfl | hs
      · rw [sup_bot_eq]; exact ⟨P, hP⟩
      choose Q hQ using show ∀ t ∈ (P.avoid s).parts, ∃ Q : Finpartition t, ↑Q.parts ⊆ C by
        simp_rw [Finpartition.mem_avoid]
        rintro _ ⟨t, ht, -, rfl⟩
        exact hC.exists_finpartition_sdiff (hP ht) hsC
      exists P.avoid s |>.bind Q |>.extend hs disjoint_sdiff_left (sdiff_sup_self _ _)
      rw [Finpartition.extend_parts, coe_insert, insert_subset_iff, Finpartition.bind_parts,
        coe_biUnion, iUnion₂_subset_iff, Subtype.forall]
      exact ⟨hsC, fun t ht _ => hQ t ht⟩
  mpr := by
    intro ⟨P, hP⟩
    rw [← P.sup_parts, sup_id_set_eq_sUnion]
    exact supClosed_supClosure.sSup_mem
      (Finset.finite_toSet _)
      (subset_supClosure hC.empty_mem)
      (hP.trans subset_supClosure)

name: sdiff_mem_supClosure
statement:
theorem sdiff_mem_supClosure (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) :
    s \ t ∈ supClosure C
proof:
:=
  hC.mem_supClosure_iff.mpr <| hC.exists_finpartition_sdiff hs ht

name: isSetRing_supClosure
statement:
theorem isSetRing_supClosure (hC : IsSetSemiring C) : IsSetRing (supClosure C) where
  empty_mem
proof:
:= subset_supClosure hC.empty_mem
  union_mem _ _ h₁ h₂ := supClosed_supClosure h₁ h₂
  sdiff_mem := by
    rintro s _ hs ⟨T, hT, hTC, rfl⟩
    rw [sup'_eq_sup]
    clear hT
    induction T using Finset.induction generalizing s with
    | empty => simpa
    | insert t T _ ih =>
      simp_rw [sup_insert, id, sup_eq_union, ← sdiff_sdiff]
      rw [coe_insert, insert_subset_iff] at hTC
      obtain ⟨htC, hTC⟩ := hTC
      refine ih ?_ hTC
      obtain ⟨S, hS, hSC, rfl⟩ := hs
      rw [sup'_eq_sup, ← Finset.sup_sdiff_right]
      refine supClosed_supClosure.finsetSup_mem hS fun s hs => ?_
      exact hC.sdiff_mem_supClosure (hSC hs) htC

name: empty_notMem_disjointOfDiff
statement:
lemma empty_notMem_disjointOfDiff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) :
    ∅ ∉ hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht
proof:
:=
  Finpartition.bot_notMem _

name: subset_disjointOfDiff
statement:
lemma subset_disjointOfDiff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) :
    ↑(hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht) ⊆ C
proof:
:=
  (hC.exists_finpartition_sdiff hs ht).choose_spec

name: pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfDiff
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfDiff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) :
    PairwiseDisjoint (hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht : Set (Set α)) id
proof:
:=
  Finpartition.supIndep _ |>.pairwiseDisjoint

name: sUnion_disjointOfDiff
statement:
lemma sUnion_disjointOfDiff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) :
    ⋃₀ hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht = s \ t
proof:
:=
  (sup_id_eq_sSup _).symm.trans (Finpartition.sup_parts _)

name: notMem_disjointOfDiff
statement:
lemma notMem_disjointOfDiff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) :
    t ∉ hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht
proof:
:= by
  intro hs_mem
  cases disjoint_sdiff_self_right.eq_bot_of_le (Finpartition.le _ hs_mem)
  exact hC.empty_notMem_disjointOfDiff hs ht hs_mem

name: sUnion_insert_disjointOfDiff
statement:
lemma sUnion_insert_disjointOfDiff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C)
    (ht : t ∈ C) (hst : t ⊆ s) :
    ⋃₀ insert t (hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht) = s
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← union_sdiff_cancel hst, ← hC.sUnion_disjointOfDiff hs ht]
  simp only [sUnion_insert]

name: disjoint_sUnion_disjointOfDiff
statement:
lemma disjoint_sUnion_disjointOfDiff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) :
    Disjoint t (⋃₀ hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hC.sUnion_disjointOfDiff]
  exact disjoint_sdiff_right

name: pairwiseDisjoint_insert_disjointOfDiff
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_insert_disjointOfDiff (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C)
    (ht : t ∈ C) :
    PairwiseDisjoint (insert t (hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht) : Set (Set α)) id
proof:
:= by
  have h := hC.pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfDiff hs ht
  refine PairwiseDisjoint.insert_of_notMem h (hC.notMem_disjointOfDiff hs ht) fun u hu ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [id]
  refine Disjoint.mono_right ?_ (hC.disjoint_sUnion_disjointOfDiff hs ht)
  exact subset_sUnion_of_mem hu

name: exists_finpartition_sdiff_sUnion
statement:
private theorem exists_finpartition_sdiff_sUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) :
    ∃ P : Finpartition (s \ ⋃₀ I), ↑P.parts ⊆ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hC.mem_supClosure_iff, ← sSup_eq_sUnion, ← sup_id_eq_sSup]
  have hC' := hC.isSetRing_supClosure
  exact hC'.sdiff_mem (subset_supClosure hs) <| hC'.finsetSup_mem <| hI.trans subset_supClosure

name: empty_notMem_disjointOfDiffUnion
statement:
lemma empty_notMem_disjointOfDiffUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C)
    (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) :
    ∅ ∉ hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI
proof:
:=
  Finpartition.bot_notMem _

name: disjointOfDiffUnion_subset
statement:
lemma disjointOfDiffUnion_subset (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) :
    ↑(hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI) ⊆ C
proof:
:=
  (hC.exists_finpartition_sdiff_sUnion hs hI).choose_spec

name: pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfDiffUnion
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfDiffUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C)
    (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) : PairwiseDisjoint (hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI : Set (Set α)) id
proof:
:=
  (Finpartition.supIndep _).pairwiseDisjoint

name: sdiff_sUnion_eq_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion
statement:
lemma sdiff_sUnion_eq_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C)
    (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) : s \ ⋃₀ I = ⋃₀ hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI
proof:
:=
  (Finpartition.sup_parts _).symm.trans (sup_id_eq_sSup _)

name: exists_disjoint_finset_sdiff_eq
statement:
lemma exists_disjoint_finset_sdiff_eq (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) :
    ∃ J : Finset (Set α), ↑J ⊆ C ∧ PairwiseDisjoint (J : Set (Set α)) id ∧
      s \ ⋃₀ I = ⋃₀ J
proof:
:=
  ⟨hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI,
   hC.disjointOfDiffUnion_subset hs hI,
   hC.pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI,
   hC.sdiff_sUnion_eq_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI⟩

name: sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion_subset
statement:
lemma sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion_subset (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C)
    (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) : ⋃₀ (hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI : Set (Set α)) ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hC.sdiff_sUnion_eq_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion]
  exact sdiff_subset

name: subset_of_diffUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion
statement:
lemma subset_of_diffUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (hI : ↑I ⊆ C)
    (t : Set α) (ht : t ∈ (hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI : Set (Set α))) :
    t ⊆ s \ ⋃₀ I
proof:
:= by
  revert t ht
  rw [← sUnion_subset_iff, hC.sdiff_sUnion_eq_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI]

name: subset_of_mem_disjointOfDiffUnion
statement:
lemma subset_of_mem_disjointOfDiffUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) {I : Finset (Set α)}
    (hs : s ∈ C) (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) (t : Set α)
    (ht : t ∈ (hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI : Set (Set α))) :
    t ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans <| hC.subset_of_diffUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI t ht
  exact sdiff_le (a := s) (b := ⋃₀ I)

name: disjoint_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion
statement:
lemma disjoint_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C)
    (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) :
    Disjoint (⋃₀ (I : Set (Set α))) (⋃₀ hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hC.sdiff_sUnion_eq_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion]; exact Set.disjoint_sdiff_right

name: disjoint_disjointOfDiffUnion
statement:
lemma disjoint_disjointOfDiffUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) :
    Disjoint I (hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  rw [Finset.not_disjoint_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨u, huI, hu_disjointOfDiffUnion⟩ := h
  have h_disj : u ≤ ⊥ :=
    hC.disjoint_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI (subset_sUnion_of_mem huI)
    (subset_sUnion_of_mem hu_disjointOfDiffUnion)
  simp only [Set.bot_eq_empty, subset_empty_iff] at h_disj
  refine hC.empty_notMem_disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI ?_
  rwa [h_disj] at hu_disjointOfDiffUnion

name: pairwiseDisjoint_union_disjointOfDiffUnion
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_union_disjointOfDiffUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C)
    (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) (h_dis : PairwiseDisjoint (I : Set (Set α)) id) :
    PairwiseDisjoint (I ∪ hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI : Set (Set α)) id
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairwiseDisjoint_union]
  refine ⟨h_dis, hC.pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI, fun u hu v hv _ ↦ ?_⟩
  simp_rw [id]
  exact disjoint_of_subset (subset_sUnion_of_mem hu) (subset_sUnion_of_mem hv)
    (hC.disjoint_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI)

name: sUnion_union_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion_of_subset
statement:
lemma sUnion_union_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion_of_subset (hC : IsSetSemiring C)
    (hs : s ∈ C) (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) (hI_ss : ∀ t ∈ I, t ⊆ s) :
    ⋃₀ I ∪ ⋃₀ hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI = s
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← union_sdiff_cancel (Set.sUnion_subset hI_ss : ⋃₀ ↑I ⊆ s),
    hC.sdiff_sUnion_eq_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI]

name: sUnion_union_disjointOfDiffUnion_of_subset
statement:
lemma sUnion_union_disjointOfDiffUnion_of_subset (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C)
    (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) (hI_ss : ∀ t ∈ I, t ⊆ s) :
    ⋃₀ ↑(I ∪ hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI) = s
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← sUnion_union_sUnion_disjointOfDiffUnion_of_subset hC hs hI hI_ss]
  simp_rw [coe_union]
  rw [sUnion_union]

name: exists_partition_disjointed
proof:
:=
  hC.mem_supClosure_iff.mp <|
    hC.isSetRing_supClosure.disjointed_mem (fun _ ↦ subset_supClosure (hJ (Subtype.coe_prop _))) _

name: disjointOfUnion_coe
statement:
private theorem disjointOfUnion_coe (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hJ : ↑J ⊆ C) (j : J) :
    hC.disjointOfUnion hJ j = (hC.exists_partition_disjointed hJ j).choose.parts
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjointOfUnion, dite_eq_left j.2]

name: pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfUnion
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hJ : ↑J ⊆ C) :
    PairwiseDisjoint J (hC.disjointOfUnion hJ)
proof:
:= by
  refine Pairwise.set_of_subtype _ _ fun j k hjk ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [Function.onFun, hC.disjointOfUnion_coe hJ, Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
  exact fun s hs t ht ↦ Disjoint.ne (Finpartition.ne_bot _ hs) <|
    .mono (Finpartition.le _ hs) (Finpartition.le _ ht) <|
    disjoint_disjointed _ <| J.equivFin.injective.ne hjk

name: disjointOfUnion_subset
statement:
lemma disjointOfUnion_subset (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hJ : ↑J ⊆ C) (hj : j ∈ J) :
    (disjointOfUnion hC hJ j : Set (Set α)) ⊆ C
proof:
:= by
  lift j to J using hj
  rw [hC.disjointOfUnion_coe hJ]
  exact (hC.exists_partition_disjointed hJ j).choose_spec

name: pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfUnion_of_mem
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfUnion_of_mem (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hJ : ↑J ⊆ C) (hj : j ∈ J) :
    PairwiseDisjoint (hC.disjointOfUnion hJ j : Set (Set α)) id
proof:
:= by
  lift j to J using hj
  rw [disjointOfUnion_coe, ← supIndep_iff_pairwiseDisjoint]
  exact Finpartition.supIndep _

name: pairwiseDisjoint_biUnion_disjointOfUnion
statement:
lemma pairwiseDisjoint_biUnion_disjointOfUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hJ : ↑J ⊆ C) :
    PairwiseDisjoint (⋃ x ∈ J, (hC.disjointOfUnion hJ x : Set (Set α))) id
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← SetLike.mem_coe]
  refine Set.PairwiseDisjoint.biUnion
    (Pairwise.set_of_subtype _ _ ?_)
    (fun _ ↦ hC.pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfUnion_of_mem hJ)
  simp_rw [Function.onFun, disjointOfUnion_coe, SetLike.mem_coe, ← Finset.sup_eq_iSup,
    Finpartition.sup_parts]
  exact (disjoint_disjointed _).comp_of_injective J.equivFin.injective

name: disjointOfUnion_subset_of_mem
statement:
lemma disjointOfUnion_subset_of_mem (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hJ : ↑J ⊆ C) (hj : j ∈ J) :
    ⋃₀ hC.disjointOfUnion hJ j ⊆ j
proof:
:= by
  lift j to J using hj
  grw [disjointOfUnion_coe, ← Finset.sup_id_set_eq_sUnion, Finpartition.sup_parts,
    disjointed_subset, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: subset_of_mem_disjointOfUnion
statement:
lemma subset_of_mem_disjointOfUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hJ : ↑J ⊆ C) (hj : j ∈ J) {x : Set α}
    (hx : x ∈ (hC.disjointOfUnion hJ) j) : x ⊆ j
proof:
:=
  sUnion_subset_iff.mp (hC.disjointOfUnion_subset_of_mem hJ hj) x hx

name: empty_notMem_disjointOfUnion
statement:
lemma empty_notMem_disjointOfUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hJ : ↑J ⊆ C) (hj : j ∈ J) :
    ∅ ∉ hC.disjointOfUnion hJ j
proof:
:= by
  lift j to J using hj
  rw [disjointOfUnion_coe]
  exact Finpartition.bot_notMem _

name: sUnion_disjointOfUnion
statement:
lemma sUnion_disjointOfUnion (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (hJ : ↑J ⊆ C) :
    ⋃₀ ⋃ x ∈ J, (hC.disjointOfUnion hJ x : Set (Set α)) = ⋃₀ J
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sUnion_iUnion, ← iSup_eq_iUnion, iSup_subtype', disjointOfUnion_coe,
    ← Finset.sup_id_set_eq_sUnion, Finpartition.sup_parts, J.equivFin.surjective.iSup_comp,
    iSup_disjointed, J.equivFin.symm.surjective.iSup_comp, iSup_subtype, Finset.sup_eq_iSup, id]

name: disjointOfUnion_props
statement:
theorem disjointOfUnion_props (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (h1 : ↑J ⊆ C) :
    ∃ K : Set α → Finset (Set α),
      PairwiseDisjoint J K
      ∧ (∀ i ∈ J, ↑(K i) ⊆ C)
      ∧ PairwiseDisjoint (⋃ x ∈ J, (K x : Set (Set α))) id
      ∧ (∀ j ∈ J, ⋃₀ K j ⊆ j)
      ∧ (∀ j ∈ J, ∅ ∉ K j)
      ∧ ⋃₀ J = ⋃₀ (⋃ x ∈ J, (K x : Set (Set α)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨hC.disjointOfUnion h1,
   hC.pairwiseDisjoint_disjointOfUnion h1,
   fun _ ↦ hC.disjointOfUnion_subset h1,
   hC.pairwiseDisjoint_biUnion_disjointOfUnion h1,
   fun _ ↦ hC.disjointOfUnion_subset_of_mem h1,
   fun _ ↦ hC.empty_notMem_disjointOfUnion h1,
   (hC.sUnion_disjointOfUnion h1).symm⟩

name: _root_.Set.Ioc_mem_ofPred_Ioc_le
statement:
private lemma _root_.Set.Ioc_mem_ofPred_Ioc_le [LinearOrder α] (u v : α) :
    Set.Ioc u v ∈ {s : Set α | ∃ u v, u ≤ v ∧ s = Set.Ioc u v}
proof:
:=
  ⟨u, max u v, by grind, by grind⟩

name: Ioc
statement:
protected lemma Ioc [LinearOrder α] [Nonempty α] :
    IsSetSemiring {s : Set α | ∃ u v, u ≤ v ∧ s = Set.Ioc u v} where
  empty_mem
proof:
:= by
    inhabit α
    exact ⟨default, default, le_rfl, by simp⟩
  inter_mem := by
    rintro s ⟨u, v, huv, rfl⟩ t ⟨u', v', hu'v', rfl⟩
    rw [Set.Ioc_inter_Ioc]
    apply Ioc_mem_ofPred_Ioc_le
  sdiff_eq_sUnion' := by
    rintro s ⟨u, v, huv, rfl⟩ t ⟨u', v', hu'v', rfl⟩
    rcases le_or_gt u' u with hu | hu
    · rcases Ioc_mem_ofPred_Ioc_le (max u v') v with ⟨u'', v'', h'', heq⟩
      exists {Set.Ioc u'' v''}
      grind [coe_singleton, pairwiseDisjoint_singleton]
    rcases le_or_gt v v' with hv | hv
    · rcases Ioc_mem_ofPred_Ioc_le u (min u' v) with ⟨u'', v'', h'', heq⟩
      exists {Set.Ioc u'' v''}
      grind [coe_singleton, pairwiseDisjoint_singleton]
    rw [show Set.Ioc u v \ Set.Ioc u' v' = Set.Ioc u u' ∪ Set.Ioc v' v by grind]
    refine ⟨{Set.Ioc u u', Set.Ioc v' v}, by grind, ?_, by simp⟩
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp [Function.onFun]
    grind

name: aux
statement:
private lemma aux₀
    (h : ∀ δ, 0 < δ →
      ∃ y, closedBall y (δ / 4) ⊆ closedBall x δ ∧ closedBall y (δ / 4) ⊆ interior s) :
    ¬Tendsto (fun r ↦ volume (closure s ∩ closedBall x r) / volume (closedBall x r)) (𝓝[>] 0)
        (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  choose f hf₀ hf₁ using h
  intro H
  obtain ⟨ε, -, hε', hε₀⟩ := exists_seq_strictAnti_tendsto_nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ)
  refine not_eventually.2
    (Frequently.of_forall fun _ ↦ lt_irrefl <| ENNReal.ofReal <| 4⁻¹ ^ Fintype.card ι)
    ((Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt (H.comp hε₀) tendsto_const_nhds ?_).mono fun n ↦
      lt_of_le_of_lt ?_)
  on_goal 2 =>
    calc
      ENNReal.ofReal (4⁻¹ ^ Fintype.card ι)
        = volume (closedBall (f (ε n) (hε' n)) (ε n / 4)) / volume (closedBall x (ε n)) := ?_
      _ ≤ volume (closure s ∩ closedBall x (ε n)) / volume (closedBall x (ε n)) := by
        gcongr
        exact subset_inter ((hf₁ _ <| hε' n).trans interior_subset_closure) <| hf₀ _ <| hε' n
    have := hε' n
    rw [Real.volume_pi_closedBall, Real.volume_pi_closedBall, ← ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos,
      ← div_pow, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ), div_right_comm, div_self, one_div]
  all_goals positivity

name: aux
statement:
private lemma aux₁
    (h : ∀ δ, 0 < δ →
      ∃ y, closedBall y (δ / 4) ⊆ closedBall x δ ∧ closedBall y (δ / 4) ⊆ interior sᶜ) :
    ¬Tendsto (fun r ↦ volume (closure s ∩ closedBall x r) / volume (closedBall x r)) (𝓝[>] 0)
        (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  choose f hf₀ hf₁ using h
  intro H
  obtain ⟨ε, -, hε', hε₀⟩ := exists_seq_strictAnti_tendsto_nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ)
  refine not_eventually.2
      (Frequently.of_forall fun _ ↦ lt_irrefl <| 1 - ENNReal.ofReal (4⁻¹ ^ Fintype.card ι))
      ((Filter.Tendsto.eventually_lt tendsto_const_nhds (H.comp hε₀) <|
            ENNReal.sub_lt_self ENNReal.one_ne_top one_ne_zero ?_).mono
        fun n ↦ lt_of_le_of_lt' ?_)
  on_goal 2 =>
    calc
      volume (closure s ∩ closedBall x (ε n)) / volume (closedBall x (ε n))
        ≤ volume (closedBall x (ε n) \ closedBall (f (ε n) <| hε' n) (ε n / 4)) /
          volume (closedBall x (ε n)) := by
        gcongr
        rw [sdiff_eq_compl_inter]
        refine inter_subset_inter_left _ ?_
        rw [subset_compl_comm, ← interior_compl]
        exact hf₁ _ _
      _ = 1 - ENNReal.ofReal (4⁻¹ ^ Fintype.card ι) := ?_
    have := hε' n
    rw [measure_sdiff (hf₀ _ _) _ ((Real.volume_pi_closedBall _ _).trans_ne ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top),
      Real.volume_pi_closedBall, Real.volume_pi_closedBall, ENNReal.sub_div fun _ _ ↦ _,
      ENNReal.div_self _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, ← ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos, ← div_pow,
      mul_div_mul_left _ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ), div_right_comm, div_self, one_div]
  all_goals try positivity
  · simp_all
  · exact measurableSet_closedBall.nullMeasurableSet

name: IsUpperSet.null_frontier
statement: theorem IsUpperSet.null_frontier (hs : IsUpperSet s) : volume (frontier s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine measure_mono_null (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    (Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div_of_measurableSet _
      (isClosed_closure (s := s)).measurableSet)
  by_cases h : x ∈ closure s <;>
    simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_ofPred, h, not_false_eq_true, indicator_of_notMem,
      indicator_of_mem, Pi.one_apply]
  · refine aux₁ fun _ ↦ hs.compl.exists_subset_ball <| frontier_subset_closure ?_
    rwa [frontier_compl]
  · exact aux₀ fun _ ↦ hs.exists_subset_ball <| frontier_subset_closure hx

name: IsLowerSet.null_frontier
statement: theorem IsLowerSet.null_frontier (hs : IsLowerSet s) : volume (frontier s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine measure_mono_null (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    (Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div_of_measurableSet _
      (isClosed_closure (s := s)).measurableSet)
  by_cases h : x ∈ closure s <;>
    simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_ofPred, h, not_false_eq_true, indicator_of_notMem,
      indicator_of_mem, Pi.one_apply]
  · refine aux₁ fun _ ↦ hs.compl.exists_subset_ball <| frontier_subset_closure ?_
    rwa [frontier_compl]
  · exact aux₀ fun _ ↦ hs.exists_subset_ball <| frontier_subset_closure hx

name: Set.OrdConnected.null_frontier
statement: theorem Set.OrdConnected.null_frontier (hs : s.OrdConnected) : volume (frontier s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hs.upperClosure_inter_lowerClosure]
  exact measure_mono_null (frontier_inter_subset _ _) <| measure_union_null
    (measure_inter_null_of_null_left _ (UpperSet.upper _).null_frontier)
    (measure_inter_null_of_null_right _ (LowerSet.lower _).null_frontier)

name: Set.OrdConnected.nullMeasurableSet
statement: protected theorem Set.OrdConnected.nullMeasurableSet (hs : s.OrdConnected) : NullMeasurableSet s
proof:
:=
  nullMeasurableSet_of_null_frontier hs.null_frontier

name: IsAntichain.volume_eq_zero
statement: theorem IsAntichain.volume_eq_zero [Nonempty ι] (hs : IsAntichain (· ≤ ·) s) : volume s = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine measure_mono_null ?_ hs.ordConnected.null_frontier
  rw [← closure_sdiff_interior, hs.interior_eq_empty, sdiff_empty]
  exact subset_closure

name: Measurable.const_sup
