name: Finset.measurable_sup'
proof:
:=
  Finset.sup'_induction hs _ (fun _f hf _g hg => hf.sup hg) fun n hn => hf n hn

name: Finset.measurable_range_sup'
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem Finset.measurable_range_sup' {f : ℕ → δ → α} {n : ℕ} (hf : ∀ k ≤ n, Measurable (f k)) :
    Measurable ((range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.measurable_sup' _ ?_
  simpa [Finset.mem_range]

name: Finset.measurable_range_sup''
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem Finset.measurable_range_sup'' {f : ℕ → δ → α} {n : ℕ} (hf : ∀ k ≤ n, Measurable (f k)) :
    Measurable fun x => (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one fun k => f k x
proof:
:= by
  convert! Finset.measurable_range_sup' hf using 1
  ext x
  simp

name: isCaratheodory_iff_le'
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_iff_le' {s : Set α} :
    IsCaratheodory m s ↔ ∀ t, m (t ∩ s) + m (t \ s) ≤ m t
proof:
:=
  forall_congr' fun _ => le_antisymm_iff.trans <| and_iff_right <| measure_le_inter_add_sdiff _ _ _

name: isCaratheodory_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isCaratheodory_empty : IsCaratheodory m ∅
proof: := by simp [IsCaratheodory, sdiff_empty]

name: isCaratheodory_compl
statement: theorem isCaratheodory_compl : IsCaratheodory m s₁ → IsCaratheodory m s₁ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsCaratheodory, sdiff_eq, add_comm]

name: isCaratheodory_compl_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isCaratheodory_compl_iff : IsCaratheodory m sᶜ ↔ IsCaratheodory m s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using isCaratheodory_compl m h, isCaratheodory_compl m⟩

name: isCaratheodory_union
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_union (h₁ : IsCaratheodory m s₁) (h₂ : IsCaratheodory m s₂) :
    IsCaratheodory m (s₁ ∪ s₂)
proof:
:= fun t => by
  rw [h₁ t, h₂ (t ∩ s₁), h₂ (t \ s₁), h₁ (t ∩ (s₁ ∪ s₂)), inter_sdiff_assoc _ _ s₁,
    Set.inter_assoc _ _ s₁, inter_eq_self_of_subset_right Set.subset_union_left,
    union_sdiff_left, h₂ (t ∩ s₁)]
  simp [sdiff_eq, add_assoc]

name: IsCaratheodory.biUnion_of_finite
statement:
lemma IsCaratheodory.biUnion_of_finite {ι : Type*} {s : ι → Set α} {t : Set ι} (ht : t.Finite)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ t, m.IsCaratheodory (s i)) :
    m.IsCaratheodory (⋃ i ∈ t, s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  lift t to Finset ι using ht
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i t hi IH =>
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, iUnion_iUnion_eq_or_left] at h ⊢
    exact m.isCaratheodory_union (h _ <| Or.inl rfl) (IH fun _ hj ↦ h _ <| Or.inr hj)

name: measure_inter_union
statement:
theorem measure_inter_union (h : s₁ ∩ s₂ ⊆ ∅) (h₁ : IsCaratheodory m s₁) {t : Set α} :
    m (t ∩ (s₁ ∪ s₂)) = m (t ∩ s₁) + m (t ∩ s₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h₁, Set.inter_assoc, Set.union_inter_cancel_left, inter_sdiff_assoc,
    union_sdiff_cancel_left h]

name: isCaratheodory_iUnion_lt
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_iUnion_lt {s : ℕ → Set α} :
    ∀ {n : ℕ}, (∀ i < n, IsCaratheodory m (s i)) → IsCaratheodory m (⋃ i < n, s i)
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | n + 1, h => by
    rw [biUnion_lt_succ]
    exact isCaratheodory_union m
            (isCaratheodory_iUnion_lt fun i hi => h i <| lt_of_lt_of_le hi <| Nat.le_succ _)
            (h n (le_refl (n + 1)))

name: isCaratheodory_inter
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_inter (h₁ : IsCaratheodory m s₁) (h₂ : IsCaratheodory m s₂) :
    IsCaratheodory m (s₁ ∩ s₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isCaratheodory_compl_iff, Set.compl_inter]
  exact isCaratheodory_union _ (isCaratheodory_compl _ h₁) (isCaratheodory_compl _ h₂)

name: isCaratheodory_sdiff
statement:
lemma isCaratheodory_sdiff (h₁ : IsCaratheodory m s₁) (h₂ : IsCaratheodory m s₂) :
    IsCaratheodory m (s₁ \ s₂)
proof: := m.isCaratheodory_inter h₁ (m.isCaratheodory_compl h₂)

name: isCaratheodory_partialSups
statement:
lemma isCaratheodory_partialSups {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot ι]
    {s : ι → Set α} (h : ∀ i, m.IsCaratheodory (s i)) (i : ι) :
    m.IsCaratheodory (partialSups s i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [partialSups_apply, Finset.sup'_eq_sup, Finset.sup_set_eq_biUnion, ← Finset.mem_coe,
    Finset.coe_Iic] using .biUnion_of_finite (finite_Iic _) (fun j _ ↦ h j)

name: isCaratheodory_disjointed
statement:
lemma isCaratheodory_disjointed {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot ι]
    {s : ι → Set α} (h : ∀ i, m.IsCaratheodory (s i)) (i : ι) :
    m.IsCaratheodory (disjointed s i)
proof:
:=
  disjointedRec (fun _ j ht ↦ m.isCaratheodory_sdiff ht <| h j) (h i)

name: isCaratheodory_sum
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_sum {s : ℕ → Set α} (h : ∀ i, IsCaratheodory m (s i))
    (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on s)) {t : Set α} :
    ∀ {n}, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, m (t ∩ s i)) = m (t ∩ ⋃ i < n, s i)
  | 0 => by simp
  | Nat.succ n => by
    rw [biUnion_lt_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Set.union_comm, isCaratheodory_sum h hd,
      m.measure_inter_union _ (h n), add_comm]
    intro a
    simpa using fun (h₁ : a ∈ s n) i (hi : i < n) h₂ => (hd (ne_of_gt hi)).le_bot ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

/

name: isCaratheodory_iUnion_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_iUnion_of_disjoint {s : ℕ → Set α} (h : ∀ i, IsCaratheodory m (s i))
    (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on s)) : IsCaratheodory m (⋃ i, s i)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isCaratheodory_iff_le' m).mpr
  intro t
  have hp : m (t ∩ ⋃ i, s i) ≤ ⨆ n, m (t ∩ ⋃ i < n, s i) := by
    convert! measure_iUnion_le (μ := m) fun i => t ∩ s i using 1
    · simp [inter_iUnion]
    · simp [ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_nat, isCaratheodory_sum m h hd]
  grw [hp, ENNReal.iSup_add]
  refine iSup_le fun n => ?_
  rw [isCaratheodory_iUnion_lt _ (fun i _ => h i) t (n := n)]
  gcongr with i
  exact iUnion_subset fun _ => .rfl

name: isCaratheodory_iUnion
statement:
lemma isCaratheodory_iUnion {s : ℕ → Set α} (h : ∀ i, m.IsCaratheodory (s i)) :
    m.IsCaratheodory (⋃ i, s i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iUnion_disjointed]
  exact m.isCaratheodory_iUnion_of_disjoint (m.isCaratheodory_disjointed h)
    (disjoint_disjointed _)

name: f_iUnion
statement:
theorem f_iUnion {s : ℕ → Set α} (h : ∀ i, IsCaratheodory m (s i)) (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on s)) :
    m (⋃ i, s i) = ∑' i, m (s i)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (measure_iUnion_le s) ?_
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_nat]
  refine iSup_le fun n => ?_
  have := @isCaratheodory_sum _ m _ h hd univ n
  simp only [inter_comm, inter_univ, univ_inter] at this; simp only [this]
  exact m.mono (iUnion₂_subset fun i _ => subset_iUnion _ i)

name: isCaratheodory_iff
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_iff {s : Set α} :
    MeasurableSet[OuterMeasure.caratheodory m] s ↔ ∀ t, m t = m (t ∩ s) + m (t \ s)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: isCaratheodory_iff_le
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_iff_le {s : Set α} :
    MeasurableSet[OuterMeasure.caratheodory m] s ↔ ∀ t, m (t ∩ s) + m (t \ s) ≤ m t
proof:
:=
  isCaratheodory_iff_le' m

name: iUnion_eq_of_caratheodory
proof:
:=
  f_iUnion m h hd

name: ofFunction_caratheodory
proof:
:= by
  apply (isCaratheodory_iff_le _).mpr
  refine fun t => le_iInf fun f => le_iInf fun hf => ?_
  refine
    le_trans
      (add_le_add ((iInf_le_of_le fun i => f i ∩ s) <| iInf_le _ ?_)
        ((iInf_le_of_le fun i => f i \ s) <| iInf_le _ ?_))
      ?_
  · rw [← iUnion_inter]
    exact inter_subset_inter_left _ hf
  · rw [← iUnion_sdiff]
    exact sdiff_subset_sdiff_left hf
  · rw [← ENNReal.tsum_add]
    exact ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun i => hs _

name: boundedBy_caratheodory
statement:
theorem boundedBy_caratheodory {m : Set α → ℝ≥0∞} {s : Set α}
    (hs : ∀ t, m (t ∩ s) + m (t \ s) ≤ m t) : MeasurableSet[(boundedBy m).caratheodory] s
proof:
:= by
  apply ofFunction_caratheodory; intro t
  rcases t.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | h
  · simp [Set.not_nonempty_empty]
  · convert! le_trans _ (hs t)
    · simp [h]
    exact add_le_add iSup_const_le iSup_const_le

name: zero_caratheodory
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_caratheodory : (0 : OuterMeasure α).caratheodory = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_unique fun _ _ _ => (add_zero _).symm

name: top_caratheodory
statement: theorem top_caratheodory : (⊤ : OuterMeasure α).caratheodory = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_unique fun s _ =>
    (isCaratheodory_iff_le _).2 fun t =>
      t.eq_empty_or_nonempty.elim (fun ht => by simp [ht]) fun ht => by
        simp only [ht, top_apply, le_top]

name: le_add_caratheodory
statement:
theorem le_add_caratheodory (m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α) :
    m₁.caratheodory ⊓ m₂.caratheodory ≤ (m₁ + m₂ : OuterMeasure α).caratheodory
proof:
:=
  fun s ⟨hs₁, hs₂⟩ t => by simp [hs₁ t, hs₂ t, add_left_comm, add_assoc]

name: le_sum_caratheodory
statement:
theorem le_sum_caratheodory {ι} (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) :
    ⨅ i, (m i).caratheodory ≤ (sum m).caratheodory
proof:
:= fun s h t => by
  simp [fun i => MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_iInf.1 h i t, ENNReal.tsum_add]

name: le_smul_caratheodory
statement:
theorem le_smul_caratheodory (a : ℝ≥0∞) (m : OuterMeasure α) :
    m.caratheodory ≤ (a • m).caratheodory
proof:
:= fun s h t => by
      simp only [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [(isCaratheodory_iff m).mp h t]
      simp [mul_add]

name: dirac_caratheodory
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dirac_caratheodory (a : α) : (dirac a).caratheodory = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_unique fun s _ t => by
    by_cases ht : a ∈ t; swap; · simp [ht]
    by_cases hs : a ∈ s <;> simp [*]

name: measure_limsup_cofinite_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_limsup_cofinite_eq_zero {s : ι → Set α} (hs : ∑' i, μ (s i) ≠ ∞) :
    μ (limsup s cofinite) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine bot_unique <| ge_of_tendsto' (ENNReal.tendsto_tsum_compl_atTop_zero hs) fun t ↦ ?_
  calc
    μ (limsup s cofinite) ≤ μ (⋃ i : {i // i ∉ t}, s i) := by
      gcongr
      rw [hasBasis_cofinite.limsup_eq_iInf_iSup, iUnion_subtype]
      exact iInter₂_subset _ t.finite_toSet
    _ ≤ ∑' i : {i // i ∉ t}, μ (s i) := measure_iUnion_le _

name: measure_limsup_atTop_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_limsup_atTop_eq_zero {s : ℕ → Set α} (hs : ∑' i, μ (s i) ≠ ∞) :
    μ (limsup s atTop) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop, measure_limsup_cofinite_eq_zero hs]

name: ae_finite_setOfPred_mem
statement:
theorem ae_finite_setOfPred_mem {s : ι → Set α} (h : ∑' i, μ (s i) ≠ ∞) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, {i | x ∈ s i}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [ae_iff, ← measure_limsup_cofinite_eq_zero h]
  congr 1 with x
  simp [mem_limsup_iff_frequently_mem, Filter.Frequently]

name: measure_setOfPred_frequently_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_setOfPred_frequently_eq_zero {p : ℕ → α → Prop} (hp : ∑' i, μ { x | p i x } ≠ ∞) :
    μ { x | ∃ᶠ n in atTop, p n x } = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [limsup_eq_iInf_iSup_of_nat, frequently_atTop, ← bex_def, ofPred_forall,
    ofPred_exists] using! measure_limsup_atTop_eq_zero hp

name: ae_eventually_notMem
statement:
theorem ae_eventually_notMem {s : ℕ → Set α} (hs : (∑' i, μ (s i)) ≠ ∞) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, x ∉ s n
proof:
:=
  measure_setOfPred_frequently_eq_zero hs

name: measure_liminf_cofinite_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_liminf_cofinite_eq_zero [Infinite ι] {s : ι → Set α} (h : ∑' i, μ (s i) ≠ ∞) :
    μ (liminf s cofinite) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero, ← measure_limsup_cofinite_eq_zero h]
  exact measure_mono liminf_le_limsup

name: measure_liminf_atTop_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_liminf_atTop_eq_zero {s : ℕ → Set α} (h : (∑' i, μ (s i)) ≠ ∞) :
    μ (liminf s atTop) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop, measure_liminf_cofinite_eq_zero h]

name: limsup_ae_eq_of_forall_ae_eq
statement:
theorem limsup_ae_eq_of_forall_ae_eq (s : ℕ → Set α) {t : Set α}
    (h : ∀ n, s n =ᵐ[μ] t) : limsup (α := Set α) s atTop =ᵐ[μ] t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eventuallyEqSet_iff, ← eventually_countable_forall] at h
  refine eventuallyEqSet_iff.2 <| h.mono fun x hx ↦ ?_
  simp [mem_limsup_iff_frequently_mem, hx]

name: liminf_ae_eq_of_forall_ae_eq
statement:
theorem liminf_ae_eq_of_forall_ae_eq (s : ℕ → Set α) {t : Set α}
    (h : ∀ n, s n =ᵐ[μ] t) : liminf (α := Set α) s atTop =ᵐ[μ] t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eventuallyEqSet_iff, ← eventually_countable_forall] at h
  refine eventuallyEqSet_iff.2 <| h.mono fun x hx ↦ ?_
  simp only [mem_liminf_iff_eventually_mem, hx, eventually_const]

name: ofFunction_apply
statement:
theorem ofFunction_apply (s : Set α) :
    OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty s = ⨅ (t : ℕ → Set α) (_ : s ⊆ iUnion t), ∑' n, m (t n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ofFunction_eq_iInf_mem
statement:
theorem ofFunction_eq_iInf_mem {P : Set α → Prop} (m_top : ∀ s, ¬ P s → m s = ∞) (s : Set α) :
    OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty s =
      ⨅ (t : ℕ → Set α) (_ : ∀ i, P (t i)) (_ : s ⊆ ⋃ i, t i), ∑' i, m (t i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [OuterMeasure.ofFunction_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_iInf fun t ↦ le_iInf fun _ ↦ le_iInf fun h ↦ iInf₂_le _ (by exact h)
  · simp_rw [le_iInf_iff]
    refine fun t ht_subset ↦ iInf_le_of_le t ?_
    by_cases ht : ∀ i, P (t i)
    · exact iInf_le_of_le ht (iInf_le_of_le ht_subset le_rfl)
    · simp only [ht, not_false_eq_true, iInf_neg, top_le_iff]
      push Not at ht
      obtain ⟨i, hti_notMem⟩ := ht
      have hfi_top : m (t i) = ∞ := m_top _ hti_notMem
      exact ENNReal.tsum_eq_top_of_eq_top ⟨i, hfi_top⟩

name: ofFunction_le
statement: theorem ofFunction_le (s : Set α) : OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty s ≤ m s
proof:
:=
  let f : ℕ → Set α := fun i => Nat.casesOn i s fun _ => ∅
  iInf_le_of_le f <|
    iInf_le_of_le (subset_iUnion f 0) <|
      le_of_eq <| tsum_eq_single 0 <| by
        rintro (_ | i)
        · simp
        · simp [f, m_empty]

name: ofFunction_eq
statement:
theorem ofFunction_eq (s : Set α) (m_mono : ∀ ⦃t : Set α⦄, s ⊆ t → m s ≤ m t)
    (m_subadd : ∀ s : ℕ → Set α, m (⋃ i, s i) ≤ ∑' i, m (s i)) :
    OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty s = m s
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (ofFunction_le s) <|
    le_iInf fun f => le_iInf fun hf => le_trans (m_mono hf) (m_subadd f)

name: le_ofFunction
statement:
theorem le_ofFunction {μ : OuterMeasure α} :
    μ ≤ OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty ↔ ∀ s, μ s ≤ m s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H s => le_trans (H s) (ofFunction_le s), fun H _ =>
    le_iInf₂ fun f hs => by grw [hs, ← H, ← measure_iUnion_le f]⟩

name: isGreatest_ofFunction
statement:
theorem isGreatest_ofFunction :
    IsGreatest { μ : OuterMeasure α | ∀ s, μ s ≤ m s } (OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => ofFunction_le _, fun _ => le_ofFunction.2⟩

name: ofFunction_eq_sSup
statement: theorem ofFunction_eq_sSup : OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty = sSup { μ | ∀ s, μ s ≤ m s }
proof:
:=
  (@isGreatest_ofFunction α m m_empty).isLUB.sSup_eq.symm

name: ofFunction_union_of_top_of_nonempty_inter
statement:
theorem ofFunction_union_of_top_of_nonempty_inter {s t : Set α}
    (h : ∀ u, (s ∩ u).Nonempty → (t ∩ u).Nonempty → m u = ∞) :
    OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty (s ∪ t) =
      OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty s + OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty t
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (measure_union_le _ _) (le_iInf₂ fun f hf ↦ ?_)
  set μ := OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty
  rcases Classical.em (∃ i, (s ∩ f i).Nonempty ∧ (t ∩ f i).Nonempty) with (⟨i, hs, ht⟩ | he)
  · grw [← ENNReal.le_tsum i, h (f i) hs ht, ← le_top]
  set I := fun s => { i : ℕ | (s ∩ f i).Nonempty }
  have hd : Disjoint (I s) (I t) := disjoint_iff_inf_le.mpr fun i hi => he ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hI : ∀ u ⊆ s ∪ t, μ u ≤ ∑' i : I u, μ (f i) := fun u hu =>
    calc
      μ u ≤ μ (⋃ i : I u, f i) :=
        μ.mono fun x hx =>
          let ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 (hf (hu hx))
          mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨i, ⟨x, hx, hi⟩⟩, hi⟩
      _ ≤ ∑' i : I u, μ (f i) := measure_iUnion_le _
  calc
    μ s + μ t ≤ (∑' i : I s, μ (f i)) + ∑' i : I t, μ (f i) :=
      add_le_add (hI _ subset_union_left) (hI _ subset_union_right)
    _ = ∑' i : ↑(I s ∪ I t), μ (f i) :=
      (ENNReal.summable.tsum_union_disjoint (f := fun i => μ (f i)) hd ENNReal.summable).symm
    _ ≤ ∑' i, μ (f i) :=
      (ENNReal.summable.tsum_le_tsum_of_inj (↑) Subtype.coe_injective (fun _ _ => zero_le)
        (fun _ => le_rfl) ENNReal.summable)
    _ ≤ ∑' i, m (f i) := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun i => ofFunction_le _

name: comap_ofFunction
statement:
theorem comap_ofFunction {β} (f : β → α) (h : Monotone m ∨ Surjective f) :
    comap f (OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty) =
      OuterMeasure.ofFunction (fun s => m (f '' s)) (by simp; simp [m_empty])
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_ofFunction.2 fun s => ?_) fun s => ?_
  · rw [comap_apply]
    apply ofFunction_le
  · rw [comap_apply, ofFunction_apply, ofFunction_apply]
    refine iInf_mono' fun t => ⟨fun k => f ⁻¹' t k, ?_⟩
    refine iInf_mono' fun ht => ?_
    rw [Set.image_subset_iff, preimage_iUnion] at ht
    refine ⟨ht, ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun n => ?_⟩
    rcases h with hl | hr
    exacts [hl (image_preimage_subset _ _), (congr_arg m (hr.image_preimage (t n))).le]

name: map_ofFunction_le
statement:
theorem map_ofFunction_le {β} (f : α → β) :
    map f (OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty) ≤
      OuterMeasure.ofFunction (fun s => m (f ⁻¹' s)) m_empty
proof:
:=
  le_ofFunction.2 fun s => by
    rw [map_apply]
    apply ofFunction_le

name: map_ofFunction
statement:
theorem map_ofFunction {β} {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) :
    map f (OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty) =
      OuterMeasure.ofFunction (fun s => m (f ⁻¹' s)) m_empty
proof:
:= by
  refine (map_ofFunction_le _).antisymm fun s => ?_
  simp only [ofFunction_apply, map_apply, le_iInf_iff]
  intro t ht
  refine iInf_le_of_le (fun n => (range f)ᶜ ∪ f '' t n) (iInf_le_of_le ?_ ?_)
  · rw [← union_iUnion, ← inter_subset, ← image_preimage_eq_inter_range, ← image_iUnion]
    exact image_mono ht
  · refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun n => le_of_eq ?_
    simp [hf.preimage_image]

name: restrict_ofFunction
statement:
theorem restrict_ofFunction (s : Set α) (hm : Monotone m) :
    restrict s (OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty) =
      OuterMeasure.ofFunction (fun t => m (t ∩ s)) (by simp; simp [m_empty])
proof:
:= by
      rw [restrict]
      simp only [inter_comm _ s, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [comap_ofFunction _ (Or.inl hm)]
      simp only [map_ofFunction Subtype.coe_injective, Subtype.image_preimage_coe]

name: smul_ofFunction
statement:
theorem smul_ofFunction {c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c ≠ ∞) : c • OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty =
    OuterMeasure.ofFunction (c • m) (by simp [m_empty])
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s
  have : Nonempty { t : ℕ → Set α // s ⊆ ⋃ i, t i } := ⟨⟨fun _ => s, subset_iUnion (fun _ => s) 0⟩⟩
  simp only [smul_apply, ofFunction_apply, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
  iInf_subtype']
  rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf fun h => (hc h).elim]

name: boundedBy_le
statement: theorem boundedBy_le (s : Set α) : boundedBy m s ≤ m s
proof:
:=
  (ofFunction_le _).trans iSup_const_le

name: boundedBy_eq_ofFunction
statement:
theorem boundedBy_eq_ofFunction (m_empty : m ∅ = 0) (s : Set α) :
    boundedBy m s = OuterMeasure.ofFunction m m_empty s
proof:
:= by
  have : (fun s : Set α => ⨆ _ : s.Nonempty, m s) = m := by
    ext1 t
    rcases t.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h <;> simp [h, Set.not_nonempty_empty, m_empty]
  simp [boundedBy, this]

name: boundedBy_apply
statement:
theorem boundedBy_apply (s : Set α) :
    boundedBy m s = ⨅ (t : ℕ → Set α) (_ : s ⊆ iUnion t),
                      ∑' n, ⨆ _ : (t n).Nonempty, m (t n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundedBy, ofFunction_apply]

name: boundedBy_eq
statement:
theorem boundedBy_eq (s : Set α) (m_empty : m ∅ = 0) (m_mono : ∀ ⦃t : Set α⦄, s ⊆ t → m s ≤ m t)
    (m_subadd : ∀ s : ℕ → Set α, m (⋃ i, s i) ≤ ∑' i, m (s i)) : boundedBy m s = m s
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundedBy_eq_ofFunction m_empty, ofFunction_eq s m_mono m_subadd]

name: boundedBy_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem boundedBy_eq_self (m : OuterMeasure α) : boundedBy m = m
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ => boundedBy_eq _ measure_empty (fun _ ht => measure_mono ht) measure_iUnion_le

name: le_boundedBy
statement: theorem le_boundedBy {μ : OuterMeasure α} : μ ≤ boundedBy m ↔ ∀ s, μ s ≤ m s
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundedBy, le_ofFunction, forall_congr']; intro s
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h <;> simp [h, Set.not_nonempty_empty]

name: le_boundedBy'
statement:
theorem le_boundedBy' {μ : OuterMeasure α} :
    μ ≤ boundedBy m ↔ ∀ s : Set α, s.Nonempty → μ s ≤ m s
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_boundedBy, forall_congr']
  intro s
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h <;> simp [h]

name: boundedBy_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem boundedBy_top : boundedBy (⊤ : Set α → ℝ≥0∞) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, le_boundedBy']
  intro s hs
  rw [top_apply hs]
  exact le_rfl

name: boundedBy_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem boundedBy_zero : boundedBy (0 : Set α → ℝ≥0∞) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_bot, eq_bot_iff]
  apply boundedBy_le

name: smul_boundedBy
statement: theorem smul_boundedBy {c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c ≠ ∞) : c • boundedBy m = boundedBy (c • m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [boundedBy, smul_ofFunction hc]
  congr 1 with s : 1
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with (rfl | hs) <;> simp [*]

name: comap_boundedBy
statement:
theorem comap_boundedBy {β} (f : β → α)
    (h : (Monotone fun s : { s : Set α // s.Nonempty } => m s) ∨ Surjective f) :
    comap f (boundedBy m) = boundedBy fun s => m (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  refine (comap_ofFunction _ ?_).trans ?_
  · refine h.imp (fun H s t hst => iSup_le fun hs => ?_) id
    have ht : t.Nonempty := hs.mono hst
    exact (@H ⟨s, hs⟩ ⟨t, ht⟩ hst).trans (le_iSup (fun _ : t.Nonempty => m t) ht)
  · dsimp only [boundedBy]
    congr with s : 1
    rw [image_nonempty]

name: boundedBy_union_of_top_of_nonempty_inter
proof:
:=
  ofFunction_union_of_top_of_nonempty_inter fun u hs ht =>
    top_unique <| (h u hs ht).ge.trans <| le_iSup (fun _ => m u) (hs.mono inter_subset_right)

name: sInfGen_def
statement:
theorem sInfGen_def (m : Set (OuterMeasure α)) (t : Set α) :
    sInfGen m t = ⨅ (μ : OuterMeasure α) (_ : μ ∈ m), μ t
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: sInf_eq_boundedBy_sInfGen
statement:
theorem sInf_eq_boundedBy_sInfGen (m : Set (OuterMeasure α)) :
    sInf m = OuterMeasure.boundedBy (sInfGen m)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · refine le_boundedBy.2 fun s => le_iInf₂ fun μ hμ => ?_
    apply sInf_le hμ
  · refine le_sInf ?_
    intro μ hμ t
    exact le_trans (boundedBy_le t) (iInf₂_le μ hμ)

name: iSup_sInfGen_nonempty
statement:
theorem iSup_sInfGen_nonempty {m : Set (OuterMeasure α)} (h : m.Nonempty) (t : Set α) :
    ⨆ _ : t.Nonempty, sInfGen m t = ⨅ (μ : OuterMeasure α) (_ : μ ∈ m), μ t
proof:
:= by
  rcases t.eq_empty_or_nonempty with (rfl | ht)
  · simp [biInf_const h]
  · simp [ht, sInfGen_def]

name: sInf_apply
statement:
theorem sInf_apply {m : Set (OuterMeasure α)} {s : Set α} (h : m.Nonempty) :
    sInf m s =
      ⨅ (t : ℕ → Set α) (_ : s ⊆ iUnion t), ∑' n, ⨅ (μ : OuterMeasure α) (_ : μ ∈ m), μ (t n)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sInf_eq_boundedBy_sInfGen, boundedBy_apply, iSup_sInfGen_nonempty h]

name: sInf_apply'
statement:
theorem sInf_apply' {m : Set (OuterMeasure α)} {s : Set α} (h : s.Nonempty) :
    sInf m s =
      ⨅ (t : ℕ → Set α) (_ : s ⊆ iUnion t), ∑' n, ⨅ (μ : OuterMeasure α) (_ : μ ∈ m), μ (t n)
proof:
:=
  m.eq_empty_or_nonempty.elim (fun hm => by simp [hm, h]) sInf_apply

name: iInf_apply
statement:
theorem iInf_apply {ι} [Nonempty ι] (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) (s : Set α) :
    (⨅ i, m i) s = ⨅ (t : ℕ → Set α) (_ : s ⊆ iUnion t), ∑' n, ⨅ i, m i (t n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iInf, sInf_apply (range_nonempty m)]
  simp only [iInf_range]

name: iInf_apply'
statement:
theorem iInf_apply' {ι} (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) {s : Set α} (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    (⨅ i, m i) s = ⨅ (t : ℕ → Set α) (_ : s ⊆ iUnion t), ∑' n, ⨅ i, m i (t n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iInf, sInf_apply' hs]
  simp only [iInf_range]

name: biInf_apply
statement:
theorem biInf_apply {ι} {I : Set ι} (hI : I.Nonempty) (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) (s : Set α) :
    (⨅ i ∈ I, m i) s = ⨅ (t : ℕ → Set α) (_ : s ⊆ iUnion t), ∑' n, ⨅ i ∈ I, m i (t n)
proof:
:= by
  have := hI.to_subtype
  simp only [← iInf_subtype'', iInf_apply]

name: biInf_apply'
statement:
theorem biInf_apply' {ι} (I : Set ι) (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) {s : Set α} (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    (⨅ i ∈ I, m i) s = ⨅ (t : ℕ → Set α) (_ : s ⊆ iUnion t), ∑' n, ⨅ i ∈ I, m i (t n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← iInf_subtype'', iInf_apply' _ hs]

name: map_iInf_le
statement:
theorem map_iInf_le {ι β} (f : α → β) (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) :
    map f (⨅ i, m i) ≤ ⨅ i, map f (m i)
proof:
:=
  (map_mono f).map_iInf_le

name: comap_iInf
statement:
theorem comap_iInf {ι β} (f : α → β) (m : ι → OuterMeasure β) :
    comap f (⨅ i, m i) = ⨅ i, comap f (m i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_nonempty fun s hs => ?_
  refine ((comap_mono f).map_iInf_le s).antisymm ?_
  simp only [comap_apply, iInf_apply' _ hs, iInf_apply' _ (hs.image _), le_iInf_iff,
    Set.image_subset_iff, preimage_iUnion]
  refine fun t ht => iInf_le_of_le _ (iInf_le_of_le ht <| ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun k => ?_)
  exact iInf_mono fun i => (m i).mono (image_preimage_subset _ _)

name: map_iInf
statement:
theorem map_iInf {ι β} {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) :
    map f (⨅ i, m i) = restrict (range f) (⨅ i, map f (m i))
proof:
:= by
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (map_comap _ _)
  simp only [comap_iInf, comap_map hf]

name: map_iInf_comap
statement:
theorem map_iInf_comap {ι β} [Nonempty ι] {f : α → β} (m : ι → OuterMeasure β) :
    map f (⨅ i, comap f (m i)) = ⨅ i, map f (comap f (m i))
proof:
:= by
  refine (map_iInf_le _ _).antisymm fun s => ?_
  simp only [map_apply, comap_apply, iInf_apply, le_iInf_iff]
  refine fun t ht => iInf_le_of_le (fun n => f '' t n ∪ (range f)ᶜ) (iInf_le_of_le ?_ ?_)
  · rw [← iUnion_union, Set.union_comm, ← inter_subset, ← image_iUnion, ←
      image_preimage_eq_inter_range]
    exact image_mono ht
  · refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun n => iInf_mono fun i => (m i).mono ?_
    simpa only [preimage_union, preimage_compl, preimage_range, compl_univ, union_empty,
      image_subset_iff] using subset_rfl

name: map_biInf_comap
statement:
theorem map_biInf_comap {ι β} {I : Set ι} (hI : I.Nonempty) {f : α → β} (m : ι → OuterMeasure β) :
    map f (⨅ i ∈ I, comap f (m i)) = ⨅ i ∈ I, map f (comap f (m i))
proof:
:= by
  have := hI.to_subtype
  rw [← iInf_subtype'', ← iInf_subtype'']
  exact map_iInf_comap _

name: restrict_iInf_restrict
statement:
theorem restrict_iInf_restrict {ι} (s : Set α) (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) :
    restrict s (⨅ i, restrict s (m i)) = restrict s (⨅ i, m i)
proof:
:=
  calc restrict s (⨅ i, restrict s (m i))
    _ = restrict (range ((↑) : s → α)) (⨅ i, restrict s (m i)) := by rw [Subtype.range_coe]
    _ = map ((↑) : s → α) (⨅ i, comap (↑) (m i)) := (map_iInf Subtype.coe_injective _).symm
    _ = restrict s (⨅ i, m i) := congr_arg (map ((↑) : s → α)) (comap_iInf _ _).symm

name: restrict_iInf
statement:
theorem restrict_iInf {ι} [Nonempty ι] (s : Set α) (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) :
    restrict s (⨅ i, m i) = ⨅ i, restrict s (m i)
proof:
:=
  (congr_arg (map ((↑) : s → α)) (comap_iInf _ _)).trans (map_iInf_comap _)

name: restrict_biInf
statement:
theorem restrict_biInf {ι} {I : Set ι} (hI : I.Nonempty) (s : Set α) (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) :
    restrict s (⨅ i ∈ I, m i) = ⨅ i ∈ I, restrict s (m i)
proof:
:= by
  have := hI.to_subtype
  rw [← iInf_subtype'', ← iInf_subtype'']
  exact restrict_iInf _ _

name: restrict_sInf_eq_sInf_restrict
statement:
theorem restrict_sInf_eq_sInf_restrict (m : Set (OuterMeasure α)) {s : Set α} (hm : m.Nonempty) :
    restrict s (sInf m) = sInf (restrict s '' m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sInf_eq_iInf, restrict_biInf, hm, iInf_image]

name: measure_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem measure_empty : μ ∅ = 0
proof: := OuterMeasureClass.measure_empty μ

name: measure_mono
statement:
@[mono, gcongr]
theorem measure_mono (h : s ⊆ t) : μ s ≤ μ t
proof:
:=
  OuterMeasureClass.measure_mono μ h

name: measure_mono_null
statement: theorem measure_mono_null (h : s ⊆ t) (ht : μ t = 0) : μ s = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_mono (measure_mono h) ht

name: pos_mono
statement:
lemma pos_mono ⦃s t : Set α⦄ (h : s ⊆ t) (hs : 0 < μ s) :
    0 < μ t
proof: := hs.trans_le <| measure_mono h

name: measure_eq_top_mono
statement: lemma measure_eq_top_mono (h : s ⊆ t) (hs : μ s = ∞) : μ t = ∞
proof: := eq_top_mono (measure_mono h) hs

name: measure_lt_top_mono
statement: lemma measure_lt_top_mono (h : s ⊆ t) (ht : μ t < ∞) : μ s < ∞
proof: := (measure_mono h).trans_lt ht

name: measure_pos_of_superset
statement: theorem measure_pos_of_superset (h : s ⊆ t) (hs : μ s ≠ 0) : 0 < μ t
proof:
:=
  hs.bot_lt.trans_le (measure_mono h)

name: measure_iUnion_le
statement: theorem measure_iUnion_le [Countable ι] (s : ι → Set α) : μ (⋃ i, s i) ≤ ∑' i, μ (s i)
proof:
:= by
  refine rel_iSup_tsum μ measure_empty (· ≤ ·) (fun t ↦ ?_) _
  calc
    μ (⋃ i, t i) = μ (⋃ i, disjointed t i) := by rw [iUnion_disjointed]
    _ ≤ ∑' i, μ (disjointed t i) :=
      OuterMeasureClass.measure_iUnion_nat_le _ _ (disjoint_disjointed _)
    _ ≤ ∑' i, μ (t i) := by gcongr; exact disjointed_subset ..

name: measure_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem measure_biUnion_le {I : Set ι} (μ : F) (hI : I.Countable) (s : ι → Set α) :
    μ (⋃ i ∈ I, s i) ≤ ∑' i : I, μ (s i)
proof:
:= by
  have := hI.to_subtype
  rw [biUnion_eq_iUnion]
  apply measure_iUnion_le

name: measure_biUnion_finset_le
statement:
theorem measure_biUnion_finset_le (I : Finset ι) (s : ι → Set α) :
    μ (⋃ i ∈ I, s i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, μ (s i)
proof:
:=
  (measure_biUnion_le μ I.countable_toSet s).trans_eq <| I.tsum_subtype (μ <| s ·)

name: measure_iUnion_fintype_le
statement:
theorem measure_iUnion_fintype_le [Fintype ι] (μ : F) (s : ι → Set α) :
    μ (⋃ i, s i) ≤ ∑ i, μ (s i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using measure_biUnion_finset_le Finset.univ s

name: measure_union_le
statement: theorem measure_union_le (s t : Set α) : μ (s ∪ t) ≤ μ s + μ t
proof:
:= by
  simpa [union_eq_iUnion] using measure_iUnion_fintype_le μ (cond · s t)

name: measure_univ_le_add_compl
statement: lemma measure_univ_le_add_compl (s : Set α) : μ univ ≤ μ s + μ sᶜ
proof:
:=
  s.union_compl_self ▸ measure_union_le s sᶜ

name: measure_le_inter_add_sdiff
statement: theorem measure_le_inter_add_sdiff (μ : F) (s t : Set α) : μ s ≤ μ (s ∩ t) + μ (s \ t)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using measure_union_le (s ∩ t) (s \ t)

name: measure_sdiff_null
statement: theorem measure_sdiff_null (ht : μ t = 0) : μ (s \ t) = μ s
proof:
:=
  (measure_mono sdiff_subset).antisymm <| calc
    μ s ≤ μ (s ∩ t) + μ (s \ t) := measure_le_inter_add_sdiff _ _ _
    _ ≤ μ t + μ (s \ t) := by gcongr; apply inter_subset_right
    _ = μ (s \ t) := by simp [ht]

name: measure_biUnion_null_iff
statement:
theorem measure_biUnion_null_iff {I : Set ι} (hI : I.Countable) {s : ι → Set α} :
    μ (⋃ i ∈ I, s i) = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ I, μ (s i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h i hi ↦ measure_mono_null (subset_biUnion_of_mem hi) h, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  have _ := hI.to_subtype
  simpa [h] using measure_iUnion_le (μ := μ) fun x : I ↦ s x

name: measure_sUnion_null_iff
statement:
theorem measure_sUnion_null_iff {S : Set (Set α)} (hS : S.Countable) :
    μ (⋃₀ S) = 0 ↔ ∀ s ∈ S, μ s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sUnion_eq_biUnion, measure_biUnion_null_iff hS]

name: measure_iUnion_null_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem measure_iUnion_null_iff {ι : Sort*} [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} :
    μ (⋃ i, s i) = 0 ↔ ∀ i, μ (s i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sUnion_range, measure_sUnion_null_iff (countable_range s), forall_mem_range]

name: measure_union_null_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem measure_union_null_iff : μ (s ∪ t) = 0 ↔ μ s = 0 ∧ μ t = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [union_eq_iUnion, and_comm]

name: measure_union_null
statement: theorem measure_union_null (hs : μ s = 0) (ht : μ t = 0) : μ (s ∪ t) = 0
proof: := by simp [*]

name: measure_null_iff_singleton
statement: lemma measure_null_iff_singleton (hs : s.Countable) : μ s = 0 ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, μ {x} = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← measure_biUnion_null_iff hs, biUnion_of_singleton]

name: measure_iUnion_of_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem measure_iUnion_of_tendsto_zero {ι} (μ : F) {s : ι → Set α} (l : Filter ι) [NeBot l]
    (h0 : Tendsto (fun k => μ ((⋃ n, s n) \ s k)) l (𝓝 0)) : μ (⋃ n, s n) = ⨆ n, μ (s n)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ <| iSup_le fun n ↦ measure_mono <| subset_iUnion _ _
  set S := ⋃ n, s n
  set M := ⨆ n, μ (s n)
  have A : ∀ k, μ S ≤ M + μ (S \ s k) := fun k ↦ calc
    μ S ≤ μ (S ∩ s k) + μ (S \ s k) := measure_le_inter_add_sdiff _ _ _
    _ ≤ μ (s k) + μ (S \ s k) := by gcongr; apply inter_subset_right
    _ ≤ M + μ (S \ s k) := by gcongr; exact le_iSup (μ ∘ s) k
  have B : Tendsto (fun k ↦ M + μ (S \ s k)) l (𝓝 M) := by simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add h0
  exact ge_of_tendsto' B A

name: measure_null_of_locally_null
statement:
theorem measure_null_of_locally_null [TopologicalSpace α] [SecondCountableTopology α]
    (s : Set α) (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ u ∈ 𝓝[s] x, μ u = 0) : μ s = 0
proof:
:= by
  choose! u hxu hu₀ using hs
  choose t ht using TopologicalSpace.countable_cover_nhdsWithin hxu
  rcases ht with ⟨ts, t_count, ht⟩
  apply measure_mono_null ht
  exact (measure_biUnion_null_iff t_count).2 fun x hx => hu₀ x (ts hx)

name: exists_mem_forall_mem_nhdsWithin_pos_measure
statement:
theorem exists_mem_forall_mem_nhdsWithin_pos_measure [TopologicalSpace α]
    [SecondCountableTopology α] {s : Set α} (hs : μ s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, ∀ t ∈ 𝓝[s] x, 0 < μ t
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hs
  simp only [nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at hs
  exact measure_null_of_locally_null s hs

name: iUnion_of_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem iUnion_of_tendsto_zero {ι} (m : OuterMeasure α) {s : ι → Set α} (l : Filter ι) [NeBot l]
    (h0 : Tendsto (fun k => m ((⋃ n, s n) \ s k)) l (𝓝 0)) : m (⋃ n, s n) = ⨆ n, m (s n)
proof:
:=
  measure_iUnion_of_tendsto_zero m l h0

name: iUnion_nat_of_monotone_of_tsum_ne_top
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine measure_iUnion_of_tendsto_zero m atTop ?_
  refine tendsto_nhds_bot_mono' (ENNReal.tendsto_sum_nat_add _ h0) fun n => ?_
  grw [← measure_iUnion_le]
  gcongr
  
  have h' : Monotone s := @monotone_nat_of_le_succ (Set α) _ _ h_mono
  simp only [sdiff_subset_iff, iUnion_subset_iff]
  intro i x hx
  have : ∃ i, x ∈ s i := by exists i
  rcases Nat.findX this with ⟨j, hj, hlt⟩
  clear hx i
  rcases le_or_gt j n with hjn | hnj
  · exact Or.inl (h' hjn hj)
  have : j - (n + 1) + n + 1 = j := by lia
  refine Or.inr (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j - (n + 1), ?_, hlt _ ?_⟩)
  · rwa [this]
  · rw [← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, this]

name: coe_fn_injective
statement: theorem coe_fn_injective : Injective fun (μ : OuterMeasure α) (s : Set α) => μ s
proof:

  DFunLike.coe_injective

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {μ₁ μ₂ : OuterMeasure α} (h : ∀ s, μ₁ s = μ₂ s) : μ₁ = μ₂

theorem iSup_apply {ι} (f : ι → OuterMeasure α) (s : Set α) : (⨆ i : ι, f i) s = ⨆ i, f i s

theorem coe_iSup {ι} (f : ι → OuterMeasure α) : ⇑(⨆ i, f i) = ⨆ i, ⇑(f i)

name: sup_apply
statement:

theorem sup_apply (m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α) (s : Set α) : (m₁ ⊔ m₂) s = m₁ s ⊔ m₂ s
proof:

  have := iSup_apply (fun b => cond b m₁ m₂) s; rwa [iSup_bool_eq, iSup_bool_eq] at this

name: smul_iSup
statement:
theorem smul_iSup {R : Type*} [SMul R ℝ≥0∞] [IsScalarTower R ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0∞]
    {ι : Sort*} (f : ι → OuterMeasure α) (c : R) :
    (c • ⨆ i, f i) = ⨆ i, c • f i

  ext fun s => by simp only [smul_apply, iSup_apply, ENNReal.smul_iSup]

name: mono''
statement:
@[mono, gcongr]
theorem mono'' {m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α} {s₁ s₂ : Set α} (hm : m₁ ≤ m₂) (hs : s₁ ⊆ s₂) :
    m₁ s₁ ≤ m₂ s₂
proof:

  (hm s₁).trans (m₂.mono hs)

@[simp]
theorem map_apply {β} (f : α → β) (m : OuterMeasure α) (s : Set β) : map f m s = m (f ⁻¹' s)

name: map_id

name: map_map

@[simp]

theorem map_sup {β} (f : α → β) (m m' : OuterMeasure α) : map f (m ⊔ m') = map f m ⊔ map f m'

name: comap_apply

theorem comap_apply {β} (f : α → β) (m : OuterMeasure β) (s : Set α) : comap f m s = m (f '' s)

name: comap_iSup

theorem comap_iSup {β ι} (f : α → β) (m : ι → OuterMeasure β) :

name: restrict_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_apply (s t : Set α) (m : OuterMeasure α) : restrict s m t = m (t ∩ s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrict, inter_comm t]

name: restrict_mono
statement:
@[mono]
theorem restrict_mono {s t : Set α} (h : s ⊆ t) {m m' : OuterMeasure α} (hm : m ≤ m') :
    restrict s m ≤ restrict t m'
proof:
:= fun u => by
  simp only [restrict_apply]
  exact (hm _).trans (m'.mono <| inter_subset_inter_right _ h)

name: restrict_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_univ (m : OuterMeasure α) : restrict univ m = m
proof:
:=
  ext fun s => by simp

name: restrict_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_empty (m : OuterMeasure α) : restrict ∅ m = 0
proof:
:=
  ext fun s => by simp

name: restrict_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_iSup {ι} (s : Set α) (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) :
    restrict s (⨆ i, m i) = ⨆ i, restrict s (m i)
proof: := by simp [restrict]

name: map_comap
statement: theorem map_comap {β} (f : α → β) (m : OuterMeasure β) : map f (comap f m) = restrict (range f) m
proof:
:=
  ext fun s => congr_arg m <| by simp only [image_preimage_eq_inter_range, Subtype.range_coe]

name: map_comap_le
statement: theorem map_comap_le {β} (f : α → β) (m : OuterMeasure β) : map f (comap f m) ≤ m
proof:
:= fun _ =>
  m.mono <| image_preimage_subset _ _

name: restrict_le_self
statement: theorem restrict_le_self (m : OuterMeasure α) (s : Set α) : restrict s m ≤ m
proof:
:=
  map_comap_le _ _

name: map_le_restrict_range
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_le_restrict_range {β} {ma : OuterMeasure α} {mb : OuterMeasure β} {f : α → β} :
    map f ma ≤ restrict (range f) mb ↔ map f ma ≤ mb
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.trans (restrict_le_self _ _), fun h s => by simpa using h (s ∩ range f)⟩

name: map_comap_of_surjective
statement:
theorem map_comap_of_surjective {β} {f : α → β} (hf : Surjective f) (m : OuterMeasure β) :
    map f (comap f m) = m
proof:
:=
  ext fun s => by rw [map_apply, comap_apply, hf.image_preimage]

name: le_comap_map
statement: theorem le_comap_map {β} (f : α → β) (m : OuterMeasure α) : m ≤ comap f (map f m)
proof:
:= fun _ =>
  m.mono <| subset_preimage_image _ _

name: comap_map
statement: theorem comap_map {β} {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) (m : OuterMeasure α) : comap f (map f m) = m
proof:
:=
  ext fun s => by rw [comap_apply, map_apply, hf.preimage_image]

name: top_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top_apply {s : Set α} (h : s.Nonempty) : (⊤ : OuterMeasure α) s = ∞
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, as⟩ := h
  top_unique <| le_trans (by simp [as]) (le_iSup₂ (∞ • dirac a) trivial)

name: top_apply'
statement: theorem top_apply' (s : Set α) : (⊤ : OuterMeasure α) s = ⨅ _ : s = ∅, 0
proof:
:=
  s.eq_empty_or_nonempty.elim (fun h => by simp [h]) fun h => by simp [h, h.ne_empty]

name: comap_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_top (f : α → β) : comap f ⊤ = ⊤
proof:
:=
  ext_nonempty fun s hs => by rw [comap_apply, top_apply hs, top_apply (hs.image _)]

name: map_top
statement: theorem map_top (f : α → β) : map f ⊤ = restrict (range f) ⊤
proof:
:=
  ext fun s => by
    rw [map_apply, restrict_apply, ← image_preimage_eq_inter_range, top_apply', top_apply',
      Set.image_eq_empty]

name: map_top_of_surjective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_top_of_surjective (f : α → β) (hf : Surjective f) : map f ⊤ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_top, hf.range_eq, restrict_univ]

name: ofFunction_eq
statement:
theorem ofFunction_eq (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (m : AddContent ℝ≥0∞ C)
    (m_sigma_subadd : m.IsSigmaSubadditive) (m_top : ∀ s ∉ C, m s = ∞) (hs : s ∈ C) :
    OuterMeasure.ofFunction m addContent_empty s = m s
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (OuterMeasure.ofFunction_le s) ?_
  rw [OuterMeasure.ofFunction_eq_iInf_mem _ _ m_top]
  refine le_iInf fun f ↦ le_iInf fun hf ↦ le_iInf fun hs_subset ↦ ?_
  calc m s = m (s ∩ ⋃ i, f i) := by rw [inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hs_subset]
    _ = m (⋃ i, s ∩ f i) := by rw [inter_iUnion]
    _ ≤ ∑' i, m (s ∩ f i) := by
      refine m_sigma_subadd (fun i ↦ hC.inter_mem _ hs _ (hf i)) ?_
      rwa [← inter_iUnion, inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hs_subset]
    _ ≤ ∑' i, m (f i) := by
      refine ENNReal.summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun i ↦ ?_) ENNReal.summable
      exact addContent_mono hC (hC.inter_mem _ hs _ (hf i)) (hf i) Set.inter_subset_right

name: inducedOuterMeasure_eq
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_eq (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (m : AddContent ℝ≥0∞ C)
    (m_sigma_subadd : m.IsSigmaSubadditive) (hs : s ∈ C) :
    inducedOuterMeasure (fun x _ ↦ m x) hC.empty_mem addContent_empty s = m s
proof:
:= by
  suffices inducedOuterMeasure (fun x _ ↦ m x) hC.empty_mem addContent_empty s = m.extend hC s by
    rwa [m.extend_eq hC hs] at this
  refine Eq.trans ?_ ((m.extend hC).ofFunction_eq hC ?_ ?_ hs)
  · congr
  · intro f hf hf_mem
    rw [m.extend_eq hC hf_mem]
    refine (m_sigma_subadd hf hf_mem).trans_eq ?_
    congr with i
    rw [m.extend_eq hC (hf i)]
  · exact fun _ ↦ m.extend_eq_top _

name: isCaratheodory_ofFunction_of_mem
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_ofFunction_of_mem (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (m : AddContent ℝ≥0∞ C)
    (m_top : ∀ s ∉ C, m s = ∞) (hs : s ∈ C) :
    (OuterMeasure.ofFunction m addContent_empty).IsCaratheodory s
proof:
:= by
  rw [OuterMeasure.isCaratheodory_iff_le']
  intro t
  conv_rhs => rw [OuterMeasure.ofFunction_eq_iInf_mem _ _ m_top]
  refine le_iInf fun f ↦ le_iInf fun hf ↦ le_iInf fun hf_subset ↦ ?_
  let A : ℕ → Finset (Set α) := fun i ↦ hC.disjointOfDiff (hf i) (hC.inter_mem _ (hf i) _ hs)
  have h_diff_eq_sUnion i : f i \ s = ⋃₀ A i := by simp [A, IsSetSemiring.sUnion_disjointOfDiff]
  have h_m_eq i : m (f i) = m (f i ∩ s) + ∑ u ∈ A i, m u :=
    eq_add_disjointOfDiff_of_subset hC (hC.inter_mem (f i) (hf i) s hs) (hf i) inter_subset_left
  simp_rw [h_m_eq]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_add]
  refine add_le_add ?_ ?_
  · refine iInf_le_of_le (fun i ↦ f i ∩ s) <| iInf_le_of_le ?_ le_rfl
    rw [← iUnion_inter]
    exact Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hf_subset
  · apply le_trans <| (OuterMeasure.ofFunction m addContent_empty).mono
      <| (iUnion_sdiff s f) ▸ sdiff_subset_sdiff_left hf_subset
    simp only [OuterMeasure.measureOf_eq_coe, A]
    apply le_trans <| measure_iUnion_le (μ := OuterMeasure.ofFunction m addContent_empty)
      (fun i ↦ f i \ s)
    apply ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum
    intro i
    simp_rw [sUnion_eq_biUnion] at h_diff_eq_sUnion
    rw [h_diff_eq_sUnion]
    obtain h6 := MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset_le
      (μ := OuterMeasure.ofFunction m addContent_empty) (A i) id
    simp only [id_eq] at h6
    exact le_trans h6 <| Finset.sum_le_sum <| fun b _ ↦ OuterMeasure.ofFunction_le b

name: isCaratheodory_inducedOuterMeasure_of_mem
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_inducedOuterMeasure_of_mem (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (m : AddContent ℝ≥0∞ C)
    {s : Set α} (hs : s ∈ C) :
    (inducedOuterMeasure (fun x _ ↦ m x) hC.empty_mem addContent_empty).IsCaratheodory s
proof:
:=
  isCaratheodory_ofFunction_of_mem hC (m.extend hC) (fun _ ↦ m.extend_eq_top hC) hs

name: isCaratheodory_inducedOuterMeasure
statement:
theorem isCaratheodory_inducedOuterMeasure (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (m : AddContent ℝ≥0∞ C)
    (s : Set α) (hs : MeasurableSet[MeasurableSpace.generateFrom C] s) :
    (inducedOuterMeasure (fun x _ ↦ m x) hC.empty_mem addContent_empty).IsCaratheodory s
proof:
:= by
  induction hs with
  | basic u hu => exact isCaratheodory_inducedOuterMeasure_of_mem hC m hu
  | empty => exact OuterMeasure.isCaratheodory_empty _
  | compl t _ h => exact OuterMeasure.isCaratheodory_compl _ h
  | iUnion f _ h => exact OuterMeasure.isCaratheodory_iUnion _ h

name: measureCaratheodory_eq_inducedOuterMeasure
statement:
theorem measureCaratheodory_eq_inducedOuterMeasure (hC : IsSetSemiring C) (m : AddContent ℝ≥0∞ C)
    (m_sigma_subadd : m.IsSigmaSubadditive) :
    m.measureCaratheodory hC m_sigma_subadd s
      = inducedOuterMeasure (fun x _ ↦ m x) hC.empty_mem addContent_empty s
proof: := rfl

name: measureCaratheodory_eq
statement:
theorem measureCaratheodory_eq (m : AddContent ℝ≥0∞ C) (hC : IsSetSemiring C)
    (m_sigma_subadd : m.IsSigmaSubadditive) (hs : s ∈ C) :
    m.measureCaratheodory hC m_sigma_subadd s = m s
proof:
:=
  m.inducedOuterMeasure_eq hC m_sigma_subadd hs

name: measure_eq
statement:
theorem measure_eq [mα : MeasurableSpace α] (m : AddContent ℝ≥0∞ C) (hC : IsSetSemiring C)
    (hC_gen : mα = MeasurableSpace.generateFrom C) (m_sigma_subadd : m.IsSigmaSubadditive)
    (hs : s ∈ C) :
    m.measure hC hC_gen.le m_sigma_subadd s = m s
proof:
:= by
  rw [measure, trim_measurableSet_eq]
  · exact m.measureCaratheodory_eq hC m_sigma_subadd hs
  · rw [hC_gen]
    apply MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom hs

name: measureOf_eq_coe
statement: @[simp] theorem measureOf_eq_coe (m : OuterMeasure α) : m.measureOf = m
proof: := rfl

name: coe_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_mk (m : Set α → ℝ≥0∞) (h₁ h₂ h₃) : OuterMeasure.mk m h₁ h₂ h₃ = m
proof: := rfl

name: mem_ae_iff
statement: theorem mem_ae_iff {s : Set α} : s ∈ ae μ ↔ μ sᶜ = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ae_iff
statement: theorem ae_iff {p : α → Prop} : (∀ᵐ a ∂μ, p a) ↔ μ { a | ¬p a } = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: compl_mem_ae_iff
statement: theorem compl_mem_ae_iff {s : Set α} : sᶜ ∈ ae μ ↔ μ s = 0

name: frequently_ae_iff

name: _root_.Set.EqOn.aeEq

name: ae_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma ae_eq_top : ae μ = ⊤ ↔ ∀ a, μ {a} ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Filter.ext_iff, mem_ae_iff, mem_top, ne_eq]
  refine ⟨fun h a ha ↦ by simpa [ha] using (h {a}ᶜ).1, fun h s ↦ ⟨fun hs ↦ ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [← compl_empty_iff, ← not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty]

name: ae_eq_empty

name: ae_le_set

proof:

    s ≤ᵐ[μ] t ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → x ∈ t := Iff.rfl

name: sdiff_ae_eq_self

name: measure_symmDiff_eq_zero_iff

theorem measure_symmDiff_eq_zero_iff {s t : Set α} : μ (s ∆ t) = 0 ↔ s =ᵐ[μ] t

name: union_ae_eq_univ_of_ae_eq_univ_left

proof:
:=

name: union_ae_eq_univ_of_ae_eq_univ_right

:=

name: _root_.Set.mulIndicator_ae_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem _root_.Set.mulIndicator_ae_eq_one {M : Type*} [One M] {f : α → M} {s : Set α} :
    s.mulIndicator f =ᵐ[μ] 1 ↔ μ (s ∩ f.mulSupport) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [EventuallyEq, eventually_iff, ae, compl_ofPred]; rfl

name: measure_mono_ae
statement:
@[mono]
theorem measure_mono_ae (H : s ≤ᵐ[μ] t) : μ s ≤ μ t
proof:
:=
  calc
    μ s ≤ μ (s ∪ t) := measure_mono subset_union_left
    _ = μ (t ∪ s \ t) := by rw [union_sdiff_self, Set.union_comm]
    _ ≤ μ t + μ (s \ t) := measure_union_le _ _
    _ = μ t := by rw [ae_le_set.1 H, add_zero]

name: measure_congr
statement: theorem measure_congr (H : s =ᵐ[μ] t) : μ s = μ t
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm H.subset.measure_le H.symm.subset.measure_le

name: measure_mono_null_ae
statement: theorem measure_mono_null_ae (H : s ≤ᵐ[μ] t) (ht : μ t = 0) : μ s = 0
proof:
:=
  nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 <| ht ▸ H.measure_le

name: extend_eq
statement: theorem extend_eq {s : α} (h : P s) : extend m s = m s h
proof: := by simp [extend, h]

name: extend_eq_top
statement: theorem extend_eq_top {s : α} (h : ¬P s) : extend m s = ∞
proof: := by simp [extend, h]

name: smul_extend
statement:
theorem smul_extend [Semiring R] [IsDomain R] [Module R ℝ≥0∞] [IsScalarTower R ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0∞]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree R ℝ≥0∞] {c : R} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    c • extend m = extend fun s h => c • m s h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext s; by_cases h : P s <;> simp [extend, ENNReal.smul_top, *]

name: ennreal_smul_extend
statement: lemma ennreal_smul_extend {c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c ≠ 0) : c • extend m = extend fun s h => c • m s h
proof:
:= by
  ext s; by_cases h : P s <;> simp [extend, *]

name: le_extend
statement: theorem le_extend {s : α} (h : P s) : m s h ≤ extend m s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extend, le_iInf_iff]
  intro
  rfl

name: extend_congr
proof:
:=
  iInf_congr_Prop hP fun _h => hm _ _

name: extend_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extend_top {α : Type*} {P : α → Prop} : extend (fun _ _ => ∞ : ∀ s : α, P s → ℝ≥0∞) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ => iInf_eq_top.mpr fun _ => rfl

name: extend_iUnion_nat
statement:
theorem extend_iUnion_nat {f : ℕ → Set α} (hm : ∀ i, P (f i))
    (mU : m (⋃ i, f i) (PU hm) = ∑' i, m (f i) (hm i)) :
    extend m (⋃ i, f i) = ∑' i, extend m (f i)
proof:
:=
  (extend_eq _ _).trans <|
    mU.trans <| by
      congr with i
      rw [extend_eq]

name: extend_empty
statement: theorem extend_empty : extend m ∅ = 0
proof:
:=
  (extend_eq _ P0).trans m0

name: extend_iUnion_le_tsum_nat'
statement:
theorem extend_iUnion_le_tsum_nat' (s : ℕ → Set α) :
    extend m (⋃ i, s i) ≤ ∑' i, extend m (s i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : ∀ i, P (s i)
  · rw [extend_eq _ (PU h), congr_arg tsum _]
    · apply msU h
    funext i
    apply extend_eq _ (h i)
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    grw [← ENNReal.le_tsum i, extend_eq_top _ hi]
    exact le_top

name: extend_mono'
statement: theorem extend_mono' ⦃s₁ s₂ : Set α⦄ (h₁ : P s₁) (hs : s₁ ⊆ s₂) : extend m s₁ ≤ extend m s₂
proof:
:= by
  refine le_iInf ?_
  intro h₂
  rw [extend_eq m h₁]
  exact m_mono h₁ h₂ hs

name: extend_iUnion
statement:
theorem extend_iUnion {β} [Countable β] {f : β → Set α} (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on f))
    (hm : ∀ i, P (f i)) : extend m (⋃ i, f i) = ∑' i, extend m (f i)
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_encodable β
  rw [← Encodable.iUnion_decode₂, ← tsum_iUnion_decode₂]
  · exact
      extend_iUnion_nat PU (fun n => Encodable.iUnion_decode₂_cases P0 hm)
        (mU _ (Encodable.iUnion_decode₂_disjoint_on hd))
  · exact extend_empty P0 m0

name: extend_union
statement:
theorem extend_union {s₁ s₂ : Set α} (hd : Disjoint s₁ s₂) (h₁ : P s₁) (h₂ : P s₂) :
    extend m (s₁ ∪ s₂) = extend m s₁ + extend m s₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [union_eq_iUnion,
    extend_iUnion P0 m0 PU mU (pairwise_disjoint_on_bool.2 hd) (Bool.forall_bool.2 ⟨h₂, h₁⟩),
    tsum_fintype]
  simp

name: le_inducedOuterMeasure
statement:
theorem le_inducedOuterMeasure {μ : OuterMeasure α} :
    μ ≤ inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 ↔ ∀ (s) (hs : P s), μ s ≤ m s hs
proof:
:=
  le_ofFunction.trans <| forall_congr' fun _s => le_iInf_iff

name: inducedOuterMeasure_union_of_false_of_nonempty_inter
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_union_of_false_of_nonempty_inter {s t : Set α}
    (h : ∀ u, (s ∩ u).Nonempty → (t ∩ u).Nonempty → ¬P u) :
    inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 (s ∪ t) =
      inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 s + inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 t
proof:
:=
  ofFunction_union_of_top_of_nonempty_inter fun u hsu htu => @iInf_of_empty _ _ _ ⟨h u hsu htu⟩ _

name: inducedOuterMeasure_eq_extend'
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_eq_extend' {s : Set α} (hs : P s) :
    inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 s = extend m s
proof:
:=
  ofFunction_eq s (fun _t => extend_mono' m_mono hs) (extend_iUnion_le_tsum_nat' PU msU)

name: inducedOuterMeasure_eq'
statement: theorem inducedOuterMeasure_eq' {s : Set α} (hs : P s) : inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 s = m s hs
proof:
:=
  (inducedOuterMeasure_eq_extend' PU msU m_mono hs).trans <| extend_eq _ _

name: inducedOuterMeasure_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_eq_iInf (s : Set α) :
    inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 s = ⨅ (t : Set α) (ht : P t) (_ : s ⊆ t), m t ht
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp only [le_iInf_iff]
    intro t ht hs
    grw [hs]
    exact le_of_eq (inducedOuterMeasure_eq' _ msU m_mono _)
  · refine le_iInf ?_
    intro f
    refine le_iInf ?_
    intro hf
    refine le_trans ?_ (extend_iUnion_le_tsum_nat' _ msU _)
    refine le_iInf ?_
    intro h2f
    exact iInf_le_of_le _ (iInf_le_of_le h2f <| iInf_le _ hf)

name: inducedOuterMeasure_zero
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_zero (Pu : P univ) :
    inducedOuterMeasure (fun _ _ => 0) P0 (by simp) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [inducedOuterMeasure_eq_iInf PU (fun _ _ => by simp) (fun _ _ => by simp)]
  exact le_antisymm (iInf₂_le_of_le univ Pu (by simp)) zero_le

name: inducedOuterMeasure_preimage
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_preimage (f : α ≃ α) (Pm : ∀ s : Set α, P (f ⁻¹' s) ↔ P s)
    (mm : ∀ (s : Set α) (hs : P s), m (f ⁻¹' s) ((Pm _).mpr hs) = m s hs) {A : Set α} :
    inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 (f ⁻¹' A) = inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 A
proof:
:= by
    rw [inducedOuterMeasure_eq_iInf _ msU m_mono, inducedOuterMeasure_eq_iInf _ msU m_mono]; symm
    refine f.injective.preimage_surjective.iInf_congr (preimage f) fun s => ?_
    refine iInf_congr_Prop (Pm s) ?_; intro hs
    refine iInf_congr_Prop f.surjective.preimage_subset_preimage_iff ?_
    intro _; exact mm s hs

name: inducedOuterMeasure_exists_set
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_exists_set {s : Set α} (hs : inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 s ≠ ∞)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : Set α,
      P t ∧ s ⊆ t ∧ inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 t ≤ inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 s + ε
proof:
:= by
  have h := ENNReal.lt_add_right hs hε
  conv at h =>
    lhs
    rw [inducedOuterMeasure_eq_iInf _ msU m_mono]
  simp only [iInf_lt_iff] at h
  rcases h with ⟨t, h1t, h2t, h3t⟩
  exact
    ⟨t, h1t, h2t, le_trans (le_of_eq <| inducedOuterMeasure_eq' _ msU m_mono h1t) (le_of_lt h3t)⟩

name: inducedOuterMeasure_caratheodory
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_caratheodory (s : Set α) :
    MeasurableSet[(inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0).caratheodory] s ↔
      ∀ t : Set α,
        P t →
          inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 (t ∩ s) + inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 (t \ s) ≤
            inducedOuterMeasure m P0 m0 t
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCaratheodory_iff_le]
  constructor
  · intro h t _ht
    exact h t
  · intro h u
    conv_rhs => rw [inducedOuterMeasure_eq_iInf _ msU m_mono]
    refine le_iInf ?_
    intro t
    refine le_iInf ?_
    intro ht
    refine le_iInf ?_
    intro h2t
    refine le_trans ?_ ((h t ht).trans_eq <| inducedOuterMeasure_eq' _ msU m_mono ht)
    gcongr

name: extend_mono
statement:
theorem extend_mono {s₁ s₂ : Set α} (h₁ : MeasurableSet s₁) (hs : s₁ ⊆ s₂) :
    extend m s₁ ≤ extend m s₂
proof:
:= by
  refine le_iInf ?_; intro h₂
  have :=
    extend_union MeasurableSet.empty m0 MeasurableSet.iUnion mU disjoint_sdiff_self_right h₁
      (h₂.diff h₁)
  rw [union_sdiff_cancel hs] at this
  rw [← extend_eq m]
  exact le_iff_exists_add.2 ⟨_, this⟩

name: extend_iUnion_le_tsum_nat
statement:
theorem extend_iUnion_le_tsum_nat : ∀ s : ℕ → Set α,
    extend m (⋃ i, s i) ≤ ∑' i, extend m (s i)
proof:
:= by
  refine extend_iUnion_le_tsum_nat' MeasurableSet.iUnion ?_; intro f h
  simp +singlePass only [iUnion_disjointed.symm]
  rw [mU (MeasurableSet.disjointed h) (disjoint_disjointed _)]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun i => ?_
  rw [← extend_eq m, ← extend_eq m]
  exact extend_mono m0 mU (MeasurableSet.disjointed h _) (disjointed_le f _)

name: inducedOuterMeasure_eq_extend
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_eq_extend {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    inducedOuterMeasure m MeasurableSet.empty m0 s = extend m s
proof:
:=
  ofFunction_eq s (fun _t => extend_mono m0 mU hs) (extend_iUnion_le_tsum_nat m0 mU)

name: inducedOuterMeasure_eq
statement:
theorem inducedOuterMeasure_eq {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    inducedOuterMeasure m MeasurableSet.empty m0 s = m s hs
proof:
:=
  (inducedOuterMeasure_eq_extend m0 mU hs).trans <| extend_eq _ _

name: le_trim_iff
statement:
theorem le_trim_iff {m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α} :
    m₁ ≤ m₂.trim ↔ ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → m₁ s ≤ m₂ s
proof:
:=
  le_inducedOuterMeasure

name: le_trim
statement: theorem le_trim : m ≤ m.trim
proof: := le_trim_iff.2 fun _ _ ↦ le_rfl

name: null_of_trim_null
statement: lemma null_of_trim_null {s : Set α} (h : m.trim s = 0) : m s = 0
proof:
:=
  nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 <| (le_trim m s).trans_eq h

name: trim_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trim_eq {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) : m.trim s = m s
proof:
:=
  inducedOuterMeasure_eq' MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun f _hf => measure_iUnion_le f)
    (fun _ _ _ _ h => measure_mono h) hs

name: trim_congr
statement:
theorem trim_congr {m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α} (H : ∀ {s : Set α}, MeasurableSet s → m₁ s = m₂ s) :
    m₁.trim = m₂.trim
proof:
:= by
  simp +contextual only [trim, H]

name: trim_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem trim_mono : Monotone (trim : OuterMeasure α → OuterMeasure α)
proof:
:= fun _m₁ _m₂ H _s =>
  iInf₂_mono fun _f _hs => ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun _b => iInf_mono fun _hf => H _

name: trim_anti_measurableSpace
statement:
theorem trim_anti_measurableSpace {α} (m : OuterMeasure α) {m0 m1 : MeasurableSpace α}
    (h : m0 ≤ m1) : @trim _ m1 m ≤ @trim _ m0 m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_trim_iff]
  intro s hs
  rw [trim_eq _ (h s hs)]

name: trim_le_trim_iff
statement:
theorem trim_le_trim_iff {m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α} :
    m₁.trim ≤ m₂.trim ↔ ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → m₁ s ≤ m₂ s
proof:
:=
  le_trim_iff.trans <| forall₂_congr fun s hs => by rw [trim_eq _ hs]

name: trim_eq_trim_iff
statement:
theorem trim_eq_trim_iff {m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α} :
    m₁.trim = m₂.trim ↔ ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → m₁ s = m₂ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_antisymm_iff, trim_le_trim_iff, forall_and]

name: trim_eq_iInf
statement: theorem trim_eq_iInf (s : Set α) : m.trim s = ⨅ (t) (_ : s ⊆ t) (_ : MeasurableSet t), m t
proof:
:= by
  simp +singlePass only [iInf_comm]
  exact
    inducedOuterMeasure_eq_iInf MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun f _ => measure_iUnion_le f)
      (fun _ _ _ _ h => measure_mono h) s

name: trim_eq_iInf'
statement: theorem trim_eq_iInf' (s : Set α) : m.trim s = ⨅ t : { t // s ⊆ t ∧ MeasurableSet t }, m t
proof:
:= by
  simp [iInf_subtype, iInf_and, trim_eq_iInf]

name: trim_trim
statement: theorem trim_trim (m : OuterMeasure α) : m.trim.trim = m.trim
proof:
:=
  trim_eq_trim_iff.2 fun _s => m.trim_eq

name: trim_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trim_top : (⊤ : OuterMeasure α).trim = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_unique <| le_trim _

name: trim_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trim_zero : (0 : OuterMeasure α).trim = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  exact nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 <| (measure_mono (subset_univ s)).trans_eq <| trim_eq _ .univ

name: trim_sum_ge
statement: theorem trim_sum_ge {ι} (m : ι → OuterMeasure α) : (sum fun i => (m i).trim) ≤ (sum m).trim
proof:
:=
  fun s => by
  simp only [sum_apply, trim_eq_iInf, le_iInf_iff]
  exact fun t st ht =>
    ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun i => iInf_le_of_le t <| iInf_le_of_le st <| iInf_le _ ht

name: exists_measurable_superset_eq_trim
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_superset_eq_trim (m : OuterMeasure α) (s : Set α) :
    ∃ t, s ⊆ t ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧ m t = m.trim s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [trim_eq_iInf]; set ms := ⨅ (t : Set α) (_ : s ⊆ t) (_ : MeasurableSet t), m t
  by_cases hs : ms = ∞
  · simp only [hs]
    simp only [iInf_eq_top, ms] at hs
    exact ⟨univ, subset_univ s, MeasurableSet.univ, hs _ (subset_univ s) MeasurableSet.univ⟩
  · have : ∀ r > ms, ∃ t, s ⊆ t ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧ m t < r := by
      intro r hs
      have : ∃ t, MeasurableSet t ∧ s ⊆ t ∧ m t < r := by simpa [ms, iInf_lt_iff] using hs
      rcases this with ⟨t, hmt, hin, hlt⟩
      exists t
    have : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ t, s ⊆ t ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧ m t < ms + (n : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
      intro n
      refine this _ (ENNReal.lt_add_right hs ?_)
      simp
    choose t hsub hm hm' using this
    refine ⟨⋂ n, t n, subset_iInter hsub, MeasurableSet.iInter hm, ?_⟩
    have : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ms + (n : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 (ms + 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.add ENNReal.tendsto_inv_nat_nhds_zero
    rw [add_zero] at this
    refine le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto' this fun n => ?_) ?_
    · exact le_trans (measure_mono <| iInter_subset t n) (hm' n).le
    · refine iInf_le_of_le (⋂ n, t n) ?_
      refine iInf_le_of_le (subset_iInter hsub) ?_
      exact iInf_le _ (MeasurableSet.iInter hm)

name: exists_measurable_superset_of_trim_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_superset_of_trim_eq_zero {m : OuterMeasure α} {s : Set α}
    (h : m.trim s = 0) : ∃ t, s ⊆ t ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧ m t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_measurable_superset_eq_trim m s with ⟨t, hst, ht, hm⟩
  exact ⟨t, hst, ht, h ▸ hm⟩

name: exists_measurable_superset_forall_eq_trim
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_superset_forall_eq_trim {ι} [Countable ι] (μ : ι → OuterMeasure α)
    (s : Set α) : ∃ t, s ⊆ t ∧ MeasurableSet t ∧ ∀ i, μ i t = (μ i).trim s
proof:
:= by
  choose t hst ht hμt using fun i => (μ i).exists_measurable_superset_eq_trim s
  replace hst := subset_iInter hst
  replace ht := MeasurableSet.iInter ht
  refine ⟨⋂ i, t i, hst, ht, fun i => le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  exacts [hμt i ▸ (μ i).mono (iInter_subset _ _), (measure_mono hst).trans_eq ((μ i).trim_eq ht)]

name: trim_binop
statement:
theorem trim_binop {m₁ m₂ m₃ : OuterMeasure α} {op : ℝ≥0∞ → ℝ≥0∞ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ s, m₁ s = op (m₂ s) (m₃ s)) (s : Set α) : m₁.trim s = op (m₂.trim s) (m₃.trim s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_measurable_superset_forall_eq_trim ![m₁, m₂, m₃] s with ⟨t, _hst, _ht, htm⟩
  simp only [Fin.forall_iff_succ, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ] at htm
  rw [← htm.1, ← htm.2.1, ← htm.2.2.1, h]

name: trim_op
statement:
theorem trim_op {m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α} {op : ℝ≥0∞ → ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ s, m₁ s = op (m₂ s))
    (s : Set α) : m₁.trim s = op (m₂.trim s)
proof:
:=
  @trim_binop α _ m₁ m₂ 0 (fun a _b => op a) h s

name: trim_add
statement: theorem trim_add (m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α) : (m₁ + m₂).trim = m₁.trim + m₂.trim
proof:
:=
  ext <| trim_binop (add_apply m₁ m₂)

name: trim_smul
statement:
theorem trim_smul {R : Type*} [SMul R ℝ≥0∞] [IsScalarTower R ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0∞] (c : R)
    (m : OuterMeasure α) : (c • m).trim = c • m.trim
proof:
:=
  ext <| trim_op (smul_apply m c)

name: trim_sup
statement: theorem trim_sup (m₁ m₂ : OuterMeasure α) : (m₁ ⊔ m₂).trim = m₁.trim ⊔ m₂.trim
proof:
:=
  ext fun s => (trim_binop (sup_apply m₁ m₂) s).trans (sup_apply _ _ _).symm

name: trim_iSup
statement:
theorem trim_iSup {ι} [Countable ι] (μ : ι → OuterMeasure α) :
    trim (⨆ i, μ i) = ⨆ i, trim (μ i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← @iSup_plift_down _ ι]
  ext1 s
  obtain ⟨t, _, _, hμt⟩ :=
    exists_measurable_superset_forall_eq_trim
      (Option.elim' (⨆ i, μ (PLift.down i)) (μ ∘ PLift.down)) s
  simp only [Option.forall, Option.elim'] at hμt
  simp only [iSup_apply, ← hμt.1]
  exact iSup_congr hμt.2

name: restrict_trim
statement:
theorem restrict_trim {μ : OuterMeasure α} {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (restrict s μ).trim = restrict s μ.trim
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun t => ?_) (le_trim_iff.2 fun t ht => ?_)
  · rw [restrict_apply]
    rcases μ.exists_measurable_superset_eq_trim (t ∩ s) with ⟨t', htt', ht', hμt'⟩
    rw [← hμt']
    rw [inter_subset] at htt'
    refine (measure_mono htt').trans ?_
    rw [trim_eq _ (hs.compl.union ht'), restrict_apply, union_inter_distrib_right, compl_inter_self,
      Set.empty_union]
    exact measure_mono inter_subset_left
  · rw [restrict_apply, trim_eq _ (ht.inter hs), restrict_apply]

name: transpose_eq_cbmApplyMeasure
statement:
lemma transpose_eq_cbmApplyMeasure (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :
    μ.transpose B = cbmApplyMeasure μ B
proof: := by rfl

name: cbmApplyMeasure_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cbmApplyMeasure_apply (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) (s : Set X) (x : E) :
    cbmApplyMeasure μ B s x = B x (μ s)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: cbmApplyMeasure_union
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [of_union hdisj hs ht]

name: norm_cbmApplyMeasure_le
statement:
theorem norm_cbmApplyMeasure_le (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) (s : Set X) :
    ‖cbmApplyMeasure μ B s‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * ‖μ s‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [opNorm_le_iff (by positivity)]
  intro x
  grw [cbmApplyMeasure_apply, le_opNorm₂, mul_right_comm]

name: dominatedFinMeasAdditive_cbmApplyMeasure
statement:
theorem dominatedFinMeasAdditive_cbmApplyMeasure (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :
    DominatedFinMeasAdditive μ.variation (μ.transpose B) ‖B‖
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s t hs ht _ _ hdisj ↦ cbmApplyMeasure_union μ B hs ht hdisj, fun s hs hsf ↦ ?_⟩
  apply (norm_cbmApplyMeasure_le _ _ _).trans
  gcongr
  exact norm_measure_le_variation hsf.ne

name: dominatedFinMeasAdditive_transpose_cbmApplyMeasure
statement:
theorem dominatedFinMeasAdditive_transpose_cbmApplyMeasure
    (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :
    DominatedFinMeasAdditive (μ.transpose B).variation (μ.transpose B) 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s t hs ht _ _ hdisj ↦ cbmApplyMeasure_union μ B hs ht hdisj, fun s hs hsf ↦ ?_⟩
  simpa using! norm_measure_le_variation hsf.ne

name: transpose_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma transpose_zero : (0 : VectorMeasure X F).transpose B = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [transpose]

name: transpose_restrict
statement:
lemma transpose_restrict (s : Set X) :
    (μ.restrict s).transpose B = (μ.transpose B).restrict s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : MeasurableSet s
  · ext t ht : 1
    simp [VectorMeasure.restrict_apply, hs, ht, transpose]
  · simp [restrict_not_measurable _ hs]

name: transpose_map
statement: lemma transpose_map : (μ.map φ).transpose B = (μ.transpose B).map φ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hφ : Measurable φ; swap
  · simp [map, hφ]
  ext s hs
  simp [transpose, map_apply, hs, hφ]

name: transpose_add
statement:
lemma transpose_add :
    (μ + ν).transpose B = μ.transpose B + ν.transpose B
proof:
:= by
  simp [transpose]

name: transpose_smul
statement:
lemma transpose_smul (c : ℝ) :
    (c • μ).transpose B = c • μ.transpose B
proof:
:= by
  simp [transpose, mapRange_smul]

name: transpose_dirac
statement:
lemma transpose_dirac (x : X) (v : F) :
    (dirac x v).transpose B = dirac x (B.flip v)
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs : 1
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> simp [transpose, hx, hs]

name: variation_transpose_le
statement:
lemma variation_transpose_le :
    (μ.transpose B).variation ≤ ‖B‖₊ • μ.variation
proof:
:= by
  apply variation_le_of_forall_enorm_le (fun s hs ↦ ?_)
  apply opENorm_le_bound _ (fun x ↦ ?_)
  simp only [transpose, mapRange_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, coe_coe, flip_apply,
    Measure.smul_apply, Measure.nnreal_smul_coe_apply]
  grw [le_opENorm, le_opENorm, enorm_measure_le_variation, ← enorm_eq_nnnorm]
  exact le_of_eq (by ring)

name: absolutelyContinuous_variation_transpose
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_variation_transpose (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :
    (μ.transpose B).variation ≪ μ.variation
proof:
:=
  Measure.absolutelyContinuous_of_le_smul (variation_transpose_le μ B)

name: variation_transpose_eq_smul
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (variation_transpose_le _ _).trans
    gcongr
    apply opNNNorm_le_bound _ _ (fun x ↦ opNNNorm_le_bound _ _ (fun y ↦ by simp [hB]))
  · rcases eq_or_ne C 0 with rfl | hC
    · simp [Measure.zero_le]
    suffices μ.variation ≤ C⁻¹ • (μ.transpose B).variation by
      grw [this, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hC, one_smul]
    apply variation_le_of_forall_enorm_le (fun s hs ↦ ?_)
    have : ‖μ s‖ₑ ≤ C⁻¹ • ‖(μ.transpose B) s‖ₑ := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ (x : E), x ≠ 0 := exists_ne 0
      have : ‖B.flip (μ s) x‖₊ ≤ ‖B.flip (μ s)‖₊ * ‖x‖₊ := le_opNNNorm _ _
      simp only [flip_apply, hB] at this
      rw [mul_right_comm, mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (by simpa), ← le_div_iff₀' (by positivity),
        div_eq_inv_mul, ← ENNReal.coe_le_coe] at this
      exact this
    grw [this, enorm_measure_le_variation, Measure.smul_apply]

name: variation_transpose_eq
statement:
lemma variation_transpose_eq [Nontrivial E] (hB : ∀ x y, ‖B x y‖₊ = ‖x‖₊ * ‖y‖₊) :
    (μ.transpose B).variation = μ.variation
proof:
:= by
  have : μ.variation = (1 : ℝ≥0) • μ.variation := by simp
  rw [this]
  apply variation_transpose_eq_smul
  simpa using hB

name: variation_transpose_lsmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma variation_transpose_lsmul :
    (μ.transpose (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)).variation = μ.variation
proof:
:= by
  apply variation_transpose_eq
  simp [nnnorm_smul, mul_comm]

name: variation_transpose_lsmul_flip
statement:
@[simp] lemma variation_transpose_lsmul_flip [Nontrivial E] {μ : SignedMeasure X} :
    (μ.transpose (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ (E := E)).flip).variation = μ.variation
proof:
:= by
  apply variation_transpose_eq
  simp [nnnorm_smul, mul_comm]

name: integral_eq_setToFun
statement:
lemma integral_eq_setToFun : ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; μ] = setToFun μ.variation (μ.transpose B)
    (dominatedFinMeasAdditive_cbmApplyMeasure μ B) f
proof: := by rfl

name: integral_eq_setToFun_transpose
statement:
lemma integral_eq_setToFun_transpose (hf : μ.Integrable f) :
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; μ] = setToFun (μ.transpose B).variation (μ.transpose B)
      (dominatedFinMeasAdditive_transpose_cbmApplyMeasure μ B) f
proof:
:=
  setToFun_congr_measure_of_integrable _ (by simp) (variation_transpose_le _ _) _ _ _ hf

name: integral_of_not_completeSpace
statement:
theorem integral_of_not_completeSpace (hG : ¬CompleteSpace G) :
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; μ] = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [integral, setToFun, hG]

name: transpose_zero_cbm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transpose_zero_cbm (μ : VectorMeasure X F) :
    μ.transpose (0 : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) = 0
proof:
:= by

  simp [transpose]

name: transpose_add_vectorMeasure
statement:

theorem transpose_add_vectorMeasure (μ ν : VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :
    (μ + ν).transpose B = μ.transpose B + ν.transpose B
proof:

name: transpose_add_cbm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transpose_add_cbm (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B C : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :
    μ.transpose (B + C) = μ.transpose B + μ.transpose C
proof:
:= by

  simp [transpose]

name: transpose_finsetSum_vectorMeasure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transpose_finsetSum_vectorMeasure (μ : ι → VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G)
    (s : Finset ι) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, μ i).transpose B = ∑ i ∈ s, (μ i).transpose B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s his ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert, his, ih]

name: transpose_finsetSum_cbm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transpose_finsetSum_cbm (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B : ι → E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) (s : Finset ι) :
    μ.transpose (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, μ.transpose (B i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s his ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert, his, ih]

name: transpose_neg_vectorMeasure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transpose_neg_vectorMeasure (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :
    (-μ).transpose B = - (μ.transpose B)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [transpose]

name: transpose_neg_cbm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transpose_neg_cbm (μ : VectorMeasure X F) (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) :

name: transpose_sub_vectorMeasure

name: transpose_sub_cbm

  simp [transpose]

name: integral_undef
statement:
theorem integral_undef (h : ¬ μ.Integrable f) :

  simp [integral, setToFun_undef _ h]

name: integral_zero
statement:

theorem integral_zero : ∫ᵛ _, 0 ∂[B; μ] = 0

  setToFun_zero _

name: integral_congr_ae
statement:
theorem integral_congr_ae (h : f =ᵐ[μ.variation] g) :

name: Integrable.smul
statement:
@[to_fun] lemma Integrable.smul {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜] [SMulZeroClass 𝕜 E]
    [IsBoundedSMul 𝕜 E] (c : 𝕜) (hf : μ.Integrable f) :

name: Integrable.finsetSum
statement:
theorem Integrable.finsetSum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → X → E}

name: integral_smul_vectorMeasure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_smul_vectorMeasure (f : X → E) (c : ℝ) :
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; c • μ] = c • ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; μ]
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hG : CompleteSpace G; swap
  · simp [integral, setToFun, hG]
  simp_rw [integral, ← setToFun_smul_left]
  have : (c • μ).variation = ‖c‖₊ • μ.variation := by
    simp [variation_smul]
  simp only [this]
  have : DominatedFinMeasAdditive μ.variation ((c • μ).transpose B) (‖c‖ * ‖B‖) := by
    simp only [transpose_smul, FunLike.coe_smul]
    exact (dominatedFinMeasAdditive_cbmApplyMeasure μ B).smul c
  rw! [← setToFun_congr_smul_measure' _ this, transpose_smul]
  rfl

name: integral_smul_nnreal_vectorMeasure

theorem integral_smul_nnreal_vectorMeasure (f : X → E) (c : ℝ≥0) :

proof:
:=
  setToFun_add_left'' (by simp [transpose]) hμ hν (by grw [variation_add_le])
    (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)

name: integral_finsetSum_vectorMeasure
proof:
:= by

  | insert a s ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp, ha, not_false_eq_true,
      Finset.sum_insert] at hf ⊢

name: integral_neg_vectorMeasure

name: integral_zero_cbm

name: integral_add_cbm
statement:
theorem integral_add_cbm (hB : μ.Integrable f) :
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B + C; μ] = ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; μ] + ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[C; μ]
proof:
:= by
  refine setToFun_add_left'' (by simp [transpose]) hB hB ?_
    (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  nth_rw 1 [← add_zero μ.variation]

  exact Measure.zero_le μ.variation

name: norm_integral_le_lintegral_norm
statement:
theorem norm_integral_le_lintegral_norm :
    ‖∫ᵛ a, f a ∂[B; μ]‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * ENNReal.toReal (∫⁻ a, ENNReal.ofReal ‖f a‖ ∂μ.variation)
proof:
:=
  (norm_setToFun_le_toReal _ (by simp)).trans (by simp)

name: norm_integral_le_integral_norm
statement:
theorem norm_integral_le_integral_norm :
    ‖∫ᵛ a, f a ∂[B; μ]‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * ∫ a, ‖f a‖ ∂μ.variation
proof:
:= by
  have le_ae : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ.variation, 0 ≤ ‖f a‖ :=
    Eventually.of_forall fun a => norm_nonneg _
  by_cases h : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ.variation
  · calc ‖∫ᵛ a, f a ∂[B; μ]‖
    _ ≤ ‖B‖ * ENNReal.toReal (∫⁻ a, ENNReal.ofReal ‖f a‖ ∂μ.variation) :=
      norm_integral_le_lintegral_norm
    _ = ‖B‖ * ∫ a, ‖f a‖ ∂μ.variation := by
      rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae le_ae <| h.norm]
  · rw [integral_non_aestronglyMeasurable h, norm_zero]
    positivity

name: enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm
statement:
theorem enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm :
    ‖∫ᵛ a, f a ∂[B; μ]‖ₑ ≤ ‖B‖ₑ * ∫⁻ a, ‖f a‖ₑ ∂μ.variation
proof:
:= by
  apply (enorm_setToFun_le _ (by simp)).trans
  gcongr
  simp [← coe_nnnorm]

name: enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm_transpose
statement:
theorem enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm_transpose :
    ‖∫ᵛ a, f a ∂[B; μ]‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻ a, ‖f a‖ₑ ∂(μ.transpose B).variation
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : μ.Integrable f
  · rw [integral_eq_setToFun_transpose hf]
    apply (enorm_setToFun_le _ (by simp)).trans (by simp)
  · simp [integral_undef hf]

name: dist_integral_le_lintegral_edist
statement:
theorem dist_integral_le_lintegral_edist (hf : μ.Integrable f) (hg : μ.Integrable g) :
    dist (∫ᵛ a, f a ∂[B; μ]) (∫ᵛ a, g a ∂[B; μ]) ≤
      ‖B‖ * (∫⁻ a, edist (f a) (g a) ∂μ.variation).toReal
proof:
:= by
  grw [dist_eq_norm, ← integral_sub hf hg, norm_integral_le_lintegral_norm]
  simp [edist_eq_enorm_sub]

name: edist_integral_le_lintegral_edist
statement:
theorem edist_integral_le_lintegral_edist (hf : μ.Integrable f) (hg : μ.Integrable g) :
    edist (∫ᵛ a, f a ∂[B; μ]) (∫ᵛ a, g a ∂[B; μ]) ≤
      ‖B‖ₑ * ∫⁻ a, edist (f a) (g a) ∂μ.variation
proof:
:= by
  rw [edist_dist]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_of_le_toReal
  grw [dist_integral_le_lintegral_edist hf hg, ENNReal.toReal_mul, toReal_enorm]

name: frequently_ae_ne_zero_of_integral_ne_zero

theorem frequently_ae_ne_zero_of_integral_ne_zero

name: exists_ne_zero_of_integral_ne_zero

name: integral_toSignedMeasure
statement:
@[simp] lemma integral_toSignedMeasure {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : X → G} :
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂<•μ.toSignedMeasure = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial G with h'G | h'G
  · apply Subsingleton.elim
  rw [integral_eq_setToFun, MeasureTheory.integral_eq_setToFun]
  simp only [Measure.variation_toSignedMeasure]
  apply setToFun_congr_left' _ _ (fun s hs h's ↦ ?_)
  simp only [transpose, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_flip, mapRange_apply,
    Measure.toSignedMeasure_apply_measurable hs, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, weightedSMul]
  rfl

name: integral_dirac'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_dirac' [MeasurableSpace X] [CompleteSpace G] {a : X} {v : F}
    (hfm : StronglyMeasurable f) :
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; VectorMeasure.dirac a v] = B (f a) v
proof:
:= by
  borelize E
  have : IsFiniteMeasure ((dirac a v).transpose B).variation := by
    have : ‖B.flip v‖ₑ • Measure.dirac a = ‖B.flip v‖₊ • Measure.dirac a := rfl
    simp only [transpose_dirac, variation_dirac, this]
    infer_instance
  calc
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; VectorMeasure.dirac a v] = ∫ᵛ _, f a ∂[B; VectorMeasure.dirac a v] := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      simp only [variation_dirac]
      exact Measure.ae_smul_measure (ae_eq_dirac' hfm.measurable) _
    _ = B (f a) v := by simp

name: integral_dirac
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integral_dirac [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X] [CompleteSpace G]
    {a : X} {v : F} :
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; VectorMeasure.dirac a v] = B (f a) v
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure ((dirac a v).transpose B).variation := by
    have : ‖B.flip v‖ₑ • Measure.dirac a = ‖B.flip v‖₊ • Measure.dirac a := rfl
    simp only [transpose_dirac, variation_dirac, this]
    infer_instance
  calc
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; VectorMeasure.dirac a v] = ∫ᵛ _, f a ∂[B; VectorMeasure.dirac a v] := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      simp only [variation_dirac]
      exact Measure.ae_smul_measure (ae_eq_dirac f) _
    _ = B (f a) v := by simp

name: integral_unique
statement:
theorem integral_unique [Unique X] [CompleteSpace G] :
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; μ] = B (f default) (μ univ)
proof:
:=
  calc
    ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; μ] = ∫ᵛ _, f default ∂[B; μ] := by congr with x; congr; exact Unique.uniq _ x
    _ = B (f default) (μ univ) := by rw [integral_const]

name: tendsto_integral_of_L1
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_of_L1 {ι} (f : X → E)
    (hfi : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ.variation) {F : ι → X → E}
    {l : Filter ι} (hFi : ∀ᶠ i in l, μ.Integrable (F i))
    (hF : Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫⁻ x, ‖F i x - f x‖ₑ ∂μ.variation) l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ᵛ x, F i x ∂[B; μ]) l (𝓝 <| ∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; μ])
proof:
:=
  tendsto_setToFun_of_L1 _ f hfi hFi hF

name: tendsto_integral_of_L1'
statement:
lemma tendsto_integral_of_L1' {ι} (f : X → E)
    (hfi : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ.variation) {F : ι → X → E}
    {l : Filter ι} (hFi : ∀ᶠ i in l, μ.Integrable (F i))
    (hF : Tendsto (fun i ↦ eLpNorm (F i - f) 1 μ.variation) l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ᵛ x, F i x ∂[B; μ]) l (𝓝 (∫ᵛ x, f x ∂[B; μ]))
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_integral_of_L1 f hfi hFi ?_
  simp_rw [eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm, Pi.sub_apply] at hF
  exact hF

name: continuousWithinAt_of_dominated
statement:
theorem continuousWithinAt_of_dominated {F : Y → X → E} {x₀ : Y} {bound : X → ℝ} {s : Set Y}
    (hF_meas : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[s] x₀, AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ.variation)

    (h_cont : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ.variation, ContinuousWithinAt (fun x ↦ F x a) s x₀) :
    ContinuousWithinAt (fun x ↦ ∫ᵛ a, F x a ∂[B; μ]) s x₀

  continuousWithinAt_setToFun_of_dominated _ hF_meas h_bound bound_integrable h_cont

name: continuousAt_of_dominated

theorem continuousAt_of_dominated {F : Y → X → E} {x₀ : Y} {bound : X → ℝ}

    (h_bound : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, ∀ᵐ a ∂μ.variation, ‖F x a‖ ≤ bound a)

    (h_cont : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ.variation, ContinuousAt (fun x ↦ F x a) x₀) :

statement:
theorem continuousOn_of_dominated {F : Y → X → E} {bound : X → ℝ} {s : Set Y}
    (hF_meas : ∀ x ∈ s, AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ.variation)

name: continuous_of_dominated
statement:
theorem continuous_of_dominated {F : Y → X → E} {bound : X → ℝ}
    (hF_meas : ∀ x, AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ.variation)
    (h_bound : ∀ x, ∀ᵐ a ∂μ.variation, ‖F x a‖ ≤ bound a)
    (bound_integrable : Integrable bound μ.variation)
    (h_cont : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ.variation, Continuous fun x ↦ F x a) :
    Continuous fun x ↦ ∫ᵛ a, F x a ∂[B; μ]
