  (measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _).compl

name: measurable
statement:
theorem measurable (hf : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ) (p : α → (ι → β) → Prop) (i : ι) :
    Measurable (aeSeq hf p i)
proof:
:=
  Measurable.ite aeSeqSet_measurableSet (hf i).measurable_mk <| measurable_const' fun _ _ => rfl

name: measure_compl_aeSeqSet_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_compl_aeSeqSet_eq_zero [Countable ι] (hf : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ)
    (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x fun n => f n x) : μ (aeSeqSet hf p)ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeSeqSet, compl_compl, measure_toMeasurable]
  have hf_eq := fun i => (hf i).ae_eq_mk
  simp_rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, ← ae_all_iff] at hf_eq
  exact Filter.Eventually.and hf_eq hp

name: aeSeq_eq_mk_ae
statement:
theorem aeSeq_eq_mk_ae [Countable ι] (hf : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ)
    (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x fun n => f n x) : ∀ᵐ a : α ∂μ, ∀ i : ι, aeSeq hf p i a = (hf i).mk (f i) a
proof:
:=
  have h_ss : aeSeqSet hf p ⊆ { a : α | ∀ i, aeSeq hf p i a = (hf i).mk (f i) a } := fun x hx i =>
    by simp only [aeSeq, hx, ite_true]
  (ae_iff.2 (measure_compl_aeSeqSet_eq_zero hf hp)).mono h_ss

name: aeSeq_eq_fun_ae
statement:
theorem aeSeq_eq_fun_ae [Countable ι] (hf : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ)
    (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x fun n => f n x) : ∀ᵐ a : α ∂μ, ∀ i : ι, aeSeq hf p i a = f i a
proof:
:=
  haveI h_ss : { a : α | ¬∀ i : ι, aeSeq hf p i a = f i a } ⊆ (aeSeqSet hf p)ᶜ := fun _ =>
    mt fun hx i => aeSeq_eq_fun_of_mem_aeSeqSet hf hx i
  measure_mono_null h_ss (measure_compl_aeSeqSet_eq_zero hf hp)

name: aeSeq_n_eq_fun_n_ae
statement:
theorem aeSeq_n_eq_fun_n_ae [Countable ι] (hf : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ)
    (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x fun n => f n x) (n : ι) : aeSeq hf p n =ᵐ[μ] f n
proof:
:=
  ae_all_iff.mp (aeSeq_eq_fun_ae hf hp) n

name: iSup
statement:
theorem iSup [SupSet β] [Countable ι] (hf : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ)
    (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x fun n => f n x) : ⨆ n, aeSeq hf p n =ᵐ[μ] ⨆ n, f n
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [aeSeq_eq_fun_ae hf hp] with x hx
  simp [iSup_apply, hx]

name: iInf
statement:
theorem iInf [InfSet β] [Countable ι] (hf : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ)
    (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x fun n ↦ f n x) : ⨅ n, aeSeq hf p n =ᵐ[μ] ⨅ n, f n
proof:
:=
  iSup (β := βᵒᵈ) hf hp

name: tendstoInDistribution_iff_forall_integral_rclike_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_iff_forall_integral_rclike_tendsto
    (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] [OpensMeasurableSpace E]
    (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) (μ i)) (hZ : AEMeasurable Z μ') :
    TendstoInDistribution X l Z μ μ' ↔
      ∀ f : E →ᵇ 𝕜, Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ ω, f (X i ω) ∂(μ i)) l (𝓝 (∫ ω, f (Z ω) ∂μ'))
proof:
:= by
  have h_map (i) (f : E →ᵇ 𝕜) :
      ∫ x, f x ∂(μ i).map (X i) = ∫ ω, f (X i ω) ∂(μ i) := integral_map (hX i) (by fun_prop)
  have h_map' (f : E →ᵇ 𝕜) :
      ∫ x, f x ∂μ'.map Z = ∫ ω, f (Z ω) ∂μ' := integral_map hZ (by fun_prop)
  refine ⟨fun h f ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨hX, hZ, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hf := (ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_forall_integral_rclike_tendsto 𝕜).mp h.tendsto f
    simpa [h_map, h_map'] using hf
  · apply (ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_forall_integral_rclike_tendsto (Ω := E) 𝕜).mpr
    intro f
    simpa [h_map, h_map'] using h f

name: tendstoInDistribution_const
statement:
lemma tendstoInDistribution_const [OpensMeasurableSpace E] (hZ : AEMeasurable Z μ') :
    TendstoInDistribution (fun _ ↦ Z) l Z (fun _ ↦ μ') μ' where
  forall_aemeasurable
proof:
:= fun _ ↦ by fun_prop
  tendsto := tendsto_const_nhds

name: tendstoInDistribution_of_identDistrib
statement:
lemma tendstoInDistribution_of_identDistrib [OpensMeasurableSpace E] (i : ι)
    (hX : ∀ j, IdentDistrib (X i) (X j) (μ i) (μ j)) (hZ : IdentDistrib (X i) Z (μ i) μ') :
    TendstoInDistribution X l Z μ μ' where
  forall_aemeasurable j
proof:
:= (hX j).aemeasurable_snd
  aemeasurable_limit := hZ.aemeasurable_snd
  tendsto := by
    convert! tendsto_const_nhds with j
    exact (hX j).map_eq.symm.trans hZ.map_eq

name: TendstoInDistribution.congr
statement:
protected lemma TendstoInDistribution.congr [OpensMeasurableSpace E] {T : Ω' → E}
    (hXY : ∀ i, X i =ᵐ[μ i] Y i) (hZT : Z =ᵐ[μ'] T) (h : TendstoInDistribution X l Z μ μ') :
    TendstoInDistribution Y l T μ μ' where
  forall_aemeasurable i
proof:
:= (h.forall_aemeasurable i).congr (hXY i)
  aemeasurable_limit := h.aemeasurable_limit.congr hZT
  tendsto := by
    convert! h.tendsto using 2 with n
    · simpa using Measure.map_congr (hXY n).symm
    · rw! [Measure.map_congr hZT]
      rfl

name: tendstoInDistribution_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tendstoInDistribution_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty E] :
    TendstoInDistribution X l Z μ μ' where
  forall_aemeasurable
proof:
:= fun _ ↦ (measurable_of_subsingleton_codomain _).aemeasurable
  aemeasurable_limit := (measurable_of_subsingleton_codomain _).aemeasurable
  tendsto := by
    simp only [Subsingleton.elim _ (0 : Measure E)]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds

name: tendstoInDistribution_unique
statement:
lemma tendstoInDistribution_unique [HasOuterApproxClosed E] [BorelSpace E]
    (X : (i : ι) → Ω i → E) {Z : Ω' → E} {W : Ω'' → E} [l.NeBot]
    (h1 : TendstoInDistribution X l Z μ μ') (h2 : TendstoInDistribution X l W μ μ'') :
    μ'.map Z = μ''.map W
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq := tendsto_nhds_unique h1.tendsto h2.tendsto
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff] at h_eq
  simpa using h_eq

name: TendstoInDistribution.continuous_comp
statement:
theorem TendstoInDistribution.continuous_comp {F : Type*} [OpensMeasurableSpace E]
    [TopologicalSpace F] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] {g : E → F} (hg : Continuous g)
    (h : TendstoInDistribution X l Z μ μ') :
    TendstoInDistribution (fun n ↦ g ∘ X n) l (g ∘ Z) μ μ' where
  forall_aemeasurable
proof:
:= fun n ↦ hg.measurable.comp_aemeasurable (h.forall_aemeasurable n)
  aemeasurable_limit := hg.measurable.comp_aemeasurable h.aemeasurable_limit
  tendsto := by
    convert! ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_map_of_tendsto_of_continuous _ _ h.tendsto hg
    · simp only [ProbabilityMeasure.map, ProbabilityMeasure.coe_mk, Subtype.mk.injEq]
      rw [AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable hg.aemeasurable (h.forall_aemeasurable _)]
    · simp only [ProbabilityMeasure.map, ProbabilityMeasure.coe_mk]
      congr
      rw [AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable hg.aemeasurable h.aemeasurable_limit]

name: tendstoInDistribution_of_ae_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_of_ae_tendsto [l.IsCountablyGenerated]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace E] {X : ι → Ω' → E}
    (hX₁ : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ') (hZ : AEMeasurable Z μ')
    (hX₂ : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ', Tendsto (fun i ↦ X i ω) l (𝓝 (Z ω))) :
    TendstoInDistribution X l Z (fun _ ↦ μ') μ' where
  forall_aemeasurable
proof:
:= hX₁
  aemeasurable_limit := hZ
  tendsto := by
    simp_rw [ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_forall_lintegral_tendsto, ProbabilityMeasure.coe_mk]
    intro f
    rw [lintegral_map' (by fun_prop) hZ]
    conv in ∫⁻ _, _ ∂_ => rw [lintegral_map' (by fun_prop) (hX₁ i)]
    apply tendsto_lintegral_filter_of_dominated_convergence' (bound := fun _ ↦ edist 0 f)
    · exact .of_forall (by fun_prop)
    · simp [f.apply_le_edist_zero]
    · simp
    filter_upwards [hX₂] with ω hω
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using f.continuous.tendsto (Z ω) |>.comp hω

name: TendstoInMeasure.tendstoInDistribution
statement:
theorem TendstoInMeasure.tendstoInDistribution [PseudoEMetricSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [l.IsCountablyGenerated] [l.NeBot] {X : ι → Ω' → E}
    (h : TendstoInMeasure μ' X l Z) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ') :
    TendstoInDistribution X l Z (fun _ ↦ μ') μ'
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := h.aemeasurable hX
  refine ⟨hX, hZ, ?_⟩
  refine Filter.tendsto_of_subseq_tendsto (fun ns hns ↦ ?_)
  obtain ⟨ms, hms1, hms2⟩ := h.comp hns |>.exists_seq_tendsto_ae'
  refine ⟨ms, TendstoInDistribution.tendsto ?_⟩
  exact tendstoInDistribution_of_ae_tendsto (by fun_prop) hZ hms2

name: tendstoInDistribution_of_tendstoInMeasure_sub
statement:
lemma tendstoInDistribution_of_tendstoInMeasure_sub {X : ι → Ω'' → E}
    [l.IsCountablyGenerated] (Y : ι → Ω'' → E) (Z : Ω' → E)
    (hXZ : TendstoInDistribution X l Z (fun _ ↦ μ'') μ') (hXY : TendstoInMeasure μ'' (Y - X) l 0)
    (hY : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) μ'') :
    TendstoInDistribution Y l Z (fun _ ↦ μ'') μ'
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : AEMeasurable Z μ' := hXZ.aemeasurable_limit
  have hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ'' := hXZ.forall_aemeasurable
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty E with hE | hE
  · simp
  let x₀ : E := hE.some
  refine ⟨hY, hZ, ?_⟩
  
  
  suffices ∀ (F : E → ℝ) (hF_bounded : ∃ (C : ℝ), ∀ x y, dist (F x) (F y) ≤ C)
      (hF_lip : ∃ L, LipschitzWith L F),
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ''.map (Y n))) l (𝓝 (∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ'.map Z))) by
    rwa [tendsto_iff_forall_lipschitz_integral_tendsto]
  rintro F ⟨M, hF_bounded⟩ ⟨L, hF_lip⟩
  have hF_cont : Continuous F := hF_lip.continuous
  
  obtain rfl | hL := eq_zero_or_pos L
  · simp only [LipschitzWith.zero_iff] at hF_lip
    specialize hF_lip x₀
    simp only [← hF_lip, integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
    simpa using! tendsto_const_nhds
  
  simp_rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds, Real.dist_eq]
  suffices ∀ ε > 0, ∀ᶠ n in l, |∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ''.map (Y n)) - ∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ'.map Z)| < L * ε by
    intro ε hε
    convert! this (ε / L) (by positivity)
    field_simp
  intro ε hε
  
  have h_le n : |∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ''.map (Y n)) - ∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ'.map Z)|
      ≤ L * (ε / 2) + M * μ''.real {ω | ε / 2 ≤ ‖Y n ω - X n ω‖}
        + |∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ''.map (X n)) - ∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ'.map Z)| := by
    refine (abs_sub_le (∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ''.map (Y n))) (∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ''.map (X n)))
      (∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ'.map Z))).trans ?_
    gcongr
    
    
    
    have h_int_Y : Integrable (fun x ↦ F (Y n x)) μ'' := by
      refine Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) (‖F x₀‖ + M) (ae_of_all _ fun a ↦ ?_)
      specialize hF_bounded (Y n a) x₀
      rw [← sub_le_iff_le_add']
      exact (abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (F (Y n a)) (F x₀)).trans hF_bounded
    have h_int_X : Integrable (fun x ↦ F (X n x)) μ'' := by
      refine Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) (‖F x₀‖ + M) (ae_of_all _ fun a ↦ ?_)
      specialize hF_bounded (X n a) x₀
      rw [← sub_le_iff_le_add']
      exact (abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (F (X n a)) (F x₀)).trans hF_bounded
    have h_int_sub : Integrable (fun a ↦ ‖F (Y n a) - F (X n a)‖) μ'' := by
      rw [integrable_norm_iff (by fun_prop)]
      exact h_int_Y.sub h_int_X
    
    rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
      ← integral_sub h_int_Y h_int_X, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc ‖∫ a, F (Y n a) - F (X n a) ∂μ''‖
    _ ≤ ∫ a, ‖F (Y n a) - F (X n a)‖ ∂μ'' := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    
    _ = ∫ a in {x | ‖Y n x - X n x‖ < ε / 2}, ‖F (Y n a) - F (X n a)‖ ∂μ''
        + ∫ a in {x | ε / 2 ≤ ‖Y n x - X n x‖}, ‖F (Y n a) - F (X n a)‖ ∂μ'' := by
      symm
      simp_rw [← not_lt]
      refine integral_add_compl₀ ?_ h_int_sub
      exact nullMeasurableSet_lt (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    
    
    _ ≤ ∫ a in {x | ‖Y n x - X n x‖ < ε / 2}, L * (ε / 2) ∂μ''
        + ∫ a in {x | ε / 2 ≤ ‖Y n x - X n x‖}, M ∂μ'' := by
      gcongr ?_ + ?_
      · refine setIntegral_mono_on₀ h_int_sub.integrableOn integrableOn_const ?_ ?_
        · exact nullMeasurableSet_lt (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
        · exact fun x hx ↦ hF_lip.norm_sub_le_of_le hx.le
      · refine setIntegral_mono h_int_sub.integrableOn integrableOn_const fun a ↦ ?_
        rw [← dist_eq_norm]
        convert!
          hF_bounded _
            _
              

    
    _ = L * (ε / 2) * μ''.real {x | ‖Y n x - X n x‖ < ε / 2}
        + M * μ''.real {ω | ε / 2 ≤ ‖Y n ω - X n ω‖} := by
      simp only [integral_const, MeasurableSet.univ, measureReal_restrict_apply, Set.univ_inter,
        smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    _ ≤ L * (ε / 2) + M * μ''.real {ω | ε / 2 ≤ ‖Y n ω - X n ω‖} := by
      rw [mul_assoc]
      gcongr
      grw [measureReal_le_one, mul_one]
  
  have h_tendsto :
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ L * (ε / 2) + M * μ''.real {ω | ε / 2 ≤ ‖Y n ω - X n ω‖}
        + |∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ''.map (X n)) - ∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ'.map Z)|) l (𝓝 (L * ε / 2)) := by
    suffices Tendsto (fun n ↦ L * (ε / 2) + M * μ''.real {ω | ε / 2 ≤ ‖Y n ω - X n ω‖}
        + |∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ''.map (X n)) - ∫ ω, F ω ∂(μ'.map Z)|) l (𝓝 (L * ε / 2 + M * 0 + 0)) by
      simpa
    refine (Tendsto.add ?_ (Tendsto.const_mul _ ?_)).add ?_
    · rw [mul_div_assoc]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds
    · simp only [tendstoInMeasure_iff_measureReal_norm, Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero] at hXY
      exact hXY (ε / 2) (by positivity)
    · replace hXZ := hXZ.tendsto
      simp_rw [tendsto_iff_forall_lipschitz_integral_tendsto] at hXZ
      simpa [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero] using! hXZ F ⟨M, hF_bounded⟩ ⟨L, hF_lip⟩
  have h_lt : L * ε / 2 < L * ε := half_lt_self (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [h_tendsto.eventually_lt_const h_lt] with n hn using (h_le n).trans_lt hn

name: TendstoInMeasure.tendstoInDistribution_of_aemeasurable
statement:
lemma TendstoInMeasure.tendstoInDistribution_of_aemeasurable [l.IsCountablyGenerated]
    {X : ι → Ω' → E} (h : TendstoInMeasure μ' X l Z) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ')
    (hZ : AEMeasurable Z μ') :
    TendstoInDistribution X l Z (fun _ ↦ μ') μ'
proof:
:=
  tendstoInDistribution_of_tendstoInMeasure_sub X Z (tendstoInDistribution_const hZ)
    (by simpa [tendstoInMeasure_iff_norm] using h) hX

name: TendstoInDistribution.prodMk_of_tendstoInMeasure_const
statement:
theorem TendstoInDistribution.prodMk_of_tendstoInMeasure_const
    {E' : Type*} {mE' : MeasurableSpace E'} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E'] [SecondCountableTopology E']
    [BorelSpace E']
    [l.IsCountablyGenerated] (X : ι → Ω'' → E) (Y : ι → Ω'' → E') (Z : Ω' → E)
    {c : E'} (hXZ : TendstoInDistribution X l Z (fun _ ↦ μ'') μ')
    (hY : TendstoInMeasure μ'' Y l (fun _ ↦ c))
    (hY_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) μ'') :
    TendstoInDistribution (fun n ω ↦ (X n ω, Y n ω)) l (fun ω ↦ (Z ω, c)) (fun _ ↦ μ'') μ'
proof:
:= by
  have hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ'' := hXZ.forall_aemeasurable
  refine tendstoInDistribution_of_tendstoInMeasure_sub (X := fun n ω ↦ (X n ω, c))
    (fun n ω ↦ (X n ω, Y n ω)) (fun ω ↦ (Z ω, c)) ?_ ?_ (fun i ↦ (hX i).prodMk (hY_meas i))
  · exact hXZ.continuous_comp (g := fun x ↦ (x, c)) (by fun_prop)
  · suffices TendstoInMeasure μ'' (fun n ω ↦ ((0 : E), Y n ω - c)) l 0 by
      convert! this with n ω
      simp
    simpa [tendstoInMeasure_iff_norm] using hY

name: TendstoInDistribution.continuous_comp_prodMk_of_tendstoInMeasure_const
statement:
theorem TendstoInDistribution.continuous_comp_prodMk_of_tendstoInMeasure_const {E' F : Type*}
    {mE' : MeasurableSpace E'} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E'] [SecondCountableTopology E']
    [BorelSpace E']
    [TopologicalSpace F] [MeasurableSpace F] [BorelSpace F] {g : E × E' → F} (hg : Continuous g)
    [l.IsCountablyGenerated] {X : ι → Ω'' → E} {Y : ι → Ω'' → E'}
    {c : E'} (hXZ : TendstoInDistribution X l Z (fun _ ↦ μ'') μ')
    (hY_tendsto : TendstoInMeasure μ'' Y l (fun _ ↦ c))
    (hY : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) μ'') :
    TendstoInDistribution (fun n ω ↦ g (X n ω, Y n ω)) l (fun ω ↦ g (Z ω, c)) (fun _ ↦ μ'') μ'
proof:
:= by
  refine TendstoInDistribution.continuous_comp hg ?_
  exact hXZ.prodMk_of_tendstoInMeasure_const X Y Z hY_tendsto hY

name: TendstoInDistribution.add_of_tendstoInMeasure_const
statement:
lemma TendstoInDistribution.add_of_tendstoInMeasure_const {X Y : ι → Ω'' → E}
    [l.IsCountablyGenerated] {c : E} (hXZ : TendstoInDistribution X l Z (fun _ ↦ μ'') μ')
    (hY_tendsto : TendstoInMeasure μ'' Y l (fun _ ↦ c)) (hY : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (Y i) μ'') :
    TendstoInDistribution (fun n ↦ X n + Y n) l (fun ω ↦ Z ω + c) (fun _ ↦ μ'') μ'
proof:
:=
  hXZ.continuous_comp_prodMk_of_tendstoInMeasure_const
    (g := fun (x : E × E) ↦ x.1 + x.2) (by fun_prop) hY_tendsto hY

name: le_sum_apply
statement: theorem le_sum_apply (μ : ι → Measure α) (s : Set α) : ∑' i, μ i s ≤ sum μ s
proof:
:= by
  grw [sum, ← le_toMeasure_apply]; rfl

name: sum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_apply (μ : ι → Measure α) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    sum μ s = ∑' i, μ i s
proof:
:=
  toMeasure_apply _ _ hs

name: sum_apply
statement:
theorem sum_apply₀ (μ : ι → Measure α) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s (sum μ)) :
    sum μ s = ∑' i, μ i s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ (le_sum_apply _ _)
  rcases hs.exists_measurable_subset_ae_eq with ⟨t, ts, t_meas, ht⟩
  calc
  sum μ s = sum μ t := measure_congr ht.symm
  _ = ∑' i, μ i t := sum_apply _ t_meas
  _ ≤ ∑' i, μ i s := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun i ↦ measure_mono ts

name: sum_apply_of_countable
statement:
theorem sum_apply_of_countable [Countable ι] (μ : ι → Measure α) (s : Set α) :
    sum μ s = ∑' i, μ i s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ (le_sum_apply _ _)
  rcases exists_measurable_superset_forall_eq μ s with ⟨t, hst, htm, ht⟩
  calc
  sum μ s ≤ sum μ t := measure_mono hst
  _ = ∑' i, μ i t := sum_apply _ htm
  _ = ∑' i, μ i s := by simp [ht]

name: le_sum
statement: theorem le_sum (μ : ι → Measure α) (i : ι) : μ i ≤ sum μ
proof:
:=
  le_iff.2 fun s hs ↦ by grw [sum_apply μ hs, ← ENNReal.le_tsum i]

name: sum_apply_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_apply_eq_zero [Countable ι] :
    sum μ s = 0 ↔ ∀ i, μ i s = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [sum_apply_of_countable]

name: sum_apply_eq_zero'
statement:
theorem sum_apply_eq_zero' (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    sum μ s = 0 ↔ ∀ i, μ i s = 0
proof: := by simp [hs]

name: sum_eq_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma sum_eq_zero : sum μ = 0 ↔ ∀ i, μ i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp +contextual [Measure.ext_iff, forall_comm (α := ι)]

name: sum_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sum_zero : Measure.sum (fun (_ : ι) ↦ (0 : Measure α)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  simp [Measure.sum_apply _ hs]

name: sum_sum
statement:
theorem sum_sum (μ : ι → ι' → Measure α) :
    (sum fun n => sum (μ n)) = sum (fun (p : ι × ι') ↦ μ p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s hs
  simp [sum_apply _ hs, ENNReal.tsum_prod']

name: sum_comm
statement:
theorem sum_comm (μ : ι → ι' → Measure α) :
    (sum fun n => sum (μ n)) = sum fun m => sum fun n => μ n m
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s hs
  simp_rw [sum_apply _ hs]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]

name: ae_sum_iff
statement:
theorem ae_sum_iff [Countable ι] {p : α → Prop} :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂sum μ, p x) ↔ ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ i, p x
proof:
:=
  sum_apply_eq_zero

name: ae_sum_iff'
statement:
theorem ae_sum_iff' {p : α → Prop} (h : MeasurableSet { x | p x }) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂sum μ, p x) ↔ ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ i, p x
proof:
:=
  sum_apply_eq_zero' h.compl

name: sum_fintype
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_fintype [Fintype ι] (μ : ι → Measure α) : sum μ = ∑ i, μ i
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s hs
  simp only [sum_apply, finsetSum_apply, hs, tsum_fintype]

name: sum_coe_finset
statement:
theorem sum_coe_finset (s : Finset ι) (μ : ι → Measure α) :
    (sum fun i : s => μ i) = ∑ i ∈ s, μ i
proof: := by rw [sum_fintype, Finset.sum_coe_sort s μ]

name: ae_sum_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ae_sum_eq [Countable ι] (μ : ι → Measure α) : ae (sum μ) = ⨆ i, ae (μ i)
proof:
:=
  Filter.ext fun _ => ae_sum_iff.trans mem_iSup.symm

name: sum_bool
statement: theorem sum_bool (μ : Bool → Measure α) : sum μ = μ true + μ false
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_fintype, Fintype.sum_bool]

name: sum_cond
statement: theorem sum_cond (μ ν : Measure α) : (sum fun b => cond b μ ν) = μ + ν
proof:
:=
  sum_bool _

name: sum_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty ι] (μ : ι → Measure α) : sum μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← measure_univ_eq_zero, sum_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ, tsum_empty]

name: sum_add_sum_compl
statement:
theorem sum_add_sum_compl (s : Set ι) (μ : ι → Measure α) :
    ((sum fun i : s => μ i) + sum fun i : ↥sᶜ => μ i) = sum μ
proof:
:= by
  ext1 t ht
  simp only [add_apply, sum_apply _ ht]
  exact ENNReal.summable.tsum_add_tsum_compl (f := fun i => μ i t) ENNReal.summable

name: sum_congr
statement: theorem sum_congr {μ ν : ℕ → Measure α} (h : ∀ n, μ n = ν n) : sum μ = sum ν
proof:
:=
  congr_arg sum (funext h)

name: sum_add_sum
statement: theorem sum_add_sum (μ ν : ι → Measure α) : sum μ + sum ν = sum fun n => μ n + ν n
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s hs
  simp only [add_apply, sum_apply _ hs,
    ENNReal.summable.tsum_add ENNReal.summable]

name: sum_comp_equiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma sum_comp_equiv (e : ι' ≃ ι) (μ : ι → Measure α) :
    sum (μ ∘ e) = sum μ
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  simpa [hs, sum_apply] using e.tsum_eq (fun n ↦ μ n s)

name: sum_extend_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma sum_extend_zero {f : ι → ι'} (hf : Injective f) (μ : ι → Measure α) :
    sum (Function.extend f μ 0) = sum μ
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  simp [*, Function.apply_extend (fun μ : Measure α ↦ μ s)]

name: trim_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trim_eq_self [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} : μ.trim le_rfl = μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [Measure.trim]

name: toOuterMeasure_trim_eq_trim_toOuterMeasure
statement:
theorem toOuterMeasure_trim_eq_trim_toOuterMeasure (μ : Measure α) (hm : m ≤ m0) :
    @Measure.toOuterMeasure _ m (μ.trim hm) = @OuterMeasure.trim _ m μ.toOuterMeasure
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.trim, toMeasure_toOuterMeasure (ms := m)]

name: zero_trim
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_trim (hm : m ≤ m0) : (0 : Measure α).trim hm = (0 : @Measure α m)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Measure.trim, @OuterMeasure.toMeasure_zero _ m]

name: trim_measurableSet_eq
statement: theorem trim_measurableSet_eq (hm : m ≤ m0) (hs : @MeasurableSet α m s) : μ.trim hm s = μ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.trim, toMeasure_apply (ms := m) _ _ hs, Measure.coe_toOuterMeasure]

name: le_trim
statement: theorem le_trim (hm : m ≤ m0) : μ s ≤ μ.trim hm s
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Measure.trim]
  exact @le_toMeasure_apply _ m _ _ _

name: trim_eq_map
statement: lemma trim_eq_map (hm : m ≤ m0) : μ.trim hm = @Measure.map _ _ _ m id μ
proof:
:= by
  refine @Measure.ext α m _ _ (fun s hs ↦ ?_)
  rw [Measure.map_apply (measurable_id'' hm) hs, trim_measurableSet_eq hm hs, Set.preimage_id]

name: map_trim_comap
statement:
lemma map_trim_comap {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) :
    @Measure.map _ _ (mβ.comap f) _ f (μ.trim hf.comap_le) = μ.map f
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.map_apply hf hs, Measure.map_apply _ hs, trim_measurableSet_eq]
  · exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  · exact Measurable.of_comap_le le_rfl

name: trim_comap_apply
statement:
lemma trim_comap_apply {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    μ.trim hf.comap_le (f ⁻¹' s) = μ.map f s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_trim_comap hf, Measure.map_apply (Measurable.of_comap_le le_rfl) hs]

name: ae_map_iff_ae_trim
statement:
lemma ae_map_iff_ae_trim {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f)
    {p : β → Prop} (hp : MeasurableSet { x | p x }) :
    (∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map f, p y) ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.trim hf.comap_le), p (f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_trim_comap hf, ae_map_iff (Measurable.of_comap_le le_rfl).aemeasurable hp]

name: trim_add
statement: lemma trim_add {ν : Measure α} (hm : m ≤ m0) : (μ + ν).trim hm = μ.trim hm + ν.trim hm
proof:
:=
  @Measure.ext _ m _ _ (fun s hs ↦ by simp [trim_measurableSet_eq hm hs])

name: measure_eq_zero_of_trim_eq_zero
statement: theorem measure_eq_zero_of_trim_eq_zero (hm : m ≤ m0) (h : μ.trim hm s = 0) : μ s = 0
proof:
:= by
  grw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero, ← h, le_trim hm]

name: measure_trim_toMeasurable_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_trim_toMeasurable_eq_zero {hm : m ≤ m0} (hs : μ.trim hm s = 0) :
    μ (@toMeasurable α m (μ.trim hm) s) = 0
proof:
:=
  measure_eq_zero_of_trim_eq_zero hm (by rwa [@measure_toMeasurable _ m])

name: ae_of_ae_trim
statement:
theorem ae_of_ae_trim (hm : m ≤ m0) {μ : Measure α} {P : α → Prop} (h : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.trim hm, P x) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x
proof:
:=
  measure_eq_zero_of_trim_eq_zero hm h

name: ae_eq_of_ae_eq_trim
statement:
theorem ae_eq_of_ae_eq_trim {E} {hm : m ≤ m0} {f₁ f₂ : α → E}
    (h12 : f₁ =ᵐ[μ.trim hm] f₂) : f₁ =ᵐ[μ] f₂
proof:
:=
  measure_eq_zero_of_trim_eq_zero hm h12

name: ae_le_of_ae_le_trim
statement:
theorem ae_le_of_ae_le_trim {E} [LE E] {hm : m ≤ m0} {f₁ f₂ : α → E}
    (h12 : f₁ ≤ᵐ[μ.trim hm] f₂) : f₁ ≤ᵐ[μ] f₂
proof:
:=
  measure_eq_zero_of_trim_eq_zero hm h12

name: trim_trim
statement:
theorem trim_trim {m₁ m₂ : MeasurableSpace α} {hm₁₂ : m₁ ≤ m₂} {hm₂ : m₂ ≤ m0} :
    (μ.trim hm₂).trim hm₁₂ = μ.trim (hm₁₂.trans hm₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine @Measure.ext _ m₁ _ _ (fun t ht => ?_)
  rw [trim_measurableSet_eq hm₁₂ ht, trim_measurableSet_eq (hm₁₂.trans hm₂) ht,
    trim_measurableSet_eq hm₂ (hm₁₂ t ht)]

name: restrict_trim
statement:
theorem restrict_trim (hm : m ≤ m0) (μ : Measure α) (hs : @MeasurableSet α m s) :
    @Measure.restrict α m (μ.trim hm) s = (μ.restrict s).trim hm
proof:
:= by
  refine @Measure.ext _ m _ _ (fun t ht => ?_)
  rw [@Measure.restrict_apply α m _ _ _ ht, trim_measurableSet_eq hm ht,
    Measure.restrict_apply (hm t ht),
    trim_measurableSet_eq hm (@MeasurableSet.inter α m t s ht hs)]

name: measure_spanningSets_trim_lt_top
statement:
theorem measure_spanningSets_trim_lt_top (hm : m ≤ m0) (μ : Measure α) [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)]
    (n : ℕ) :
    μ (spanningSets (μ.trim hm) n) < ⊤
proof:
:=
  (le_trim hm).trans_lt (measure_spanningSets_lt_top (μ.trim hm) n)

name: sigmaFiniteTrim_mono
statement:
theorem sigmaFiniteTrim_mono {m m₂ m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : Measure α} (hm : m ≤ m0)
    (hm₂ : m₂ ≤ m) [SigmaFinite (μ.trim (hm₂.trans hm))] : SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)
proof:
:= by
  have : SigmaFinite ((μ.trim hm).trim hm₂) := by simpa [trim_trim]
  exact ⟨⟨
    { set := spanningSets ((μ.trim hm).trim hm₂)
      set_mem := fun _ => Set.mem_univ _
      finite := fun i => measure_spanningSets_trim_lt_top hm₂ (μ.trim hm) i
      spanning := iUnion_spanningSets _ }⟩⟩

name: SigmaFinite.of_trim
statement:
lemma SigmaFinite.of_trim {m m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : Measure α} (hm : m ≤ m0)
    [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)] : SigmaFinite μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trim_eq_self (μ := μ)]
  exact sigmaFiniteTrim_mono le_rfl hm

name: sigmaFinite_trim_bot_iff
statement: theorem sigmaFinite_trim_bot_iff : SigmaFinite (μ.trim bot_le) ↔ IsFiniteMeasure μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmaFinite_bot_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨?_⟩, fun h => ⟨?_⟩⟩ <;> have h_univ := h.measure_univ_lt_top
  · rwa [trim_measurableSet_eq bot_le MeasurableSet.univ] at h_univ
  · rwa [trim_measurableSet_eq bot_le MeasurableSet.univ]

name: Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.trim
statement:
lemma Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.trim {ν : Measure α} (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (hm : m ≤ m0) :
    μ.trim hm ≪ ν.trim hm
proof:
:= by
  refine Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk (fun s hs hsν ↦ ?_)
  rw [trim_measurableSet_eq hm hs] at hsν ⊢
  exact hμν hsν

name: _root_.ae_eq_trim_of_measurable
statement:
theorem _root_.ae_eq_trim_of_measurable {α β} {m m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : Measure α}
    [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableEq β]
    (hm : m ≤ m0) {f g : α → β} (hf : Measurable[m] f) (hg : Measurable[m] g) (hfg : f =ᵐ[μ] g) :
    f =ᵐ[μ.trim hm] g
proof:
:= by
  rwa [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_iff, trim_measurableSet_eq hm _]
  measurability

name: mk
statement:
theorem mk {s t : Set α} (hs : μ s = 0) (ht : ν t = 0) (hst : univ ⊆ s ∪ t) :
    MutuallySingular μ ν
proof:
:= by
  use toMeasurable μ s, measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _, (measure_toMeasurable _).trans hs
  refine measure_mono_null (fun x hx => (hst trivial).resolve_left fun hxs => hx ?_) ht
  exact subset_toMeasurable _ _ hxs

name: measurableSet_nullSet
statement: lemma measurableSet_nullSet (h : μ ⟂ₘ ν) : MeasurableSet h.nullSet
proof: := h.choose_spec.1

name: measure_nullSet
statement:
@[simp]
lemma measure_nullSet (h : μ ⟂ₘ ν) : μ h.nullSet = 0
proof: := h.choose_spec.2.1

name: measure_compl_nullSet
statement:
@[simp]
lemma measure_compl_nullSet (h : μ ⟂ₘ ν) : ν h.nullSetᶜ = 0
proof: := h.choose_spec.2.2

name: restrict_nullSet
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_nullSet (h : μ ⟂ₘ ν) : μ.restrict h.nullSet = 0
proof: := by simp

name: restrict_compl_nullSet
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrict_compl_nullSet (h : μ ⟂ₘ ν) : ν.restrict h.nullSetᶜ = 0
proof: := by simp

name: zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_right : μ ⟂ₘ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨∅, MeasurableSet.empty, measure_empty, rfl⟩

name: symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem symm (h : ν ⟂ₘ μ) : μ ⟂ₘ ν
proof:
:=
  let ⟨i, hi, his, hit⟩ := h
  ⟨iᶜ, hi.compl, hit, (compl_compl i).symm ▸ his⟩

name: comm
statement: theorem comm : μ ⟂ₘ ν ↔ ν ⟂ₘ μ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.symm, fun h => h.symm⟩

name: zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_left : 0 ⟂ₘ μ
proof:
:=
  zero_right.symm

name: mono_ac
statement: theorem mono_ac (h : μ₁ ⟂ₘ ν₁) (hμ : μ₂ ≪ μ₁) (hν : ν₂ ≪ ν₁) : μ₂ ⟂ₘ ν₂
proof:
:=
  let ⟨s, hs, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  ⟨s, hs, hμ h₁, hν h₂⟩

name: congr_ac
statement:
lemma congr_ac (hμμ₂ : μ ≪ μ₂) (hμ₂μ : μ₂ ≪ μ) (hνν₂ : ν ≪ ν₂) (hν₂ν : ν₂ ≪ ν) :
    μ ⟂ₘ ν ↔ μ₂ ⟂ₘ ν₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.mono_ac hμ₂μ hν₂ν, fun h ↦ h.mono_ac hμμ₂ hνν₂⟩

name: mono
statement: theorem mono (h : μ₁ ⟂ₘ ν₁) (hμ : μ₂ ≤ μ₁) (hν : ν₂ ≤ ν₁) : μ₂ ⟂ₘ ν₂
proof:
:=
  h.mono_ac hμ.absolutelyContinuous hν.absolutelyContinuous

name: self_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma self_iff (μ : Measure α) : μ ⟂ₘ μ ↔ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ by (rw [h]; exact zero_left)⟩
  rintro ⟨s, hs, hμs, hμs_compl⟩
  suffices μ Set.univ = 0 by rwa [measure_univ_eq_zero] at this
  rw [← Set.union_compl_self s, measure_union disjoint_compl_right hs.compl, hμs, hμs_compl,
    add_zero]

name: sum_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_left {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] {μ : ι → Measure α} : sum μ ⟂ₘ ν ↔ ∀ i, μ i ⟂ₘ ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h i => h.mono (le_sum _ _) le_rfl, fun H => ?_⟩
  choose s hsm hsμ hsν using H
  refine ⟨⋂ i, s i, MeasurableSet.iInter hsm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [sum_apply _ (MeasurableSet.iInter hsm), ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero]
    exact fun i => measure_mono_null (iInter_subset _ _) (hsμ i)
  · rwa [compl_iInter, measure_iUnion_null_iff]

name: sum_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_right {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] {ν : ι → Measure α} : μ ⟂ₘ sum ν ↔ ∀ i, μ ⟂ₘ ν i
proof:
:=
  comm.trans <| sum_left.trans <| forall_congr' fun _ => comm

name: add_left_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_left_iff : μ₁ + μ₂ ⟂ₘ ν ↔ μ₁ ⟂ₘ ν ∧ μ₂ ⟂ₘ ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_cond, sum_left, Bool.forall_bool, cond, cond, and_comm]

name: add_right_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_right_iff : μ ⟂ₘ ν₁ + ν₂ ↔ μ ⟂ₘ ν₁ ∧ μ ⟂ₘ ν₂
proof:
:=
  comm.trans <| add_left_iff.trans <| and_congr comm comm

name: add_left
statement: theorem add_left (h₁ : ν₁ ⟂ₘ μ) (h₂ : ν₂ ⟂ₘ μ) : ν₁ + ν₂ ⟂ₘ μ
proof:
:=
  add_left_iff.2 ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: add_right
statement: theorem add_right (h₁ : μ ⟂ₘ ν₁) (h₂ : μ ⟂ₘ ν₂) : μ ⟂ₘ ν₁ + ν₂
proof:
:=
  add_right_iff.2 ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: smul
statement: theorem smul (r : ℝ≥0∞) (h : ν ⟂ₘ μ) : r • ν ⟂ₘ μ
proof:
:=
  h.mono_ac (AbsolutelyContinuous.rfl.smul_left r) AbsolutelyContinuous.rfl

name: smul_nnreal
statement: theorem smul_nnreal (r : ℝ≥0) (h : ν ⟂ₘ μ) : r • ν ⟂ₘ μ
proof:
:=
  h.smul r

name: restrict
statement: lemma restrict (h : μ ⟂ₘ ν) (s : Set α) : μ.restrict s ⟂ₘ ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.nullSet, h.measurableSet_nullSet, ?_, h.measure_compl_nullSet⟩
  rw [Measure.restrict_apply h.measurableSet_nullSet]
  exact measure_mono_null Set.inter_subset_left h.measure_nullSet

name: eq_zero_of_absolutelyContinuous_of_mutuallySingular
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Measure.MutuallySingular.self_iff]
  exact h_ms.mono_ac Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.rfl h_ac

name: absolutelyContinuous_of_add_of_mutuallySingular
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_of_add_of_mutuallySingular {ν₁ ν₂ : Measure α}
    (h : μ ≪ ν₁ + ν₂) (h_ms : μ ⟂ₘ ν₂) : μ ≪ ν₁
proof:
:= by
  refine AbsolutelyContinuous.mk fun s hs hs_zero ↦ ?_
  let t := h_ms.nullSet
  have ht : MeasurableSet t := h_ms.measurableSet_nullSet
  have htμ : μ t = 0 := h_ms.measure_nullSet
  have htν₂ : ν₂ tᶜ = 0 := h_ms.measure_compl_nullSet
  have : μ s = μ (s ∩ tᶜ) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← inter_union_compl s t]
    rw [measure_union, measure_inter_null_of_null_right _ htμ, zero_add]
    · exact (disjoint_compl_right.inter_right' _).inter_left' _
    · exact hs.inter ht.compl
  rw [this]
  refine h ?_
  simp only [Measure.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, add_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨measure_inter_null_of_null_left _ hs_zero, measure_inter_null_of_null_right _ htν₂⟩

name: _root_.MeasurableEmbedding.mutuallySingular_map
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨f '' hμν.nullSet, hf.measurableSet_image' hμν.measurableSet_nullSet, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hf.map_apply, hf.injective.preimage_image, hμν.measure_nullSet]
  · rw [hf.map_apply, Set.preimage_compl, hf.injective.preimage_image, hμν.measure_compl_nullSet]

name: exists_null_set_measure_lt_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma exists_null_set_measure_lt_of_disjoint (h : Disjoint μ ν) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ s, μ s = 0 ∧ ν sᶜ ≤ 2 * ε
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (μ ⊓ ν) univ = 0 := le_bot_iff.1 (h (inf_le_left (b := ν)) inf_le_right) ▸ rfl
  simp_rw [Measure.inf_apply MeasurableSet.univ, inter_univ] at h₁
  have h₂ : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ t, μ t + ν tᶜ < ε * (1 / 2) ^ n := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨m, ⟨t, ht₁, rfl⟩, hm₂⟩ :
        ∃ x ∈ {m | ∃ t, m = μ t + ν tᶜ}, x < ε * (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n := by
      refine exists_lt_of_csInf_lt ⟨ν univ, ∅, by simp⟩ <| h₁ ▸ ENNReal.mul_pos ?_ (by simp)
      norm_cast
      exact hε.ne.symm
    exact ⟨t, hm₂⟩
  choose t ht₂ using h₂
  refine ⟨⋂ n, t n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine eq_zero_of_le_mul_pow (by simp)
      fun n ↦ ((measure_mono <| iInter_subset_of_subset n fun _ ht ↦ ht).trans
      (le_add_right le_rfl)).trans (ht₂ n).le
  · rw [compl_iInter, (by simp [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, mul_comm] :
      2 * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) = ∑' (n : ℕ), ε * (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n)]
    refine (measure_iUnion_le _).trans ?_
    exact ENNReal.summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun n ↦ (le_add_left le_rfl).trans (ht₂ n).le)
      ENNReal.summable

name: mutuallySingular_of_disjoint
statement: lemma mutuallySingular_of_disjoint (h : Disjoint μ ν) : μ ⟂ₘ ν
proof:
:= by
  have h' (n : ℕ) : ∃ s, μ s = 0 ∧ ν sᶜ ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n := by
    convert!
      exists_null_set_measure_lt_of_disjoint h (ε := (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)) <| pow_pos (by simp) (n + 1)
    conv =>
      
      enter [1, 1]
      equals ((1 : ℝ≥0) / (2 : ℝ≥0)) => rfl
    norm_cast
    ring
  choose s hs₂ hs₃ using h'
  refine Measure.MutuallySingular.mk (t := (⋃ n, s n)ᶜ) (measure_iUnion_null hs₂) ?_ ?_
  · rw [compl_iUnion]
    refine eq_zero_of_le_mul_pow (ε := 1) (by simp : (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) < 1) <| fun n ↦ ?_
    rw [ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul]
    exact (measure_mono <| iInter_subset_of_subset n fun _ ht ↦ ht).trans (hs₃ n)
  · rw [union_compl_self]

name: MutuallySingular.disjoint
statement: lemma MutuallySingular.disjoint (h : μ ⟂ₘ ν) : Disjoint μ ν
proof:
:= by
  have h_bot_iff (ξ : Measure α) : ξ ≤ ⊥ ↔ ξ = 0 := by
    rw [le_bot_iff]
    rfl
  intro ξ hξμ hξν
  rw [h_bot_iff]
  ext s hs
  simp only [Measure.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  rw [← inter_union_compl s h.nullSet, measure_union, add_eq_zero]
  · exact ⟨measure_inter_null_of_null_right _ <| absolutelyContinuous_of_le hξμ h.measure_nullSet,
      measure_inter_null_of_null_right _ <| absolutelyContinuous_of_le hξν h.measure_compl_nullSet⟩
  · exact Disjoint.mono inter_subset_right inter_subset_right disjoint_compl_right
  · exact hs.inter h.measurableSet_nullSet.compl

name: MutuallySingular.disjoint_ae
statement: lemma MutuallySingular.disjoint_ae (h : μ ⟂ₘ ν) : Disjoint (ae μ) (ae ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  intro s _
  refine ⟨s ∪ h.nullSetᶜ, ?_, s ∪ h.nullSet, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_ae_iff, compl_union, compl_compl]
    exact measure_inter_null_of_null_right _ h.measure_nullSet
  · rw [mem_ae_iff, compl_union]
    exact measure_inter_null_of_null_right _ h.measure_compl_nullSet
  · rw [union_eq_compl_compl_inter_compl, union_eq_compl_compl_inter_compl,
      ← compl_union, compl_compl, inter_union_compl, compl_compl]

name: disjoint_of_disjoint_ae
statement: lemma disjoint_of_disjoint_ae (h : Disjoint (ae μ) (ae ν)) : Disjoint μ ν
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Filter.disjoint_iff, mem_ae_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨s, hs, t, ht, hst⟩ := h
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  have : (⊥ : Measure α) = 0 := rfl
  refine Measure.le_intro fun u hu _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [Measure.inf_apply hu, this, coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, nonpos_iff_eq_zero]
  refine csInf_eq_bot_of_bot_mem ⟨t, ?_⟩
  simp [measure_mono_null (inter_subset_left.trans hst.subset_compl_left) hs,
    measure_mono_null inter_subset_left ht]

name: mutuallySingular_tfae
statement:
lemma mutuallySingular_tfae : List.TFAE
    [ μ ⟂ₘ ν,
      Disjoint μ ν,
      Disjoint (ae μ) (ae ν) ]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2
  | h => h.disjoint
  tfae_have 2 → 1
  | h => mutuallySingular_of_disjoint h
  tfae_have 1 → 3
  | h => h.disjoint_ae
  tfae_have 3 → 2
  | h => disjoint_of_disjoint_ae h
  tfae_finish

name: mutuallySingular_iff_disjoint
statement: lemma mutuallySingular_iff_disjoint : μ ⟂ₘ ν ↔ Disjoint μ ν
proof:
:=
  mutuallySingular_tfae.out 1 2

name: mutuallySingular_iff_disjoint_ae
statement: lemma mutuallySingular_iff_disjoint_ae : μ ⟂ₘ ν ↔ Disjoint (ae μ) (ae ν)
proof:
:=
  mutuallySingular_tfae.out 1 3

name: count_ne_zero''
statement: @[simp] lemma count_ne_zero'' [Nonempty α] : (count : Measure α) ≠ 0
proof: := by simp [count]

name: le_count_apply
statement: theorem le_count_apply : ∑' _ : s, (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ count s
proof:
:=
  calc
    (∑' _ : s, 1 : ℝ≥0∞) = ∑' i, indicator s 1 i := tsum_subtype s 1
    _ ≤ ∑' i, dirac i s := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun _ => le_dirac_apply
    _ ≤ count s := le_sum_apply _ _

name: count_apply
statement: theorem count_apply (hs : MeasurableSet s) : count s = s.encard
proof:
:= by
  simp [count, hs, ← tsum_subtype]

name: count_apply_finset'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_apply_finset' {s : Finset α} (hs : MeasurableSet (s : Set α)) :
    count (↑s : Set α) = #s
proof: := by simp [count_apply hs]

name: count_apply_finset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_apply_finset [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (s : Finset α) :
    count (↑s : Set α) = #s
proof:
:=
  count_apply_finset' s.measurableSet

name: count_apply_finite'
statement:
theorem count_apply_finite' {s : Set α} (s_fin : s.Finite) (s_mble : MeasurableSet s) :
    count s = #s_fin.toFinset

name: count_apply_finite
statement:
theorem count_apply_finite [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite) :
    count s = #hs.toFinset
proof: := by rw [← count_apply_finset, Finite.coe_toFinset]

name: count_apply_infinite
statement: theorem count_apply_infinite (hs : s.Infinite) : count s = ∞
proof:
:= by
  refine top_unique (le_of_tendsto' ENNReal.tendsto_nat_nhds_top fun n => ?_)
  rcases hs.exists_subset_card_eq n with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  calc
    (#t : ℝ≥0∞) = ∑ i ∈ t, 1 := by simp
    _ = ∑' i : (t : Set α), 1 := (t.tsum_subtype 1).symm
    _ ≤ count (t : Set α) := le_count_apply
    _ ≤ count s := measure_mono ht

name: count_apply_eq_top'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_apply_eq_top' (s_mble : MeasurableSet s) : count s = ∞ ↔ s.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : s.Finite
  · simp [Set.Infinite, hs, count_apply_finite' hs s_mble]
  · change s.Infinite at hs
    simp [hs, count_apply_infinite]

name: count_apply_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_apply_eq_top [MeasurableSingletonClass α] : count s = ∞ ↔ s.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : s.Finite
  · exact count_apply_eq_top' hs.measurableSet
  · change s.Infinite at hs
    simp [hs, count_apply_infinite]

name: count_apply_lt_top'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_apply_lt_top' (s_mble : MeasurableSet s) : count s < ∞ ↔ s.Finite
proof:
:=
  calc
    count s < ∞ ↔ count s ≠ ∞ := lt_top_iff_ne_top
    _ ↔ ¬s.Infinite := not_congr (count_apply_eq_top' s_mble)
    _ ↔ s.Finite := Classical.not_not

name: count_apply_lt_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_apply_lt_top [MeasurableSingletonClass α] : count s < ∞ ↔ s.Finite
proof:
:=
  calc
    count s < ∞ ↔ count s ≠ ∞ := lt_top_iff_ne_top
    _ ↔ ¬s.Infinite := not_congr count_apply_eq_top
    _ ↔ s.Finite := Classical.not_not

name: count_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_eq_zero_iff : count s = 0 ↔ s = ∅ where
  mp h
proof:
:= eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun x hx ↦ by
    simpa [hx] using ((ENNReal.le_tsum x).trans <| le_sum_apply _ _).trans_eq h
  mpr := by rintro rfl; exact measure_empty

name: count_ne_zero_iff
statement: lemma count_ne_zero_iff : count s ≠ 0 ↔ s.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  count_eq_zero_iff.not.trans nonempty_iff_ne_empty.symm

name: ae_count_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ae_count_iff {p : α → Prop} : (∀ᵐ x ∂count, p x) ↔ ∀ x, p x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x ↦ ?_, ae_of_all _⟩
  rw [ae_iff, count_eq_zero_iff] at h
  by_contra hx
  rwa [← mem_empty_iff_false x, ← h]

name: count_singleton'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_singleton' {a : α} (ha : MeasurableSet ({a} : Set α)) : count ({a} : Set α) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [count_apply_finite' (Set.finite_singleton a) ha, Set.Finite.toFinset]
  simp

name: count_singleton
statement: theorem count_singleton [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (a : α) : count ({a} : Set α) = 1
proof:
:=
  count_singleton' (measurableSet_singleton a)

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.count_real_singleton'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.count_real_singleton'
    {a : α} (ha : MeasurableSet ({a} : Set α)) :
    count.real ({a} : Set α) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureReal_def, count_singleton' ha, ENNReal.toReal_one]

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.count_real_singleton
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.count_real_singleton [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (a : α) :
    count.real ({a} : Set α) = 1
proof:
:=
  count_real_singleton' (measurableSet_singleton a)

name: count_injective_image'
statement:
theorem count_injective_image' {f : β → α} (hf : Function.Injective f) {s : Set β}
    (s_mble : MeasurableSet s) (fs_mble : MeasurableSet (f '' s)) : count (f '' s) = count s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs : s.Finite
  · lift s to Finset β using hs
    rw [← Finset.coe_image, count_apply_finset' _, count_apply_finset' s_mble,
      s.card_image_of_injective hf]
    simpa only [Finset.coe_image] using fs_mble
  · rw [count_apply_infinite hs]
    rw [← finite_image_iff hf.injOn] at hs
    rw [count_apply_infinite hs]

name: count_injective_image
statement:
theorem count_injective_image [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasurableSingletonClass β] {f : β → α}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (s : Set β) : count (f '' s) = count s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : s.Finite
  · exact count_injective_image' hf hs.measurableSet (Finite.image f hs).measurableSet
  rw [count_apply_infinite hs]
  rw [← finite_image_iff hf.injOn] at hs
  rw [count_apply_infinite hs]

name: count_univ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma count_univ : count (univ : Set α) = ENat.card α
proof: := by simp [count_apply .univ, encard_univ]

name: count_real_univ
statement: @[simp] lemma count_real_univ : count.real (.univ : Set α) = Nat.card α
proof: := by simp [Measure.real]

name: _root_.Subsingleton.count_eq_dirac
statement:
lemma _root_.Subsingleton.count_eq_dirac [Subsingleton α] (i : α) :
    count = dirac i
proof:
:= by
  calc count
      = count.restrict univ := by simp
    _ = count.restrict {i} := by congr; ext j; simp [Subsingleton.elim j i]
    _ = dirac i := by simp

name: _root_.Unique.count_eq_dirac
statement: lemma _root_.Unique.count_eq_dirac [Unique α] : count = dirac (default : α)
proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.count_eq_dirac _

name: _root_.Function.Injective.map_count_le
statement:
lemma _root_.Function.Injective.map_count_le {f : α → β}
    (hf : f.Injective) (h2f : Measurable f) : count.map f ≤ count
proof:
:= by
  refine le_intro fun s hs _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_apply h2f hs, count_apply (hs.preimage h2f), count_apply hs, ← hf.encard_image]
  have := image_preimage_subset f s
  gcongr

name: Measure.MeasureDense.nonempty
statement: theorem Measure.MeasureDense.nonempty (h𝒜 : μ.MeasureDense 𝒜) : 𝒜.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rcases h𝒜.approx ∅ MeasurableSet.empty (by simp) 1 (by simp) with ⟨t, ht, -⟩
  exact ⟨t, ht⟩

name: Measure.MeasureDense.nonempty'
statement:
theorem Measure.MeasureDense.nonempty' (h𝒜 : μ.MeasureDense 𝒜) :
    {s | s ∈ 𝒜 ∧ μ s ≠ ∞}.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rcases h𝒜.approx ∅ MeasurableSet.empty (by simp) 1 (by simp) with ⟨t, ht, hμt⟩
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  convert! ne_top_of_lt hμt
  rw [← bot_eq_empty, bot_symmDiff]

name: measureDense_measurableSet
statement:
theorem measureDense_measurableSet : μ.MeasureDense {s | MeasurableSet s} where
  measurable _ h
proof:
:= h
  approx s hs _ ε ε_pos := ⟨s, hs, by simpa⟩

name: Measure.MeasureDense.completion
statement:
theorem Measure.MeasureDense.completion (h𝒜 : μ.MeasureDense 𝒜) : μ.completion.MeasureDense 𝒜 where
  measurable s hs
proof:
:= (h𝒜.measurable s hs).nullMeasurableSet
  approx s hs hμs ε ε_pos := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hμst⟩ :=
      h𝒜.approx (toMeasurable μ s) (measurableSet_toMeasurable μ s) (by simpa) ε ε_pos
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    convert! hμst using 1
    rw [completion_apply]
    exact measure_congr <| ae_eq_set_symmDiff (NullMeasurableSet.toMeasurable_ae_eq hs).symm
      Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl

name: Measure.MeasureDense.fin_meas_approx
proof:
:= by
  rcases h𝒜.approx s ms hμs ε ε_pos with ⟨t, t_mem, ht⟩
  exact ⟨t, t_mem, (measure_ne_top_iff_of_symmDiff <| ne_top_of_lt ht).1 hμs, ht⟩

name: Measure.MeasureDense.indicatorConstLp_subset_closure
statement:
theorem Measure.MeasureDense.indicatorConstLp_subset_closure (h𝒜 : μ.MeasureDense 𝒜) (c : E) :
    {indicatorConstLp p hs hμs c | (s : Set X) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hμs : μ s ≠ ∞)} ⊆
    closure {indicatorConstLp p (h𝒜.measurable s hs) hμs c |
      (s : Set X) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜) (hμs : μ s ≠ ∞)}
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hc := eq_or_ne c 0
  · refine Subset.trans ?_ subset_closure
    rintro - ⟨s, ms, hμs, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hμt⟩ := h𝒜.nonempty'
    refine ⟨t, ht, hμt, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [indicatorConstLp]
    simp
  · have p_pos : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp) one_le_p.elim
    rintro - ⟨s, ms, hμs, rfl⟩
    refine Metric.mem_closure_iff.2 fun ε hε ↦ ?_
    have aux : 0 < (ε / ‖c‖) ^ p.toReal := rpow_pos_of_pos (div_pos hε (norm_pos_iff.2 hc)) _
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hμt, hμst⟩ := h𝒜.fin_meas_approx ms hμs ((ε / ‖c‖) ^ p.toReal) aux
    refine ⟨indicatorConstLp p (h𝒜.measurable t ht) hμt c,
      ⟨t, ht, hμt, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [dist_indicatorConstLp_eq_norm, norm_indicatorConstLp p_pos.ne.symm p_ne_top.elim]
    calc
      ‖c‖ * μ.real (s ∆ t) ^ (1 / p.toReal)
        < ‖c‖ * (ENNReal.ofReal ((ε / ‖c‖) ^ p.toReal)).toReal ^ (1 / p.toReal) := by
          have := toReal_pos p_pos.ne.symm p_ne_top.elim
          rw [measureReal_def]
          gcongr
          exact ofReal_ne_top
      _ = ε := by
        rw [toReal_ofReal (by positivity),
          one_div, Real.rpow_rpow_inv (by positivity) (toReal_pos p_pos.ne.symm p_ne_top.elim).ne',
          mul_div_cancel₀ _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hc)]

name: Measure.MeasureDense.fin_meas
statement:
theorem Measure.MeasureDense.fin_meas (h𝒜 : μ.MeasureDense 𝒜) :
    μ.MeasureDense {s | s ∈ 𝒜 ∧ μ s ≠ ∞} where
  measurable s h
proof:
:= h𝒜.measurable s h.1
  approx s ms hμs ε ε_pos := by
    rcases Measure.MeasureDense.fin_meas_approx h𝒜 ms hμs ε ε_pos with ⟨t, t_mem, hμt, hμst⟩
    exact ⟨t, ⟨t_mem, hμt⟩, hμst⟩

name: Measure.MeasureDense.of_generateFrom_isSetAlgebra_finite
statement:
theorem Measure.MeasureDense.of_generateFrom_isSetAlgebra_finite [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜) (hgen : m = MeasurableSpace.generateFrom 𝒜) : μ.MeasureDense 𝒜 where
  measurable s hs
proof:
:= hgen ▸ measurableSet_generateFrom hs
  approx s ms := by
    
    
    
    have : MeasurableSet s ∧ ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ t ∈ 𝒜, μ.real (s ∆ t) < ε := by
      rw [hgen] at ms
      induction s, ms using generateFrom_induction with
      
      | hC t t_mem _ =>
        exact ⟨hgen ▸ measurableSet_generateFrom t_mem, fun ε ε_pos ↦ ⟨t, t_mem, by simpa⟩⟩
      
      | empty => exact ⟨MeasurableSet.empty, fun ε ε_pos ↦ ⟨∅, h𝒜.empty_mem, by simpa⟩⟩
      
      
      | compl t _ ht =>
        refine ⟨ht.1.compl, fun ε ε_pos ↦ ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨u, u_mem, hμtcu⟩ := ht.2 ε ε_pos
        exact ⟨uᶜ, h𝒜.compl_mem u_mem, by rwa [compl_symmDiff_compl]⟩
      
      | iUnion f _ hf =>
        refine ⟨MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun n ↦ (hf n).1), fun ε ε_pos ↦ ?_⟩
        
        have := tendsto_measure_iUnion_accumulate (μ := μ) (s := f)
        rw [← tendsto_toReal_iff (fun _ ↦ measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_ne_top _ _)] at this
        
        rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 this (ε / 2) (by linarith [ε_pos]) with ⟨N, hN⟩
        
        choose g g_mem hg using fun n ↦ (hf n).2 (ε / (2 * (N + 1))) (div_pos ε_pos (by linarith))
        
        
        
        
        
        refine ⟨⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), g n, h𝒜.biUnion_mem _ (fun i _ ↦ g_mem i), ?_⟩
        calc
          μ.real ((⋃ n, f n) ∆ (⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), g n))
            ≤ (μ ((⋃ n, f n) \ ((⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), f n)) ∪
              ((⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), f n) ∆
              (⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), g ↑n)))).toReal :=
                toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _)
                  (measure_mono <| symmDiff_of_ge (iUnion_subset <|
                  fun i ↦ iUnion_subset (fun _ ↦ subset_iUnion f i)) ▸ symmDiff_triangle ..)
          _ ≤ (μ ((⋃ n, f n) \
              ((⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), f n)))).toReal +
              (μ ((⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), f n) ∆
              (⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), g ↑n))).toReal := by
                rw [← toReal_add (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_ne_top _ _)]
                exact toReal_mono (add_ne_top.2 ⟨measure_ne_top _ _, measure_ne_top _ _⟩) <|
                  measure_union_le _ _
          _ < ε := by
                rw [← add_halves ε]
                apply _root_.add_lt_add
                · rw [measure_sdiff (h_fin := measure_ne_top _ _),
                    toReal_sub_of_le (ha := measure_ne_top _ _)]
                  · apply lt_of_le_of_lt (sub_le_dist ..)
                    simp only [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_add_one_iff]
                    exact (dist_comm (α := ℝ) .. ▸ hN N (le_refl N))
                  · exact measure_mono <| iUnion_subset <|
                      fun i ↦ iUnion_subset fun _ ↦ subset_iUnion f i
                  · exact iUnion_subset <| fun i ↦ iUnion_subset (fun _ ↦ subset_iUnion f i)
                  · exact MeasurableSet.biUnion (countable_coe_iff.1 inferInstance)
                      (fun n _ ↦ (hf n).1.nullMeasurableSet)
                · calc
                    (μ ((⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), f n) ∆
                    (⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), g ↑n))).toReal
                      ≤ μ.real (⋃ n ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)), f n ∆ g n) :=
                          toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_mono biSup_symmDiff_biSup_le)
                    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), μ.real (f n ∆ g n) := by
                          simp_rw [measureReal_def, ← toReal_sum (fun _ _ ↦ measure_ne_top _ _)]
                          exact toReal_mono (ne_of_lt <| sum_lt_top.2 fun _ _ ↦ measure_lt_top μ _)
                            (measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _)
                    _ < ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (ε / (2 * (N + 1))) :=
                          Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun i _ ↦ le_of_lt (hg i)) ⟨0, by simp, hg 0⟩
                    _ ≤ ε / 2 := by
                          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul,
                            Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
                          rw [div_mul_eq_div_mul_one_div, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm ((N : ℝ) + 1),
                            mul_assoc]
                          exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by linarith [ε_pos]) <|
                            le_of_eq <| mul_one_div_cancel <| Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero _
    rintro - ε ε_pos
    rcases this.2 ε ε_pos with ⟨t, t_mem, hμst⟩
    exact ⟨t, t_mem, (lt_ofReal_iff_toReal_lt (measure_ne_top _ _)).2 hμst⟩

name: Measure.MeasureDense.of_generateFrom_isSetAlgebra_sigmaFinite
statement:
theorem Measure.MeasureDense.of_generateFrom_isSetAlgebra_sigmaFinite (h𝒜 : IsSetAlgebra 𝒜)
    (S : μ.FiniteSpanningSetsIn 𝒜) (hgen : m = MeasurableSpace.generateFrom 𝒜) :
    μ.MeasureDense 𝒜 where
  measurable s hs
proof:
:= hgen ▸ measurableSet_generateFrom hs
  approx s ms hμs ε ε_pos := by
    
    let T := accumulate S.set
    have T_mem (n) : T n ∈ 𝒜 := by
      simpa using! h𝒜.biUnion_mem {k | k ≤ n}.toFinset (fun k _ ↦ S.set_mem k)
    have T_finite (n) : μ (T n) < ∞ := by
      simpa using! measure_biUnion_lt_top {k | k ≤ n}.toFinset.finite_toSet
        (fun k _ ↦ S.finite k)
    have T_spanning : ⋃ n, T n = univ := S.spanning ▸ iUnion_accumulate
    
    
    have mono : Monotone (fun n ↦ (T n) ∩ s) := fun m n hmn ↦ inter_subset_inter_left s
        (biUnion_subset_biUnion_left fun k hkm ↦ Nat.le_trans hkm hmn)
    have := tendsto_measure_iUnion_atTop (μ := μ) mono
    rw [← tendsto_toReal_iff] at this
    · 
      rcases Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 this (ε / 2) (by linarith [ε_pos]) with ⟨N, hN⟩
      have : Fact (μ (T N) < ∞) := Fact.mk <| T_finite N
      
      
      rcases (Measure.MeasureDense.of_generateFrom_isSetAlgebra_finite
        (μ.restrict (T N)) h𝒜 hgen).approx s ms
        (ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (μ.restrict_apply_le _ s) hμs.lt_top))
        (ε / 2) (by linarith [ε_pos])
        with ⟨t, t_mem, ht⟩
      
      
      
      
      refine ⟨t ∩ T N, h𝒜.inter_mem t_mem (T_mem N), ?_⟩
      calc
        μ (s ∆ (t ∩ T N))
          ≤ μ (s \ (s ∩ T N)) + μ ((s ∆ t) ∩ T N) := by
              rw [← symmDiff_of_le (inter_subset_left ..), symmDiff_comm _ s,
                inter_symmDiff_distrib_right]
              exact measure_symmDiff_le _ _ _
        _ < ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 2) + ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 2) := by
              apply ENNReal.add_lt_add
              · rw [measure_sdiff
                    (inter_subset_left ..)
                    (ms.inter (hgen ▸ measurableSet_generateFrom (T_mem N))).nullMeasurableSet
                    (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hμs (measure_mono (inter_subset_left ..))),
                  lt_ofReal_iff_toReal_lt (sub_ne_top hμs),
                  toReal_sub_of_le (measure_mono (inter_subset_left ..)) hμs]
                apply lt_of_le_of_lt (sub_le_dist ..)
                nth_rw 1 [← univ_inter s]
                rw [inter_comm s, dist_comm, ← T_spanning, iUnion_inter _ T]
                apply hN N (le_refl _)
              · rwa [← μ.restrict_apply' (hgen ▸ measurableSet_generateFrom (T_mem N))]
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
              rw [← ofReal_add (by linarith [ε_pos]) (by linarith [ε_pos]), add_halves]
    · exact fun n ↦ ne_top_of_le_ne_top hμs (measure_mono (inter_subset_right ..))
    · exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top hμs
        (measure_mono (iUnion_subset (fun i ↦ inter_subset_right ..)))

name: exists_countable_measureDense
statement:
theorem exists_countable_measureDense [IsSeparable μ] :
    ∃ 𝒜, 𝒜.Countable ∧ μ.MeasureDense 𝒜
proof:
:=
  IsSeparable.exists_countable_measureDense

name: isSeparable_of_sigmaFinite
statement:
theorem isSeparable_of_sigmaFinite [CountablyGenerated X] [SigmaFinite μ] :
    IsSeparable μ where
  exists_countable_measureDense
proof:
:= by
    have h := countable_countableGeneratingSet (α := X)
    have hgen := generateFrom_countableGeneratingSet (α := X)
    let 𝒜 := (countableGeneratingSet X) ∪ {μ.toFiniteSpanningSetsIn.set n | n : ℕ}
    have count_𝒜 : 𝒜.Countable :=
      countable_union.2 ⟨h, countable_iff_exists_subset_range.2
        ⟨μ.toFiniteSpanningSetsIn.set, fun _ hx ↦ hx⟩⟩
    refine ⟨generateSetAlgebra 𝒜, countable_generateSetAlgebra count_𝒜,
      Measure.MeasureDense.of_generateFrom_isSetAlgebra_sigmaFinite isSetAlgebra_generateSetAlgebra
      { set := μ.toFiniteSpanningSetsIn.set
        set_mem := fun n ↦ self_subset_generateSetAlgebra (𝒜 := 𝒜) <| Or.inr ⟨n, rfl⟩
        finite := μ.toFiniteSpanningSetsIn.finite
        spanning := μ.toFiniteSpanningSetsIn.spanning }
      (le_antisymm ?_ (generateFrom_le (fun s hs ↦ ?_)))⟩
    · rw [← hgen]
      exact generateFrom_mono <| le_trans self_subset_generateSetAlgebra <|
        generateSetAlgebra_mono <| subset_union_left ..
    · induction hs using generateSetAlgebra_induction with
      | base t t_mem =>
        rcases t_mem with t_mem | ⟨n, rfl⟩
        · exact hgen ▸ measurableSet_generateFrom t_mem
        · exact μ.toFiniteSpanningSetsIn.set_mem n
      | empty => exact MeasurableSet.empty
      | compl t _ t_mem => exact MeasurableSet.compl t_mem
      | union t u _ _ t_mem u_mem => exact MeasurableSet.union t_mem u_mem

name: pi_map_pi

name: continuous_pi
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem continuous_pi [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (α i)] [∀ i, SecondCountableTopology (α i)]
    [∀ i, PseudoMetrizableSpace (α i)] [∀ i, OpensMeasurableSpace (α i)] :
    Continuous (fun (μ : Π i, ProbabilityMeasure (α i)) ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.pi μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  /- It suffices to check the convergence along elements of a π-system containing arbitrarily
  small neighborhoods of any point, by `tendsto_probabilityMeasure_of_tendsto_of_mem`.
  We take as a π-system the sets of the form `s₁ × ... × sₙ` where all the `sᵢ` have
  null frontier. -/
  let S : Set (Set (Π i, α i)) := {t | ∃ (s : Π i, Set (α i)), t = univ.pi s ∧
    (∀ i, MeasurableSet (s i)) ∧ (∀ i, μ i (frontier (s i)) = 0)}
  have : IsPiSystem S := by
    rintro - ⟨s, rfl, smeas, hs⟩ - ⟨s', rfl, s'meas, hs'⟩ -
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ s i ∩ s' i, pi_inter_distrib.symm, fun i ↦ (smeas i).inter (s'meas i),
      fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    simp_rw [null_iff_toMeasure_null] at hs hs' ⊢
    exact null_frontier_inter (hs i) (hs' i)
  apply this.tendsto_probabilityMeasure_of_tendsto_of_mem
  · rintro - ⟨s, rfl, smeas, hs⟩
    exact MeasurableSet.univ_pi smeas
  · let : ∀ i, PseudoMetricSpace (α i) :=
      fun i ↦ TopologicalSpace.pseudoMetrizableSpacePseudoMetric (α i)
    intro u u_open x xu
    obtain ⟨ε, εpos, hε⟩ : ∃ ε > 0, ball x ε ⊆ u := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 u_open x xu
    have A (i) : ∃ r ∈ Ioo 0 ε, (μ i : Measure (α i)) (frontier (Metric.thickening r {x i})) = 0 :=
      exists_null_frontier_thickening _ _ εpos
    choose! r rpos hr using A
    refine ⟨univ.pi (fun i ↦ ball (x i) (r i)), ⟨fun i ↦ ball (x i) (r i), rfl,
      fun i ↦ measurableSet_ball, fun i ↦ by simpa using hr i⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply IsOpen.mem_nhds
      · exact isOpen_set_pi finite_univ (by simp)
      · simpa using fun i ↦ (rpos i).1
    · calc univ.pi fun i ↦ ball (x i) (r i)
      _ ⊆ univ.pi fun i ↦ ball (x i) ε := by gcongr with i hi; exact (rpos i).2.le
      _ ⊆ u := by rwa [← ball_pi _ εpos]
  · rintro - ⟨s, rfl, smeas, hs⟩
    simp only [pi_pi]
    apply tendsto_finsetProd _ (fun i hi ↦ ?_)
    exact tendsto_measure_of_null_frontier_of_tendsto (Tendsto.apply_nhds (fun ⦃U⦄ a ↦ a) i) (hs i)

name: le_toOuterMeasure_caratheodory

:=
  fun _s hs _t => (measure_inter_add_sdiff _ hs).symm

name: toMeasure_toOuterMeasure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_toOuterMeasure (m : OuterMeasure α) (h : ms ≤ m.caratheodory) :
    (m.toMeasure h).toOuterMeasure = m.trim
proof:
:=

name: toMeasure_apply
proof:
:=
  m.trim_eq hs

name: le_toMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem le_toMeasure_apply (m : OuterMeasure α) (h : ms ≤ m.caratheodory) (s : Set α) :
    m s ≤ m.toMeasure h s
proof:

name: toMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem toMeasure_apply₀ (m : OuterMeasure α) (h : ms ≤ m.caratheodory) {s : Set α}
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s (m.toMeasure h)) : m.toMeasure h s = m s
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_toMeasure_apply _ _ _)
  rcases hs.exists_measurable_subset_ae_eq with ⟨t, hts, htm, heq⟩
  calc
    m.toMeasure h s = m.toMeasure h t := measure_congr heq.symm
    _ = m t := toMeasure_apply m h htm
    _ ≤ m s := m.mono hts

name: toOuterMeasure_toMeasure

name: tilted_of_not_integrable
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tilted_of_not_integrable (hf : ¬ Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) : μ.tilted f = 0

name: tilted_of_not_aemeasurable

proof:

  refine tilted_of_not_integrable ?_
  suffices ¬ AEMeasurable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ by exact fun h ↦ this h.1.aemeasurable

name: tilted_zero_measure

name: tilted_const'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tilted_const' (μ : Measure α) (c : ℝ) :
    μ.tilted (fun _ ↦ c) = (μ Set.univ)⁻¹ • μ
proof:
:= by
  cases eq_zero_or_neZero μ with
  | inl h => rw [h]; simp
  | inr h0 =>
    simp only [Measure.tilted, withDensity_const, integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases h_univ : μ Set.univ = ∞
    · simp only [measureReal_def, h_univ, ENNReal.toReal_top, zero_mul, div_zero,
      ENNReal.ofReal_zero, zero_smul, ENNReal.inv_top]
    congr
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv, mul_comm, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (exp_pos _).ne', mul_one,
      measureReal_def, ← ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal]
    simp [h0.out]

name: tilted_zero

name: tilted_congr
statement:
lemma tilted_congr {g : α → ℝ} (hfg : f =ᵐ[μ] g) :
    μ.tilted f = μ.tilted g
proof:
:= by
  have h_int_eq : ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ = ∫ x, exp (g x) ∂μ := by
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [hfg] with x hx
    rw [hx]
  refine withDensity_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hfg] with x hx
  rw [h_int_eq, hx]

name: tilted_eq_withDensity_nnreal
statement:
lemma tilted_eq_withDensity_nnreal (μ : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    μ.tilted f = μ.withDensity (fun x ↦ ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0∞)
      (.mk (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) (by positivity)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.tilted]
  congr with x
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_coe_nnreal]

name: tilted_apply'
statement:
lemma tilted_apply' (μ : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :

name: tilted_apply
statement:
lemma tilted_apply (μ : Measure α) [SFinite μ] (f : α → ℝ) (s : Set α) :
    μ.tilted f s = ∫⁻ a in s, ENNReal.ofReal (exp (f a) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) ∂μ
proof:
