name: tilted_apply_eq_ofReal_integral'
statement:
lemma tilted_apply_eq_ofReal_integral' {s : Set α} (f : α → ℝ) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    μ.tilted f s = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ a in s, exp (f a) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ
  · rw [tilted_apply' _ _ hs, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal]
    · exact hf.integrableOn.div_const _
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun _ ↦ by positivity)
  · simp only [hf, not_false_eq_true, tilted_of_not_integrable, Measure.coe_zero,
      Pi.zero_apply, integral_undef hf, div_zero, integral_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]

name: tilted_apply_eq_ofReal_integral
statement:
lemma tilted_apply_eq_ofReal_integral [SFinite μ] (f : α → ℝ) (s : Set α) :
    μ.tilted f s = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ a in s, exp (f a) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ
  · rw [tilted_apply _ _, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal]
    · exact hf.integrableOn.div_const _
    · exact ae_of_all _ (fun _ ↦ by positivity)
  · simp [tilted_of_not_integrable hf, integral_undef hf]

name: isProbabilityMeasure_tilted
statement:
lemma isProbabilityMeasure_tilted [NeZero μ] (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.tilted f)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  simp_rw [tilted_apply' _ _ MeasurableSet.univ, setLIntegral_univ,
    ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos (integral_exp_pos hf), div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [lintegral_mul_const'' _ hf.1.aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal,
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hf (ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ (exp_pos _).le),
    ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel]
  · simp only [ne_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le]
    exact integral_exp_pos hf
  · simp

name: setLIntegral_tilted'
statement:
lemma setLIntegral_tilted' (f : α → ℝ) (g : α → ℝ≥0∞) {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ∫⁻ x in s, g x ∂(μ.tilted f)
      = ∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) * g x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : AEMeasurable f μ
  · rw [Measure.tilted, setLIntegral_withDensity_eq_setLIntegral_mul_non_measurable₀]
    · simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
    · refine AEMeasurable.restrict ?_
      exact ((measurable_exp.comp_aemeasurable hf).div_const _).ennreal_ofReal
    · exact hs
    · filter_upwards
      simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top, implies_true]
  · have hf' : ¬ Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ := by
      exact fun h ↦ hf (aemeasurable_of_aemeasurable_exp h.1.aemeasurable)
    simp only [hf, not_false_eq_true, tilted_of_not_aemeasurable, Measure.restrict_zero,
      lintegral_zero_measure]
    rw [integral_undef hf']
    simp

name: setLIntegral_tilted
statement:
lemma setLIntegral_tilted [SFinite μ] (f : α → ℝ) (g : α → ℝ≥0∞) (s : Set α) :
    ∫⁻ x in s, g x ∂(μ.tilted f)
      = ∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) * g x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : AEMeasurable f μ
  · rw [Measure.tilted, setLIntegral_withDensity_eq_setLIntegral_mul_non_measurable₀']
    · simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
    · refine AEMeasurable.restrict ?_
      exact ((measurable_exp.comp_aemeasurable hf).div_const _).ennreal_ofReal
    · filter_upwards
      simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top, implies_true]
  · have hf' : ¬ Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ := by
      exact fun h ↦ hf (aemeasurable_of_aemeasurable_exp h.1.aemeasurable)
    simp only [hf, not_false_eq_true, tilted_of_not_aemeasurable, Measure.restrict_zero,
      lintegral_zero_measure]
    rw [integral_undef hf']
    simp

name: lintegral_tilted
statement:
lemma lintegral_tilted (f : α → ℝ) (g : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∫⁻ x, g x ∂(μ.tilted f)
      = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) * (g x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← setLIntegral_univ, setLIntegral_tilted' f g MeasurableSet.univ, setLIntegral_univ]

name: setIntegral_tilted'
statement:
lemma setIntegral_tilted' (f : α → ℝ) (g : α → E) {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ∫ x in s, g x ∂(μ.tilted f) = ∫ x in s, (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) • (g x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : AEMeasurable f μ
  · rw [tilted_eq_withDensity_nnreal, setIntegral_withDensity_eq_setIntegral_smul₀ _ _ hs]
    · congr
    · suffices AEMeasurable (fun x ↦ exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) μ by
        rw [← aemeasurable_coe_nnreal_real_iff]
        refine AEMeasurable.restrict ?_
        simpa only [NNReal.coe_mk]
      exact (measurable_exp.comp_aemeasurable hf).div_const _
  · have hf' : ¬ Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ := by
      exact fun h ↦ hf (aemeasurable_of_aemeasurable_exp h.1.aemeasurable)
    simp only [hf, not_false_eq_true, tilted_of_not_aemeasurable, Measure.restrict_zero,
      integral_zero_measure]
    rw [integral_undef hf']
    simp

name: setIntegral_tilted
statement:
lemma setIntegral_tilted [SFinite μ] (f : α → ℝ) (g : α → E) (s : Set α) :
    ∫ x in s, g x ∂(μ.tilted f) = ∫ x in s, (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) • (g x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : AEMeasurable f μ
  · rw [tilted_eq_withDensity_nnreal, setIntegral_withDensity_eq_setIntegral_smul₀']
    · congr
    · suffices AEMeasurable (fun x ↦ exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) μ by
        rw [← aemeasurable_coe_nnreal_real_iff]
        refine AEMeasurable.restrict ?_
        simpa only [NNReal.coe_mk]
      exact (measurable_exp.comp_aemeasurable hf).div_const _
  · have hf' : ¬ Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ := by
      exact fun h ↦ hf (aemeasurable_of_aemeasurable_exp h.1.aemeasurable)
    simp only [hf, not_false_eq_true, tilted_of_not_aemeasurable, Measure.restrict_zero,
      integral_zero_measure]
    rw [integral_undef hf']
    simp

name: integral_tilted
statement:
lemma integral_tilted (f : α → ℝ) (g : α → E) :
    ∫ x, g x ∂(μ.tilted f) = ∫ x, (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) • (g x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← setIntegral_univ, setIntegral_tilted' f g MeasurableSet.univ, setIntegral_univ]

name: integral_exp_tilted
statement:
lemma integral_exp_tilted (f g : α → ℝ) :
    ∫ x, exp (g x) ∂(μ.tilted f) = (∫ x, exp ((f + g) x) ∂μ) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  cases eq_zero_or_neZero μ with
  | inl h => rw [h]; simp
  | inr h0 =>
    rw [integral_tilted f]
    simp_rw [smul_eq_mul]
    have : ∀ x, (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) * exp (g x)
        = (exp ((f + g) x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) := by
      intro x
      rw [Pi.add_apply, exp_add]
      ring
    simp_rw [this, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [integral_mul_const]

name: tilted_tilted
statement:
lemma tilted_tilted (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) (g : α → ℝ) :
    (μ.tilted f).tilted g = μ.tilted (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  cases eq_zero_or_neZero μ with
  | inl h => simp [h]
  | inr h0 =>
    ext1 s hs
    rw [tilted_apply' _ _ hs, tilted_apply' _ _ hs, setLIntegral_tilted' f _ hs]
    congr with x
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity),
      integral_exp_tilted f, Pi.add_apply, exp_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    have := (integral_exp_pos hf).ne'
    simp [field]

name: tilted_comm
proof:
:= by
  rw [tilted_tilted hf, add_comm, tilted_tilted hg]

name: tilted_neg_same'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tilted_neg_same' (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) :
    (μ.tilted f).tilted (-f) = (μ Set.univ)⁻¹ • μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [tilted_tilted hf]; simp

name: tilted_neg_same
statement:
lemma tilted_neg_same [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) :
    (μ.tilted f).tilted (-f) = μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [hf]

name: tilted_absolutelyContinuous
statement: lemma tilted_absolutelyContinuous (μ : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) : μ.tilted f ≪ μ
proof:
:=
  withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _

name: absolutelyContinuous_tilted
statement: lemma absolutelyContinuous_tilted (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) : μ ≪ μ.tilted f
proof:
:= by
  cases eq_zero_or_neZero μ with
  | inl h => simp only [h, tilted_zero_measure]; exact fun _ _ ↦ by simp
  | inr h0 =>
    refine withDensity_absolutelyContinuous' ?_ ?_
    · exact (hf.1.aemeasurable.div_const _).ennreal_ofReal
    · filter_upwards
      simp only [ne_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le]
      exact fun _ ↦ div_pos (exp_pos _) (integral_exp_pos hf)

name: integrable_tilted_iff
statement:
lemma integrable_tilted_iff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) (g : α → E) :
    Integrable g (μ.tilted f) ↔ Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x) • g x) μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : μ = 0
  · simp [hμ]
  have hf_meas : AEMeasurable f μ := aemeasurable_of_aemeasurable_exp hf.1.aemeasurable
  rw [Measure.tilted, integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul₀' (by fun_prop) (by simp)]
  calc Integrable (fun x ↦ (ENNReal.ofReal (exp (f x) / ∫ a, exp (f a) ∂μ)).toReal • g x) μ
  _ ↔ Integrable (fun x ↦ (exp (f x) / ∫ a, exp (f a) ∂μ) • g x) μ := by
    congr! with a
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal]
    positivity
  _ ↔ Integrable (fun x ↦ (∫ a, exp (f a) ∂μ)⁻¹ • exp (f x) • g x) μ := by
    congr! 2 with a
    rw [smul_smul, div_eq_inv_mul]
  _ ↔ Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x) • g x) μ := by
    rw [integrable_fun_smul_iff]
    simp only [ne_eq, inv_eq_zero]
    have : NeZero μ := ⟨hμ⟩
    exact (integral_exp_pos hf).ne'

name: rnDeriv_tilted_right
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_tilted_right (μ ν : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) ν) :
    μ.rnDeriv (ν.tilted f)
      =ᵐ[ν] fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (exp (-f x) * ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂ν) * μ.rnDeriv ν x
proof:
:= by
  cases eq_zero_or_neZero ν with
  | inl h => simp_rw [h, ae_zero, Filter.EventuallyEq]; exact Filter.eventually_bot
  | inr h0 =>
    refine (Measure.rnDeriv_withDensity_right μ ν ?_ ?_ ?_).trans ?_
    · exact (hf.1.aemeasurable.div_const _).ennreal_ofReal
    · filter_upwards
      simp only [ne_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le]
      exact fun _ ↦ div_pos (exp_pos _) (integral_exp_pos hf)
    · refine ae_of_all _ (by simp)
    · filter_upwards with x
      congr
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos, inv_div', ← exp_neg, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_inv]
      exact div_pos (exp_pos _) (integral_exp_pos hf)

name: toReal_rnDeriv_tilted_right
statement:
lemma toReal_rnDeriv_tilted_right (μ ν : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) ν) :
    (fun x ↦ (μ.rnDeriv (ν.tilted f) x).toReal)
      =ᵐ[ν] fun x ↦ exp (-f x) * (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂ν) * (μ.rnDeriv ν x).toReal
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [rnDeriv_tilted_right μ ν hf] with x hx
  rw [hx]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, mul_eq_mul_right_iff, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal_eq_iff]
  exact Or.inl (by positivity)

name: rnDeriv_tilted_left
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_tilted_left {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hfν : AEMeasurable f ν) :
    (μ.tilted f).rnDeriv ν
      =ᵐ[ν] fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (exp (f x) / (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ)) * μ.rnDeriv ν x
proof:
:= by
  let g := fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (exp (f x) / (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ))
  refine Measure.rnDeriv_withDensity_left (μ := μ) (ν := ν) (f := g) ?_ ?_
  · exact ((measurable_exp.comp_aemeasurable hfν).div_const _).ennreal_ofReal
  · exact ae_of_all _ (fun x ↦ by simp [g])

name: toReal_rnDeriv_tilted_left
statement:
lemma toReal_rnDeriv_tilted_left {ν : Measure α} [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hfν : AEMeasurable f ν) :
    (fun x ↦ ((μ.tilted f).rnDeriv ν x).toReal)
      =ᵐ[ν] fun x ↦ exp (f x) / (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) * (μ.rnDeriv ν x).toReal
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [rnDeriv_tilted_left μ hfν] with x hx
  rw [hx]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, mul_eq_mul_right_iff, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal_eq_iff]
  exact Or.inl (by positivity)

name: rnDeriv_tilted_left_self
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_tilted_left_self [SigmaFinite μ] (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) :
    (μ.tilted f).rnDeriv μ =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (rnDeriv_tilted_left μ hf).trans ?_
  filter_upwards [Measure.rnDeriv_self μ] with x hx
  rw [hx, mul_one]

name: log_rnDeriv_tilted_left_self
statement:
lemma log_rnDeriv_tilted_left_self [SigmaFinite μ] (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) :
    (fun x ↦ log ((μ.tilted f).rnDeriv μ x).toReal)
      =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ f x - log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  cases eq_zero_or_neZero μ with
  | inl h => simp_rw [h, ae_zero, Filter.EventuallyEq]; exact Filter.eventually_bot
  | inr h0 =>
    have hf' : AEMeasurable f μ := aemeasurable_of_aemeasurable_exp hf.1.aemeasurable
    filter_upwards [rnDeriv_tilted_left_self hf'] with x hx
    rw [hx, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity), log_div (exp_pos _).ne', log_exp]
    exact (integral_exp_pos hf).ne'

name: CompletelyRegularSpace.exists_BCNN
statement:
lemma CompletelyRegularSpace.exists_BCNN {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompletelyRegularSpace X]
    {K : Set X} (K_closed : IsClosed K) {x : X} (x_notin_K : x ∉ K) :
    ∃ (f : X →ᵇ ℝ≥0), f x = 1 ∧ (∀ y ∈ K, f y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, g_cont, gx_zero, g_one_on_K⟩ :=
    CompletelyRegularSpace.completely_regular x K K_closed x_notin_K
  have g_bdd : ∀ x y, dist (Real.toNNReal (g x)) (Real.toNNReal (g y)) ≤ 1 := by
    refine fun x y ↦ ((Real.lipschitzWith_toNNReal).dist_le_mul (g x) (g y)).trans ?_
    simpa using Real.dist_le_of_mem_Icc_01 (g x).prop (g y).prop
  set g' := BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfBound
      ⟨fun x ↦ Real.toNNReal (g x), continuous_real_toNNReal.comp g_cont.subtype_val⟩ 1 g_bdd
  set f := 1 - g'
  refine ⟨f, by simp [f, g', gx_zero], fun y y_in_K ↦ by simp [f, g', g_one_on_K y_in_K, tsub_self]⟩

name: injective_diracProba
statement:
lemma injective_diracProba {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace.SeparatesPoints X] :
    Function.Injective (fun (x : X) ↦ diracProba x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y x_eq_y
  simpa [diracProba, dirac_eq_dirac_iff] using congr(ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure $x_eq_y)

name: diracProba_toMeasure_apply'
statement:
@[simp] lemma diracProba_toMeasure_apply' (x : X) {A : Set X} (A_mble : MeasurableSet A) :
    (diracProba x).toMeasure A = A.indicator 1 x
proof: := Measure.dirac_apply' x A_mble

name: diracProba_toMeasure_apply_of_mem
statement:
@[simp] lemma diracProba_toMeasure_apply_of_mem {x : X} {A : Set X} (x_in_A : x ∈ A) :
    (diracProba x).toMeasure A = 1
proof: := Measure.dirac_apply_of_mem x_in_A

name: diracProba_toMeasure_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma diracProba_toMeasure_apply [MeasurableSingletonClass X] (x : X) (A : Set X) :
    (diracProba x).toMeasure A = A.indicator 1 x
proof: := Measure.dirac_apply _ _

name: continuous_diracProba
statement: lemma continuous_diracProba : Continuous (fun (x : X) ↦ diracProba x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  apply fun x ↦ ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_forall_lintegral_tendsto.mpr fun f ↦ ?_
  have f_mble : Measurable (fun X ↦ (f X : ℝ≥0∞)) :=
    measurable_coe_nnreal_ennreal_iff.mpr f.continuous.measurable
  simp only [diracProba, ProbabilityMeasure.coe_mk, lintegral_dirac' _ f_mble]
  exact (ENNReal.continuous_coe.comp f.continuous).continuousAt

name: not_tendsto_diracProba_of_not_tendsto
statement:
lemma not_tendsto_diracProba_of_not_tendsto [CompletelyRegularSpace X] {x : X} (L : Filter X)
    (h : ¬ Tendsto id L (𝓝 x)) :
    ¬ Tendsto diracProba L (𝓝 (diracProba x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, U_nhds, hU⟩ : ∃ U, U ∈ 𝓝 x ∧ ∃ᶠ x in L, x ∉ U := by
    contrapose! h
    exact h
  have Uint_nhds : interior U ∈ 𝓝 x := by simpa only [interior_mem_nhds] using U_nhds
  obtain ⟨f, fx_eq_one, f_vanishes_outside⟩ :=
    CompletelyRegularSpace.exists_BCNN isOpen_interior.isClosed_compl
      (by simpa only [mem_compl_iff, not_not] using mem_of_mem_nhds Uint_nhds)
  rw [ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_forall_lintegral_tendsto, not_forall]
  use f
  simp only [diracProba, ProbabilityMeasure.coe_mk, fx_eq_one,
             lintegral_dirac' _ (measurable_coe_nnreal_ennreal_iff.mpr f.continuous.measurable)]
  apply not_tendsto_iff_exists_frequently_notMem.mpr
  refine ⟨Ioi 0, Ioi_mem_nhds (by simp only [ENNReal.coe_one, zero_lt_one]),
          hU.mp (Eventually.of_forall ?_)⟩
  intro x x_notin_U
  rw [f_vanishes_outside x (compl_subset_compl.mpr interior_subset x_notin_U)]
  simp only [ENNReal.coe_zero, mem_Ioi, lt_self_iff_false, not_false_eq_true]

name: tendsto_diracProba_iff_tendsto
statement:
lemma tendsto_diracProba_iff_tendsto [CompletelyRegularSpace X] {x : X} (L : Filter X) :
    Tendsto diracProba L (𝓝 (diracProba x)) ↔ Tendsto id L (𝓝 x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · contrapose
    exact not_tendsto_diracProba_of_not_tendsto L
  · intro h
    have aux := (@continuous_diracProba X _ _ _).continuousAt (x := x)
    simp only [ContinuousAt] at aux
    exact aux.comp h

name: diracProba_diracProbaInverse
statement:
@[simp] lemma diracProba_diracProbaInverse {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : range (diracProba (X := X))) :
    diracProba (diracProbaInverse μ) = μ
proof: := (mem_range.mp μ.prop).choose_spec

name: diracProbaInverse_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply injective_diracProba (X := X)
  simp only [← h]
  exact (mem_range.mp μ.prop).choose_spec

name: diracProba_comp_diracProbaEquiv_symm_eq_val
statement:
lemma diracProba_comp_diracProbaEquiv_symm_eq_val [T0Space X] :
    diracProba ∘ (diracProbaEquiv (X := X)).symm = fun μ ↦ μ.val
proof:
:= by
  funext μ; simp [diracProbaEquiv]

name: tendsto_diracProbaEquivSymm_iff_tendsto
statement:
lemma tendsto_diracProbaEquivSymm_iff_tendsto [T0Space X] [CompletelyRegularSpace X]
    {μ : range (diracProba (X := X))} (F : Filter (range (diracProba (X := X)))) :
    Tendsto diracProbaEquiv.symm F (𝓝 (diracProbaEquiv.symm μ)) ↔ Tendsto id F (𝓝 μ)
proof:
:= by
  have key :=
    tendsto_diracProba_iff_tendsto (F.map diracProbaEquiv.symm) (x := diracProbaEquiv.symm μ)
  rw [← (diracProbaEquiv (X := X)).symm_comp_self, ← tendsto_map'_iff] at key
  simp only [tendsto_map'_iff, map_map, Equiv.self_comp_symm, map_id] at key
  simp only [← key, diracProba_comp_diracProbaEquiv_symm_eq_val]
  convert! tendsto_subtype_rng.symm
  exact apply_rangeSplitting (fun x ↦ diracProba x) μ

name: continuous_diracProbaEquiv
statement:
lemma continuous_diracProbaEquiv [T0Space X] :
    Continuous (diracProbaEquiv (X := X))
proof:
:=
  Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_diracProba mem_range_self

name: continuous_diracProbaEquivSymm
statement:
lemma continuous_diracProbaEquivSymm [T0Space X] [CompletelyRegularSpace X] :
    Continuous (diracProbaEquiv (X := X)).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro μ
  apply continuousAt_of_tendsto_nhds (y := diracProbaInverse μ)
  exact (tendsto_diracProbaEquivSymm_iff_tendsto _).mpr fun _ mem_nhds ↦ mem_nhds

name: isEmbedding_diracProba
statement:
theorem isEmbedding_diracProba [T0Space X] [CompletelyRegularSpace X] :
    IsEmbedding (fun (x : X) ↦ diracProba x)
proof:
:=
  IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.comp diracProbaHomeomorph.isEmbedding

name: exists_null_pairwise_disjoint_sdiff
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => toMeasurable μ (s i ∩ ⋃ j ∈ ({i}ᶜ : Set ι), s j), fun i =>
    measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [measure_toMeasurable, inter_iUnion]
    exact (measure_biUnion_null_iff <| to_countable _).2 fun j hj => hd (Ne.symm hj)
  · simp only [Pairwise, disjoint_left, onFun, mem_sdiff, not_and, and_imp, Classical.not_not]
    intro i j hne x hi hU hj
    replace hU : x ∉ s i ∩ iUnion fun j ↦ iUnion fun _ ↦ s j :=
      fun h ↦ hU (subset_toMeasurable _ _ h)
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_iUnion, not_and, not_exists] at hU
    exact (hU hi j hne.symm hj).elim

name: eq
statement: protected theorem eq (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) : μ (s ∩ t) = 0

name: symm
statement:
@[symm]
protected theorem symm (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) : AEDisjoint μ t s
proof: := by rwa [AEDisjoint, inter_comm]

name: comm
statement: protected theorem comm : AEDisjoint μ s t ↔ AEDisjoint μ t s
proof:
:=
  ⟨AEDisjoint.symm, AEDisjoint.symm⟩

name: _root_.Disjoint.aedisjoint
statement: protected theorem _root_.Disjoint.aedisjoint (h : Disjoint s t) : AEDisjoint μ s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [AEDisjoint, disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 h, measure_empty]

name: _root_.Pairwise.aedisjoint
statement:
protected theorem _root_.Pairwise.aedisjoint {f : ι → Set α} (hf : Pairwise (Disjoint on f)) :
    Pairwise (AEDisjoint μ on f)
proof:
:=
  hf.mono fun _i _j h => h.aedisjoint

name: _root_.Set.PairwiseDisjoint.aedisjoint
statement:
protected theorem _root_.Set.PairwiseDisjoint.aedisjoint {f : ι → Set α} {s : Set ι}
    (hf : s.PairwiseDisjoint f) : s.Pairwise (AEDisjoint μ on f)
proof:
:=

name: mono_ae
statement: theorem mono_ae (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) (hu : u ≤ᵐ[μ] s) (hv : v ≤ᵐ[μ] t) : AEDisjoint μ u v
proof:
:=
  measure_mono_null_ae (hu.inter hv) h

name: mono
statement: protected theorem mono (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) (hu : u ⊆ s) (hv : v ⊆ t) : AEDisjoint μ u v
proof:
:=
  mono_ae h hu.eventuallySubset hv.eventuallySubset

name: congr
statement:
protected theorem congr (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) (hu : u =ᵐ[μ] s) (hv : v =ᵐ[μ] t) :
    AEDisjoint μ u v
proof:
:=
  mono_ae h (Filter.EventuallyEq.le hu) (Filter.EventuallyEq.le hv)

name: iUnion_left_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iUnion_left_iff {ι : Sort*} [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} :
    AEDisjoint μ (⋃ i, s i) t ↔ ∀ i, AEDisjoint μ (s i) t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [AEDisjoint, iUnion_inter, measure_iUnion_null_iff]

name: iUnion_right_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iUnion_right_iff {ι : Sort*} [Countable ι] {t : ι → Set α} :
    AEDisjoint μ s (⋃ i, t i) ↔ ∀ i, AEDisjoint μ s (t i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [AEDisjoint, inter_iUnion, measure_iUnion_null_iff]

name: union_left_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem union_left_iff : AEDisjoint μ (s ∪ t) u ↔ AEDisjoint μ s u ∧ AEDisjoint μ t u
proof:
:= by
  simp [union_eq_iUnion, and_comm]

name: union_right_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem union_right_iff : AEDisjoint μ s (t ∪ u) ↔ AEDisjoint μ s t ∧ AEDisjoint μ s u
proof:
:= by
  simp [union_eq_iUnion, and_comm]

name: union_left
statement: theorem union_left (hs : AEDisjoint μ s u) (ht : AEDisjoint μ t u) : AEDisjoint μ (s ∪ t) u
proof:
:=
  union_left_iff.mpr ⟨hs, ht⟩

name: union_right
statement: theorem union_right (ht : AEDisjoint μ s t) (hu : AEDisjoint μ s u) : AEDisjoint μ s (t ∪ u)
proof:
:=
  union_right_iff.2 ⟨ht, hu⟩

name: sdiff_ae_eq_left
statement: theorem sdiff_ae_eq_left (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) : (s \ t : Set α) =ᵐ[μ] s
proof:
:=
  @sdiff_self_inter _ s t ▸ sdiff_null_ae_eq_self h

name: sdiff_ae_eq_right
statement: theorem sdiff_ae_eq_right (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) : (t \ s : Set α) =ᵐ[μ] t
proof:
:=
  sdiff_ae_eq_left <| AEDisjoint.symm h

name: measure_sdiff_left
statement: theorem measure_sdiff_left (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) : μ (s \ t) = μ s
proof:
:=
  measure_congr <| AEDisjoint.sdiff_ae_eq_left h

name: measure_sdiff_right
statement: theorem measure_sdiff_right (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) : μ (t \ s) = μ t
proof:
:=
  measure_congr <| AEDisjoint.sdiff_ae_eq_right h

name: exists_disjoint_diff
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_diff (h : AEDisjoint μ s t) :
    ∃ u, MeasurableSet u ∧ μ u = 0 ∧ Disjoint (s \ u) t
proof:
:=
  ⟨toMeasurable μ (s ∩ t), measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _, (measure_toMeasurable _).trans h,
    disjoint_sdiff_self_left.mono_left (b := s \ t) fun x hx => by
      simpa using ⟨hx.1, fun hxt => hx.2 <| subset_toMeasurable _ _ ⟨hx.1, hxt⟩⟩⟩

name: of_null_right
statement: theorem of_null_right (h : μ t = 0) : AEDisjoint μ s t
proof:
:=
  measure_mono_null inter_subset_right h

name: of_null_left
statement: theorem of_null_left (h : μ s = 0) : AEDisjoint μ s t
proof:
:=
  AEDisjoint.symm (of_null_right h)

name: aedisjoint_compl_left
statement: theorem aedisjoint_compl_left : AEDisjoint μ sᶜ s
proof:
:=
  (@disjoint_compl_left _ _ s).aedisjoint

name: aedisjoint_compl_right
statement: theorem aedisjoint_compl_right : AEDisjoint μ s sᶜ
proof:
:=
  (@disjoint_compl_right _ _ s).aedisjoint

name: measure_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem measure_eq_iSup (H : InnerRegularWRT μ p q) (hU : q U) :
    μ U = ⨆ (K) (_ : K ⊆ U) (_ : p K), μ K
proof:
:= by
  refine
    le_antisymm (le_of_forall_lt fun r hr => ?_) (iSup₂_le fun K hK => iSup_le fun _ => μ.mono hK)
  simpa only [lt_iSup_iff, exists_prop] using H hU r hr

name: eq_of_innerRegularWRT_of_forall_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_innerRegularWRT_of_forall_eq {ν : Measure α} (hμ : μ.InnerRegularWRT p q)
    (hν : ν.InnerRegularWRT p q) (hμν : ∀ U, p U → μ U = ν U)
    {U : Set α} (hU : q U) : μ U = ν U
proof:
:= by
  rw [hμ.measure_eq_iSup hU, hν.measure_eq_iSup hU]
  congr! 4 with t _ ht2
  exact hμν t ht2

name: exists_subset_lt_add
statement:
theorem exists_subset_lt_add (H : InnerRegularWRT μ p q) (h0 : p ∅) (hU : q U) (hμU : μ U ≠ ∞)
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) : ∃ K, K ⊆ U ∧ p K ∧ μ U < μ K + ε
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (μ U) 0 with h₀ | h₀
  · refine ⟨∅, empty_subset _, h0, ?_⟩
    rwa [measure_empty, h₀, zero_add, pos_iff_ne_zero]
  · rcases H hU _ (ENNReal.sub_lt_self hμU h₀ hε) with ⟨K, hKU, hKc, hrK⟩
    exact ⟨K, hKU, hKc, ENNReal.lt_add_of_sub_lt_right (Or.inl hμU) hrK⟩

name: map
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU r hr
  rw [map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf (hB₂ _ hU)] at hr
  rcases H (hAB U hU) r hr with ⟨K, hKU, hKc, hK⟩
  refine ⟨f '' K, image_subset_iff.2 hKU, hAB' _ hKc, ?_⟩
  exact hK.trans_le (le_map_apply_image hf _)

name: map'
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU r hr
  rw [f.map_apply U] at hr
  rcases H (hAB U hU) r hr with ⟨K, hKU, hKc, hK⟩
  refine ⟨f '' K, image_subset_iff.2 hKU, hAB' _ hKc, ?_⟩
  rwa [f.map_apply, f.preimage_image]

name: comap
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU r hr
  rw [hf.comap_apply] at hr
  obtain ⟨K, hKU, hK, hμU⟩ := H (hAB U hU) r hr
  have hKrange := hKU.trans (image_subset_range _ _)
  refine ⟨f ⁻¹' K, ?_, hAB' K hKrange hK, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hf.injective.preimage_image U]; exact preimage_mono hKU
  · rwa [hf.comap_apply, image_preimage_eq_iff.mpr hKrange]

name: smul
statement: theorem smul (H : InnerRegularWRT μ p q) (c : ℝ≥0∞) : InnerRegularWRT (c • μ) p q
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU r hr
  rw [smul_apply, H.measure_eq_iSup hU, smul_eq_mul] at hr
  simpa only [ENNReal.mul_iSup, lt_iSup_iff, exists_prop] using! hr

name: trans
statement:
theorem trans {q' : Set α → Prop} (H : InnerRegularWRT μ p q) (H' : InnerRegularWRT μ q q') :
    InnerRegularWRT μ p q'
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU r hr
  rcases H' hU r hr with ⟨F, hFU, hqF, hF⟩; rcases H hqF _ hF with ⟨K, hKF, hpK, hrK⟩
  exact ⟨K, hKF.trans hFU, hpK, hrK⟩

name: rfl
statement: theorem rfl {p : Set α → Prop} : InnerRegularWRT μ p p
proof:
:=
  fun U hU _r hr ↦ ⟨U, Subset.rfl, hU, hr⟩

name: of_imp
statement: theorem of_imp (h : ∀ s, q s → p s) : InnerRegularWRT μ p q
proof:
:=
  fun U hU _ hr ↦ ⟨U, Subset.rfl, h U hU, hr⟩

name: mono
statement:
theorem mono {p' q' : Set α → Prop} (H : InnerRegularWRT μ p q)
    (h : ∀ s, q' s → q s) (h' : ∀ s, p s → p' s) : InnerRegularWRT μ p' q'
proof:
:=
  of_imp h' |>.trans H |>.trans (of_imp h)

name: _root_.Set.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem _root_.Set.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt [OuterRegular μ] (A : Set α) (r : ℝ≥0∞) (hr : μ A < r) :
    ∃ U, U ⊇ A ∧ IsOpen U ∧ μ U < r
proof:
:= by
  rcases OuterRegular.outerRegular (measurableSet_toMeasurable μ A) r
      (by rwa [measure_toMeasurable]) with
    ⟨U, hAU, hUo, hU⟩
  exact ⟨U, (subset_toMeasurable _ _).trans hAU, hUo, hU⟩

name: _root_.Set.measure_eq_iInf_isOpen
statement:
theorem _root_.Set.measure_eq_iInf_isOpen (A : Set α) (μ : Measure α) [OuterRegular μ] :
    μ A = ⨅ (U : Set α) (_ : A ⊆ U) (_ : IsOpen U), μ U
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun s hs => le_iInf fun _ => μ.mono hs) ?_
  refine le_of_forall_gt fun r hr => ?_
  simpa only [iInf_lt_iff, exists_prop] using A.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt r hr

name: _root_.Set.exists_isOpen_lt_add
statement:
theorem _root_.Set.exists_isOpen_lt_add [OuterRegular μ] (A : Set α) (hA : μ A ≠ ∞) {ε : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) : ∃ U, U ⊇ A ∧ IsOpen U ∧ μ U < μ A + ε
proof:
:=
  A.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt _ (ENNReal.lt_add_right hA hε)

name: _root_.Set.exists_isOpen_le_add
statement:
theorem _root_.Set.exists_isOpen_le_add (A : Set α) (μ : Measure α) [OuterRegular μ] {ε : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hε : ε ≠ 0) : ∃ U, U ⊇ A ∧ IsOpen U ∧ μ U ≤ μ A + ε
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (μ A) ∞ with (H | H)
  · exact ⟨univ, subset_univ _, isOpen_univ, by simp only [H, _root_.top_add, le_top]⟩
  · rcases A.exists_isOpen_lt_add H hε with ⟨U, AU, U_open, hU⟩
    exact ⟨U, AU, U_open, hU.le⟩

name: _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_isOpen_sdiff_lt
proof:
:= by
  rcases A.exists_isOpen_lt_add hA' hε with ⟨U, hAU, hUo, hU⟩
  use U, hAU, hUo, hU.trans_le le_top
  exact measure_sdiff_lt_of_lt_add hA.nullMeasurableSet hAU hA' hU

name: map
statement:
protected theorem map [OpensMeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [TopologicalSpace β]
    [BorelSpace β] (f : α ≃ₜ β) (μ : Measure α) [OuterRegular μ] :
    (Measure.map f μ).OuterRegular
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun A hA r hr => ?_⟩
  rw [map_apply f.measurable hA, ← f.image_symm] at hr
  rcases Set.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt _ r hr with ⟨U, hAU, hUo, hU⟩
  have : IsOpen (f.symm ⁻¹' U) := hUo.preimage f.symm.continuous
  refine ⟨f.symm ⁻¹' U, image_subset_iff.1 hAU, this, ?_⟩
  rwa [map_apply f.measurable this.measurableSet, f.preimage_symm, f.preimage_image]

name: comap'
statement:
theorem comap' {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [TopologicalSpace β] (μ : Measure β) [OuterRegular μ]
    {f : α → β} (f_cont : Continuous f) (f_me : MeasurableEmbedding f) :
    (μ.comap f).OuterRegular where
  outerRegular A hA r hr
proof:
:= by
    rw [f_me.comap_apply] at hr
    obtain ⟨U, hUA, Uopen, hμU⟩ := OuterRegular.outerRegular (f_me.measurableSet_image' hA) r hr
    refine ⟨f ⁻¹' U, by rwa [ge_iff_le, ← image_subset_iff], Uopen.preimage f_cont, ?_⟩
    rw [f_me.comap_apply]
    exact (measure_mono (image_preimage_subset _ _)).trans_lt hμU

name: comap
statement:
protected theorem comap [BorelSpace α] {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [TopologicalSpace β] [BorelSpace β]
    (μ : Measure β) [OuterRegular μ] (f : α ≃ₜ β) : (μ.comap f).OuterRegular
proof:
:=
  OuterRegular.comap' μ f.continuous f.measurableEmbedding

name: smul
statement:
protected theorem smul (μ : Measure α) [OuterRegular μ] {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : x ≠ ∞) :
    (x • μ).OuterRegular
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with (rfl | h0)
  · rw [zero_smul]
    exact OuterRegular.zero
  · refine ⟨fun A _ r hr => ?_⟩
    rw [smul_apply, A.measure_eq_iInf_isOpen, smul_eq_mul] at hr
    simpa only [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne h0 hx, gt_iff_lt, iInf_lt_iff, exists_prop] using! hr

name: of_restrict
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun A hA r hr => ?_⟩
  have HA : μ A < ∞ := lt_of_lt_of_le hr le_top
  have hm : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n) := fun n => (h' n).measurableSet
  
  obtain ⟨A, hAm, hAs, hAd, rfl⟩ :
    ∃ A' : ℕ → Set α,
      (∀ n, MeasurableSet (A' n)) ∧
        (∀ n, A' n ⊆ s n) ∧ Pairwise (Disjoint on A') ∧ A = ⋃ n, A' n := by
    refine
      ⟨fun n => A ∩ disjointed s n, fun n => hA.inter (MeasurableSet.disjointed hm _), fun n =>
        inter_subset_right.trans (disjointed_subset _ _),
        (disjoint_disjointed s).mono fun k l hkl => hkl.mono inf_le_right inf_le_right, ?_⟩
    rw [← inter_iUnion, iUnion_disjointed, univ_subset_iff.mp h'', inter_univ]
  rcases ENNReal.exists_pos_sum_of_countable' (tsub_pos_iff_lt.2 hr).ne' ℕ with ⟨δ, δ0, hδε⟩
  rw [lt_tsub_iff_right, add_comm] at hδε
  have : ∀ n, ∃ U ⊇ A n, IsOpen U ∧ μ U < μ (A n) + δ n := by
    intro n
    have H₁ : ∀ t, μ.restrict (s n) t = μ (t ∩ s n) := fun t => restrict_apply' (hm n)
    have Ht : μ.restrict (s n) (A n) ≠ ∞ := by
      rw [H₁]
      exact ((measure_mono (inter_subset_left.trans (subset_iUnion A n))).trans_lt HA).ne
    rcases (A n).exists_isOpen_lt_add Ht (δ0 n).ne' with ⟨U, hAU, hUo, hU⟩
    rw [H₁, H₁, inter_eq_self_of_subset_left (hAs _)] at hU
    exact ⟨U ∩ s n, subset_inter hAU (hAs _), hUo.inter (h' n), hU⟩
  choose U hAU hUo hU using this
  refine ⟨⋃ n, U n, iUnion_mono hAU, isOpen_iUnion hUo, ?_⟩
  calc
    μ (⋃ n, U n) ≤ ∑' n, μ (U n) := measure_iUnion_le _
    _ ≤ ∑' n, (μ (A n) + δ n) := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun n => (hU n).le
    _ = ∑' n, μ (A n) + ∑' n, δ n := ENNReal.tsum_add
    _ = μ (⋃ n, A n) + ∑' n, δ n := (congr_arg₂ (· + ·) (measure_iUnion hAd hAm).symm rfl)
    _ < r := hδε

name: measure_closure_eq_of_isCompact
statement:
lemma measure_closure_eq_of_isCompact [R1Space α] [OuterRegular μ]
    {k : Set α} (hk : IsCompact k) : μ (closure k) = μ k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ (measure_mono subset_closure)
  simp only [measure_eq_iInf_isOpen k, le_iInf_iff]
  intro u ku u_open
  exact measure_mono (hk.closure_subset_of_isOpen u_open ku)

name: ext_isOpen
statement:
theorem ext_isOpen {ν : Measure α} [OuterRegular μ] [OuterRegular ν]
    (hμν : ∀ U, IsOpen U → μ U = ν U) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  ext s ms
  rw [Set.measure_eq_iInf_isOpen, Set.measure_eq_iInf_isOpen]
  congr! 4 with t _ ht2
  exact hμν t ht2

name: ext_isOpen_isBounded
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_isOpen fun U hU ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨f, hm, hu, hf⟩ := Metric.eq_countable_union_of_isBounded_of_isOpen hU
  rw [← hu, hm.measure_iUnion, hm.measure_iUnion]
  exact iSup_congr fun i ↦ hμν (f i) (hf i).2 (hf i).1

name: FiniteSpanningSetsIn.outerRegular
statement:
protected theorem FiniteSpanningSetsIn.outerRegular
    [TopologicalSpace α] [OpensMeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    (s : μ.FiniteSpanningSetsIn { U | IsOpen U ∧ OuterRegular (μ.restrict U) }) :
    OuterRegular μ
proof:
:=
  OuterRegular.of_restrict (s := fun n ↦ s.set n) (fun n ↦ (s.set_mem n).2)
    (fun n ↦ (s.set_mem n).1) s.spanning.symm.subset

name: of_restrict
proof:
:= by
  intro F hF r hr
  have hBU : ⋃ n, F ∩ s n = F := by rw [← inter_iUnion, univ_subset_iff.mp hs, inter_univ]
  have : μ F = ⨆ n, μ (F ∩ s n) := by
    rw [← (monotone_const.inter hmono).measure_iUnion, hBU]
  rw [this] at hr
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.1 hr with ⟨n, hn⟩
  rw [← restrict_apply hF] at hn
  rcases h n hF _ hn with ⟨K, KF, hKp, hK⟩
  exact ⟨K, KF, hKp, hK.trans_le (restrict_apply_le _ _)⟩

name: restrict
statement:
lemma restrict (h : InnerRegularWRT μ p (fun s ↦ MeasurableSet s ∧ μ s ≠ ∞)) (A : Set α) :
    InnerRegularWRT (μ.restrict A) p (fun s ↦ MeasurableSet s ∧ μ.restrict A s ≠ ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rintro s ⟨s_meas, hs⟩ r hr
  rw [restrict_apply s_meas] at hs
  obtain ⟨K, K_subs, pK, rK⟩ : ∃ K, K ⊆ (toMeasurable μ (s ∩ A)) ∩ s ∧ p K ∧ r < μ K := by
    have : r < μ ((toMeasurable μ (s ∩ A)) ∩ s) := by
      apply hr.trans_le
      rw [restrict_apply s_meas]
      exact measure_mono <| subset_inter (subset_toMeasurable μ (s ∩ A)) inter_subset_left
    refine h ⟨(measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _).inter s_meas, ?_⟩ _ this
    apply (lt_of_le_of_lt _ hs.lt_top).ne
    rw [← measure_toMeasurable (s ∩ A)]
    exact measure_mono inter_subset_left
  refine ⟨K, K_subs.trans inter_subset_right, pK, ?_⟩
  calc
  r < μ K := rK
  _ = μ.restrict (toMeasurable μ (s ∩ A)) K := by
    rw [restrict_apply' (measurableSet_toMeasurable μ (s ∩ A))]
    congr
    apply (inter_eq_left.2 ?_).symm
    exact K_subs.trans inter_subset_left
  _ = μ.restrict (s ∩ A) K := by rwa [restrict_toMeasurable]
  _ ≤ μ.restrict A K := Measure.le_iff'.1 (restrict_mono inter_subset_right le_rfl) K

name: restrict_of_measure_ne_top
statement:
lemma restrict_of_measure_ne_top (h : InnerRegularWRT μ p (fun s ↦ MeasurableSet s ∧ μ s ≠ ∞))
    {A : Set α} (hA : μ A ≠ ∞) :
    InnerRegularWRT (μ.restrict A) p (fun s ↦ MeasurableSet s)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (μ A < ∞) := ⟨hA.lt_top⟩
  exact (restrict h A).trans (of_imp (fun s hs ↦ ⟨hs, measure_ne_top _ _⟩))

name: of_sigmaFinite
statement:
lemma of_sigmaFinite [SigmaFinite μ] :
    InnerRegularWRT μ (fun s ↦ MeasurableSet s ∧ μ s ≠ ∞) (fun s ↦ MeasurableSet s)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs r hr
  set B : ℕ → Set α := spanningSets μ
  have hBU : ⋃ n, s ∩ B n = s := by rw [← inter_iUnion, iUnion_spanningSets, inter_univ]
  have : μ s = ⨆ n, μ (s ∩ B n) := by
    rw [← (monotone_const.inter (monotone_spanningSets μ)).measure_iUnion, hBU]
  rw [this] at hr
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.1 hr with ⟨n, hn⟩
  refine ⟨s ∩ B n, inter_subset_left, ⟨hs.inter (measurableSet_spanningSets μ n), ?_⟩, hn⟩
  exact ((measure_mono inter_subset_right).trans_lt (measure_spanningSets_lt_top μ n)).ne

name: measurableSet_of_isOpen
statement:
theorem measurableSet_of_isOpen [OuterRegular μ] (H : InnerRegularWRT μ p IsOpen)
    (hd : ∀ ⦃s U⦄, p s → IsOpen U → p (s \ U)) :
    InnerRegularWRT μ p fun s => MeasurableSet s ∧ μ s ≠ ∞
proof:
:= by
  rintro s ⟨hs, hμs⟩ r hr
  have h0 : p ∅ := by
    have : 0 < μ univ := (bot_le.trans_lt hr).trans_le (measure_mono (subset_univ _))
    obtain ⟨K, -, hK, -⟩ : ∃ K, K ⊆ univ ∧ p K ∧ 0 < μ K := H isOpen_univ _ this
    simpa using hd hK isOpen_univ
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεs, rfl⟩ : ∃ ε ≠ 0, ε + ε ≤ μ s ∧ r = μ s - (ε + ε) := by
    use (μ s - r) / 2
    simp [*, hr.le, ENNReal.add_halves, ENNReal.sub_sub_cancel, tsub_eq_zero_iff_le]
  rcases hs.exists_isOpen_sdiff_lt hμs hε with ⟨U, hsU, hUo, hUt, hμU⟩
  rcases (U \ s).exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt _ hμU with ⟨U', hsU', hU'o, hμU'⟩
  replace hsU' := sdiff_subset_comm.1 hsU'
  rcases H.exists_subset_lt_add h0 hUo hUt.ne hε with ⟨K, hKU, hKc, hKr⟩
  refine ⟨K \ U', fun x hx => hsU' ⟨hKU hx.1, hx.2⟩, hd hKc hU'o, ENNReal.sub_lt_of_lt_add hεs ?_⟩
  calc
    μ s ≤ μ U := μ.mono hsU
    _ < μ K + ε := hKr
    _ ≤ μ (K \ U') + μ U' + ε := by grw [tsub_le_iff_right.1 le_measure_sdiff]
    _ ≤ μ (K \ U') + ε + ε := by gcongr
    _ = μ (K \ U') + (ε + ε) := add_assoc _ _ _

name: weaklyRegular_of_finite
statement:
theorem weaklyRegular_of_finite [BorelSpace α] (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (H : InnerRegularWRT μ IsClosed IsOpen) : WeaklyRegular μ
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : ∀ {s}, μ s ≠ ∞ := @(measure_ne_top μ)
  suffices ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → ∀ ε, ε ≠ 0 → ∃ F, F ⊆ s ∧ ∃ U, U ⊇ s ∧
      IsClosed F ∧ IsOpen U ∧ μ s ≤ μ F + ε ∧ μ U ≤ μ s + ε by
    refine
      { outerRegular := fun s hs r hr => ?_
        innerRegular := H }
    rcases exists_between hr with ⟨r', hsr', hr'r⟩
    rcases this s hs _ (tsub_pos_iff_lt.2 hsr').ne' with ⟨-, -, U, hsU, -, hUo, -, H⟩
    refine ⟨U, hsU, hUo, ?_⟩
    rw [add_tsub_cancel_of_le hsr'.le] at H
    exact H.trans_lt hr'r
  apply MeasurableSet.induction_on_open
  /- The proof is by measurable induction: we should check that the property is true for the empty
    set, for open sets, and is stable by taking the complement and by taking countable disjoint
    unions. The point of the property we are proving is that it is stable by taking complements
    (exchanging the roles of closed and open sets and thanks to the finiteness of the measure). -/
  
  · intro U hU ε hε
    rcases H.exists_subset_lt_add isClosed_empty hU hfin hε with ⟨F, hsF, hFc, hF⟩
    exact ⟨F, hsF, U, Subset.rfl, hFc, hU, hF.le, le_self_add⟩
  
  · rintro s hs H ε hε
    rcases H ε hε with ⟨F, hFs, U, hsU, hFc, hUo, hF, hU⟩
    refine
      ⟨Uᶜ, compl_subset_compl.2 hsU, Fᶜ, compl_subset_compl.2 hFs, hUo.isClosed_compl,
        hFc.isOpen_compl, ?_⟩
    simp only [measure_compl_le_add_iff, *, hUo.measurableSet, hFc.measurableSet, true_and]
  
  · intro s hsd hsm H ε ε0
    have ε0' : ε / 2 ≠ 0 := (ENNReal.half_pos ε0).ne'
    rcases ENNReal.exists_pos_sum_of_countable' ε0' ℕ with ⟨δ, δ0, hδε⟩
    choose F hFs U hsU hFc hUo hF hU using fun n => H n (δ n) (δ0 n).ne'
    
    
    
    have : Tendsto (fun t => (∑ k ∈ t, μ (s k)) + ε / 2) atTop (𝓝 <| μ (⋃ n, s n) + ε / 2) := by
      rw [measure_iUnion hsd hsm]
      exact Tendsto.add ENNReal.summable.hasSum tendsto_const_nhds
    rcases (this.eventually <| lt_mem_nhds <| ENNReal.lt_add_right hfin ε0').exists with ⟨t, ht⟩
    
    
    refine
      ⟨⋃ k ∈ t, F k, iUnion_mono fun k => iUnion_subset fun _ => hFs _, ⋃ n, U n, iUnion_mono hsU,
        isClosed_biUnion_finset fun k _ => hFc k, isOpen_iUnion hUo, ht.le.trans ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
        (∑ k ∈ t, μ (s k)) + ε / 2 ≤ ((∑ k ∈ t, μ (F k)) + ∑ k ∈ t, δ k) + ε / 2 := by
          rw [← sum_add_distrib]
          gcongr
          apply hF
        _ ≤ (∑ k ∈ t, μ (F k)) + ε / 2 + ε / 2 := by
          gcongr
          exact (ENNReal.sum_le_tsum _).trans hδε.le
        _ = μ (⋃ k ∈ t, F k) + ε := by
          rw [measure_biUnion_finset, add_assoc, ENNReal.add_halves]
          exacts [fun k _ n _ hkn => (hsd hkn).mono (hFs k) (hFs n),
            fun k _ => (hFc k).measurableSet]
    · calc
        μ (⋃ n, U n) ≤ ∑' n, μ (U n) := measure_iUnion_le _
        _ ≤ ∑' n, (μ (s n) + δ n) := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hU
        _ = μ (⋃ n, s n) + ∑' n, δ n := by rw [measure_iUnion hsd hsm, ENNReal.tsum_add]
        _ ≤ μ (⋃ n, s n) + ε := by grw [hδε, ENNReal.half_le_self]

name: of_pseudoMetrizableSpace
statement:
theorem of_pseudoMetrizableSpace {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [PseudoMetrizableSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) : InnerRegularWRT μ IsClosed IsOpen
proof:
:= by
  let A : PseudoMetricSpace X := TopologicalSpace.pseudoMetrizableSpacePseudoMetric X
  intro U hU r hr
  rcases hU.exists_iUnion_isClosed with ⟨F, F_closed, -, rfl, F_mono⟩
  rw [F_mono.measure_iUnion] at hr
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.1 hr with ⟨n, hn⟩
  exact ⟨F n, subset_iUnion _ _, F_closed n, hn⟩

name: isCompact_isClosed
statement:
theorem isCompact_isClosed {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [SigmaCompactSpace X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) : InnerRegularWRT μ IsCompact IsClosed
proof:
:= by
  intro F hF r hr
  set B : ℕ → Set X := compactCovering X
  have hBc : ∀ n, IsCompact (F ∩ B n) := fun n => (isCompact_compactCovering X n).inter_left hF
  have hBU : ⋃ n, F ∩ B n = F := by rw [← inter_iUnion, iUnion_compactCovering, Set.inter_univ]
  have : μ F = ⨆ n, μ (F ∩ B n) := by
    rw [← Monotone.measure_iUnion, hBU]
    exact monotone_const.inter monotone_accumulate
  rw [this] at hr
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.1 hr with ⟨n, hn⟩
  exact ⟨_, inter_subset_left, hBc n, hn⟩

name: _root_.MeasurableSet.measure_eq_iSup_isCompact
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasurableSet.measure_eq_iSup_isCompact ⦃U : Set α⦄ (hU : MeasurableSet U)
    (μ : Measure α) [InnerRegular μ] :
    μ U = ⨆ (K : Set α) (_ : K ⊆ U) (_ : IsCompact K), μ K
proof:
:=
  InnerRegular.innerRegular.measure_eq_iSup hU

name: innerRegularWRT_isClosed_isOpen
statement:
lemma innerRegularWRT_isClosed_isOpen [R1Space α] [OpensMeasurableSpace α] [h : InnerRegular μ] :
    InnerRegularWRT μ IsClosed IsOpen
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU r hr
  rcases h.innerRegular hU.measurableSet r hr with ⟨K, KU, K_comp, hK⟩
  exact ⟨closure K, K_comp.closure_subset_of_isOpen hU KU, isClosed_closure,
    hK.trans_le (measure_mono subset_closure)⟩

name: exists_isCompact_not_null
statement: theorem exists_isCompact_not_null [InnerRegular μ] : (∃ K, IsCompact K ∧ μ K ≠ 0) ↔ μ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Ne, ← measure_univ_eq_zero, MeasurableSet.univ.measure_eq_iSup_isCompact,
    ENNReal.iSup_eq_zero, not_forall, exists_prop, subset_univ, true_and]

name: _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_lt_isCompact
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_lt_isCompact [InnerRegular μ] ⦃A : Set α⦄
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) {r : ℝ≥0∞} (hr : r < μ A) :
    ∃ K, K ⊆ A ∧ IsCompact K ∧ r < μ K
proof:
:=
  InnerRegular.innerRegular hA _ hr

name: map_of_continuous
statement:
protected theorem map_of_continuous [BorelSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [TopologicalSpace β]
    [BorelSpace β] [h : InnerRegular μ] {f : α → β} (hf : Continuous f) :
    InnerRegular (Measure.map f μ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨InnerRegularWRT.map h.innerRegular hf.aemeasurable (fun _s hs ↦ hf.measurable hs)
    (fun _K hK ↦ hK.image hf) (fun _s hs ↦ hs)⟩

name: map
statement:
protected theorem map [BorelSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [TopologicalSpace β]
    [BorelSpace β] [InnerRegular μ] (f : α ≃ₜ β) : (Measure.map f μ).InnerRegular
proof:
:=
  InnerRegular.map_of_continuous f.continuous

name: map_iff
statement:
protected theorem map_iff [BorelSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [TopologicalSpace β]
    [BorelSpace β] (f : α ≃ₜ β) :
    InnerRegular (Measure.map f μ) ↔ InnerRegular μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.map f⟩
  convert! h.map f.symm
  rw [map_map f.symm.continuous.measurable f.continuous.measurable]
  simp

name: comap'
statement:
protected theorem comap' [BorelSpace α]
    {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [TopologicalSpace β] [BorelSpace β]
    (μ : Measure β) [H : InnerRegular μ] {f : α → β} (hf : IsOpenEmbedding f) :
    (μ.comap f).InnerRegular where
  innerRegular
proof:
:=
    H.innerRegular.comap hf.measurableEmbedding
    (fun _ hU ↦ hf.measurableEmbedding.measurableSet_image' hU)
    (fun _ hKrange hK ↦ hf.isInducing.isCompact_preimage' hK hKrange)

name: comap
statement:
protected theorem comap [BorelSpace α] {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} [TopologicalSpace β] [BorelSpace β]
    {μ : Measure β} [InnerRegular μ] (f : α ≃ₜ β) :
    (μ.comap f).InnerRegular
proof:
:=
  InnerRegular.comap' μ f.isOpenEmbedding

name: _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_isCompact_lt_add
statement:

    ∃ K, K ⊆ A ∧ IsCompact K ∧ μ A < μ K + ε
proof:
:=
  InnerRegularCompactLTTop.innerRegular.exists_subset_lt_add isCompact_empty ⟨hA, h'A⟩ h'A hε

name: _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_isCompact_isClosed_lt_add
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_isCompact_isClosed_lt_add
    [InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ] [R1Space α] [BorelSpace α]
    ⦃A : Set α⦄ (hA : MeasurableSet A) (h'A : μ A ≠ ∞) {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ∃ K, K ⊆ A ∧ IsCompact K ∧ IsClosed K ∧ μ A < μ K + ε
proof:
:=
  let ⟨K, hKA, hK, hμK⟩ := hA.exists_isCompact_lt_add h'A hε
  ⟨closure K, hK.closure_subset_measurableSet hA hKA, hK.closure, isClosed_closure,

name: _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_isCompact_sdiff_lt
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_isCompact_sdiff_lt [OpensMeasurableSpace α] [T2Space α]

  exact ⟨K, hKA, hKc, measure_sdiff_lt_of_lt_add hKc.nullMeasurableSet hKA
    (ne_top_of_le_ne_top h'A <| measure_mono hKA) hK⟩

name: _root_.IsCompact.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt
statement:
protected lemma _root_.IsCompact.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt [InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ]
    [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] [R1Space α] [BorelSpace α] {K : Set α}
    (hK : IsCompact K) (r : ℝ≥0∞) (hr : μ K < r) :
    ∃ U, K ⊆ U ∧ IsOpen U ∧ μ U < r
proof:
:= by
  rcases hK.exists_open_superset_measure_lt_top μ with ⟨V, hKV, hVo, hμV⟩
  have := Fact.mk hμV
  obtain ⟨U, hKU, hUo, hμU⟩ : ∃ U, K ⊆ U ∧ IsOpen U ∧ μ.restrict V U < r :=
    exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt K r <| (restrict_apply_le _ _).trans_lt hr
  refine ⟨U ∩ V, subset_inter hKU hKV, hUo.inter hVo, ?_⟩
  rwa [restrict_apply hUo.measurableSet] at hμU

name: _root_.IsCompact.measure_eq_iInf_isOpen
statement:
protected lemma _root_.IsCompact.measure_eq_iInf_isOpen [InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ]
    [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] [R1Space α] [BorelSpace α] {K : Set α} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    μ K = ⨅ (U : Set α) (_ : K ⊆ U) (_ : IsOpen U), μ U
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp only [le_iInf_iff]
    exact fun U KU _ ↦ measure_mono KU
  · apply le_of_forall_gt
    simpa only [iInf_lt_iff, exists_prop, exists_and_left] using hK.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt

name: _root_.IsCompact.exists_isOpen_lt_add
statement:
protected theorem _root_.IsCompact.exists_isOpen_lt_add [InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ]
    [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] [R1Space α] [BorelSpace α]
    {K : Set α} (hK : IsCompact K) {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ∃ U, K ⊆ U ∧ IsOpen U ∧ μ U < μ K + ε
proof:
:=
  hK.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt _ (ENNReal.lt_add_right hK.measure_lt_top.ne hε)

name: _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_isOpen_symmDiff_lt
statement:
protected theorem _root_.MeasurableSet.exists_isOpen_symmDiff_lt [InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ]
    [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] [R1Space α] [BorelSpace α]
    {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hμs : μ s ≠ ∞) {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ∃ U, IsOpen U ∧ μ U < ∞ ∧ μ (U ∆ s) < ε
proof:
:= by
  have : ε / 2 ≠ 0 := (ENNReal.half_pos hε).ne'
  rcases hs.exists_isCompact_isClosed_sdiff_lt hμs this with ⟨K, hKs, hKco, hKcl, hμK⟩
  rcases hKco.exists_isOpen_lt_add (μ := μ) this with ⟨U, hKU, hUo, hμU⟩
  refine ⟨U, hUo, hμU.trans_le le_top, ?_⟩
  rw [← ENNReal.add_halves ε, measure_symmDiff_eq hUo.nullMeasurableSet hs.nullMeasurableSet]
  gcongr
  · calc
      μ (U \ s) ≤ μ (U \ K) := by gcongr
      _ < ε / 2 := by
        apply measure_sdiff_lt_of_lt_add hKcl.nullMeasurableSet hKU _ hμU
        exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top hμs (by gcongr)
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by gcongr) hμK

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.NullMeasurableSet.exists_isOpen_symmDiff_lt
statement:
protected theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.NullMeasurableSet.exists_isOpen_symmDiff_lt
    [InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] [R1Space α] [BorelSpace α]
    {s : Set α} (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (hμs : μ s ≠ ∞) {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ∃ U, IsOpen U ∧ μ U < ∞ ∧ μ (U ∆ s) < ε
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with ⟨t, htm, hst⟩
  rcases htm.exists_isOpen_symmDiff_lt (by rwa [← measure_congr hst]) hε with ⟨U, hUo, hμU, hUs⟩
  refine ⟨U, hUo, hμU, ?_⟩
  rwa [measure_congr <| .symmDiff .rfl hst]

name: map_of_continuous
statement:
protected theorem map_of_continuous [BorelSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [TopologicalSpace β]
    [BorelSpace β] [h : InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ] {f : α → β} (hf : Continuous f) :
    InnerRegularCompactLTTop (Measure.map f μ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  refine InnerRegularWRT.map h.innerRegular hf.aemeasurable ?_ (fun K hK ↦ hK.image hf) ?_
  · rintro s ⟨hs, h's⟩
    exact ⟨hf.measurable hs, by rwa [map_apply hf.measurable hs] at h's⟩
  · rintro s ⟨hs, -⟩
    exact hs

name: restrict_of_measure_ne_top
statement:
theorem restrict_of_measure_ne_top [BorelSpace α] [WeaklyRegular μ] {A : Set α}
    (h'A : μ A ≠ ∞) : WeaklyRegular (μ.restrict A)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (μ A < ∞) := ⟨h'A.lt_top⟩
  refine InnerRegularWRT.weaklyRegular_of_finite (μ.restrict A) (fun V V_open r hr ↦ ?_)
  have : InnerRegularWRT (μ.restrict A) IsClosed (fun s ↦ MeasurableSet s) :=
    InnerRegularWRT.restrict_of_measure_ne_top innerRegular_measurable h'A
  exact this V_open.measurableSet r hr

name: map

protected theorem map [BorelSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] [TopologicalSpace β]

  exact ⟨InnerRegularWRT.comap Regular.innerRegular hf.measurableEmbedding
    (fun _ hU ↦ hf.isOpen_iff_image_isOpen.mp hU)
    (fun _ hKrange hK ↦ hf.isInducing.isCompact_preimage' hK hKrange)⟩

  intro V hV r hr
  have R : restrict μ A V ≠ ∞ := by

name: exists_measure_closedBall_le_mul
statement:
theorem exists_measure_closedBall_le_mul :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ x, μ (closedBall x (2 * ε)) ≤ C * μ (closedBall x ε)
proof:
:=
  exists_measure_closedBall_le_mul''

name: eventually_measure_le_doublingConstant_mul
statement:
theorem eventually_measure_le_doublingConstant_mul :
    ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ x, μ (closedBall x (2 * ε)) ≤ doublingConstant μ * μ (closedBall x ε)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec <| exists_measure_closedBall_le_mul μ

name: exists_eventually_forall_measure_closedBall_le_mul
statement:
theorem exists_eventually_forall_measure_closedBall_le_mul (K : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ x, ∀ t ≤ K, μ (closedBall x (t * ε)) ≤ C * μ (closedBall x ε)
proof:
:= by
  let C := doublingConstant μ
  suffices ∀ n,
      ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ x, μ (closedBall x ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * ε)) ≤ C ^ n * μ (closedBall x ε) by
    rcases pow_unbounded_of_one_lt K one_lt_two with ⟨n, hn⟩
    use C ^ n
    filter_upwards [eventually_mem_nhdsWithin, this n] with ε hε₀ hε x t ht
    rw [mem_Ioi] at hε₀
    grw [ht, hn, ENNReal.coe_pow]
    exact hε x
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ihn =>
    replace ihn := eventually_nhdsGT_zero_mul_left (two_pos : 0 < (2 : ℝ)) ihn
    filter_upwards [ihn, eventually_measure_le_doublingConstant_mul μ] with ε hεn hε x
    grw [pow_succ, mul_assoc, hεn, hε, ← mul_assoc, pow_succ]

name: one_le_scalingConstantOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_le_scalingConstantOf (K : ℝ) : 1 ≤ scalingConstantOf μ K
proof:
:=
  le_max_of_le_right <| le_refl 1

name: eventually_measure_mul_le_scalingConstantOf_mul
statement:
theorem eventually_measure_mul_le_scalingConstantOf_mul (K : ℝ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ,
      0 < R ∧
        ∀ x t r, t ∈ Ioc 0 K → r ≤ R →
          μ (closedBall x (t * r)) ≤ scalingConstantOf μ K * μ (closedBall x r)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Classical.choose_spec (exists_eventually_forall_measure_closedBall_le_mul μ K)
  rcases mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioc_subset.1 h with ⟨R, Rpos, hR⟩
  refine ⟨R, Rpos, fun x t r ht hr => ?_⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy r 0 with (rneg | rfl | rpos)
  · have : t * r < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg ht.1 rneg
    simp only [closedBall_eq_empty.2 this, measure_empty, zero_le]
  · simp only [mul_zero]
    refine le_mul_of_one_le_of_le ?_ le_rfl
    apply ENNReal.one_le_coe_iff.2 (le_max_right _ _)
  · apply (hR ⟨rpos, hr⟩ x t ht.2).trans
    gcongr
    apply le_max_left

name: eventually_measure_le_scaling_constant_mul
statement:
theorem eventually_measure_le_scaling_constant_mul (K : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ x, μ (closedBall x (K * r)) ≤ scalingConstantOf μ K * μ (closedBall x r)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Classical.choose_spec
      (exists_eventually_forall_measure_closedBall_le_mul μ K)] with r hr x
  grw [hr x K le_rfl, scalingConstantOf, ← le_max_left]

name: eventually_measure_le_scaling_constant_mul'
statement:
theorem eventually_measure_le_scaling_constant_mul' (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) :
    ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] 0, ∀ x,
      μ (closedBall x r) ≤ scalingConstantOf μ K⁻¹ * μ (closedBall x (K * r))
proof:
:= by
  convert! eventually_nhdsGT_zero_mul_left hK (eventually_measure_le_scaling_constant_mul μ K⁻¹)
  simp [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hK.ne']

name: scalingScaleOf_pos
statement: theorem scalingScaleOf_pos (K : ℝ) : 0 < scalingScaleOf μ K
proof:
:=
  (eventually_measure_mul_le_scalingConstantOf_mul μ K).choose_spec.1

name: measure_mul_le_scalingConstantOf_mul
statement:
theorem measure_mul_le_scalingConstantOf_mul {K : ℝ} {x : α} {t r : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 K)
    (hr : r ≤ scalingScaleOf μ K) :
    μ (closedBall x (t * r)) ≤ scalingConstantOf μ K * μ (closedBall x r)
proof:
:=
  (eventually_measure_mul_le_scalingConstantOf_mul μ K).choose_spec.2 x t r ht hr

statement:
lemma support_eq_forall_isOpen : μ.support =
    {x : X | ∀ u : Set X, x ∈ u → IsOpen u → 0 < μ u}
proof:
:= by
  simp [Set.ext_iff, nhds_basis_opens _ |>.mem_measureSupport]

name: isClosed_support
statement: lemma isClosed_support {μ : Measure X} : IsClosed μ.support
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isClosed_iff_frequently, nhds_basis_opens _ |>.mem_measureSupport,
    nhds_basis_opens _ |>.frequently_iff]
  grind

name: isOpen_compl_support
statement: lemma isOpen_compl_support {μ : Measure X} : IsOpen μ.supportᶜ
proof:
:=
  isOpen_compl_iff.mpr μ.isClosed_support

name: subset_compl_support_of_isOpen
statement:
lemma subset_compl_support_of_isOpen {t : Set X} (ht : IsOpen t) (h : μ t = 0) :
    t ⊆ μ.supportᶜ
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx ↦ notMem_support_iff_exists.mpr ⟨t, ht.mem_nhds hx, h⟩

name: support_subset_of_isClosed
statement:
lemma support_subset_of_isClosed {t : Set X} (ht : IsClosed t) (h : t ∈ ae μ) :
    μ.support ⊆ t
proof:
:=
  Set.compl_subset_compl.mp <| subset_compl_support_of_isOpen ht.isOpen_compl h

name: compl_support_eq_sUnion
statement: lemma compl_support_eq_sUnion : μ.supportᶜ = ⋃₀ {t : Set X | IsOpen t ∧ μ t = 0}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_sUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, and_right_comm,
    nhds_basis_opens x |>.notMem_measureSupport, fun t ↦ and_comm (b := x ∈ t)]

name: support_eq_sInter
statement: lemma support_eq_sInter : μ.support = ⋂₀ {t : Set X | IsClosed t ∧ μ tᶜ = 0}
proof:
:= by
  convert! congr($(compl_support_eq_sUnion (μ := μ))ᶜ)
  all_goals simp [Set.compl_sUnion, compl_involutive.image_eq_preimage_symm]

name: measure_eq_zero_of_isCompact_subset_compl_support
statement:
lemma measure_eq_zero_of_isCompact_subset_compl_support {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKsub : K ⊆ μ.supportᶜ) : μ K = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine hK.induction_on measure_empty ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact fun _ _ hst ht ↦ measure_mono_null hst ht
  · exact fun _ _ hs ht ↦ measure_union_null hs ht
  · intro x hxK
    obtain ⟨U, hUnhds, hU0⟩ := notMem_support_iff_exists.1 (hKsub hxK)
    exact ⟨U, mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds hUnhds, hU0⟩

name: support_mem_ae_of_innerRegularWRT_isCompact_isOpen
statement:
lemma support_mem_ae_of_innerRegularWRT_isCompact_isOpen
    (hμ : μ.InnerRegularWRT IsCompact IsOpen) : μ.support ∈ ae μ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨K, hKsub, hKcompact, hKpos⟩ := hμ isOpen_compl_support 0 (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hne)
  simp [measure_eq_zero_of_isCompact_subset_compl_support hKcompact hKsub] at hKpos

name: measure_compl_support_of_innerRegularWRT_isCompact_isOpen
statement:
@[simp]
lemma measure_compl_support_of_innerRegularWRT_isCompact_isOpen
    (hμ : μ.InnerRegularWRT IsCompact IsOpen) : μ μ.supportᶜ = 0
proof:
:=
  support_mem_ae_of_innerRegularWRT_isCompact_isOpen hμ

name: support_mem_ae_of_innerRegular
statement:
lemma support_mem_ae_of_innerRegular [OpensMeasurableSpace X] [μ.InnerRegular] :
    μ.support ∈ ae μ
proof:
:=
  support_mem_ae_of_innerRegularWRT_isCompact_isOpen fun _ hU r hr =>
    InnerRegular.innerRegular hU.measurableSet r hr

name: measure_compl_support_of_innerRegular
statement:
@[simp]
lemma measure_compl_support_of_innerRegular [OpensMeasurableSpace X] [μ.InnerRegular] :

name: support_mem_ae_of_regular
statement: lemma support_mem_ae_of_regular [μ.Regular] : μ.support ∈ ae μ
proof:

name: measure_compl_support_of_regular
statement:
@[simp]
lemma measure_compl_support_of_regular [μ.Regular] : μ μ.supportᶜ = 0
proof:

name: support_mem_ae_of_isLindelof
statement: lemma support_mem_ae_of_isLindelof (h : IsLindelof μ.supportᶜ) : μ.support ∈ ae μ
proof:
:= by
  refine compl_compl μ.support ▸ h.compl_mem_sets_of_nhdsWithin fun s hs ↦ ?_
  simpa [compl_mem_ae_iff, isOpen_compl_support.nhdsWithin_eq hs]
    using notMem_support_iff_exists.mp hs

name: support_mem_ae
statement: lemma support_mem_ae : μ.support ∈ ae μ
proof:

  support_mem_ae_of_isLindelof <| HereditarilyLindelofSpace.isLindelof μ.supportᶜ

name: measure_compl_support
statement:

lemma measure_compl_support : μ μ.supportᶜ = 0
proof: := support_mem_ae

name: nonempty_inter_support_of_pos
statement:
lemma nonempty_inter_support_of_pos {s : Set X} (hμ : 0 < μ s) :
    (s ∩ μ.support).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.not_disjoint_iff_nonempty_inter]
  contrapose! hμ
  exact μ.mono hμ.subset_compl_right |>.trans <| by simp

name: nullMeasurableSet_compl_support
statement: lemma nullMeasurableSet_compl_support : NullMeasurableSet (μ.supportᶜ) μ
proof:
:=
  NullMeasurableSet.of_null measure_compl_support

name: nullMeasurableSet_support
statement: lemma nullMeasurableSet_support : NullMeasurableSet μ.support μ
proof:
:=
  NullMeasurableSet.compl_iff.mp nullMeasurableSet_compl_support

name: nonempty_support
statement: lemma nonempty_support (hμ : μ ≠ 0) : μ.support.Nonempty
proof:
:=
   Nonempty.right <| nonempty_inter_support_of_pos <| measure_univ_pos.mpr hμ

name: nonempty_support_iff
statement: lemma nonempty_support_iff : μ.support.Nonempty ↔ μ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h e ↦ (not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mpr <| congrArg Measure.support e |>.trans
    <| support_zero) h, fun h ↦ nonempty_support h⟩

name: support_eq_empty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_eq_empty_iff : μ.support = ∅ ↔ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [← Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty, not_congr nonempty_support_iff]

name: mem_support_restrict
statement:
lemma mem_support_restrict {s : Set X} {x : X} :
    x ∈ (μ.restrict s).support ↔ ∃ᶠ u in (𝓝[s] x).smallSets, 0 < μ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [nhds_basis_opens x |>.mem_measureSupport,
    (nhdsWithin_basis_open x s).frequently_smallSets pos_mono]
  grind [IsOpen.measurableSet, restrict_apply]

name: interior_inter_support
statement:
lemma interior_inter_support {s : Set X} :
    interior s ∩ μ.support ⊆ (μ.restrict s).support
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hxs, hxμ⟩
  rw [mem_support_restrict, (nhdsWithin_basis_open x s).frequently_smallSets pos_mono]
  rw [(nhds_basis_opens x).mem_measureSupport] at hxμ
  rintro u ⟨hxu, hu⟩
  apply hxμ (u ∩ interior s) ⟨⟨hxu, hxs⟩, hu.inter isOpen_interior⟩ |>.trans_le
  gcongr
  exact interior_subset

name: support_restrict_subset
statement:
lemma support_restrict_subset {s : Set X} :
    (μ.restrict s).support ⊆ closure s ∩ μ.support
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.subset_inter (support_subset_of_isClosed isClosed_closure ?_)
    (support_mono restrict_le_self)
  rw [mem_ae_iff, μ.restrict_apply isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.measurableSet]
  convert! μ.empty
  exact subset_closure.disjoint_compl_left.eq_bot

name: zero_toOuterMeasure

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.toMeasure_zero

name: apply_eq_zero_of_isEmpty

theorem ae_smul_measure {p : α → Prop} [SMul R ℝ≥0∞] [IsScalarTower R ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0∞]

proof:
:=
  ae_iff.2 <| by rw [smul_apply, ae_iff.1 h, ← smul_one_smul ℝ≥0∞, smul_zero]

name: measure_eq_left_of_subset_of_measure_add_eq
statement:
theorem measure_eq_left_of_subset_of_measure_add_eq (h : (μ + ν) t ≠ ∞) (h' : s ⊆ t)
    (h'' : (μ + ν) s = (μ + ν) t) : μ s = μ t
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (measure_mono h') ?_
  have : μ t + ν t ≤ μ s + ν t :=
    calc
      μ t + ν t = μ s + ν s := h''.symm
      _ ≤ μ s + ν t := by gcongr
  apply ENNReal.le_of_add_le_add_right _ this
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top h (le_add_left le_rfl)

name: measure_eq_right_of_subset_of_measure_add_eq
statement:
theorem measure_eq_right_of_subset_of_measure_add_eq (h : (μ + ν) t ≠ ∞) (h' : s ⊆ t)
    (h'' : (μ + ν) s = (μ + ν) t) : ν s = ν t
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm] at h'' h
  exact measure_eq_left_of_subset_of_measure_add_eq h h' h''

name: measure_toMeasurable_add_inter_left
statement:
theorem measure_toMeasurable_add_inter_left (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : (μ + ν) t ≠ ∞) :
    μ (toMeasurable (μ + ν) t ∩ s) = μ (t ∩ s)
proof:
:= by
  refine (measure_inter_eq_of_measure_eq hs ?_ (subset_toMeasurable _ _) ?_).symm
  · refine
      measure_eq_left_of_subset_of_measure_add_eq ?_ (subset_toMeasurable _ _)
        (measure_toMeasurable t).symm
    rwa [measure_toMeasurable t]
  · simp only [not_or, ENNReal.add_eq_top, Pi.add_apply, Ne, coe_add] at ht
    exact ht.1

name: measure_toMeasurable_add_inter_right
statement:
theorem measure_toMeasurable_add_inter_right (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : (μ + ν) t ≠ ∞) :
    ν (toMeasurable (μ + ν) t ∩ s) = ν (t ∩ s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm] at ht ⊢
  exact measure_toMeasurable_add_inter_left hs ht

name: comap
statement:
theorem comapₗ_apply {_ : MeasurableSpace α} {_ : MeasurableSpace β} (f : α → β)
    (hfi : Injective f) (hf : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet (f '' s)) (μ : Measure β)
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) : comapₗ f μ s = μ (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comapₗ, dite_eq_left, liftLinear_apply _ hs, OuterMeasure.comap_apply, coe_toOuterMeasure]
  exact ⟨hfi, hf⟩

name: comap_apply
statement:
theorem comap_apply₀ (f : α → β) (μ : Measure β) (hfi : Injective f)
    (hf : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → NullMeasurableSet (f '' s) μ)
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s (comap f μ)) : comap f μ s = μ (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comap, dite_eq_left (And.intro hfi hf)] at hs ⊢
  rw [toMeasure_apply₀ _ _ hs, OuterMeasure.comap_apply, coe_toOuterMeasure]

name: comap_undef
proof: := dite_eq_right h

name: le_comap_apply
statement:
theorem le_comap_apply (f : α → β) (μ : Measure β) (hfi : Injective f)
    (hf : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → NullMeasurableSet (f '' s) μ) (s : Set α) :
    μ (f '' s) ≤ comap f μ s
proof:
:= by
  grw [comap, dite_eq_left (And.intro hfi hf), ← le_toMeasure_apply]; rfl

name: comap_apply
statement:
theorem comap_apply (f : α → β) (hfi : Injective f)
    (hf : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet (f '' s)) (μ : Measure β) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    comap f μ s = μ (f '' s)
proof:
:=
  comap_apply₀ f μ hfi (fun s hs => (hf s hs).nullMeasurableSet) hs.nullMeasurableSet

name: comap_apply_le
statement:
theorem comap_apply_le (f : α → β) (μ : Measure β) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s (μ.comap f)) :
    μ.comap f s ≤ μ (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Injective f ∧ ∀ t, MeasurableSet t → NullMeasurableSet (f '' t) μ
  · rw [comap_apply₀ _ _ hf.1 hf.2 hs]
  · simp [comap_undef hf]

name: comap
statement:
theorem comapₗ_eq_comap (f : α → β) (hfi : Injective f)
    (hf : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet (f '' s)) (μ : Measure β) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    comapₗ f μ s = comap f μ s
proof:
:=
  (comapₗ_apply f hfi hf μ hs).trans (comap_apply f hfi hf μ hs).symm

name: measure_image_eq_zero_of_comap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_image_eq_zero_of_comap_eq_zero (f : α → β) (μ : Measure β) (hfi : Injective f)
    (hf : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → NullMeasurableSet (f '' s) μ) {s : Set α} (hs : comap f μ s = 0) :
    μ (f '' s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero]
  exact (le_comap_apply f μ hfi hf s).trans hs.le

name: ae_eq_image_of_ae_eq_comap
statement:
theorem ae_eq_image_of_ae_eq_comap (f : α → β) (μ : Measure β) (hfi : Injective f)
    (hf : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → NullMeasurableSet (f '' s) μ)
    {s t : Set α} (hst : s =ᵐ[comap f μ] t) : f '' s =ᵐ[μ] f '' t
proof:
:= by
  rw [EventuallyEqSet, EventuallyEq, ae_iff] at hst ⊢
  have h_eq_α : { a : α | ¬(a ∈ s) = (a ∈ t) } = s \ t ∪ t \ s := by
    ext1 x
    simp only [eq_iff_iff, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_union, Set.mem_sdiff]
    tauto
  have h_eq_β : { a : β | ¬(a ∈ f '' s) = (a ∈ f '' t) } = f '' s \ f '' t ∪ f '' t \ f '' s := by
    ext1 x
    simp only [eq_iff_iff, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_union, Set.mem_sdiff]
    tauto
  rw [← Set.image_sdiff hfi, ← Set.image_sdiff hfi, ← Set.image_union] at h_eq_β
  rw [h_eq_β]
  rw [h_eq_α] at hst
  exact measure_image_eq_zero_of_comap_eq_zero f μ hfi hf hst

name: NullMeasurableSet.image
statement:
theorem NullMeasurableSet.image (f : α → β) (μ : Measure β) (hfi : Injective f)
    (hf : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → NullMeasurableSet (f '' s) μ)
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s (μ.comap f)) : NullMeasurableSet (f '' s) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨toMeasurable μ (f '' toMeasurable (μ.comap f) s), measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _, ?_⟩
  refine EventuallyEq.trans ?_ (NullMeasurableSet.toMeasurable_ae_eq ?_).symm
  swap
  · exact hf _ (measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _)
  have h : toMeasurable (comap f μ) s =ᵐ[comap f μ] s :=
    NullMeasurableSet.toMeasurable_ae_eq hs
  exact ae_eq_image_of_ae_eq_comap f μ hfi hf h.symm

name: comap_preimage
statement:
theorem comap_preimage (f : α → β) (μ : Measure β) (hf : Injective f) (hf' : Measurable f)
    (h : ∀ t, MeasurableSet t → NullMeasurableSet (f '' t) μ) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    μ.comap f (f ⁻¹' s) = μ (s ∩ range f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comap_apply₀ _ _ hf h (hf' hs).nullMeasurableSet, image_preimage_eq_inter_range]

name: comap_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma comap_zero (f : α → β) : (0 : Measure β).comap f = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Injective f ∧ ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → NullMeasurableSet (f '' s) (0 : Measure β)
  · simp [comap, hf]
  · simp [comap, hf]

name: comap_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comap_id (μ : Measure β) : comap (fun x ↦ x) μ = μ
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [comap_apply, image_id']
  · exact injective_id
  all_goals simp [*]

name: comap_comap
statement:
lemma comap_comap (hf' : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet (f '' s)) (hg : Injective g)
    (hg' : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → MeasurableSet (g '' s)) (μ : Measure γ) :
    comap f (comap g μ) = comap (g ∘ f) μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Injective f
  · ext s hs
    rw [comap_apply _ hf hf' _ hs, comap_apply _ hg hg' _ (hf' _ hs),
      comap_apply _ (hg.comp hf) (fun t ht ↦ image_comp g f _ ▸ hg' _ <| hf' _ ht) _ hs, image_comp]
  · rw [comap, dite_eq_right <| mt And.left hf, comap, dite_eq_right fun h ↦ hf h.1.of_comp]

name: comap_smul
statement: lemma comap_smul {μ : Measure β} (c : ℝ≥0∞) : comap f (c • μ) = c • comap f μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hc := eq_or_ne c 0
  · simp
  by_cases h : Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ s : Set α, MeasurableSet s → NullMeasurableSet (f '' s) μ
  · ext s hs
    rw [comap_apply₀ f _ h.1 _ hs.nullMeasurableSet, smul_apply, smul_apply,
      comap_apply₀ f μ h.1 h.2 hs.nullMeasurableSet]
    simpa [nullMeasurableSet_smul_measure_iff hc] using h.2
  · have h' : ¬ (Function.Injective f ∧
        ∀ (s : Set α), MeasurableSet s → NullMeasurableSet (f '' s) (c • μ)) := by
      simpa [nullMeasurableSet_smul_measure_iff hc] using h
    simp [comap_undef, h, h']

name: measurable_fun_prod
statement:
theorem measurable_fun_prod {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β] :
    Measurable (fun (μ : ProbabilityMeasure α × ProbabilityMeasure β)
      ↦ μ.1.toMeasure.prod μ.2.toMeasure)
proof:
:= by
  apply Measurable.measure_of_isPiSystem_of_isProbabilityMeasure generateFrom_prod.symm
    isPiSystem_prod _
  simp only [mem_image2, mem_ofPred_eq, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  intro _ u Hu v Hv Heq
  simp_rw [← Heq, Measure.prod_prod]
  apply Measurable.mul
  · exact (Measure.measurable_coe Hu).comp (measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_fst)
  · exact (Measure.measurable_coe Hv).comp (measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_snd)

name: self_eq_mass_mul_normalize
statement:
@[simp]
theorem self_eq_mass_mul_normalize (s : Set Ω) : μ s = μ.mass * μ.normalize s
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h := eq_or_ne μ 0
  · simp
  have mass_nonzero : μ.mass ≠ 0 := by rwa [μ.mass_nonzero_iff]
  simp only [normalize, dite_eq_right mass_nonzero]
  simp [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ mass_nonzero, coeFn_def]

name: self_eq_mass_smul_normalize
statement: theorem self_eq_mass_smul_normalize : μ = μ.mass • μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_forall_apply_eq
  intro s _s_mble
  rw [μ.self_eq_mass_mul_normalize s, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ProbabilityMeasure.coeFn_comp_toFiniteMeasure_eq_coeFn]

name: normalize_eq_of_nonzero
statement: theorem normalize_eq_of_nonzero (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) (s : Set Ω) : μ.normalize s = μ.mass⁻¹ * μ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [μ.self_eq_mass_mul_normalize, μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero, inv_mul_cancel_left₀,
    Ne, not_false_iff]

name: normalize_eq_inv_mass_smul_of_nonzero
statement:
theorem normalize_eq_inv_mass_smul_of_nonzero (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) :
    μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure = μ.mass⁻¹ • μ
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 3 [μ.self_eq_mass_smul_normalize]
  rw [← smul_assoc]
  simp only [μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀, Ne,
    not_false_iff, one_smul]

name: toMeasure_normalize_eq_of_nonzero
statement:
theorem toMeasure_normalize_eq_of_nonzero (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) :
    (μ.normalize : Measure Ω) = μ.mass⁻¹ • μ
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s _s_mble
  rw [← μ.normalize.ennreal_coeFn_eq_coeFn_toMeasure s, μ.normalize_eq_of_nonzero nonzero s,
    ENNReal.coe_mul, ennreal_coeFn_eq_coeFn_toMeasure]
  exact Measure.coe_nnreal_smul_apply _ _ _

name: _root_.ProbabilityMeasure.toFiniteMeasure_normalize_eq_self
proof:
:= by
  apply ProbabilityMeasure.eq_of_forall_apply_eq
  intro s _s_mble
  rw [μ.toFiniteMeasure.normalize_eq_of_nonzero μ.toFiniteMeasure_nonzero s]
  simp only [ProbabilityMeasure.mass_toFiniteMeasure, inv_one, one_mul, μ.coeFn_toFiniteMeasure]

name: average_eq_integral_normalize
statement:
theorem average_eq_integral_normalize {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) (f : Ω → E) :
    average (μ : Measure Ω) f = ∫ ω, f ω ∂(μ.normalize : Measure Ω)
proof:
:= by
  rw [μ.toMeasure_normalize_eq_of_nonzero nonzero, average]
  congr
  simp [ENNReal.coe_inv (μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero), ennreal_mass]

name: testAgainstNN_eq_mass_mul
statement:
theorem testAgainstNN_eq_mass_mul (f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0) :
    μ.testAgainstNN f = μ.mass * μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [μ.self_eq_mass_smul_normalize]
  rw [μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.smul_testAgainstNN_apply μ.mass f, smul_eq_mul]

name: normalize_testAgainstNN
statement:
theorem normalize_testAgainstNN (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) (f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0) :
    μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f = μ.mass⁻¹ * μ.testAgainstNN f
proof:
:= by
  simp [μ.testAgainstNN_eq_mass_mul, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ <| μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero]

name: tendsto_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_mass
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h_mass : μ.mass = 0
  · simp only [μ.mass_zero_iff.mp h_mass, zero_testAgainstNN_apply, zero_mass] at mass_lim ⊢
    exact tendsto_zero_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_zero_mass mass_lim f
  simp_rw [fun i ↦ (μs i).testAgainstNN_eq_mass_mul f, μ.testAgainstNN_eq_mass_mul f]
  rw [ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_nhds_iff_toFiniteMeasure_tendsto_nhds] at μs_lim
  rw [tendsto_iff_forall_testAgainstNN_tendsto] at μs_lim
  have lim_pair :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (⟨(μs i).mass, (μs i).normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f⟩ : ℝ≥0 × ℝ≥0))
      F (𝓝 ⟨μ.mass, μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f⟩) :=
    (Prod.tendsto_iff _ _).mpr ⟨mass_lim, μs_lim f⟩
  exact tendsto_mul.comp lim_pair

name: tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto {γ : Type*} {F : Filter γ}
    {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω} (μs_lim : Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ)) (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) (f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f) F
      (𝓝 (μ.normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f))
proof:
:= by
  have lim_mass := μs_lim.mass
  have aux : {(0 : ℝ≥0)}ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 μ.mass :=
    isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds (μ.mass_nonzero_iff.mpr nonzero)
  have eventually_nonzero : ∀ᶠ i in F, μs i ≠ 0 := by
    simp_rw [← mass_nonzero_iff]
    exact lim_mass aux
  have eve : ∀ᶠ i in F,
      (μs i).normalize.toFiniteMeasure.testAgainstNN f =
        (μs i).mass⁻¹ * (μs i).testAgainstNN f := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_iff.mp eventually_nonzero]
    intro i hi
    apply normalize_testAgainstNN _ hi
  simp_rw [tendsto_congr' eve, μ.normalize_testAgainstNN nonzero]
  have lim_pair :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (⟨(μs i).mass⁻¹, (μs i).testAgainstNN f⟩ : ℝ≥0 × ℝ≥0)) F
      (𝓝 ⟨μ.mass⁻¹, μ.testAgainstNN f⟩) := by
    refine (Prod.tendsto_iff _ _).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (continuousOn_inv₀.continuousAt aux).tendsto.comp lim_mass
    · exact tendsto_iff_forall_testAgainstNN_tendsto.mp μs_lim f
  exact tendsto_mul.comp lim_pair

name: tendsto_of_tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_mass
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_iff_forall_testAgainstNN_tendsto]
  exact fun f ↦
    tendsto_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_mass μs_lim mass_lim f

name: tendsto_normalize_of_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_nhds_iff_toFiniteMeasure_tendsto_nhds,
    tendsto_iff_forall_testAgainstNN_tendsto]
  exact fun f ↦ tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto μs_lim nonzero f

name: tendsto_normalize_iff_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_normalize_iff_tendsto {γ : Type*} {F : Filter γ} {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω}
    (nonzero : μ ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).normalize) F (𝓝 μ.normalize) ∧
        Tendsto (fun i ↦ (μs i).mass) F (𝓝 μ.mass) ↔
      Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨normalized_lim, mass_lim⟩
    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_normalize_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_mass normalized_lim mass_lim
  · intro μs_lim
    exact ⟨tendsto_normalize_of_tendsto μs_lim nonzero, μs_lim.mass⟩

name: integral_charFun_Icc
statement:
lemma integral_charFun_Icc [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∫ t in -r..r, charFun μ t = 2 * r * ∫ x, sinc (r * x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have h_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun (x y : ℝ) ↦ cexp (x * y * I))
      ((volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (-r) r)).prod μ) := by
    simp only [neg_le_self_iff, hr.le, Set.uIoc_of_le]
    
    rw [← integrable_norm_iff (by fun_prop)]
    suffices (fun a => ‖Function.uncurry (fun (x y : ℝ) ↦ cexp (x * y * I)) a‖) = fun _ ↦ 1 by
      rw [this]
      fun_prop
    ext p
    rw [← Prod.mk.eta (p := p)]
    norm_cast
    simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  calc ∫ t in -r..r, charFun μ t
  _ = ∫ x in -r..r, ∫ y, cexp (x * y * I) ∂μ := by simp_rw [charFun_apply_real]
  _ = ∫ y, ∫ x in -r..r, cexp (x * y * I) ∂volume ∂μ := by
    rw [intervalIntegral_integral_swap h_int]
  _ = ∫ y, if r * y = 0 then 2 * (r : ℂ)
      else y⁻¹ * ∫ x in -(y * r)..y * r, cexp (x * I) ∂volume ∂μ := by
    congr with y
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · simp [hy, two_mul]
    simp only [mul_eq_zero, hr.ne', hy, or_self, ↓reduceIte, ofReal_inv]
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_smul_comp (E := ℂ) (a := -r) (b := r)
      (f := fun x ↦ y * x) (f' := fun _ ↦ y) (g := fun x ↦ cexp (x * I)) ?_ (by fun_prop)
      (by fun_prop)
    swap
    · intro x hx
      simp_rw [mul_comm y]
      exact hasDerivAt_mul_const _
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, ofReal_mul, real_smul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      mul_neg] at h
    rw [← h, ← mul_assoc]
    norm_cast
    simp [mul_comm _ y, mul_inv_cancel₀ hy]
  _ = ∫ x, 2 * (r : ℂ) * sinc (r * x) ∂μ := by
    congr with y
    rw [integral_exp_mul_I_eq_sinc]
    split_ifs with hry
    · simp [hry]
    have hy : y ≠ 0 := fun hy ↦ hry (by simp [hy])
    norm_cast
    field_simp
  _ = 2 * r * ∫ x, sinc (r * x) ∂μ := by
    norm_cast
    rw [← integral_const_mul]

name: measureReal_abs_gt_le_integral_charFun
statement:
lemma measureReal_abs_gt_le_integral_charFun [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hr : 0 < r) :
    μ.real {x | r < |x|} ≤ 2⁻¹ * r * ‖∫ t in (-2 * r⁻¹)..(2 * r⁻¹), 1 - charFun μ t‖
proof:
:= by
  have integrable_sinc_const_mul (r : ℝ) : Integrable (fun x ↦ sinc (r * x)) μ :=
    (integrable_map_measure stronglyMeasurable_sinc.aestronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop)).mp
      integrable_sinc
  calc μ.real {x | r < |x|}
  _ = μ.real {x | 2 < |2 * r⁻¹ * x|} := by
    congr 1 with x
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, abs_mul, Nat.abs_ofNat]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (a := r⁻¹) (by positivity), mul_assoc, ← inv_mul_lt_iff₀ (by positivity),
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), lt_inv_mul_iff₀ (by positivity), mul_one]
  _ = ∫ x in {x | 2 < |2 * r⁻¹ * x|}, 1 ∂μ := by simp
  _ = 2 * ∫ x in {x | 2 < |2 * r⁻¹ * x|}, 2⁻¹ ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr with _
    rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)]
  _ ≤ 2 * ∫ x in {x | 2 < |2 * r⁻¹ * x|}, 1 - sinc (2 * r⁻¹ * x) ∂μ := by
    gcongr (2 : ℝ) * ?_
    refine setIntegral_mono_on ?_
      ((integrable_const _).sub (integrable_sinc_const_mul _)).integrableOn ?_ fun x hx ↦ ?_
    · exact Integrable.integrableOn <| by fun_prop
    · exact MeasurableSet.preimage measurableSet_Ioi (by fun_prop)
    · have hx_ne : 2 * r⁻¹ * x ≠ 0 := by
        intro hx0
        simp only [hx0, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, abs_zero] at hx
        linarith
      rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, ← le_sub_iff_add_le']
      norm_num
      rw [one_div]
      refine (sinc_le_inv_abs hx_ne).trans ?_
      exact (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr (le_of_lt hx)
  _ ≤ 2 * ∫ x, 1 - sinc (2 * r⁻¹ * x) ∂μ := by
    grw [setIntegral_le_integral (by fun_prop) <| ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ ?_]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, sub_nonneg]
    exact sinc_le_one (2 * r⁻¹ * x)
  _ ≤ 2 * ‖∫ x, 1 - sinc (2 * r⁻¹ * x) ∂μ‖ := by
    gcongr
    exact Real.le_norm_self _
  _ = 2⁻¹ * r *
      ‖2 * (r : ℂ)⁻¹ + 2 * r⁻¹ - 2 * (2 * r⁻¹) * ∫ x, sinc (2 * r⁻¹ * x) ∂μ‖ := by
    norm_cast
    rw [← two_mul, mul_assoc 2, ← mul_sub, norm_mul, Real.norm_ofNat, ← mul_assoc,
      ← mul_one_sub, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (r := 2 * r⁻¹) (by positivity), ← mul_assoc]
    congr
    · ring_nf
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity), one_mul]
    · rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) (integrable_sinc_const_mul _)]
      simp
  _ = 2⁻¹ * r * ‖∫ t in (-2 * r⁻¹)..(2 * r⁻¹), 1 - charFun μ t‖ := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const intervalIntegrable_charFun, neg_mul,
      integral_charFun_Icc (by positivity)]
    simp

name: measureReal_abs_dual_gt_le_integral_charFunDual
statement:
lemma measureReal_abs_dual_gt_le_integral_charFunDual {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] {mE : MeasurableSpace E} [OpensMeasurableSpace E]
    {μ : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (L : StrongDual ℝ E) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :

name: measureReal_abs_inner_gt_le_integral_charFun
statement:
lemma measureReal_abs_inner_gt_le_integral_charFun {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {mE : MeasurableSpace E} [OpensMeasurableSpace E]
    {μ : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {a : E} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
