name: tendsto_zero_testAgainstNN_of_tendsto_zero_mass
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have obs := fun i ↦ (μs i).testAgainstNN_lipschitz_estimate f 0
  simp_rw [testAgainstNN_zero, zero_add] at obs
  simp_rw [show ∀ i, dist ((μs i).testAgainstNN f) 0 = (μs i).testAgainstNN f by
      simp only [dist_nndist, NNReal.nndist_zero_eq_val', imp_true_iff]]
  apply squeeze_zero (fun i ↦ NNReal.coe_nonneg _) obs
  have lim_pair : Tendsto (fun i ↦ (⟨nndist f 0, (μs i).mass⟩ : ℝ × ℝ)) F (𝓝 ⟨nndist f 0, 0⟩) :=
    (Prod.tendsto_iff _ _).mpr ⟨tendsto_const_nhds, (NNReal.continuous_coe.tendsto 0).comp mass_lim⟩
  simpa using! tendsto_mul.comp lim_pair

  intro f

  intro f

name: tendsto_of_forall_integral_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_iff_forall_lintegral_tendsto.mpr
  intro f
  apply (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal_iff (fi := F)
      (fun i ↦ (f.lintegral_lt_top_of_nnreal (μs i)).ne) (f.lintegral_lt_top_of_nnreal μ).ne).mp
  have lip : LipschitzWith 1 ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) := NNReal.isometry_coe.lipschitzWith
  set f₀ := BoundedContinuousFunction.comp _ lip f with _def_f₀
  have f₀_eq : ⇑f₀ = ((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) ∘ ⇑f := rfl
  have f₀_nn : 0 ≤ ⇑f₀ := fun _ ↦ by
    simp only [f₀_eq, Pi.zero_apply, Function.comp_apply, NNReal.zero_le_coe]
  have f₀_ae_nn : 0 ≤ᵐ[(μ : Measure Ω)] ⇑f₀ := .of_forall f₀_nn
  have f₀_ae_nns : ∀ i, 0 ≤ᵐ[(μs i : Measure Ω)] ⇑f₀ := fun i ↦ .of_forall f₀_nn
  have aux :=
    integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae f₀_ae_nn f₀.continuous.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  have auxs := fun i ↦
    integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (f₀_ae_nns i) f₀.continuous.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  simp_rw [f₀_eq, Function.comp_apply, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] at aux auxs
  simpa only [← aux, ← auxs] using! h f₀

name: tendsto_iff_forall_integral_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_iff_forall_integral_tendsto {γ : Type*} {F : Filter γ} {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω}
    {μ : FiniteMeasure Ω} :
    Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ) ↔
      ∀ f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ,
        Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i : Measure Ω)) F (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂(μ : Measure Ω)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, tendsto_of_forall_integral_tendsto⟩
  rw [tendsto_iff_forall_lintegral_tendsto]
  intro h f
  simp_rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.integral_eq_integral_nnrealPart_sub]
  set f_pos := f.nnrealPart with _def_f_pos
  set f_neg := (-f).nnrealPart with _def_f_neg
  have tends_pos := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal (f_pos.lintegral_lt_top_of_nnreal μ).ne).comp (h f_pos)
  have tends_neg := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal (f_neg.lintegral_lt_top_of_nnreal μ).ne).comp (h f_neg)
  have aux :
    ∀ g : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0,
      (ENNReal.toReal ∘ fun i : γ ↦ ∫⁻ x : Ω, ↑(g x) ∂(μs i : Measure Ω)) =
        fun i : γ ↦ (∫⁻ x : Ω, ↑(g x) ∂(μs i : Measure Ω)).toReal :=
    fun _ ↦ rfl
  simp_rw [aux, BoundedContinuousFunction.toReal_lintegral_coe_eq_integral] at tends_pos tends_neg
  exact Tendsto.sub tends_pos tends_neg

name: tendsto_iff_forall_integral_rclike_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_iff_forall_integral_rclike_tendsto {γ : Type*} (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜]
    {F : Filter γ} {μs : γ → FiniteMeasure Ω} {μ : FiniteMeasure Ω} :
    Tendsto μs F (𝓝 μ) ↔
      ∀ f : Ω →ᵇ 𝕜,
        Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ ω, f ω ∂(μs i : Measure Ω)) F (𝓝 (∫ ω, f ω ∂(μ : Measure Ω)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tendsto_iff_forall_integral_tendsto]
  refine ⟨fun h f ↦ ?_, fun h f ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← integral_re_add_im (integrable μ f)]
    simp_rw [← integral_re_add_im (integrable (μs _) f)]
    refine Tendsto.add ?_ ?_
    · exact (RCLike.continuous_ofReal.tendsto _).comp (h (f.comp RCLike.re RCLike.lipschitzWith_re))
    · exact (Tendsto.comp (RCLike.continuous_ofReal.tendsto _)
        (h (f.comp RCLike.im RCLike.lipschitzWith_im))).mul_const _
  · specialize h ((RCLike.ofRealAm (K := 𝕜)).compLeftContinuousBounded ℝ
      RCLike.lipschitzWith_ofReal f)
    simp only [AlgHom.compLeftContinuousBounded_apply_apply, RCLike.ofRealAm_coe,
      integral_ofReal] at h
    exact tendsto_ofReal_iff'.mp h

name: continuous_iff_forall_continuous_lintegral
statement:
lemma continuous_iff_forall_continuous_lintegral :
    Continuous μs ↔ ∀ f : Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0, Continuous fun x ↦ ∫⁻ ω, f ω ∂(μs x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [continuous_iff_continuousAt, ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_forall_lintegral_tendsto,

name: continuous_iff_forall_continuous_integral
statement:
lemma continuous_iff_forall_continuous_integral :

proof:

    forall_comm (α := X)]

name: continuous_lintegral_boundedContinuousFunction
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_lintegral_boundedContinuousFunction [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
    (f : X →ᵇ ℝ≥0) : Continuous fun μ : FiniteMeasure X ↦ ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ

name: continuous_integral_boundedContinuousFunction
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_integral_boundedContinuousFunction [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X]
    (f : X →ᵇ ℝ) : Continuous fun μ : FiniteMeasure X ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂μ

name: continuous_iff_forall_continuousMap_continuous_lintegral
statement:
lemma continuous_iff_forall_continuousMap_continuous_lintegral :
    Continuous μs ↔ ∀ f : C(Ω, ℝ≥0), Continuous fun x ↦ ∫⁻ ω, f ω ∂(μs x)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_forall_continuous_lintegral.trans

name: continuous_iff_forall_continuousMap_continuous_integral

name: continuous_lintegral_continuousMap
statement:
lemma continuous_lintegral_continuousMap [FunLike F X ℝ≥0] [ContinuousMapClass F X ℝ≥0] (f : F) :
    Continuous fun μ : FiniteMeasure X ↦ ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_forall_continuousMap_continuous_lintegral.1 continuous_id ⟨f, map_continuous f⟩

name: continuous_integral_continuousMap

lemma continuous_integral_continuousMap [FunLike F X ℝ] [ContinuousMapClass F X ℝ] (f : F) :

  continuous_iff_forall_continuousMap_continuous_integral.1 continuous_id ⟨f, map_continuous f⟩

name: toMeasure_comap
statement:
@[simp] lemma toMeasure_comap (f : Ω → Ω') (μ : FiniteMeasure Ω') :
    (μ.comap f).toMeasure = (μ : Measure Ω').comap f
proof: := rfl

name: mass_comap_le
statement:
lemma mass_comap_le (f : Ω → Ω') (μ : FiniteMeasure Ω') :
    (μ.comap f).mass ≤ μ.mass
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mass, comap, mk_apply, coeFn_def, ne_eq, measure_ne_top, not_false_eq_true,
    ENNReal.toNNReal_le_toNNReal]
  apply (Measure.comap_apply_le _ _ nullMeasurableSet_univ).trans (measure_mono (subset_univ _))

name: _root_.Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.continuousOn_comap_finiteMeasure
proof:
:= by
  intro μ hμ
  simp only [ContinuousWithinAt]
  rw [tendsto_iff_forall_integral_tendsto]
  intro g
  obtain ⟨g', -, hg'⟩ : ∃ g' : Ω' →ᵇ ℝ, ‖g'‖ = ‖g‖ ∧ g' ∘ f = g :=
    exists_extension_norm_eq_of_isClosedEmbedding g hf
  have A x : g x = g' (f x) := by change (⇑g) x = (⇑g' ∘ f) x; simp only [hg']
  simp only [comap, toMeasure_mk, A, ← MeasurableEmbedding.integral_map hf.measurableEmbedding,
    MeasurableEmbedding.map_comap hf.measurableEmbedding]
  have B {ν : FiniteMeasure Ω'} (hν : ν (range f)ᶜ = 0) :
      ∫ y in range f, g' y ∂ν = ∫ y, g' y ∂ν := by
    congr
    simp only [null_iff_toMeasure_null] at hν
    exact Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hν
  rw [B hμ]
  have : Tendsto (fun (ν : FiniteMeasure Ω') ↦ ∫ y, g' y ∂ν) (𝓝[{μ | μ (range f)ᶜ = 0}] μ)
      (𝓝 (∫ (y : Ω'), g' y ∂μ)) := by
    rw [nhdsWithin]
    have A : Tendsto (fun (ν : FiniteMeasure Ω') ↦ ∫ y, g' y ∂ν) (𝓝 μ) (𝓝 (∫ (y : Ω'), g' y ∂μ)) :=
      tendsto_iff_forall_integral_tendsto.1 tendsto_id _
    exact Tendsto.mono_left A inf_le_left
  apply Tendsto.congr' _ this
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with ν hν using (B hν).symm

name: toMeasure_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma toMeasure_map (ν : FiniteMeasure Ω) (f : Ω → Ω') :
    (ν.map f).toMeasure = ν.toMeasure.map f
proof: := rfl

name: map_apply'
statement:
lemma map_apply' (ν : FiniteMeasure Ω) {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_aemble : AEMeasurable f ν)
    {A : Set Ω'} (A_mble : MeasurableSet A) :
    (ν.map f : Measure Ω') A = (ν : Measure Ω) (f ⁻¹' A)
proof:
:=
  Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable f_aemble A_mble

name: map_apply_of_aemeasurable
statement:
lemma map_apply_of_aemeasurable (ν : FiniteMeasure Ω) {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_aemble : AEMeasurable f ν)
    {A : Set Ω'} (A_mble : MeasurableSet A) :
    ν.map f A = ν (f ⁻¹' A)
proof:
:= by
  have key := ν.map_apply' f_aemble A_mble
  exact (ENNReal.toNNReal_eq_toNNReal_iff' (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_ne_top _ _)).mpr key

name: map_apply
statement:
lemma map_apply (ν : FiniteMeasure Ω) {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_mble : Measurable f)
    {A : Set Ω'} (A_mble : MeasurableSet A) :
    ν.map f A = ν (f ⁻¹' A)
proof:
:=
  map_apply_of_aemeasurable ν f_mble.aemeasurable A_mble

name: map_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_add {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_mble : Measurable f) (ν₁ ν₂ : FiniteMeasure Ω) :
    (ν₁ + ν₂).map f = ν₁.map f + ν₂.map f
proof: := by ext; simp [*]

name: map_smul
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_smul {f : Ω → Ω'} (c : ℝ≥0) {ν : FiniteMeasure Ω} (hf : AEMeasurable f ν) :
    (c • ν).map f = c • (ν.map f)
proof:
:= by
  ext s _
  simp [toMeasure_smul, hf]

name: mass_map_le
statement:
lemma mass_map_le {f : Ω → Ω'} {μ : FiniteMeasure Ω} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) :
    (μ.map f).mass ≤ μ.mass
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mass, coeFn_def, toMeasure_map, ne_eq, measure_ne_top, not_false_eq_true,
    ENNReal.toNNReal_le_toNNReal]
  rw [Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf MeasurableSet.univ]
  exact measure_mono (subset_univ _)

name: tendsto_map_of_tendsto_of_continuous
statement:
lemma tendsto_map_of_tendsto_of_continuous {ι : Type*} {L : Filter ι}
    (νs : ι → FiniteMeasure Ω) (ν : FiniteMeasure Ω) (lim : Tendsto νs L (𝓝 ν))
    {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_cont : Continuous f) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ (νs i).map f) L (𝓝 (ν.map f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteMeasure.tendsto_iff_forall_lintegral_tendsto] at lim ⊢
  intro g
  convert! lim (g.compContinuous ⟨f, f_cont⟩) <;>
  · simp only [map, compContinuous_apply, ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    refine lintegral_map ?_ f_cont.measurable
    exact (ENNReal.continuous_coe.comp g.continuous).measurable

name: continuous_map
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_map {f : Ω → Ω'} (f_cont : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun ν ↦ FiniteMeasure.map ν f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  exact fun _ ↦ tendsto_map_of_tendsto_of_continuous _ _ continuous_id.continuousAt f_cont

name: Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding_map_finiteMeasure
statement:
lemma Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding_map_finiteMeasure {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace Ω] [BorelSpace Ω] [NormalSpace Ω']
    (f : Ω → Ω') (hf : IsClosedEmbedding f) :
    IsEmbedding (fun (μ : FiniteMeasure Ω) ↦ μ.map f)
proof:
:= by
  let M : Set (FiniteMeasure Ω') := {μ | μ (range f)ᶜ = 0}
  have A : IsEmbedding (Subtype.val : M → FiniteMeasure Ω') := IsEmbedding.subtypeVal
  let B : FiniteMeasure Ω ≃ₜ M :=
  { toFun μ := by
      refine ⟨μ.map f, ?_⟩
      simp only [null_iff_toMeasure_null, mem_ofPred_eq, toMeasure_map, M]
      rw [Measure.map_apply hf.continuous.measurable hf.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl.measurableSet]
      simp
    invFun := M.domRestrict (fun μ ↦ μ.comap f)
    continuous_toFun := by fun_prop
    continuous_invFun := by
      rw [← continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
      exact hf.continuousOn_comap_finiteMeasure
    left_inv μ := by
      ext s hs
      simp only [Set.domRestrict_apply, toMeasure_comap, toMeasure_map]
      rw [Measure.comap_apply, Measure.map_apply, preimage_image_eq]
      · exact hf.injective
      · exact hf.continuous.measurable
      · exact hf.measurableEmbedding.measurableSet_image' hs
      · exact hf.injective
      · exact fun t ht ↦ hf.measurableEmbedding.measurableSet_image' ht
      · exact hs
    right_inv μ := by
      ext s hs
      simp only [Set.domRestrict_apply, toMeasure_map]
      rw [Measure.map_apply hf.continuous.measurable hs]
      simp only [toMeasure_comap]
      rw [Measure.comap_apply _ hf.injective, image_preimage_eq_inter_range]
      · rw [← Measure.restrict_apply hs, Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem]
        exact (null_iff_toMeasure_null (↑μ) (range f)ᶜ).mp (by exact μ.2)
      · exact fun t ht ↦ hf.measurableEmbedding.measurableSet_image' ht
      · exact hf.continuous.measurable hs }
  exact A.comp B.isEmbedding

name: ext_of_forall_mem_subalgebra_integral_eq_of_pseudoEMetric_complete_countable
statement:
theorem ext_of_forall_mem_subalgebra_integral_eq_of_pseudoEMetric_complete_countable
    [PseudoEMetricSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [CompleteSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {P P' : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure P] [IsFiniteMeasure P']
    {A : StarSubalgebra 𝕜 (E →ᵇ 𝕜)} (hA : (A.map (toContinuousMapStarₐ 𝕜)).SeparatesPoints)
    (heq : ∀ g ∈ A, ∫ x, (g : E → 𝕜) x ∂P = ∫ x, (g : E → 𝕜) x ∂P') : P = P'
proof:
:= by
  
  let A_toReal := (A.restrictScalars ℝ).comap
    (ofRealAm.compLeftContinuousBounded ℝ lipschitzWith_ofReal)
  
  have hA_toReal : (A_toReal.map (toContinuousMapₐ ℝ)).SeparatesPoints := by
    rw [RCLike.restrict_toContinuousMap_eq_toContinuousMapStar_restrict]
    exact Subalgebra.SeparatesPoints.rclike_to_real hA
  
  have heq' : ∀ g ∈ A_toReal, ∫ x, (g : E → ℝ) x ∂P = ∫ x, (g : E → ℝ) x ∂P' := by
    intro g hgA_toReal
    rw [← @ofReal_inj 𝕜, ← integral_ofReal, ← integral_ofReal]
    exact heq _ hgA_toReal
  apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
  intro f
  have h0 : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => 6 * √ε) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    nth_rewrite 3 [← mul_zero 6]
    apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds (Tendsto.const_mul 6 _)
    nth_rewrite 2 [← sqrt_zero]
    exact Continuous.tendsto continuous_sqrt 0
  have lim1 : Tendsto (fun ε => |∫ x, mulExpNegMulSq ε (f x) ∂P - ∫ x, mulExpNegMulSq ε (f x) ∂P'|)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero' (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun x _ => abs_nonneg _))
      (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall _) h0
    exact fun ε hε => dist_integral_mulExpNegMulSq_comp_le f hA_toReal heq' hε
  have lim2 : Tendsto (fun ε => |∫ x, mulExpNegMulSq ε (f x) ∂P
      - ∫ x, mulExpNegMulSq ε (f x) ∂P'|) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 |∫ x, f x ∂↑P - ∫ x, f x ∂↑P'|) :=
    Tendsto.abs (Tendsto.sub (tendsto_integral_mulExpNegMulSq_comp f)
      (tendsto_integral_mulExpNegMulSq_comp f))
  exact eq_of_abs_sub_eq_zero (tendsto_nhds_unique lim2 lim1)

name: ext_of_forall_mem_subalgebra_integral_eq_of_polish
statement:
theorem ext_of_forall_mem_subalgebra_integral_eq_of_polish [TopologicalSpace E] [PolishSpace E]
    [BorelSpace E] {P P' : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure P] [IsFiniteMeasure P']
    {A : StarSubalgebra 𝕜 (E →ᵇ 𝕜)} (hA : (A.map (toContinuousMapStarₐ 𝕜)).SeparatesPoints)
    (heq : ∀ g ∈ A, ∫ x, (g : E → 𝕜) x ∂P = ∫ x, (g : E → 𝕜) x ∂P') : P = P'
proof:
:= by
  let := TopologicalSpace.upgradeIsCompletelyMetrizable E
  exact ext_of_forall_mem_subalgebra_integral_eq_of_pseudoEMetric_complete_countable hA heq

name: llr_def
statement: lemma llr_def (μ ν : Measure α) : llr μ ν = fun x ↦ log (μ.rnDeriv ν x).toReal
proof: := rfl

name: llr_self
statement: lemma llr_self (μ : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] : llr μ μ =ᵐ[μ] 0
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [μ.rnDeriv_self] with a ha using by simp [llr, ha]

name: exp_llr
statement:
lemma exp_llr (μ ν : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] :
    (fun x ↦ exp (llr μ ν x))
      =ᵐ[ν] fun x ↦ if μ.rnDeriv ν x = 0 then 1 else (μ.rnDeriv ν x).toReal
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Measure.rnDeriv_lt_top μ ν] with x hx
  by_cases h_zero : μ.rnDeriv ν x = 0
  · simp only [llr, h_zero, ENNReal.toReal_zero, log_zero, exp_zero, ite_true]
  · rw [llr, exp_log, ite_eq_right h_zero]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_pos h_zero hx.ne

name: exp_llr_of_ac
statement:
lemma exp_llr_of_ac (μ ν : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] [Measure.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) :
    (fun x ↦ exp (llr μ ν x)) =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ (μ.rnDeriv ν x).toReal
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hμν.ae_le (exp_llr μ ν), Measure.rnDeriv_pos hμν] with x hx_eq hx_pos
  rw [hx_eq, ite_eq_right hx_pos.ne']

name: exp_llr_of_ac'
statement:
lemma exp_llr_of_ac' (μ ν : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hμν : ν ≪ μ) :
    (fun x ↦ exp (llr μ ν x)) =ᵐ[ν] fun x ↦ (μ.rnDeriv ν x).toReal
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [exp_llr μ ν, Measure.rnDeriv_pos' hμν] with x hx hx_pos
  rwa [ite_eq_right hx_pos.ne'] at hx

name: neg_llr
statement:
lemma neg_llr [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hμν : μ ≪ ν) :
    -llr μ ν =ᵐ[μ] llr ν μ
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Measure.inv_rnDeriv hμν] with x hx
  rw [Pi.neg_apply, llr, llr, ← log_inv, ← ENNReal.toReal_inv]
  congr

name: exp_neg_llr
statement:
lemma exp_neg_llr [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hμν : μ ≪ ν) :
    (fun x ↦ exp (-llr μ ν x)) =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [neg_llr hμν, exp_llr_of_ac' ν μ hμν] with x hx hx_exp_log
  rw [Pi.neg_apply] at hx
  rw [hx, hx_exp_log]

name: exp_neg_llr'
statement:
lemma exp_neg_llr' [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hμν : ν ≪ μ) :
    (fun x ↦ exp (-llr μ ν x)) =ᵐ[ν] fun x ↦ (ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [neg_llr hμν, exp_llr_of_ac ν μ hμν] with x hx hx_exp_log
  rw [Pi.neg_apply, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg] at hx
  rw [← hx, hx_exp_log]

name: measurable_llr
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_llr (μ ν : Measure α) : Measurable (llr μ ν)
proof:
:=
  (Measure.measurable_rnDeriv μ ν).ennreal_toReal.log

name: stronglyMeasurable_llr
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma stronglyMeasurable_llr (μ ν : Measure α) : StronglyMeasurable (llr μ ν)
proof:
:=
  (measurable_llr μ ν).stronglyMeasurable

name: llr_smul_left
statement:
lemma llr_smul_left [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [Measure.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc_ne_top : c ≠ ∞) :
    llr (c • μ) ν =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ llr μ ν x + log c.toReal
proof:
:= by
  simp only [llr, llr_def]
  have h := Measure.rnDeriv_smul_left_of_ne_top μ ν hc_ne_top
  filter_upwards [hμν.ae_le h, Measure.rnDeriv_pos hμν, hμν.ae_le (Measure.rnDeriv_lt_top μ ν)]
    with x hx_eq hx_pos hx_ne_top
  rw [hx_eq]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  rw [log_mul]
  rotate_left
  · rw [ENNReal.toReal_ne_zero]
    simp [hc, hc_ne_top]
  · rw [ENNReal.toReal_ne_zero]
    simp [hx_pos.ne', hx_ne_top.ne]
  ring

name: llr_smul_nnreal_left
statement:
lemma llr_smul_nnreal_left [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [Measure.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    llr (c • μ) ν =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ llr μ ν x + log c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Measure.coe_nnreal_smul]
  filter_upwards [llr_smul_left hμν (c : ℝ≥0∞) (by simpa) (by simp)] with x hx
  rw [hx]
  simp

name: llr_smul_right
statement:
lemma llr_smul_right [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [Measure.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc_ne_top : c ≠ ∞) :
    llr μ (c • ν) =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ llr μ ν x - log c.toReal
proof:
:= by
  simp only [llr, llr_def]
  have h := Measure.rnDeriv_smul_right_of_ne_top μ ν hc hc_ne_top
  filter_upwards [hμν.ae_le h, Measure.rnDeriv_pos hμν, hμν.ae_le (Measure.rnDeriv_lt_top μ ν)]
    with x hx_eq hx_pos hx_ne_top
  rw [hx_eq]
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
  rw [log_mul]
  rotate_left
  · rw [ENNReal.toReal_ne_zero]
    simp [hc, hc_ne_top]
  · rw [ENNReal.toReal_ne_zero]
    simp [hx_pos.ne', hx_ne_top.ne]
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_inv, log_inv]
  ring

name: llr_smul_nnreal_right
statement:
lemma llr_smul_nnreal_right [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [Measure.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    llr μ (c • ν) =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ llr μ ν x - log c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Measure.coe_nnreal_smul]
  filter_upwards [llr_smul_right hμν (c : ℝ≥0∞) (by simpa) (by simp)] with x hx
  rw [hx]
  simp

name: llr_smul_inv_left_eq_smul_right
statement:
lemma llr_smul_inv_left_eq_smul_right [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [Measure.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc_ne_top : c ≠ ∞) :
    llr (c⁻¹ • μ) ν =ᵐ[μ] llr μ (c • ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hc' : c⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by simp [hc_ne_top]
  have hc_ne_top' : c⁻¹ ≠ ∞ := by simp [hc]
  filter_upwards [llr_smul_left hμν c⁻¹ hc' hc_ne_top', llr_smul_right hμν c hc hc_ne_top] with
    x hx_left hx_right
  rw [hx_left, hx_right]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: llr_smul_same
statement:
lemma llr_smul_same [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [Measure.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc_ne_top : c ≠ ∞) :
    llr (c • μ) (c • ν) =ᵐ[μ] llr μ ν
proof:
:= by
  simp only [llr_def]
  lift c to ℝ≥0 using hc_ne_top
  norm_cast at hc
  filter_upwards [hμν.ae_le (Measure.rnDeriv_smul_same μ ν hc)] with x hx using by simp [hx]

name: llr_smul_nnreal_same
statement:
lemma llr_smul_nnreal_same [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [Measure.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (c : ℝ≥0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    llr (c • μ) (c • ν) =ᵐ[μ] llr μ ν
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Measure.coe_nnreal_smul]
  filter_upwards [llr_smul_same hμν (c : ℝ≥0∞) (by simpa) (by simp)] with x hx
  rw [hx]

name: integrable_rnDeriv_mul_log_iff
statement:
lemma integrable_rnDeriv_mul_log_iff [SigmaFinite μ] [μ.HaveLebesgueDecomposition ν] (hμν : μ ≪ ν) :
    Integrable (fun a ↦ (μ.rnDeriv ν a).toReal * log (μ.rnDeriv ν a).toReal) ν
      ↔ Integrable (llr μ ν) μ
proof:
:=
  integrable_rnDeriv_smul_iff hμν

name: integral_rnDeriv_mul_log
statement:
lemma integral_rnDeriv_mul_log [SigmaFinite μ] [μ.HaveLebesgueDecomposition ν] (hμν : μ ≪ ν) :
    ∫ a, (μ.rnDeriv ν a).toReal * log (μ.rnDeriv ν a).toReal ∂ν = ∫ a, llr μ ν a ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← smul_eq_mul, integral_rnDeriv_smul hμν, llr]

name: llr_tilted_left
statement:
lemma llr_tilted_left [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν] (hμν : μ ≪ ν)
    (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) (hfν : AEMeasurable f ν) :
    (llr (μ.tilted f) ν) =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ f x - log (∫ z, exp (f z) ∂μ) + llr μ ν x
proof:
:= by
  cases eq_zero_or_neZero μ with
  | inl hμ =>
    simp only [hμ, ae_zero, Filter.EventuallyEq, Filter.eventually_bot]
  | inr h0 =>
    filter_upwards [hμν.ae_le (toReal_rnDeriv_tilted_left μ hfν), Measure.rnDeriv_pos hμν,
      hμν.ae_le (Measure.rnDeriv_lt_top μ ν)] with x hx hx_pos hx_lt_top
    rw [llr, hx, log_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, log_mul (exp_pos _).ne', log_exp, log_inv, llr,
      ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    · simp only [ne_eq, inv_eq_zero]
      exact (integral_exp_pos hf).ne'
    · simp only [ne_eq, div_eq_zero_iff]
      push Not
      exact ⟨(exp_pos _).ne', (integral_exp_pos hf).ne'⟩
    · simp [ENNReal.toReal_eq_zero_iff, hx_lt_top.ne, hx_pos.ne']

name: integrable_llr_tilted_left
statement:
lemma integrable_llr_tilted_left [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (hf : Integrable f μ) (h_int : Integrable (llr μ ν) μ)
    (hfμ : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) (hfν : AEMeasurable f ν) :
    Integrable (llr (μ.tilted f) ν) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [integrable_congr (llr_tilted_left hμν hfμ hfν)]
  exact Integrable.add (hf.sub (integrable_const _)) h_int

name: integral_llr_tilted_left
statement:
lemma integral_llr_tilted_left [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (hf : Integrable f μ) (h_int : Integrable (llr μ ν) μ)
    (hfμ : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) (hfν : AEMeasurable f ν) :
    ∫ x, llr (μ.tilted f) ν x ∂μ = ∫ x, llr μ ν x ∂μ + ∫ x, f x ∂μ - log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  calc ∫ x, llr (μ.tilted f) ν x ∂μ
    = ∫ x, f x - log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) + llr μ ν x ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (llr_tilted_left hμν hfμ hfν)
  _ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ - log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) + ∫ x, llr μ ν x ∂μ := by
        rw [integral_add ?_ h_int]
        swap; · exact hf.sub (integrable_const _)
        rw [integral_sub hf (integrable_const _)]
        simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
  _ = ∫ x, llr μ ν x ∂μ + ∫ x, f x ∂μ - log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ) := by abel

name: llr_tilted_right
statement:
lemma llr_tilted_right [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) ν) :
    (llr μ (ν.tilted f)) =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ -f x + log (∫ z, exp (f z) ∂ν) + llr μ ν x
proof:
:= by
  cases eq_zero_or_neZero ν with
  | inl h =>
    have hμ : μ = 0 := by ext s _; exact hμν (by simp [h])
    simp only [hμ, ae_zero, Filter.EventuallyEq, Filter.eventually_bot]
  | inr h0 =>
    filter_upwards [hμν.ae_le (toReal_rnDeriv_tilted_right μ ν hf), Measure.rnDeriv_pos hμν,
      hμν.ae_le (Measure.rnDeriv_lt_top μ ν)] with x hx hx_pos hx_lt_top
    rw [llr, hx, log_mul, log_mul (exp_pos _).ne', log_exp, llr]
    · exact (integral_exp_pos hf).ne'
    · refine (mul_pos (exp_pos _) (integral_exp_pos hf)).ne'
    · simp [ENNReal.toReal_eq_zero_iff, hx_lt_top.ne, hx_pos.ne']

name: integrable_llr_tilted_right
statement:
lemma integrable_llr_tilted_right [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (hfμ : Integrable f μ)
    (h_int : Integrable (llr μ ν) μ) (hfν : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) ν) :
    Integrable (llr μ (ν.tilted f)) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [integrable_congr (llr_tilted_right hμν hfν)]
  exact Integrable.add (hfμ.neg.add (integrable_const _)) h_int

name: integral_llr_tilted_right
statement:
lemma integral_llr_tilted_right [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (hfμ : Integrable f μ) (hfν : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) ν)
    (h_int : Integrable (llr μ ν) μ) :
    ∫ x, llr μ (ν.tilted f) x ∂μ = ∫ x, llr μ ν x ∂μ - ∫ x, f x ∂μ + log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂ν)
proof:
:= by
  calc ∫ x, llr μ (ν.tilted f) x ∂μ
    = ∫ x, -f x + log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂ν) + llr μ ν x ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (llr_tilted_right hμν hfν)
  _ = -∫ x, f x ∂μ + log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂ν) + ∫ x, llr μ ν x ∂μ := by
        rw [← integral_neg, integral_add ?_ h_int]
        swap; · exact hfμ.neg.add (integrable_const _)
        rw [integral_add ?_ (integrable_const _)]
        swap; · exact hfμ.neg
        simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
  _ = ∫ x, llr μ ν x ∂μ - ∫ x, f x ∂μ + log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂ν) := by abel

name: liftLinear_apply
statement:
lemma liftLinear_apply₀ {f : OuterMeasure α →ₗ[ℝ≥0∞] OuterMeasure β} (hf) {s : Set β}
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s (liftLinear f hf μ)) : liftLinear f hf μ s = f μ.toOuterMeasure s
proof:
:=
  toMeasure_apply₀ _ (hf μ) hs

name: liftLinear_apply
proof:
:=
  toMeasure_apply _ (hf μ) hs

name: le_liftLinear_apply
statement:
theorem le_liftLinear_apply {f : OuterMeasure α →ₗ[ℝ≥0∞] OuterMeasure β} (hf) (s : Set β) :
    f μ.toOuterMeasure s ≤ liftLinear f hf μ s
proof:
:=
  le_toMeasure_apply _ (hf μ) s

name: map
statement:
theorem mapₗ_congr {f g : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) (h : f =ᵐ[μ] g) :
    mapₗ f μ = mapₗ g μ
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s hs
  simpa only [mapₗ, hf, hg, hs, dite_eq_left, liftLinear_apply, OuterMeasure.map_apply]
    using! measure_congr (h.preimage s)

name: nonempty_of_not_aemeasurable
statement:
private lemma nonempty_of_not_aemeasurable {f : α → β} (hf : ¬AEMeasurable f μ) :
    Nonempty β
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hf
  exact (measurable_of_empty_codomain f).aemeasurable

name: map
statement:
theorem mapₗ_mk_apply_of_aemeasurable {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) :
    mapₗ (hf.mk f) μ = map f μ
proof: := by simp [map, hf]

name: map
statement:
theorem mapₗ_apply_of_measurable {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) (μ : Measure α) :
    mapₗ f μ = map f μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← mapₗ_mk_apply_of_aemeasurable hf.aemeasurable]
  exact mapₗ_congr hf hf.aemeasurable.measurable_mk hf.aemeasurable.ae_eq_mk

name: map_add
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_add (μ ν : Measure α) {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (μ + ν).map f = μ.map f + ν.map f
proof: := by simp [← mapₗ_apply_of_measurable hf]

name: map_zero
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_zero (f : α → β) : (0 : Measure α).map f = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : AEMeasurable f (0 : Measure α) <;> simp [map, hf]

name: map_of_not_aemeasurable_of_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_of_not_aemeasurable_of_ne_zero {f : α → β} {μ : Measure α} (hf : ¬AEMeasurable f μ)
    (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    haveI : Nonempty β
proof:
:= by exact nonempty_of_not_aemeasurable hf
    μ.map f = dirac Classical.ofNonempty := by simp [map, hf, hμ]

name: map_congr
statement: theorem map_congr {f g : α → β} (h : f =ᵐ[μ] g) : Measure.map f μ = Measure.map g μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : AEMeasurable f μ
  · have hg : AEMeasurable g μ := hf.congr h
    simp only [← mapₗ_mk_apply_of_aemeasurable hf, ← mapₗ_mk_apply_of_aemeasurable hg]
    exact
      mapₗ_congr hf.measurable_mk hg.measurable_mk (hf.ae_eq_mk.symm.trans (h.trans hg.ae_eq_mk))
  · have hg : ¬AEMeasurable g μ := by simpa [← aemeasurable_congr h] using hf
    obtain rfl | hμ := eq_or_ne μ 0
    · simp
    simp [map_of_not_aemeasurable_of_ne_zero, hf, hg, hμ]

name: map_smul
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_smul {R : Type*} [SMul R ℝ≥0∞] [IsScalarTower R ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0∞]
    (c : R) {μ : Measure α} {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) : (c • μ).map f = c • μ.map f
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, (c • μ).map f = c • μ.map f by simpa using this (c • 1)
  clear c; intro c
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with (rfl | hc); · simp
  have hfc : AEMeasurable f (c • μ) :=
    ⟨hf.mk f, hf.measurable_mk, (ae_ennreal_smul_measure_iff hc).2 hf.ae_eq_mk⟩
  simp only [← mapₗ_mk_apply_of_aemeasurable hf, ← mapₗ_mk_apply_of_aemeasurable hfc, map_smulₛₗ,
    RingHom.id_apply]
  congr 1
  apply mapₗ_congr hfc.measurable_mk hf.measurable_mk
  exact .trans ((ae_ennreal_smul_measure_iff hc).1 hfc.ae_eq_mk.symm) hf.ae_eq_mk

name: map_apply
statement:
lemma map_apply₀ {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) {s : Set β}
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s (map f μ)) : μ.map f s = μ (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map, dite_eq_left hf, mapₗ, dite_eq_left hf.measurable_mk] at hs ⊢
  rw [liftLinear_apply₀ _ hs, measure_congr (hf.ae_eq_mk.preimage s)]
  rfl

name: map_apply_of_aemeasurable
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply_of_aemeasurable (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    μ.map f s = μ (f ⁻¹' s)
proof: := map_apply₀ hf hs.nullMeasurableSet

name: map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply (hf : Measurable f) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    μ.map f s = μ (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:=
  map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf.aemeasurable hs

name: map_toOuterMeasure
statement:
theorem map_toOuterMeasure (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) :
    (μ.map f).toOuterMeasure = (OuterMeasure.map f μ.toOuterMeasure).trim
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trimmed, OuterMeasure.trim_eq_trim_iff]
  intro s hs
  simp [hf, hs]

name: map_eq_zero_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma map_eq_zero_iff (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) : μ.map f = 0 ↔ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← measure_univ_eq_zero, map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf .univ, preimage_univ]

name: map
statement: @[simp] lemma mapₗ_eq_zero_iff (hf : Measurable f) : Measure.mapₗ f μ = 0 ↔ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapₗ_apply_of_measurable hf, map_eq_zero_iff hf.aemeasurable]

name: measure_preimage_of_map_eq_self
statement:
lemma measure_preimage_of_map_eq_self {f : α → α} (hf : map f μ = μ) (hfm : AEMeasurable f μ)
    {s : Set α} (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) : μ (f ⁻¹' s) = μ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_apply₀ hfm, hf]
  rwa [hf]

name: map_ne_zero_iff
statement: lemma map_ne_zero_iff (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) : μ.map f ≠ 0 ↔ μ ≠ 0
proof: := (map_eq_zero_iff hf).not

name: map
statement: lemma mapₗ_ne_zero_iff (hf : Measurable f) : Measure.mapₗ f μ ≠ 0 ↔ μ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (mapₗ_eq_zero_iff hf).not

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map id μ = μ
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ => map_apply measurable_id

name: map_id'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id' : map (fun x => x) μ = μ
proof:
:=
  map_id

name: map_map
statement:
theorem map_map {g : β → γ} {f : α → β} (hg : Measurable g) (hf : Measurable f) :
    (μ.map f).map g = μ.map (g ∘ f)
proof:
:=
  ext fun s hs => by simp [hf, hg, hs, hg hs, hg.comp hf, ← preimage_comp]

name: map_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem map_mono {f : α → β} (h : μ ≤ ν) (hf : Measurable f) : μ.map f ≤ ν.map f
proof:
:=
  le_iff.2 fun s hs ↦ by simp [hf.aemeasurable, hs, h _]

name: le_map_apply
statement: theorem le_map_apply {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (s : Set β) : μ (f ⁻¹' s) ≤ μ.map f s
proof:
:=
  calc
    μ (f ⁻¹' s) ≤ μ (f ⁻¹' toMeasurable (μ.map f) s) := by gcongr; apply subset_toMeasurable
    _ = μ.map f (toMeasurable (μ.map f) s) :=
      (map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf <| measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _).symm
    _ = μ.map f s := measure_toMeasurable _

name: le_map_apply_image
statement:
theorem le_map_apply_image {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (s : Set α) :
    μ s ≤ μ.map f (f '' s)
proof:
:=
  (measure_mono (subset_preimage_image f s)).trans (le_map_apply hf _)

name: preimage_null_of_map_null
statement:
theorem preimage_null_of_map_null {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) {s : Set β}
    (hs : μ.map f s = 0) : μ (f ⁻¹' s) = 0
proof:
:=
  nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp <| (le_map_apply hf s).trans_eq hs

name: tendsto_ae_map
statement: theorem tendsto_ae_map {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) : Tendsto f (ae μ) (ae (μ.map f))
proof:
:=
  fun _ hs => preimage_null_of_map_null hf hs

name: mem_ae_map_iff
statement:
theorem mem_ae_map_iff {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    s ∈ ae (μ.map f) ↔ f ⁻¹' s ∈ ae μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_ae_iff, map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf hs.compl, preimage_compl]

name: mem_ae_of_mem_ae_map
statement:
theorem mem_ae_of_mem_ae_map {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) {s : Set β}
    (hs : s ∈ ae (μ.map f)) : f ⁻¹' s ∈ ae μ
proof:
:=
  (tendsto_ae_map hf).eventually hs

name: ae_map_iff
statement:
theorem ae_map_iff {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) {p : β → Prop}
    (hp : MeasurableSet { x | p x }) : (∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map f, p y) ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (f x)
proof:
:=
  mem_ae_map_iff hf hp

name: ae_of_ae_map
statement:
theorem ae_of_ae_map {f : α → β} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) {p : β → Prop} (h : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ.map f, p y) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (f x)
proof:
:=
  mem_ae_of_mem_ae_map hf h

name: ae_map_mem_range
statement:
theorem ae_map_mem_range {m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {f : α → β} (hf : MeasurableSet (range f))
    {μ : Measure α} (h : AEMeasurable f μ) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.map f, x ∈ range f
proof:
:= by
  change range f ∈ ae (μ.map f)
  rw [mem_ae_map_iff h hf]
  filter_upwards using mem_range_self

name: map_injective
statement: theorem map_injective (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) : Function.Injective (Measure.map f)
proof:
:= by
  intro μ ν h
  ext s hs
  rw [← Set.preimage_image_eq s hf.injective, ← hf.map_apply, ← hf.map_apply]
  congr

name: map_apply
statement: protected theorem map_apply (f : α ≃ᵐ β) (s : Set β) : μ.map f s = μ (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:=
  f.measurableEmbedding.map_apply _ _

name: map_symm_map
statement:
@[simp]

name: continuous_prod
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem continuous_prod [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [SecondCountableTopology α]
    [SecondCountableTopology β] [PseudoMetrizableSpace α] [PseudoMetrizableSpace β]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace α] [OpensMeasurableSpace β] :
    Continuous (fun (μ : ProbabilityMeasure α × ProbabilityMeasure β) ↦ μ.1.prod μ.2)
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 (fun μ ↦ ?_)
  /- It suffices to check the convergence along elements of a π-system containing arbitrarily
  small neighborhoods of any point, by `tendsto_probabilityMeasure_of_tendsto_of_mem`.
  We take as a π-system the sets of the form `a ×ˢ b` where `a` and `b` have null frontier. -/
  let S : Set (Set (α × β)) := {t | ∃ (a : Set α) (b : Set β),
    MeasurableSet a ∧ μ.1 (frontier a) = 0 ∧ MeasurableSet b ∧ μ.2 (frontier b) = 0
    ∧ t = a ×ˢ b}
  have : IsPiSystem S := by
    rintro - ⟨a, b, ameas, ha, bmeas, hb, rfl⟩ - ⟨a', b', a'meas, ha', b'meas, hb', rfl⟩ -
    refine ⟨a ∩ a', b ∩ b', ameas.inter a'meas, ?_, bmeas.inter b'meas, ?_, prod_inter_prod⟩
    · rw [null_iff_toMeasure_null] at ha ha' ⊢
      exact null_frontier_inter ha ha'
    · rw [null_iff_toMeasure_null] at hb hb' ⊢
      exact null_frontier_inter hb hb'
  apply this.tendsto_probabilityMeasure_of_tendsto_of_mem
  · rintro s ⟨a, b, ameas, -, bmeas, -, rfl⟩
    exact ameas.prod bmeas
  · let : PseudoMetricSpace α := TopologicalSpace.pseudoMetrizableSpacePseudoMetric α
    let : PseudoMetricSpace β := TopologicalSpace.pseudoMetrizableSpacePseudoMetric β
    intro u u_open x xu
    obtain ⟨ε, εpos, hε⟩ : ∃ ε > 0, ball x ε ⊆ u := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 u_open x xu
    rcases exists_null_frontier_thickening (μ.1 : Measure α) {x.1} εpos with ⟨r, hr, μr⟩
    rcases exists_null_frontier_thickening (μ.2 : Measure β) {x.2} εpos with ⟨r', hr', μr'⟩
    simp only [thickening_singleton] at μr μr'
    refine ⟨ball x.1 r ×ˢ ball x.2 r', ⟨ball x.1 r, ball x.2 r', measurableSet_ball,
      by simp [coeFn_def, μr], measurableSet_ball, by simp [coeFn_def, μr'], rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_ball).mem_nhds (by simp [hr.1, hr'.1])
    · calc ball x.1 r ×ˢ ball x.2 r'
      _ ⊆ ball x.1 ε ×ˢ ball x.2 ε := by gcongr; exacts [hr.2.le, hr'.2.le]
      _ ⊆ _ := by rwa [ball_prod_same]
  · rintro s ⟨a, b, ameas, ha, bmeas, hb, rfl⟩
    simp only [prod_prod]
    apply Filter.Tendsto.mul
    · exact tendsto_measure_of_null_frontier_of_tendsto tendsto_id.fst_nhds ha
    · exact tendsto_measure_of_null_frontier_of_tendsto tendsto_id.snd_nhds hb

name: restrict_mono'
statement:
theorem restrict_mono' {_m0 : MeasurableSpace α} ⦃s s' : Set α⦄ ⦃μ ν : Measure α⦄ (hs : s ≤ᵐ[μ] s')
    (hμν : μ ≤ ν) : μ.restrict s ≤ ν.restrict s'
proof:
:=
  Measure.le_iff.2 fun t ht => calc
    μ.restrict s t = μ (t ∩ s) := restrict_apply ht
    _ ≤ μ (t ∩ s') := (measure_mono_ae <| hs.mono fun _x hx ⟨hxt, hxs⟩ => ⟨hxt, hx hxs⟩)
    _ ≤ ν (t ∩ s') := le_iff'.1 hμν (t ∩ s')
    _ = ν.restrict s' t := (restrict_apply ht).symm

name: restrict_mono

  restrict_mono' (ae_of_all _ hs) hμν

    calc
      μ s ≤ μ (toMeasurable (μ.restrict t) s ∩ t) :=

      _ = μ.restrict t s := by
        rw [← restrict_apply (measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _), measure_toMeasurable]

statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_compl_add_restrict (hs : MeasurableSet s) : μ.restrict sᶜ + μ.restrict s = μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, restrict_add_restrict_compl hs]

name: restrict_union_le
statement: theorem restrict_union_le (s s' : Set α) : μ.restrict (s ∪ s') ≤ μ.restrict s + μ.restrict s'
proof:
:=
  le_iff.2 fun t ht ↦ by
    simpa [ht, inter_union_distrib_left] using measure_union_le (t ∩ s) (t ∩ s')

name: restrict_iUnion_apply_ae
statement:
theorem restrict_iUnion_apply_ae [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hd : Pairwise (AEDisjoint μ on s))
    (hm : ∀ i, NullMeasurableSet (s i) μ) {t : Set α} (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i) t = ∑' i, μ.restrict (s i) t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrict_apply, ht, inter_iUnion]
  exact
    measure_iUnion₀ (hd.mono fun i j h => h.mono inter_subset_right inter_subset_right)
      fun i => ht.nullMeasurableSet.inter (hm i)

name: restrict_iUnion_apply
statement:
theorem restrict_iUnion_apply [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on s))
    (hm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (s i)) {t : Set α} (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i) t = ∑' i, μ.restrict (s i) t
proof:
:=
  restrict_iUnion_apply_ae hd.aedisjoint (fun i => (hm i).nullMeasurableSet) ht

name: restrict_iUnion_apply_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem restrict_iUnion_apply_eq_iSup [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hd : Directed (· ⊆ ·) s)
    {t : Set α} (ht : MeasurableSet t) : μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i) t = ⨆ i, μ.restrict (s i) t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrict_apply ht, inter_iUnion]
  rw [Directed.measure_iUnion]
  exacts [hd.mono_comp _ fun s₁ s₂ => inter_subset_inter_right _]

name: restrict_map
statement:
theorem restrict_map {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (μ.map f).restrict s = (μ.restrict <| f ⁻¹' s).map f
proof:
:=
  ext fun t ht => by simp [*, hf ht]

name: restrict_inter_toMeasurable
statement:
theorem restrict_inter_toMeasurable (h : μ s ≠ ∞) (ht : MeasurableSet t) (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    μ.restrict (t ∩ toMeasurable μ s) = μ.restrict s
proof:
:= by
  ext u hu
  rw [restrict_apply hu, restrict_apply hu, inter_comm t, inter_comm, inter_assoc,
    measure_toMeasurable_inter (ht.inter hu) h]
  congr 1
  grind

name: restrict_toMeasurable
statement: theorem restrict_toMeasurable (h : μ s ≠ ∞) : μ.restrict (toMeasurable μ s) = μ.restrict s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using restrict_inter_toMeasurable h MeasurableSet.univ (subset_univ _)

name: restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem
statement:
theorem restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem {_m0 : MeasurableSpace α} ⦃s : Set α⦄ ⦃μ : Measure α⦄
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s) : μ.restrict s = μ
proof:
:=
  calc
    μ.restrict s = μ.restrict univ := restrict_congr_set (eventuallyEqSet_univ.mpr hs)
    _ = μ := restrict_univ

name: restrict_congr_meas
statement:
theorem restrict_congr_meas (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    μ.restrict s = ν.restrict s ↔ ∀ t ⊆ s, MeasurableSet t → μ t = ν t
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H t hts ht => by
    rw [← inter_eq_self_of_subset_left hts, ← restrict_apply ht, H, restrict_apply ht], fun H =>
    ext fun t ht => by
      rw [restrict_apply ht, restrict_apply ht, H _ inter_subset_right (ht.inter hs)]⟩

name: restrict_congr_mono
statement:
theorem restrict_congr_mono (hs : s ⊆ t) (h : μ.restrict t = ν.restrict t) :
    μ.restrict s = ν.restrict s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrict_restrict_of_subset hs, h, restrict_restrict_of_subset hs]

name: restrict_union_congr
statement:
theorem restrict_union_congr :
    μ.restrict (s ∪ t) = ν.restrict (s ∪ t) ↔
      μ.restrict s = ν.restrict s ∧ μ.restrict t = ν.restrict t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨restrict_congr_mono subset_union_left h,
    restrict_congr_mono subset_union_right h⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨hs, ht⟩
  ext1 u hu
  simp only [restrict_apply hu, inter_union_distrib_left]
  rcases exists_measurable_superset₂ μ ν (u ∩ s) with ⟨US, hsub, hm, hμ, hν⟩
  calc
    μ (u ∩ s ∪ u ∩ t) = μ (US ∪ u ∩ t) :=
      measure_union_congr_of_subset hsub hμ.le Subset.rfl le_rfl
    _ = μ US + μ ((u ∩ t) \ US) := (measure_add_sdiff hm.nullMeasurableSet _).symm
    _ = restrict μ s u + restrict μ t (u \ US) := by
      simp only [restrict_apply, hu, hu.diff hm, hμ, ← inter_comm t, inter_sdiff_assoc]
    _ = restrict ν s u + restrict ν t (u \ US) := by rw [hs, ht]
    _ = ν US + ν ((u ∩ t) \ US) := by
      simp only [restrict_apply, hu, hu.diff hm, hν, ← inter_comm t, inter_sdiff_assoc]
    _ = ν (US ∪ u ∩ t) := measure_add_sdiff hm.nullMeasurableSet _
    _ = ν (u ∩ s ∪ u ∩ t) := .symm <| measure_union_congr_of_subset hsub hν.le Subset.rfl le_rfl

name: restrict_biUnion_finset_congr
statement:
theorem restrict_biUnion_finset_congr {s : Finset ι} {t : ι → Set α} :
    μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ s, t i) = ν.restrict (⋃ i ∈ s, t i) ↔
      ∀ i ∈ s, μ.restrict (t i) = ν.restrict (t i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s _ hs =>
    simp only [forall_eq_or_imp, iUnion_iUnion_eq_or_left, Finset.mem_insert]
    rw [restrict_union_congr, ← hs]

name: restrict_iUnion_congr
statement:
theorem restrict_iUnion_congr [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} :
    μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i) = ν.restrict (⋃ i, s i) ↔ ∀ i, μ.restrict (s i) = ν.restrict (s i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h i => restrict_congr_mono (subset_iUnion _ _) h, fun h => ?_⟩
  ext1 t ht
  have D : Directed (· ⊆ ·) fun t : Finset ι => ⋃ i ∈ t, s i :=
    Monotone.directed_le fun t₁ t₂ ht => biUnion_subset_biUnion_left ht
  rw [iUnion_eq_iUnion_finset]
  simp only [restrict_iUnion_apply_eq_iSup D ht, restrict_biUnion_finset_congr.2 fun i _ => h i]

name: restrict_biUnion_congr
statement:
theorem restrict_biUnion_congr {s : Set ι} {t : ι → Set α} (hc : s.Countable) :
    μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ s, t i) = ν.restrict (⋃ i ∈ s, t i) ↔
      ∀ i ∈ s, μ.restrict (t i) = ν.restrict (t i)
proof:
:= by
  have := hc.toEncodable
  simp only [biUnion_eq_iUnion, SetCoe.forall', restrict_iUnion_congr]

name: restrict_sUnion_congr
statement:
theorem restrict_sUnion_congr {S : Set (Set α)} (hc : S.Countable) :
    μ.restrict (⋃₀ S) = ν.restrict (⋃₀ S) ↔ ∀ s ∈ S, μ.restrict s = ν.restrict s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sUnion_eq_biUnion, restrict_biUnion_congr hc]

name: restrict_sInf_eq_sInf_restrict
proof:
:= by
  ext1 s hs
  simp_rw [sInf_apply hs, restrict_apply hs, sInf_apply (MeasurableSet.inter hs ht),
    Set.image_image, restrict_toOuterMeasure_eq_toOuterMeasure_restrict ht, ←
    Set.image_image _ toOuterMeasure, ← OuterMeasure.restrict_sInf_eq_sInf_restrict _ (hm.image _),
    OuterMeasure.restrict_apply]

name: exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae
statement:
theorem exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae (hs : μ s ≠ 0) {p : α → Prop}
    (hp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x) : ∃ x, x ∈ s ∧ p x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← μ.restrict_apply_self, ← frequently_ae_mem_iff] at hs
  exact (hs.and_eventually hp).exists

name: QuasiMeasurePreserving.restrict
statement:
theorem QuasiMeasurePreserving.restrict {ν : Measure β} {f : α → β}
    (hf : QuasiMeasurePreserving f μ ν) {t : Set β} (hmaps : MapsTo f s t) :
    QuasiMeasurePreserving f (μ.restrict s) (ν.restrict t) where
  measurable
proof:
:= hf.measurable
  absolutelyContinuous := by
    refine AbsolutelyContinuous.mk fun u hum ↦ ?_
    suffices ν (u ∩ t) = 0 → μ (f ⁻¹' u ∩ s) = 0 by simpa [hum, hf.measurable, hf.measurable hum]
    refine fun hu ↦ measure_mono_null ?_ (hf.preimage_null hu)
    rw [preimage_inter]
    gcongr
    assumption

name: ext_iff_of_iUnion_eq_univ
statement:
theorem ext_iff_of_iUnion_eq_univ [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hs : ⋃ i, s i = univ) :
    μ = ν ↔ ∀ i, μ.restrict (s i) = ν.restrict (s i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrict_iUnion_congr, hs, restrict_univ, restrict_univ]

name: ext_iff_of_biUnion_eq_univ
statement:
theorem ext_iff_of_biUnion_eq_univ {S : Set ι} {s : ι → Set α} (hc : S.Countable)
    (hs : ⋃ i ∈ S, s i = univ) : μ = ν ↔ ∀ i ∈ S, μ.restrict (s i) = ν.restrict (s i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrict_biUnion_congr hc, hs, restrict_univ, restrict_univ]

name: ext_iff_of_sUnion_eq_univ
statement:
theorem ext_iff_of_sUnion_eq_univ {S : Set (Set α)} (hc : S.Countable) (hs : ⋃₀ S = univ) :
    μ = ν ↔ ∀ s ∈ S, μ.restrict s = ν.restrict s
proof:
:=
  ext_iff_of_biUnion_eq_univ hc <| by rwa [← sUnion_eq_biUnion]

name: ext_of_generateFrom_of_cover
statement:
theorem ext_of_generateFrom_of_cover {S T : Set (Set α)} (h_gen : ‹_› = generateFrom S)
    (hc : T.Countable) (h_inter : IsPiSystem S) (hU : ⋃₀ T = univ) (htop : ∀ t ∈ T, μ t ≠ ∞)
    (ST_eq : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ s ∈ S, μ (s ∩ t) = ν (s ∩ t)) (T_eq : ∀ t ∈ T, μ t = ν t) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of_sUnion_eq_univ hc hU fun t ht => ?_
  ext1 u hu
  simp only [restrict_apply hu]
  induction u, hu using induction_on_inter h_gen h_inter with
  | empty => simp only [Set.empty_inter, measure_empty]
  | basic u hu => exact ST_eq _ ht _ hu
  | compl u hu ihu =>
    have := T_eq t ht
    rw [Set.inter_comm] at ihu ⊢
    rwa [← measure_inter_add_sdiff t hu, ← measure_inter_add_sdiff t hu, ← ihu,
      ENNReal.add_right_inj] at this
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (htop t ht) (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left)
  | iUnion f hfd hfm ihf =>
    simp only [← restrict_apply (hfm _), ← restrict_apply (MeasurableSet.iUnion hfm)] at ihf ⊢
    simp only [measure_iUnion hfd hfm, ihf]

name: ext_of_generateFrom_of_cover_subset
statement:
theorem ext_of_generateFrom_of_cover_subset {S T : Set (Set α)} (h_gen : ‹_› = generateFrom S)
    (h_inter : IsPiSystem S) (h_sub : T ⊆ S) (hc : T.Countable) (hU : ⋃₀ T = univ)
    (htop : ∀ s ∈ T, μ s ≠ ∞) (h_eq : ∀ s ∈ S, μ s = ν s) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of_generateFrom_of_cover h_gen hc h_inter hU htop ?_ fun t ht => h_eq t (h_sub ht)
  intro t ht s hs; rcases (s ∩ t).eq_empty_or_nonempty with H | H
  · simp only [H, measure_empty]
  · exact h_eq _ (h_inter _ hs _ (h_sub ht) H)

name: ext_of_generateFrom_of_iUnion
statement:
theorem ext_of_generateFrom_of_iUnion (C : Set (Set α)) (B : ℕ → Set α) (hA : ‹_› = generateFrom C)
    (hC : IsPiSystem C) (h1B : ⋃ i, B i = univ) (h2B : ∀ i, B i ∈ C) (hμB : ∀ i, μ (B i) ≠ ∞)
    (h_eq : ∀ s ∈ C, μ s = ν s) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of_generateFrom_of_cover_subset hA hC ?_ (countable_range B) h1B ?_ h_eq
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply h2B
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply hμB

name: restrict_sum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_sum (μ : ι → Measure α) {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (sum μ).restrict s = sum fun i => (μ i).restrict s
proof:
:=
  ext fun t ht => by simp only [sum_apply, restrict_apply, ht, ht.inter hs]

name: restrict_sum_of_countable
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_sum_of_countable [Countable ι] (μ : ι → Measure α) (s : Set α) :
    (sum μ).restrict s = sum fun i => (μ i).restrict s
proof:
:= by
  ext t ht
  simp_rw [sum_apply _ ht, restrict_apply ht, sum_apply_of_countable]

name: AbsolutelyContinuous.restrict
statement: lemma AbsolutelyContinuous.restrict (h : μ ≪ ν) (s : Set α) : μ.restrict s ≪ ν.restrict s
proof:
:= by
  refine Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk (fun t ht htν ↦ ?_)
  rw [restrict_apply ht] at htν ⊢
  exact h htν

name: restrict_iUnion_ae
statement:
theorem restrict_iUnion_ae [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hd : Pairwise (AEDisjoint μ on s))
    (hm : ∀ i, NullMeasurableSet (s i) μ) : μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i) = sum fun i => μ.restrict (s i)
proof:
:=
  ext fun t ht => by simp only [sum_apply _ ht, restrict_iUnion_apply_ae hd hm ht]

name: restrict_iUnion
statement:
theorem restrict_iUnion [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on s))
    (hm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (s i)) : μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i) = sum fun i => μ.restrict (s i)
proof:
:=
  restrict_iUnion_ae hd.aedisjoint fun i => (hm i).nullMeasurableSet

name: restrict_biUnion
statement:
theorem restrict_biUnion {s : ι → Set α} {T : Set ι} (hT : Countable T)
    (hd : T.Pairwise (Disjoint on s)) (hm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (s i)) :
    μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ T, s i) = sum fun (i : T) => μ.restrict (s i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.biUnion_eq_iUnion]
  exact restrict_iUnion (fun i j hij ↦ hd i.coe_prop j.coe_prop (Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hij)) (hm ·)

name: restrict_biUnion_finset
proof:
:=
  restrict_biUnion (T := (T : Set ι)) Finite.to_countable hd hm

name: restrict_iUnion_le
statement:
theorem restrict_iUnion_le [Countable ι] {s : ι → Set α} :
    μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i) ≤ sum fun i => μ.restrict (s i)
proof:
:=
  le_iff.2 fun t ht ↦ by simpa [ht, inter_iUnion] using measure_iUnion_le (t ∩ s ·)

name: restrict_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem restrict_biUnion_le {s : ι → Set α} {T : Set ι} (hT : Countable T) :
    μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ T, s i) ≤ sum fun (i : T) => μ.restrict (s i)
proof:
:=
  le_iff.2 fun t ht ↦ by simpa [ht, inter_iUnion] using measure_biUnion_le μ hT (t ∩ s ·)

name: ae_restrict_iUnion_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ae_restrict_iUnion_eq [Countable ι] (s : ι → Set α) :
    ae (μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i)) = ⨆ i, ae (μ.restrict (s i))
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((ae_sum_eq fun i => μ.restrict (s i)) ▸ ae_mono restrict_iUnion_le) <|
    iSup_le fun i => ae_mono <| restrict_mono (subset_iUnion s i) le_rfl

name: ae_restrict_union_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ae_restrict_union_eq (s t : Set α) :
    ae (μ.restrict (s ∪ t)) = ae (μ.restrict s) ⊔ ae (μ.restrict t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [union_eq_iUnion, iSup_bool_eq]

name: ae_restrict_biUnion_eq
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_biUnion_eq (s : ι → Set α) {t : Set ι} (ht : t.Countable) :
    ae (μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ t, s i)) = ⨆ i ∈ t, ae (μ.restrict (s i))
proof:
:= by
  have := ht.to_subtype
  rw [biUnion_eq_iUnion, ae_restrict_iUnion_eq, ← iSup_subtype'']

name: ae_restrict_biUnion_finset_eq
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_biUnion_finset_eq (s : ι → Set α) (t : Finset ι) :
    ae (μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ t, s i)) = ⨆ i ∈ t, ae (μ.restrict (s i))
proof:
:=
  ae_restrict_biUnion_eq s t.countable_toSet

name: ae_restrict_iUnion_iff
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_iUnion_iff [Countable ι] (s : ι → Set α) (p : α → Prop) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i), p x) ↔ ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (s i), p x
proof: := by simp

name: ae_restrict_union_iff
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_union_iff (s t : Set α) (p : α → Prop) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (s ∪ t), p x) ↔ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict t, p x
proof: := by simp

name: ae_restrict_biUnion_iff
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_biUnion_iff (s : ι → Set α) {t : Set ι} (ht : t.Countable) (p : α → Prop) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ t, s i), p x) ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (s i), p x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Filter.Eventually, ae_restrict_biUnion_eq s ht, mem_iSup]

name: ae_restrict_biUnion_finset_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ae_restrict_biUnion_finset_iff (s : ι → Set α) (t : Finset ι) (p : α → Prop) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ t, s i), p x) ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (s i), p x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Filter.Eventually, ae_restrict_biUnion_finset_eq s, mem_iSup]

name: ae_eq_restrict_iUnion_iff
statement:
theorem ae_eq_restrict_iUnion_iff [Countable ι] (s : ι → Set α) (f g : α → δ) :
    f =ᵐ[μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i)] g ↔ ∀ i, f =ᵐ[μ.restrict (s i)] g
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iUnion_eq, eventually_iSup]

name: ae_eq_restrict_biUnion_iff
statement:
theorem ae_eq_restrict_biUnion_iff (s : ι → Set α) {t : Set ι} (ht : t.Countable) (f g : α → δ) :
    f =ᵐ[μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ t, s i)] g ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, f =ᵐ[μ.restrict (s i)] g
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ae_restrict_biUnion_eq s ht, EventuallyEq, eventually_iSup]

name: ae_eq_restrict_biUnion_finset_iff
statement:
theorem ae_eq_restrict_biUnion_finset_iff (s : ι → Set α) (t : Finset ι) (f g : α → δ) :
    f =ᵐ[μ.restrict (⋃ i ∈ t, s i)] g ↔ ∀ i ∈ t, f =ᵐ[μ.restrict (s i)] g
proof:
:=
  ae_eq_restrict_biUnion_iff s t.countable_toSet f g

name: ae_restrict_uIoc_eq
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_uIoc_eq [LinearOrder α] (a b : α) :
    ae (μ.restrict (Ι a b)) = ae (μ.restrict (Ioc a b)) ⊔ ae (μ.restrict (Ioc b a))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uIoc_eq_union, ae_restrict_union_eq]

name: ae_uIoc_iff
statement:
theorem ae_uIoc_iff [LinearOrder α] {a b : α} {P : α → Prop} :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Ι a b → P x) ↔ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Ioc a b → P x) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Ioc b a → P x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uIoc_eq_union, mem_union, or_imp, eventually_and]

name: ae_restrict_uIoc_iff
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_uIoc_iff [LinearOrder α] {a b : α} {P : α → Prop} :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (Ι a b), P x) ↔
      (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (Ioc a b), P x) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict (Ioc b a), P x
proof:
:= by
  rw [ae_restrict_uIoc_eq, eventually_sup]

name: ae_restrict_iff
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_iff₀ {p : α → Prop} (hp : NullMeasurableSet { x | p x } (μ.restrict s)) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x) ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → p x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ae_iff, ← compl_ofPred, Measure.restrict_apply₀ hp.compl]
  rw [iff_iff_eq]; congr with x; simp [and_comm]

name: ae_restrict_iff
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_iff {p : α → Prop} (hp : MeasurableSet { x | p x }) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x) ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → p x
proof:
:=
  ae_restrict_iff₀ hp.nullMeasurableSet

name: ae_imp_of_ae_restrict
statement:
theorem ae_imp_of_ae_restrict {s : Set α} {p : α → Prop} (h : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → p x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ae_iff] at h ⊢
  simpa [ofPred_and, inter_comm] using measure_inter_eq_zero_of_restrict h

name: ae_restrict_iff'
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_iff'₀ {p : α → Prop} (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x) ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → p x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ae_iff, ← compl_ofPred, restrict_apply₀' hs]
  rw [iff_iff_eq]; congr with x; simp [and_comm]

name: ae_restrict_iff'
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_iff' {p : α → Prop} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x) ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → p x
proof:
:=
  ae_restrict_iff'₀ hs.nullMeasurableSet

name: _root_.Filter.EventuallyEq.restrict
statement:
theorem _root_.Filter.EventuallyEq.restrict {f g : α → δ} {s : Set α} (hfg : f =ᵐ[μ] g) :
    f =ᵐ[μ.restrict s] g
proof:
:=
  hfg.filter_mono ae_restrict_le

name: ae_restrict_mem
statement: theorem ae_restrict_mem₀ (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, x ∈ s
proof:
:=
  (ae_restrict_iff'₀ hs).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => id)

name: ae_restrict_mem
statement: theorem ae_restrict_mem (hs : MeasurableSet s) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, x ∈ s
proof:
:=
  ae_restrict_mem₀ hs.nullMeasurableSet

name: ae_restrict_of_forall_mem
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_of_forall_mem {μ : Measure α} {s : Set α}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) {p : α → Prop} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, p x) : ∀ᵐ (x : α) ∂μ.restrict s, p x
proof:
:=
  (ae_restrict_mem hs).mono h

name: _root_.Set.EqOn.aeEq_restrict
statement:
lemma _root_.Set.EqOn.aeEq_restrict {α β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} {s : Set α}
    {f g : α → β} (h : s.EqOn f g) (hs : MeasurableSet s) : f =ᵐ[μ.restrict s] g
proof:
:=
  ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hs h

name: ae_restrict_of_ae
statement: theorem ae_restrict_of_ae {s : Set α} {p : α → Prop} (h : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x
proof:
:=
  h.filter_mono (ae_mono Measure.restrict_le_self)

name: ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset {s t : Set α} {p : α → Prop} (hst : s ⊆ t)
    (h : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict t, p x) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x
proof:
:=
  h.filter_mono (ae_mono <| Measure.restrict_mono hst (le_refl μ))

name: ae_of_ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_compl
statement:
theorem ae_of_ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_compl (t : Set α) {p : α → Prop}
    (ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict t, p x) (htc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict tᶜ, p x) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x
proof:
:=
  nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 <|
    calc
      μ { x | ¬p x } ≤ μ ({ x | ¬p x } ∩ t) + μ ({ x | ¬p x } ∩ tᶜ) :=
        measure_le_inter_add_sdiff _ _ _
      _ ≤ μ.restrict t { x | ¬p x } + μ.restrict tᶜ { x | ¬p x } :=
        add_le_add (le_restrict_apply _ _) (le_restrict_apply _ _)
      _ = 0 := by rw [ae_iff.1 ht, ae_iff.1 htc, zero_add]

name: mem_map_restrict_ae_iff
statement:
theorem mem_map_restrict_ae_iff {β} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {f : α → β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    t ∈ Filter.map f (ae (μ.restrict s)) ↔ μ ((f ⁻¹' t)ᶜ ∩ s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_map, mem_ae_iff, Measure.restrict_apply' hs]

name: ae_add_measure_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem ae_add_measure_iff {p : α → Prop} {ν} :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ + ν, p x) ↔ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, p x
proof:
:=
  add_eq_zero

name: ae_finsetSum_measure_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma ae_finsetSum_measure_iff {p : α → Prop} {s : Finset ι} {μ : ι → Measure α} :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂∑ i ∈ s, μ i, p x) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ i, p x
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction <;> simp [*]

name: div_ae_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem div_ae_eq_one {β} [Group β] (f g : α → β) : f / g =ᵐ[μ] 1 ↔ f =ᵐ[μ] g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.mono fun x hx ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.mono fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  · rwa [Pi.div_apply, Pi.one_apply, div_eq_one] at hx
  · rwa [Pi.div_apply, Pi.one_apply, div_eq_one]

name: one_le_div_ae
statement:
@[to_additive sub_nonneg_ae]
lemma one_le_div_ae {β : Type*} [Group β] [LE β] [MulRightMono β] (f g : α → β) :
    1 ≤ᵐ[μ] g / f ↔ f ≤ᵐ[μ] g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.mono fun a ha ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.mono fun a ha ↦ ?_⟩
  · rwa [Pi.one_apply, Pi.div_apply, one_le_div'] at ha
  · rwa [Pi.one_apply, Pi.div_apply, one_le_div']

name: le_ae_restrict
statement: theorem le_ae_restrict : ae μ ⊓ 𝓟 s ≤ ae (μ.restrict s)
proof:
:= fun _s hs =>
  eventually_inf_principal.2 (ae_imp_of_ae_restrict hs)

name: ae_restrict_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ae_restrict_eq (hs : MeasurableSet s) : ae (μ.restrict s) = ae μ ⊓ 𝓟 s
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  simp only [mem_inf_principal, mem_ae_iff, restrict_apply_eq_zero' hs, compl_ofPred,
    Classical.not_imp, fun a => and_comm (a := a ∈ s) (b := a ∉ t)]
  rfl

name: ae_restrict_eq_bot
statement: theorem ae_restrict_eq_bot {s} : ae (μ.restrict s) = ⊥ ↔ μ s = 0
proof:
:=
  ae_eq_bot.trans restrict_eq_zero

name: ae_restrict_neBot
statement: theorem ae_restrict_neBot {s} : (ae <| μ.restrict s).NeBot ↔ μ s ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  neBot_iff.trans ae_restrict_eq_bot.not

name: self_mem_ae_restrict
statement: theorem self_mem_ae_restrict {s} (hs : MeasurableSet s) : s ∈ ae (μ.restrict s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ae_restrict_eq hs, mem_principal, mem_inf_iff]
  exact ⟨_, univ_mem, s, Subset.rfl, (univ_inter s).symm⟩

name: ae_restrict_of_ae_eq_of_ae_restrict
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_of_ae_eq_of_ae_restrict {s t : Set α} (hst : s =ᵐ[μ] t) {p : α → Prop} :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict t, p x
proof: := by simp [Measure.restrict_congr_set hst]

name: ae_restrict_congr_set
statement:
theorem ae_restrict_congr_set {s t} (hst : s =ᵐ[μ] t) {p : α → Prop} :
    (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, p x) ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict t, p x
proof:
:=
  ⟨ae_restrict_of_ae_eq_of_ae_restrict hst, ae_restrict_of_ae_eq_of_ae_restrict hst.symm⟩

name: NullMeasurable.measure_preimage_eq_measure_restrict_preimage_of_ae_compl_eq_const
statement:
lemma NullMeasurable.measure_preimage_eq_measure_restrict_preimage_of_ae_compl_eq_const
    {β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace β] {b : β} {f : α → β} {s : Set α}
    (f_mble : NullMeasurable f (μ.restrict s)) (hs : f =ᵐ[Measure.restrict μ sᶜ] (fun _ ↦ b))
    {t : Set β} (t_mble : MeasurableSet t) (ht : b ∉ t) :
    μ (f ⁻¹' t) = μ.restrict s (f ⁻¹' t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.restrict_apply₀ (f_mble t_mble)]
  rw [EventuallyEq, ae_iff, Measure.restrict_apply₀] at hs
  · apply le_antisymm _ (measure_mono inter_subset_left)
    apply (measure_mono (Eq.symm (inter_union_compl (f ⁻¹' t) s)).le).trans
    apply (measure_union_le _ _).trans
    suffices μ ((f ⁻¹' t) ∩ sᶜ) = 0 by simp [this]
    rw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero, ← hs]
    gcongr
    exact fun x hx hfx ↦ ht (hfx ▸ hx)
  · exact NullMeasurableSet.of_null hs

name: nullMeasurableSet_restrict
statement:
lemma nullMeasurableSet_restrict (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) {t : Set α} :
    NullMeasurableSet t (μ.restrict s) ↔ NullMeasurableSet (t ∩ s) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨t', -, ht', t't⟩ : ∃ t' ⊇ t, MeasurableSet t' ∧ t' =ᵐ[μ.restrict s] t :=
      h.exists_measurable_superset_ae_eq
    have A : t' ∩ s =ᵐ[μ] t ∩ s := by
      have : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → (x ∈ t') = (x ∈ t) :=
        (ae_restrict_iff'₀ hs).1 t't
      filter_upwards [this] with y hy
      simpa only [eq_iff_iff, mem_inter_iff, and_congr_left_iff] using hy
    obtain ⟨s', -, hs', s's⟩ : ∃ s' ⊇ s, MeasurableSet s' ∧ s' =ᵐ[μ] s :=
      hs.exists_measurable_superset_ae_eq
    have B : t' ∩ s' =ᵐ[μ] t' ∩ s :=
      ae_eq_set_inter (EventuallyEq.refl _ _) s's
    exact (ht'.inter hs').nullMeasurableSet.congr (B.trans A)
  · have A : NullMeasurableSet (t \ s) (μ.restrict s) := by
      apply NullMeasurableSet.of_null
      rw [Measure.restrict_apply₀' hs]
      simp
    have B : NullMeasurableSet (t ∩ s) (μ.restrict s) :=
      h.mono restrict_le_self
    simpa using A.union B

name: nullMeasurableSet_restrict_of_subset
statement:
lemma nullMeasurableSet_restrict_of_subset {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ s) :
    NullMeasurableSet t (μ.restrict s) ↔ NullMeasurableSet t μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.mono restrict_le_self⟩
  obtain ⟨t', t'_subs, ht', t't⟩ : ∃ t' ⊆ t, MeasurableSet t' ∧ t' =ᵐ[μ.restrict s] t :=
    h.exists_measurable_subset_ae_eq
  have : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → (x ∈ t' ↔ x ∈ t) := by
    apply ae_imp_of_ae_restrict
    filter_upwards [t't] with x hx using by simpa using! hx
  have : t' =ᵐ[μ] t := by
    filter_upwards [this] with x hx
    simp only [eq_iff_iff]
    tauto
  exact ht'.nullMeasurableSet.congr this

name: MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet_subtype_coe
statement:
theorem MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet_subtype_coe {t : Set s} (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (ht : MeasurableSet t) : NullMeasurableSet ((↑) '' t) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.instMeasurableSpace, comap_eq_generateFrom] at ht
  induction t, ht using generateFrom_induction with
  | hC t' ht' =>
    obtain ⟨s', hs', rfl⟩ := ht'
    rw [Subtype.image_preimage_coe]
    exact hs.inter (hs'.nullMeasurableSet)
  | empty => simp only [image_empty, nullMeasurableSet_empty]
  | compl t' _ ht' =>
    simp only [← range_sdiff_image Subtype.coe_injective, Subtype.range_coe_subtype, ofPred_mem_eq]
    exact hs.diff ht'
  | iUnion f _ hf =>
    rw [image_iUnion]
    exact .iUnion hf

name: NullMeasurableSet.subtype_coe
statement:
theorem NullMeasurableSet.subtype_coe {t : Set s} (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (ht : NullMeasurableSet t (μ.comap Subtype.val)) : NullMeasurableSet (((↑) : s → α) '' t) μ
proof:
:=
  NullMeasurableSet.image _ μ Subtype.coe_injective
    (fun _ => MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet_subtype_coe hs) ht

name: measure_subtype_coe_le_comap
statement:
theorem measure_subtype_coe_le_comap (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (t : Set s) :
    μ (((↑) : s → α) '' t) ≤ μ.comap Subtype.val t
proof:
:=
  le_comap_apply _ _ Subtype.coe_injective (fun _ =>
    MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet_subtype_coe hs) _

name: measure_subtype_coe_eq_zero_of_comap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem measure_subtype_coe_eq_zero_of_comap_eq_zero (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) {t : Set s}
    (ht : μ.comap Subtype.val t = 0) : μ (((↑) : s → α) '' t) = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_iff.mpr <| (measure_subtype_coe_le_comap hs t).trans ht.le

name: Subtype.volume_def
statement: theorem Subtype.volume_def : (volume : Measure u) = volume.comap Subtype.val
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Subtype.volume_univ
statement: theorem Subtype.volume_univ (hu : NullMeasurableSet u) : volume (univ : Set u) = volume u
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.volume_def, comap_apply₀ _ _ _ _ MeasurableSet.univ.nullMeasurableSet]
  · simp only [image_univ, Subtype.range_coe_subtype, ofPred_mem_eq]
  · exact Subtype.coe_injective
  · exact fun t => MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet_subtype_coe hu

name: volume_subtype_coe_le_volume
statement:
theorem volume_subtype_coe_le_volume (hu : NullMeasurableSet u) (t : Set u) :
    volume (((↑) : u → δ) '' t) ≤ volume t
proof:
:=
  measure_subtype_coe_le_comap hu t

name: volume_subtype_coe_eq_zero_of_volume_eq_zero
statement:
theorem volume_subtype_coe_eq_zero_of_volume_eq_zero (hu : NullMeasurableSet u) {t : Set u}
    (ht : volume t = 0) : volume (((↑) : u → δ) '' t) = 0
proof:
:=
  measure_subtype_coe_eq_zero_of_comap_eq_zero hu ht

name: map_comap
statement: theorem map_comap (μ : Measure β) : (comap f μ).map f = μ.restrict (range f)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 t ht
  rw [hf.map_apply, comap_apply f hf.injective hf.measurableSet_image' _ (hf.measurable ht),
    image_preimage_eq_inter_range, Measure.restrict_apply ht]

name: comap_apply
statement: theorem comap_apply (μ : Measure β) (s : Set α) : comap f μ s = μ (f '' s)
proof:
:=
  calc
    comap f μ s = comap f μ (f ⁻¹' f '' s) := by rw [hf.injective.preimage_image]
    _ = (comap f μ).map f (f '' s) := (hf.map_apply _ _).symm
    _ = μ (f '' s) := by
      rw [hf.map_comap, restrict_apply' hf.measurableSet_range,
        inter_eq_self_of_subset_left (image_subset_range _ _)]

name: comap_map
statement: theorem comap_map (μ : Measure α) : (map f μ).comap f = μ
proof:
:= by
  ext t _
  rw [hf.comap_apply, hf.map_apply, preimage_image_eq _ hf.injective]

name: ae_map_iff
statement: theorem ae_map_iff {p : β → Prop} {μ : Measure α} : (∀ᵐ x ∂μ.map f, p x) ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ae_iff, hf.map_apply, preimage_ofPred_eq]

name: restrict_map
statement:
theorem restrict_map (μ : Measure α) (s : Set β) :
    (μ.map f).restrict s = (μ.restrict <| f ⁻¹' s).map f
proof:
:=
  Measure.ext fun t ht => by simp [hf.map_apply, ht, hf.measurable ht]

name: comap_preimage
statement:
protected theorem comap_preimage (μ : Measure β) (s : Set β) :
    μ.comap f (f ⁻¹' s) = μ (s ∩ range f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.map_apply, hf.map_comap, restrict_apply' hf.measurableSet_range]

name: comap_restrict
statement:
lemma comap_restrict (μ : Measure β) (s : Set β) :
    (μ.restrict s).comap f = (μ.comap f).restrict (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  ext t ht
  rw [Measure.restrict_apply ht, comap_apply hf, comap_apply hf,
    Measure.restrict_apply (hf.measurableSet_image.2 ht), image_inter_preimage]

name: restrict_comap
statement:
lemma restrict_comap (μ : Measure β) (s : Set α) :
    (μ.comap f).restrict s = (μ.restrict (f '' s)).comap f
proof:
:= by
  rw [comap_restrict hf, preimage_image_eq _ hf.injective]

name: _root_.MeasurableEquiv.restrict_map
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasurableEquiv.restrict_map (e : α ≃ᵐ β) (μ : Measure α) (s : Set β) :
    (μ.map e).restrict s = (μ.restrict <| e ⁻¹' s).map e
proof:
:=
  e.measurableEmbedding.restrict_map _ _

name: _root_.MeasurableEquiv.comap_apply
statement:
lemma _root_.MeasurableEquiv.comap_apply (e : α ≃ᵐ β) (μ : Measure β) (s : Set α) :
    comap e μ s = μ (e.symm ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [e.measurableEmbedding.comap_apply, e.image_eq_preimage_symm]

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.map_eq_comap
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [map_apply hf hs, hg.comap_apply, ← measure_sdiff_null hμg]
  congr
  simp
  grind

name: comap_subtype_coe_apply
statement:
theorem comap_subtype_coe_apply {_m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (μ : Measure α) (t : Set s) : comap (↑) μ t = μ ((↑) '' t)
proof:
:=
  (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hs).comap_apply _ _

name: map_comap_subtype_coe
statement:
theorem map_comap_subtype_coe {m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (μ : Measure α) : (comap (↑) μ).map ((↑) : s → α) = μ.restrict s
proof:
:= by
  rw [(MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hs).map_comap, Subtype.range_coe]

name: ae_restrict_iff_subtype
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_comap_subtype_coe hs, (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hs).ae_map_iff]

name: volume_set_coe_def
statement: theorem volume_set_coe_def (s : Set α) : (volume : Measure s) = comap ((↑) : s → α) volume
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MeasurableSet.map_coe_volume
statement:
theorem MeasurableSet.map_coe_volume {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    volume.map ((↑) : s → α) = restrict volume s
proof:
:= by
  rw [volume_set_coe_def, (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hs).map_comap volume, Subtype.range_coe]

name: volume_image_subtype_coe
statement:
theorem volume_image_subtype_coe {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (t : Set s) :
    volume ((↑) '' t : Set α) = volume t
proof:
:=
  (comap_subtype_coe_apply hs volume t).symm

name: volume_preimage_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem volume_preimage_coe (hs : NullMeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    volume (((↑) : s → α) ⁻¹' t) = volume (t ∩ s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [volume_set_coe_def,
    comap_apply₀ _ _ Subtype.coe_injective
      (fun h => MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet_subtype_coe hs)
      (measurable_subtype_coe ht).nullMeasurableSet,
    image_preimage_eq_inter_range, Subtype.range_coe]

name: piecewise_ae_eq_restrict
statement:
theorem piecewise_ae_eq_restrict [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    piecewise s f g =ᵐ[μ.restrict s] f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ae_restrict_eq hs]
  exact (piecewise_eqOn s f g).eventuallyEq.filter_mono inf_le_right

name: piecewise_ae_eq_restrict_compl
statement:
theorem piecewise_ae_eq_restrict_compl [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    piecewise s f g =ᵐ[μ.restrict sᶜ] g
proof:
:= by
  rw [ae_restrict_eq hs.compl]
  exact (piecewise_eqOn_compl s f g).eventuallyEq.filter_mono inf_le_right

name: piecewise_ae_eq_of_ae_eq_set
statement:
theorem piecewise_ae_eq_of_ae_eq_set [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] [DecidablePred (· ∈ t)]
    (hst : s =ᵐ[μ] t) : s.piecewise f g =ᵐ[μ] t.piecewise f g
proof:
:=
  hst.mem_iff.mono fun x hx => by simp [piecewise, hx]

name: mem_map_indicator_ae_iff_mem_map_restrict_ae_of_zero_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [mem_map, mem_ae_iff]
  rw [Measure.restrict_apply' hs, Set.indicator_preimage, Set.ite]
  simp_rw [Set.compl_union, Set.compl_inter]
  change μ (((f ⁻¹' t)ᶜ ∪ sᶜ) ∩ ((fun _ => (0 : β)) ⁻¹' t \ s)ᶜ) = 0 ↔ μ ((f ⁻¹' t)ᶜ ∩ s) = 0
  simp only [ht, ← Set.compl_eq_univ_sdiff, compl_compl, ite_true,
    Set.preimage_const]
  simp_rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right, Set.compl_inter_self s, Set.union_empty]

name: mem_map_indicator_ae_iff_of_zero_notMem
statement:
theorem mem_map_indicator_ae_iff_of_zero_notMem [Zero β] {t : Set β} (ht : (0 : β) ∉ t) :
    t ∈ Filter.map (s.indicator f) (ae μ) ↔ μ ((f ⁻¹' t)ᶜ ∪ sᶜ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_map, mem_ae_iff, Set.indicator_preimage, Set.ite, Set.compl_union, Set.compl_inter]
  change μ (((f ⁻¹' t)ᶜ ∪ sᶜ) ∩ ((fun _ => (0 : β)) ⁻¹' t \ s)ᶜ) = 0 ↔ μ ((f ⁻¹' t)ᶜ ∪ sᶜ) = 0
  simp only [ht, ite_false, Set.compl_empty, Set.empty_sdiff, Set.inter_univ, Set.preimage_const]

name: map_restrict_ae_le_map_indicator_ae
statement:
theorem map_restrict_ae_le_map_indicator_ae [Zero β] (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Filter.map f (ae <| μ.restrict s) ≤ Filter.map (s.indicator f) (ae μ)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  by_cases ht : (0 : β) ∈ t
  · rw [mem_map_indicator_ae_iff_mem_map_restrict_ae_of_zero_mem ht hs]
    exact id
  rw [mem_map_indicator_ae_iff_of_zero_notMem ht, mem_map_restrict_ae_iff hs]
  exact fun h => measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_left.trans Set.subset_union_left) h

name: indicator_ae_eq_restrict
statement: theorem indicator_ae_eq_restrict (hs : MeasurableSet s) : indicator s f =ᵐ[μ.restrict s] f
proof:
:= by
  classical exact piecewise_ae_eq_restrict hs

name: indicator_ae_eq_restrict_compl
statement:
theorem indicator_ae_eq_restrict_compl (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    indicator s f =ᵐ[μ.restrict sᶜ] 0
proof:
:= by
  classical exact piecewise_ae_eq_restrict_compl hs

name: indicator_ae_eq_of_restrict_compl_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem indicator_ae_eq_of_restrict_compl_ae_eq_zero (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hf : f =ᵐ[μ.restrict sᶜ] 0) : s.indicator f =ᵐ[μ] f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff' hs.compl] at hf
  filter_upwards [hf] with x hx
  by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
  · simp only [hxs, Set.indicator_of_mem]
  · simp only [hx hxs, Pi.zero_apply, Set.indicator_apply_eq_zero, imp_true_iff]

name: indicator_ae_eq_zero_of_restrict_ae_eq_zero
statement:
theorem indicator_ae_eq_zero_of_restrict_ae_eq_zero (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hf : f =ᵐ[μ.restrict s] 0) : s.indicator f =ᵐ[μ] 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff' hs] at hf
  filter_upwards [hf] with x hx
  by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
  · simp only [hxs, hx hxs, Set.indicator_of_mem]
  · simp [hxs]

name: indicator_ae_eq_of_ae_eq_set
statement: theorem indicator_ae_eq_of_ae_eq_set (hst : s =ᵐ[μ] t) : s.indicator f =ᵐ[μ] t.indicator f
proof:
:= by
  classical exact piecewise_ae_eq_of_ae_eq_set hst

name: indicator_meas_zero
statement: theorem indicator_meas_zero (hs : μ s = 0) : indicator s f =ᵐ[μ] 0
proof:
:=
  indicator_empty' f ▸ indicator_ae_eq_of_ae_eq_set (ae_eq_empty.2 hs)

name: ae_eq_restrict_iff_indicator_ae_eq
statement:
theorem ae_eq_restrict_iff_indicator_ae_eq {g : α → β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    f =ᵐ[μ.restrict s] g ↔ s.indicator f =ᵐ[μ] s.indicator g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff' hs]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩ <;> filter_upwards [h] with x hx
  · by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
    · simp [hxs, hx hxs]
    · simp [hxs]
  · intro hxs
    simpa [hxs] using hx

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.sum_restrict_le
statement:
lemma MeasureTheory.Measure.sum_restrict_le {_ : MeasurableSpace α}
    {μ : Measure α} {s : ι → Set α} {M : ℕ} (hs_meas : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (s i))
    (hs : ∀ y, {i | y ∈ s i}.encard ≤ M) :
    Measure.sum (fun i ↦ μ.restrict (s i)) ≤ M • μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_iff.mpr (fun t ht ↦ le_of_eq_of_le (sum_apply _ ht) ?_)
  refine ENNReal.summable.tsum_le_of_sum_le (fun F ↦ ?_)
  
  
  let P (C : Finset ι) := (⋂ i ∈ C, s i) ∩ (⋂ i ∈ (F \ C), (s i)ᶜ)
  let Cs := F.powerset \ {∅}
  let G (i : ι) := { C | C ∈ F.powerset ∧ i ∈ C }
  have P_meas C : MeasurableSet (P C) :=
    measurableSet_biInter C (fun i _ ↦ hs_meas i) |>.inter <|
      measurableSet_biInter _ (fun i _ ↦ (hs_meas i).compl)
  have P_cover {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ F) : s i ⊆ ⋃ C ∈ G i, P C := by
    refine fun x hx ↦ Set.mem_biUnion (x := F.filter (x ∈ s ·)) ?_ ?_
    · exact ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (filter_subset _ F), mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi, hx⟩⟩
    · simp_rw [P, mem_inter_iff, mem_iInter, Finset.mem_sdiff, mem_filter]; tauto
  have iUnion_P : ⋃ C ∈ Cs, P C ⊆ ⋃ i, s i := by
    intro x hx
    simp_rw [Cs, Finset.mem_sdiff, mem_iUnion] at hx
    have ⟨C, ⟨_, C_nonempty⟩, hxC⟩ := hx
    have ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr <| Finset.notMem_singleton.mp C_nonempty
    exact ⟨s i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hxC.1 (s i) ⟨i, by simp [hi]⟩⟩
  have P_subset_s {i : ι} {C : Finset ι} (hiC : i ∈ C) : P C ⊆ s i := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [P, mem_inter_iff, mem_iInter] at hx
    exact hx.1 i hiC
  have mem_C {i} (hi : i ∈ F) {C : Finset ι} {x : α} (hx : x ∈ P C) (hxs : x ∈ s i) : i ∈ C := by
    rw [mem_inter_iff, mem_iInter₂, mem_iInter₂] at hx
    exact of_not_not fun h ↦ hx.2 i (mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hi, h⟩) hxs
  have C_subset_C {C₁ C₂} (hC₁ : C₁ ∈ Cs) {x : α} (hx : x ∈ P C₁ ∩ P C₂) : C₁ ⊆ C₂ :=
    fun i hi ↦ mem_C (mem_powerset.mp (sdiff_subset hC₁) hi) hx.2 <| P_subset_s hi hx.1
  calc ∑ i ∈ F, (μ.restrict (s i)) t
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ F, Measure.sum (fun (C : G i) ↦ μ.restrict (P C)) t :=
      F.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ (restrict_mono_set μ (P_cover hi) t).trans <|
        restrict_biUnion_le ((finite_toSet F.powerset).subset (sep_subset _ _)).countable t
    _ = ∑ i ∈ F, ∑' (C : G i), μ.restrict (P C) t := by simp_rw [Measure.sum_apply _ ht]
    _ = ∑' C, ∑ i ∈ F, (G i).indicator (fun C ↦ μ.restrict (P C) t) C := by
      rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun _ _ ↦ ENNReal.summable)]
      congr with i
      rw [tsum_subtype (G i) (fun C ↦ (μ.restrict (P C)) t)]
    _ = ∑ C ∈ Cs, ∑ i ∈ F, (C : Set ι).indicator (fun _ ↦ (μ.restrict (P C)) t) i := by
      rw [sum_eq_tsum_indicator]
      congr with C
      by_cases hC : C ∈ F.powerset <;> by_cases hC' : C = ∅ <;>
        simp [hC, hC', Cs, G, indicator, -Finset.mem_powerset, -coe_powerset]
    _ = ∑ C ∈ Cs, {a ∈ F | a ∈ C}.card • μ.restrict (P C) t := by simp [indicator]; rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ C ∈ Cs, M • μ.restrict (P C) t := by
      refine sum_le_sum fun C hC ↦ ?_
      by_cases hPC : P C = ∅
      · simp [hPC]
      have hCM : (C : Set ι).encard ≤ M :=
        have ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hPC
        (encard_mono (mem_iInter₂.mp hx.1)).trans (hs x)
      exact nsmul_le_nsmul_left zero_le <| calc {a ∈ F | a ∈ C}.card
        _ ≤ C.card := card_mono <| fun i hi ↦ (F.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        _ = (C : Set ι).ncard := (ncard_coe_finset C).symm
        _ ≤ M := ENat.toNat_le_of_le_natCast hCM
    _ = M • (μ.restrict (⋃ C ∈ Cs, (P C)) t) := by
      rw [← smul_sum, ← Cs.tsum_subtype, μ.restrict_biUnion_finset _ P_meas, Measure.sum_apply _ ht]
      refine fun C₁ hC₁ C₂ hC₂ hC ↦ Set.disjoint_iff.mpr fun x hx ↦ hC <| ?_
      exact subset_antisymm (C_subset_C hC₁ hx) (C_subset_C hC₂ (Set.inter_comm _ _ ▸ hx))
    _ ≤ (M • μ.restrict (⋃ i, s i)) t := by
      rw [Measure.smul_apply]
      exact nsmul_le_nsmul_right (μ.restrict_mono_set iUnion_P t) M

name: measure_union
statement: theorem measure_union (hd : Disjoint s₁ s₂) (h : MeasurableSet s₂) : μ (s₁ ∪ s₂) = μ s₁ + μ s₂
proof:
:=
  measure_union₀ h.nullMeasurableSet hd.aedisjoint

name: measure_union'
statement: theorem measure_union' (hd : Disjoint s₁ s₂) (h : MeasurableSet s₁) : μ (s₁ ∪ s₂) = μ s₁ + μ s₂
proof:
:=
  measure_union₀' h.nullMeasurableSet hd.aedisjoint

name: measure_inter_add_sdiff
statement: theorem measure_inter_add_sdiff (s : Set α) (ht : MeasurableSet t) : μ (s ∩ t) + μ (s \ t) = μ s
proof:
:=
  measure_inter_add_sdiff₀ _ ht.nullMeasurableSet

name: measure_sdiff_add_inter
statement: theorem measure_sdiff_add_inter (s : Set α) (ht : MeasurableSet t) : μ (s \ t) + μ (s ∩ t) = μ s
proof:
:=
  (add_comm _ _).trans (measure_inter_add_sdiff s ht)

name: measure_sdiff_eq_top
statement: theorem measure_sdiff_eq_top (hs : μ s = ∞) (ht : μ t ≠ ∞) : μ (s \ t) = ∞
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hs
  exact ((measure_mono (subset_sdiff_union s t)).trans_lt
    ((measure_union_le _ _).trans_lt (ENNReal.add_lt_top.2 ⟨hs.lt_top, ht.lt_top⟩))).ne

name: measure_union_add_inter
statement:
theorem measure_union_add_inter (s : Set α) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    μ (s ∪ t) + μ (s ∩ t) = μ s + μ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← measure_inter_add_sdiff (s ∪ t) ht, Set.union_inter_cancel_right, union_sdiff_right, ←
