name: exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi
statement:
theorem exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (a : ℝ) {b : ℝ} (h : 0 < b) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => exp (-b * x)) (Ioi a)
proof:
:= by
  have : Tendsto (fun x => -exp (-b * x) / b) atTop (𝓝 (-0 / b)) := by
    refine Tendsto.div_const (Tendsto.neg ?_) _
    exact tendsto_exp_atBot.comp (tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop_of_neg (neg_neg_iff_pos.2 h))
  refine integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg' (fun x _ => ?_) (fun x _ => (exp_pos _).le) this
  simpa [h.ne'] using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul b).neg.exp.neg.div_const b

name: integrable_of_isBigO_exp_neg
statement:
theorem integrable_of_isBigO_exp_neg {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Ici a)) (ho : f =O[atTop] fun x => exp (-b * x)) :
    IntegrableOn f (Ioi a)
proof:
:=
  integrableOn_Ici_iff_integrableOn_Ioi (by finiteness) |>.mp <|
    (hf.locallyIntegrableOn measurableSet_Ici).integrableOn_of_isBigO_atTop
    ho ⟨Ioi b, Ioi_mem_atTop b, exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi b h0⟩

name: integrableOn_exp_neg_smul_of_isBigO_exp
statement:
theorem integrableOn_exp_neg_smul_of_isBigO_exp {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] {a b c : ℝ} {f : ℝ → E} (hfc : LocallyIntegrableOn f (Ici c))
    (hf : f =O[atTop] fun x : ℝ => exp (a * x)) (hab : a < b) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => exp (-b * x) • f x) (Ici c)
proof:
:= by
  have hloc : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => exp (-b * x) • f x) (Ici c) :=
    hfc.continuousOn_smul isClosed_Ici.isLocallyClosed (by fun_prop)
  exact hloc.integrableOn_of_isBigO_atTop (g := fun x : ℝ => exp ((a - b) * x))
    (((isBigO_refl _ atTop).smul hf).congr_right fun x => by
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, ← exp_add]; ring_nf)
    ⟨Ioi c, Ioi_mem_atTop c, by
      simpa [neg_sub] using exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi c (sub_pos.mpr hab)⟩

name: integrableOn_exp_neg_mul_of_isBigO_exp
proof:
:= by
  simpa using integrableOn_exp_neg_smul_of_isBigO_exp hfc hf hab

name: apply_le_nndist_zero

name: lintegral_le_edist_mul
statement:

    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ edist 0 f * (μ Set.univ)
proof:
:=
  le_trans (lintegral_mono (fun x ↦ ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (f.apply_le_nndist_zero x))) (by simp)

name: measurable_coe_ennreal_comp
statement:
theorem measurable_coe_ennreal_comp [OpensMeasurableSpace X] (f : X →ᵇ ℝ≥0) :
    Measurable fun x ↦ (f x : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:=
  measurable_coe_nnreal_ennreal.comp f.continuous.measurable

name: lintegral_lt_top_of_nnreal
statement: theorem lintegral_lt_top_of_nnreal (f : X →ᵇ ℝ≥0) : ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ < ∞
proof:
:= by
  apply IsFiniteMeasure.lintegral_lt_top_of_bounded_to_ennreal
  refine ⟨nndist f 0, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  have key := BoundedContinuousFunction.NNReal.upper_bound f x
  rwa [ENNReal.coe_le_coe]

name: integrable_of_nnreal
statement:
theorem integrable_of_nnreal [OpensMeasurableSpace X] (f : X →ᵇ ℝ≥0) :
    Integrable (((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) ∘ ⇑f) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(NNReal.continuous_coe.comp f.continuous).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
  simp only [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm, Function.comp_apply, NNReal.enorm_eq]
  exact lintegral_lt_top_of_nnreal _ f

name: integral_eq_integral_nnrealPart_sub
statement:
theorem integral_eq_integral_nnrealPart_sub [OpensMeasurableSpace X] (f : X →ᵇ ℝ) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂μ = (∫ x, (f.nnrealPart x : ℝ) ∂μ) - ∫ x, ((-f).nnrealPart x : ℝ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [f.self_eq_nnrealPart_sub_nnrealPart_neg, Pi.sub_apply, integral_sub,
             integrable_of_nnreal]

name: lintegral_of_real_lt_top
statement:

proof: := lintegral_lt_top_of_nnreal _ f.nnrealPart

name: toReal_lintegral_coe_eq_integral
statement:
theorem toReal_lintegral_coe_eq_integral [OpensMeasurableSpace X] (f : X →ᵇ ℝ≥0) (μ : Measure X) :
    (∫⁻ x, (f x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ).toReal = ∫ x, (f x : ℝ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae _ (by simpa [Function.comp_apply] using!
        (NNReal.continuous_coe.comp f.continuous).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable)]
  · simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (by simp)

name: lintegral_nnnorm_le
statement:
lemma lintegral_nnnorm_le (f : X →ᵇ E) :
    ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖₊ ∂μ ≤ ‖f‖₊ * (μ Set.univ)
proof:
:= by
  calc  ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖₊ ∂μ
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _, ‖f‖₊ ∂μ       := by gcongr; apply nnnorm_coe_le_nnnorm
    _ = ‖f‖₊ * (μ Set.univ) := by rw [lintegral_const]

name: integrable
statement:
lemma integrable [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : X →ᵇ E) :
    Integrable f μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨f.continuous.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable, (hasFiniteIntegral_def _ _).mp ?_⟩
  calc  ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖₊ ∂μ
    _ ≤ ‖f‖₊ * (μ Set.univ) := f.lintegral_nnnorm_le μ
    _ < ∞                   := ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.coe_lt_top (measure_lt_top μ Set.univ)

name: norm_integral_le_mul_norm
statement:
lemma norm_integral_le_mul_norm [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : X →ᵇ E) :
    ‖∫ x, f x ∂μ‖ ≤ μ.real Set.univ * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  calc  ‖∫ x, f x ∂μ‖
    _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖f x‖ ∂μ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ _, ‖f‖ ∂μ := ?_
    _ = μ.real Set.univ • ‖f‖ := by rw [integral_const]
  apply integral_mono _ (integrable_const ‖f‖) (fun x ↦ f.norm_coe_le_norm x) 
  exact (integrable_norm_iff f.continuous.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr (f.integrable μ)

name: norm_integral_le_norm
statement:
lemma norm_integral_le_norm [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : X →ᵇ E) :
    ‖∫ x, f x ∂μ‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  convert! f.norm_integral_le_mul_norm μ
  simp

name: isBounded_range_integral
statement:
lemma isBounded_range_integral
    {ι : Type*} (μs : ι → Measure X) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μs i)] (f : X →ᵇ E) :
    Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)))
proof:
:= by
  apply isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr ⟨‖f‖, fun v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hv
  rw [← hi]
  apply f.norm_integral_le_norm (μs i)

name: integral_add_const
statement:
lemma integral_add_const (f : X →ᵇ ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    ∫ x, (f + const X c) x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ + μ.real Set.univ • c
proof:
:= by
  simp [integral_add (f.integrable _) (integrable_const c)]

name: integral_const_sub
statement:
lemma integral_const_sub (f : X →ᵇ ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    ∫ x, (const X c - f) x ∂μ = μ.real Set.univ • c - ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [integral_sub (integrable_const c) (f.integrable _)]

name: tendsto_integral_of_forall_limsup_integral_le_integral
statement:
lemma tendsto_integral_of_forall_limsup_integral_le_integral {ι : Type*} {L : Filter ι}
    {μ : Measure X} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {μs : ι → Measure X} [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μs i)]
    (h : ∀ f : X →ᵇ ℝ, 0 ≤ f → L.limsup (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)) ≤ ∫ x, f x ∂μ)
    (f : X →ᵇ ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)) L (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_neBot L with rfl | hL
  · simp only [tendsto_bot]
  have obs := BoundedContinuousFunction.isBounded_range_integral μs f
  have bdd_above := BddAbove.isBoundedUnder L.univ_mem (by simpa using obs.bddAbove)
  have bdd_below := BddBelow.isBoundedUnder L.univ_mem (by simpa using obs.bddBelow)
  apply tendsto_of_le_liminf_of_limsup_le _ _ bdd_above bdd_below
  · have key := h _ (f.norm_sub_nonneg)
    simp_rw [f.integral_const_sub ‖f‖] at key
    simp only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at key
    have := limsup_const_sub L (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)) ‖f‖ bdd_above.isCobounded_ge bdd_below
    rwa [this, _root_.sub_le_sub_iff_left ‖f‖] at key
  · have key := h _ (f.add_norm_nonneg)
    simp_rw [f.integral_add_const ‖f‖] at key
    simp only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at key
    have := limsup_add_const L (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)) ‖f‖ bdd_above bdd_below.isCobounded_le
    rwa [this, add_le_add_iff_right] at key

name: tendsto_integral_of_forall_integral_le_liminf_integral
statement:
lemma tendsto_integral_of_forall_integral_le_liminf_integral {ι : Type*} {L : Filter ι}
    {μ : Measure X} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {μs : ι → Measure X} [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μs i)]
    (h : ∀ f : X →ᵇ ℝ, 0 ≤ f → ∫ x, f x ∂μ ≤ L.liminf (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)))
    (f : X →ᵇ ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)) L (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_neBot L with rfl | hL
  · simp only [tendsto_bot]
  have obs := BoundedContinuousFunction.isBounded_range_integral μs f
  have bdd_above := BddAbove.isBoundedUnder L.univ_mem (by simpa using obs.bddAbove)
  have bdd_below := BddBelow.isBoundedUnder L.univ_mem (by simpa using obs.bddBelow)
  apply @tendsto_of_le_liminf_of_limsup_le ℝ ι _ _ _ L (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)) (∫ x, f x ∂μ)
  · have key := h _ (f.add_norm_nonneg)
    simp_rw [f.integral_add_const ‖f‖] at key
    simp only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at key
    have := liminf_add_const L (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)) ‖f‖ bdd_above.isCobounded_ge bdd_below
    rwa [this, add_le_add_iff_right] at key
  · have key := h _ (f.norm_sub_nonneg)
    simp_rw [f.integral_const_sub ‖f‖] at key
    simp only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at key
    have := liminf_const_sub L (fun i ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂(μs i)) ‖f‖ bdd_above bdd_below.isCobounded_le
    rwa [this, sub_le_sub_iff_left] at key
  · exact bdd_above
  · exact bdd_below

name: circleAverage_def
statement:
lemma circleAverage_def :
    circleAverage f c R = (2 * π)⁻¹ • ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, f (circleMap c R θ)
proof: := rfl

name: circleAverage.integral_undef
statement:
theorem circleAverage.integral_undef (hf : ¬CircleIntegrable f c R) :
    circleAverage f c R = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_all [circleAverage, CircleIntegrable, intervalIntegral.integral_undef]

name: circleAverage_eq_intervalAverage
statement:
lemma circleAverage_eq_intervalAverage :
    circleAverage f c R = ⨍ θ in 0..2 * π, f (circleMap c R θ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [circleAverage, interval_average_eq]

name: circleAverage_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma circleAverage_zero [CompleteSpace E] :
    circleAverage f c 0 = f c
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleAverage]
  simp only [circleMap_zero_radius, Function.const_apply,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero,
    ← smul_assoc, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero pi_ne_zero),
    one_smul]

name: circleAverage_map_add_const
statement:
lemma circleAverage_map_add_const :
    circleAverage (fun z ↦ f (z + c)) 0 R = circleAverage f c R
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleAverage circleMap
  congr
  ext θ
  simp only [zero_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: circleAverage_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
theorem circleAverage_eq_circleIntegral {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]
    {f : ℂ → F} (h : R ≠ 0) :
    circleAverage f c R = (2 * π * I)⁻¹ • (∮ z in C(c, R), (z - c)⁻¹ • f z)
proof:
:= by
  calc circleAverage f c R
  _ = (↑(2 * π) : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, f (circleMap c R θ) := by
    simp [circleAverage, ← coe_smul]
  _ = (2 * π * I)⁻¹ • ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, I • f (circleMap c R θ) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_smul, mul_inv_rev, smul_smul]
    match_scalars
    field
  _ = (2 * π * I)⁻¹ • (∮ z in C(c, R), (z - c)⁻¹ • f z) := by
    unfold circleIntegral
    congr with θ
    simp [deriv_circleMap, circleMap_sub_center, smul_smul]
    field_simp [circleMap_ne_center h]

name: circleAverage_eq_integral_add
statement:
lemma circleAverage_eq_integral_add (η : ℝ) :
    circleAverage f c R = (2 * π)⁻¹ • ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, f (circleMap c R (θ + η))
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right (fun θ ↦ f (circleMap c R θ))]
  have t₀ : (fun θ ↦ f (circleMap c R θ)).Periodic (2 * π) :=
    fun x ↦ by simp [periodic_circleMap c R x]
  have := t₀.intervalIntegral_add_eq 0 η
  rw [zero_add, add_comm] at this
  rw [zero_add]
  simp only [circleAverage, mul_inv_rev]
  congr

name: circleAverage_neg_radius
statement:
@[simp] theorem circleAverage_neg_radius :
    circleAverage f c (-R) = circleAverage f c R
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleAverage
  simp_rw [circleMap_neg_radius, ← circleAverage_def, circleAverage_eq_integral_add π]

name: circleAverage_abs_radius
statement:
@[simp] theorem circleAverage_abs_radius :
    circleAverage f c |R| = circleAverage f c R
proof:

  by_cases! hR : 0 ≤ R
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg hR]
  · rw [abs_of_neg hR, circleAverage_neg_radius]

name: circleAverage_congr_codiscreteWithin
statement:
theorem circleAverage_congr_codiscreteWithin
    (hf : f₁ =ᶠ[codiscreteWithin (sphere c |R|)] f₂) (hR : R ≠ 0) :
    circleAverage f₁ c R = circleAverage f₂ c R
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleAverage
  congr 1
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae_restrict
  apply ae_restrict_le_codiscreteWithin measurableSet_uIoc
  apply codiscreteWithin_mono (by tauto) (circleMap_preimage_codiscrete hR hf)

statement:
theorem circleAverage_congr_sphere {f₁ f₂ : ℂ → E} (hf : Set.EqOn f₁ f₂ (sphere c |R|)) :
    circleAverage f₁ c R = circleAverage f₂ c R
proof:
:= by

  congr 1
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x ↦ by simp [hf (circleMap_mem_sphere' c R x)])

name: circleAverage_eq_circleAverage_zero_one
statement:
theorem circleAverage_eq_circleAverage_zero_one :
    circleAverage f c R = (circleAverage (fun z ↦ f (R * z + c)) 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleAverage circleMap
  congr with θ
  ring_nf
  simp

name: circleAverage_zero_one_congr_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem circleAverage_zero_one_congr_inv {f : ℂ → E} :
    circleAverage (f ·⁻¹) 0 1 = circleAverage f 0 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold circleAverage
  congr 1
  calc ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, f (circleMap 0 1 θ)⁻¹
  _ = ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, f (circleMap 0 1 (-θ)) := by
    simp [circleMap_zero_inv]
  _ = ∫ θ in 0..2 * π, f (circleMap 0 1 θ) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg (fun w ↦ f (circleMap 0 1 w))]
    have t₀ : Function.Periodic (fun w ↦ f (circleMap 0 1 w)) (2 * π) :=
      fun x ↦ by simp [periodic_circleMap 0 1 x]
    simpa using (t₀.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-(2 * π)) 0)

name: circleMap.continuous
statement:
@[fun_prop] lemma circleMap.continuous {c : ℂ} :
    Continuous (fun (x : ℝ × ℝ) ↦ circleMap c x.1 x.2)
proof:
:= by
  fun_prop [circleMap]

name: ContinuousOn.circleAverage
statement:
theorem ContinuousOn.circleAverage {f : ℂ → E} {s : Set ℝ} {c : ℂ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f {z : ℂ | ‖z - c‖ ∈ s})
    (hs : ∀ r ∈ s, 0 ≤ r) :
    ContinuousOn (circleAverage f c) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict] at *
  apply (intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' _ _ _).const_smul
  have (x : s × ℝ) : circleMap c x.1 x.2 ∈ {z | ‖z - c‖ ∈ s} := by
    simp [abs_of_nonneg (hs x.1 (Subtype.coe_prop x.1))]
  apply hf.comp (f := (fun x ↦ ⟨circleMap c x.1 x.2, this x⟩))
  fun_prop

name: ContinuousOn.eq_of_eqOn_Ioo

lemma ContinuousOn.eq_of_eqOn_Ioo {f : ℝ → ℝ} {c r R : ℝ}

name: circleAverage_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem circleAverage_mono {c : ℂ} {R : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℝ} (hf₁ : CircleIntegrable f₁ c R)
    (hf₂ : CircleIntegrable f₂ c R) (h : ∀ x ∈ Metric.sphere c |R|, f₁ x ≤ f₂ x) :
    circleAverage f₁ c R ≤ circleAverage f₂ c R
proof:
:= by
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left (by simp [pi_pos])).2
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on_of_le_Ioo (le_of_lt two_pi_pos) hf₁ hf₂
  exact fun x _ ↦ by simp [h (circleMap c R x)]

name: circleAverage_mono_on_of_le_circle

theorem circleAverage_mono_on_of_le_circle {f : ℂ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (hf : CircleIntegrable f c R)

    circleAverage f c R ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← circleAverage_const a c |R|, circleAverage, circleAverage, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left (inv_pos.2 two_pi_pos)]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on_of_le_Ioo (le_of_lt two_pi_pos) hf
    intervalIntegrable_const (fun θ _ ↦ h₂f (circleMap c R θ) (circleMap_mem_sphere' c R θ))

    abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 two_pi_pos), mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left (inv_pos.2 two_pi_pos)]

name: circleAverage_nonneg_of_nonneg
proof:

  by_cases hf : CircleIntegrable f c R
  · rw [← circleAverage_const 0 c |R|, circleAverage, circleAverage, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left (inv_pos.2 two_pi_pos)]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on_of_le_Ioo (le_of_lt two_pi_pos)
      intervalIntegrable_const hf (fun θ _ ↦ h₂f (circleMap c R θ) (circleMap_mem_sphere' c R θ))

name: IsCompact.measure_eq_biInf_integral_hasCompactSupport
statement:
lemma IsCompact.measure_eq_biInf_integral_hasCompactSupport
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    {k : Set X} (hk : IsCompact k)
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ]
    [LocallyCompactSpace X] [RegularSpace X] :
    μ k = ⨅ (f : X → ℝ) (_ : Continuous f) (_ : HasCompactSupport f) (_ : EqOn f 1 k)
      (_ : 0 ≤ f), ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, f x ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp only [le_iInf_iff]
    intro f f_cont f_comp fk f_nonneg
    apply (f_cont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport f_comp).measure_le_integral
    · exact Eventually.of_forall f_nonneg
    · exact fun x hx ↦ by simp [fk hx]
  · apply le_of_forall_gt (fun r hr ↦ ?_)
    simp only [iInf_lt_iff, exists_prop]
    obtain ⟨U, kU, U_open, mu_U⟩ : ∃ U, k ⊆ U ∧ IsOpen U ∧ μ U < r :=
      hk.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt r hr
    obtain ⟨⟨f, f_cont⟩, fk, fU, f_comp, f_range⟩ : ∃ (f : C(X, ℝ)), EqOn f 1 k ∧ EqOn f 0 Uᶜ
        ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧ ∀ (x : X), f x ∈ Icc 0 1 := exists_continuous_one_zero_of_isCompact
      hk U_open.isClosed_compl (disjoint_compl_right_iff_subset.mpr kU)
    refine ⟨f, f_cont, f_comp, fk, fun x ↦ (f_range x).1, ?_⟩
    exact (integral_le_measure (fun x _hx ↦ (f_range x).2) (fun x hx ↦ (fU hx).le)).trans_lt mu_U

name: IsOpen.measure_eq_biSup_integral_continuous
statement:
lemma IsOpen.measure_eq_biSup_integral_continuous
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [T2Space X]
    {U : Set X} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ] [NormalSpace X] :
    μ U = ⨆ (f : X → ℝ) (_ : Continuous f) (_ : EqOn f 0 Uᶜ) (_ : 0 ≤ f) (_ : f ≤ 1),
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, f x ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_of_forall_lt (fun r hr ↦ ?_)
    simp only [lt_iSup_iff, exists_prop]
    obtain ⟨K, KU, K_comp, hK⟩ : ∃ K ⊆ U, IsCompact K ∧ r < μ K :=
      MeasurableSet.exists_lt_isCompact_of_ne_top hU.measurableSet (by simp) hr
    obtain ⟨⟨f, f_cont⟩, fU, fK, f_range⟩ : ∃ (f : C(X, ℝ)), EqOn f 0 Uᶜ ∧ EqOn f 1 K
        ∧ ∀ (x : X), f x ∈ Icc 0 1 := exists_continuous_zero_one_of_isClosed
      hU.isClosed_compl K_comp.isClosed (disjoint_compl_left_iff_subset.mpr KU)
    refine ⟨f, f_cont, fU, fun x ↦ (f_range x).1, fun x ↦ (f_range x).2, ?_⟩
    apply hK.trans_le
    apply Integrable.measure_le_integral
    · apply Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 f_cont.aemeasurable
      filter_upwards [] with x using f_range x
    · filter_upwards [] with x using (f_range x).1
    · intro x hx
      apply Eq.ge
      exact fK hx
  · simp only [iSup_le_iff]
    intro f f_cont fU f_nonneg f_le
    exact integral_le_measure (fun x hx ↦ f_le x) (fun x hx ↦ le_of_eq (fU hx))

name: tendsto_measure_of_ae_tendsto_indicator
statement:
lemma tendsto_measure_of_ae_tendsto_indicator {μ : Measure α} (A_mble : MeasurableSet A)
    (As_mble : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (As i)) {B : Set α} (B_mble : MeasurableSet B)
    (B_finmeas : μ B ≠ ∞) (As_le_B : ∀ᶠ i in L, As i ⊆ B)
    (h_lim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ᶠ i in L, x ∈ As i ↔ x ∈ A) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ μ (As i)) L (𝓝 (μ A))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator_one A_mble,
           ← MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator_one (As_mble _)]
  refine tendsto_lintegral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (B.indicator (1 : α → ℝ≥0∞))
          (Eventually.of_forall ?_) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact fun i ↦ Measurable.indicator measurable_const (As_mble i)
  · filter_upwards [As_le_B] with i hi
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ by grw [hi]
  · rwa [← lintegral_indicator_one B_mble] at B_finmeas
  · simpa only [Pi.one_def, tendsto_indicator_const_apply_iff_eventually] using h_lim

name: tendsto_measure_of_ae_tendsto_indicator_of_isFiniteMeasure
statement:
lemma tendsto_measure_of_ae_tendsto_indicator_of_isFiniteMeasure
    {μ : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (A_mble : MeasurableSet A)
    (As_mble : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (As i)) (h_lim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ᶠ i in L, x ∈ As i ↔ x ∈ A) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ μ (As i)) L (𝓝 (μ A))
proof:
:=
  tendsto_measure_of_ae_tendsto_indicator L A_mble As_mble MeasurableSet.univ
    (by finiteness) (Eventually.of_forall (fun i ↦ subset_univ (As i))) h_lim

name: tendsto_measure_of_tendsto_indicator
statement:
lemma tendsto_measure_of_tendsto_indicator {μ : Measure α}
    (As_mble : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (As i)) {B : Set α} (B_mble : MeasurableSet B)
    (B_finmeas : μ B ≠ ∞) (As_le_B : ∀ᶠ i in L, As i ⊆ B)
    (h_lim : ∀ x, ∀ᶠ i in L, x ∈ As i ↔ x ∈ A) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ μ (As i)) L (𝓝 (μ A))
proof:
:= by
  rcases L.eq_or_neBot with rfl | _
  · exact tendsto_bot
  apply tendsto_measure_of_ae_tendsto_indicator L ?_ As_mble B_mble B_finmeas As_le_B
        (ae_of_all μ h_lim)
  exact measurableSet_of_tendsto_indicator L As_mble h_lim

name: tendsto_measure_of_tendsto_indicator_of_isFiniteMeasure
statement:
lemma tendsto_measure_of_tendsto_indicator_of_isFiniteMeasure
    (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (As_mble : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (As i))

  exact measurableSet_of_tendsto_indicator L As_mble h_lim

name: IsBigO.integrableAtFilter
statement:
theorem IsBigO.integrableAtFilter [IsMeasurablyGenerated l]
    (hf : f =O[l] g) (hfm : StronglyMeasurableAtFilter f l μ) (hg : IntegrableAtFilter g l μ) :
    IntegrableAtFilter f l μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.bound
  obtain ⟨s, hsl, hsm, hfg, hf, hg⟩ :=
    (hC.smallSets.and <| hfm.eventually.and hg.eventually).exists_measurable_mem_of_smallSets
  refine ⟨s, hsl, (hg.norm.const_mul C).mono hf ?_⟩
  refine (ae_restrict_mem hsm).mono fun x hx ↦ ?_
  exact (hfg x hx).trans (le_abs_self _)

name: IsBigO.integrable
statement:
theorem IsBigO.integrable (hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ)
    (hf : f =O[⊤] g) (hg : Integrable g μ) : Integrable f μ
proof:
:= by

name: IsBigO.eventually_integrableOn
statement:
theorem IsBigO.eventually_integrableOn [Norm F]
    (hf : f =O[𝓟 s ×ˢ l] (g ∘ Prod.snd))
    (hfm : ∀ᶠ x in l, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun i ↦ f (i, x)) (μ.restrict s))
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hμ : μ s < ⊤) :
    ∀ᶠ x in l, IntegrableOn (fun i ↦ f (i, x)) s μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.bound
  obtain ⟨t, htl, ht⟩ := hC.exists_mem
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := Filter.mem_prod_iff.mp htl
  obtain ⟨w, hwl, hw⟩ := hfm.exists_mem
  refine eventually_iff_exists_mem.mpr ⟨w ∩ v, inter_mem hwl hv, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict s) := ⟨Measure.restrict_apply_univ s ▸ hμ⟩
  refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (C * ‖g x‖)) (hw x hx.1) ?_
  filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.self_mem_ae_restrict hs]
  intro y hy
  exact ht (y, x) <| huv ⟨hu hy, hx.2⟩

name: IsBigO.set_integral_isBigO
statement:
theorem IsBigO.set_integral_isBigO (hf : f =O[𝓟 s ×ˢ l] (g ∘ Prod.snd)) (hμ : μ s < ⊤) :
    (fun x ↦ ∫ i in s, f (i, x) ∂μ) =O[l] g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.bound
  obtain ⟨t, htl, ht⟩ := hC.exists_mem
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := mem_prod_iff.mp htl
  refine isBigO_iff.mpr ⟨C * μ.real s, eventually_iff_exists_mem.mpr ⟨v, hv, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ C * ‖g x‖ * μ.real s :=
      norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const hμ fun y hy ↦ ht (y, x) <| huv ⟨hu hy, hx⟩
    _ = _ := by ring

name: LocallyIntegrable.integrable_of_isBigO_atTop_of_norm_isNegInvariant
statement:
theorem LocallyIntegrable.integrable_of_isBigO_atTop_of_norm_isNegInvariant
    [IsMeasurablyGenerated (atTop (α := α))] [MeasurableNeg α] [μ.IsNegInvariant]
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hsymm : norm ∘ f =ᵐ[μ] norm ∘ f ∘ Neg.neg) (ho : f =O[atTop] g)
    (hg : IntegrableAtFilter g atTop μ) : Integrable f μ
proof:
:= by
  have h_int := (hf.locallyIntegrableOn (Ici 0)).integrableOn_of_isBigO_atTop ho hg
  rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Iic_union_Ici_of_le le_rfl, integrableOn_union]
  refine ⟨?_, h_int⟩
  have h_map_neg : (μ.restrict (Ici 0)).map Neg.neg = μ.restrict (Iic 0) := by
    conv => rhs; rw [← Measure.map_neg_eq_self μ, measurableEmbedding_neg.restrict_map]
    simp
  rw [IntegrableOn, ← h_map_neg, measurableEmbedding_neg.integrable_map_iff]
  refine h_int.congr' ?_ hsymm.restrict
  refine AEStronglyMeasurable.comp_aemeasurable ?_ measurable_neg.aemeasurable
  exact h_map_neg ▸ hf.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict

name: aemeasurable_withDensity_iff
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_withDensity_iff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {f : α → ℝ≥0}
    (hf : Measurable f) {g : α → E} :
    AEMeasurable g (μ.withDensity fun x => (f x : ℝ≥0∞)) ↔
      AEMeasurable (fun x => (f x : ℝ) • g x) μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g', g'meas, hg'⟩
    have A : MeasurableSet { x : α | f x ≠ 0 } := (hf (measurableSet_singleton 0)).compl
    refine ⟨fun x => (f x : ℝ) • g' x, hf.coe_nnreal_real.smul g'meas, ?_⟩
    apply @ae_of_ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_compl _ _ _ { x | f x ≠ 0 }
    · rw [EventuallyEq, ae_withDensity_iff hf.coe_nnreal_ennreal] at hg'
      rw [ae_restrict_iff' A]
      filter_upwards [hg']
      intro a ha h'a
      have : (f a : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by simpa only [Ne, ENNReal.coe_eq_zero] using h'a
      rw [ha this]
    · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem A.compl]
      intro x hx
      simp only [Classical.not_not, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_compl_iff] at hx
      simp [hx]
  · rintro ⟨g', g'meas, hg'⟩
    refine ⟨fun x => (f x : ℝ)⁻¹ • g' x, hf.coe_nnreal_real.inv.smul g'meas, ?_⟩
    rw [EventuallyEq, ae_withDensity_iff hf.coe_nnreal_ennreal]
    filter_upwards [hg']
    intro x hx h'x
    rw [← hx, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀, one_smul]
    simp only [Ne, ENNReal.coe_eq_zero] at h'x
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_eq_zero, Ne] using h'x

name: torusMap_sub_center
statement: theorem torusMap_sub_center (c : ℂⁿ) (R : ℝⁿ) (θ : ℝⁿ) : torusMap c R θ - c = torusMap 0 R θ
proof:
:= by
  ext1 i; simp [torusMap]

name: torusMap_eq_center_iff
statement: theorem torusMap_eq_center_iff {c : ℂⁿ} {R : ℝⁿ} {θ : ℝⁿ} : torusMap c R θ = c ↔ R = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [funext_iff, torusMap, exp_ne_zero]

name: torusMap_zero_radius
statement:
@[simp]
theorem torusMap_zero_radius (c : ℂⁿ) : torusMap c 0 = const ℝⁿ c
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ ↦ torusMap_eq_center_iff.2 rfl

name: torusIntegrable_const
statement: theorem torusIntegrable_const (a : E) (c : ℂⁿ) (R : ℝⁿ) : TorusIntegrable (fun _ => a) c R
proof:
:= by
  simp [TorusIntegrable, measure_Icc_lt_top]

name: torusIntegrable_zero_radius
statement: theorem torusIntegrable_zero_radius {f : ℂⁿ → E} {c : ℂⁿ} : TorusIntegrable f c 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [TorusIntegrable, torusMap_zero_radius]
  apply torusIntegrable_const (f c) c 0

name: function_integrable
statement:
theorem function_integrable [NormedSpace ℂ E] (hf : TorusIntegrable f c R) :
    IntegrableOn (fun θ : ℝⁿ => (∏ i, R i * exp (θ i * I) * I : ℂ) • f (torusMap c R θ))
      (Icc (0 : ℝⁿ) fun _ => 2 * π) volume
proof:
:= by
  refine (hf.norm.const_mul (∏ i, |R i|)).mono' ?_ ?_
  · refine (Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable ?_).smul hf.1; fun_prop
  simp [norm_smul]

name: torusIntegral_radius_zero
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_radius_zero (hn : n ≠ 0) (f : ℂⁿ → E) (c : ℂⁿ) :
    (∯ x in T(c, 0), f x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [torusIntegral, Pi.zero_apply, ofReal_zero, zero_mul, Fin.prod_const,
    zero_pow hn, zero_smul, integral_zero]

name: torusIntegral_neg
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_neg (f : ℂⁿ → E) (c : ℂⁿ) (R : ℝⁿ) :
    (∯ x in T(c, R), -f x) = -∯ x in T(c, R), f x
proof: := by simp [torusIntegral, integral_neg]

name: torusIntegral_add
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_add (hf : TorusIntegrable f c R) (hg : TorusIntegrable g c R) :
    (∯ x in T(c, R), f x + g x) = (∯ x in T(c, R), f x) + ∯ x in T(c, R), g x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [torusIntegral, smul_add, Pi.add_apply] using
    integral_add hf.function_integrable hg.function_integrable

name: torusIntegral_sub
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_sub (hf : TorusIntegrable f c R) (hg : TorusIntegrable g c R) :
    (∯ x in T(c, R), f x - g x) = (∯ x in T(c, R), f x) - ∯ x in T(c, R), g x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, ← torusIntegral_neg] using! torusIntegral_add hf hg.neg

name: torusIntegral_smul
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_smul {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [SMulCommClass 𝕜 ℂ E] (a : 𝕜)
    (f : ℂⁿ → E) (c : ℂⁿ) (R : ℝⁿ) : (∯ x in T(c, R), a • f x) = a • ∯ x in T(c, R), f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [torusIntegral, integral_smul, ← smul_comm a (_ : ℂ) (_ : E)]

name: torusIntegral_const_mul
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_const_mul (a : ℂ) (f : ℂⁿ → ℂ) (c : ℂⁿ) (R : ℝⁿ) :
    (∯ x in T(c, R), a * f x) = a * ∯ x in T(c, R), f x
proof:
:=
  torusIntegral_smul a f c R

name: norm_torusIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const
statement:
theorem norm_torusIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const {C : ℝ} (hf : ∀ θ, ‖f (torusMap c R θ)‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖∯ x in T(c, R), f x‖ ≤ ((2 * π) ^ (n : ℕ) * ∏ i, |R i|) * C
proof:
:=
  calc
    ‖∯ x in T(c, R), f x‖ ≤ (∏ i, |R i|) * C * (volume (Icc (0 : ℝⁿ) fun _ => 2 * π)).toReal :=
      norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const measure_Icc_lt_top fun θ _ =>
        calc
          ‖(∏ i : Fin n, R i * exp (θ i * I) * I : ℂ) • f (torusMap c R θ)‖ =
              (∏ i : Fin n, |R i|) * ‖f (torusMap c R θ)‖ := by simp [norm_smul]
          _ ≤ (∏ i : Fin n, |R i|) * C := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf _) <| by positivity
    _ = ((2 * π) ^ (n : ℕ) * ∏ i, |R i|) * C := by
      simp only [Pi.zero_def, Real.volume_Icc_pi_toReal fun _ => Real.two_pi_pos.le, sub_zero,
        Fin.prod_const, mul_assoc, mul_comm ((2 * π) ^ (n : ℕ))]

name: torusIntegral_dim0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem torusIntegral_dim0 [CompleteSpace E]
    (f : ℂ⁰ → E) (c : ℂ⁰) (R : ℝ⁰) : (∯ x in T(c, R), f x) = f c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [torusIntegral, Fin.prod_univ_zero, one_smul,
    Subsingleton.elim (fun _ : Fin 0 => 2 * π) 0, Icc_self, Measure.restrict_singleton, volume_pi,
    integral_dirac, Measure.pi_of_empty (fun _ : Fin 0 ↦ volume) 0,
    Measure.dirac_apply_of_mem (mem_singleton _), Subsingleton.elim (torusMap c R 0) c]

name: torusIntegral_dim1
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_dim1 (f : ℂ¹ → E) (c : ℂ¹) (R : ℝ¹) :
    (∯ x in T(c, R), f x) = ∮ z in C(c 0, R 0), f fun _ => z
proof:
:= by
  have H₁ : (((MeasurableEquiv.funUnique _ _).symm) ⁻¹' Icc 0 fun _ => 2 * π) = Icc 0 (2 * π) :=
    (OrderIso.funUnique (Fin 1) ℝ).symm.preimage_Icc _ _
  have H₂ : torusMap c R = fun θ _ ↦ circleMap (c 0) (R 0) (θ 0) := by
    ext θ i : 2
    rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]; rfl
  rw [torusIntegral, circleIntegral, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le,
    Measure.restrict_congr_set Ioc_ae_eq_Icc,
    ← ((volume_preserving_funUnique (Fin 1) ℝ).symm _).setIntegral_preimage_emb
      (MeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding _), H₁, H₂]
  simp [circleMap_zero]

name: torusIntegral_succAbove
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_succAbove
    {f : ℂⁿ⁺¹ → E} {c : ℂⁿ⁺¹} {R : ℝⁿ⁺¹} (hf : TorusIntegrable f c R)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (∯ x in T(c, R), f x) =
      ∮ x in C(c i, R i), ∯ y in T(c ∘ i.succAbove, R ∘ i.succAbove), f (i.insertNth x y)
proof:
:= by
  set e : ℝ × ℝⁿ ≃ᵐ ℝⁿ⁺¹ := (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => ℝ) i).symm
  have hem : MeasurePreserving e :=
    (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) i).symm _
  have heπ : (e ⁻¹' Icc 0 fun _ => 2 * π) = Icc 0 (2 * π) ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝⁿ) fun _ => 2 * π :=
    ((Fin.insertNthOrderIso (fun _ => ℝ) i).preimage_Icc _ _).trans (Icc_prod_eq _ _)
  rw [torusIntegral, ← hem.map_eq, setIntegral_map_equiv, heπ, Measure.volume_eq_prod,
    setIntegral_prod, circleIntegral_def_Icc]
  · refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun θ _ => ?_
    simp +unfoldPartialApp only [e, torusIntegral, ← integral_smul,
      deriv_circleMap, i.prod_univ_succAbove _, smul_smul, torusMap, circleMap_zero]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun Θ _ => ?_
    simp only [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, i.insertNth_apply_same,
      i.insertNth_apply_succAbove, (· ∘ ·), Fin.insertNthEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
    congr 2
    simp only [funext_iff, i.forall_iff_succAbove, circleMap, Fin.insertNth_apply_same,
      Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, imp_true_iff, and_self_iff]
  · have := hf.function_integrable
    rwa [← hem.integrableOn_comp_preimage e.measurableEmbedding, heπ] at this

name: torusIntegral_succ
statement:
theorem torusIntegral_succ
    {f : ℂⁿ⁺¹ → E} {c : ℂⁿ⁺¹} {R : ℝⁿ⁺¹} (hf : TorusIntegrable f c R) :
    (∯ x in T(c, R), f x) =
      ∮ x in C(c 0, R 0), ∯ y in T(c ∘ Fin.succ, R ∘ Fin.succ), f (Fin.cons x y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using torusIntegral_succAbove hf 0

name: circleTransformDeriv_periodic
statement:
theorem circleTransformDeriv_periodic (f : ℂ → E) :
    Periodic (circleTransformDeriv R z w f) (2 * π)
proof:
:= by
  simp [circleTransformDeriv, periodic_circleMap z R _, periodic_circleMap 0 R _]

name: circleTransformDeriv_eq
statement:
theorem circleTransformDeriv_eq (f : ℂ → E) : circleTransformDeriv R z w f =
    fun θ => (circleMap z R θ - w)⁻¹ • circleTransform R z w f θ
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp_rw [circleTransformDeriv, circleTransform, ← mul_smul, ← mul_assoc]
  ring_nf
  rw [inv_pow]
  congr
  ring

name: integral_circleTransform
statement:
theorem integral_circleTransform (f : ℂ → E) :
    (∫ θ : ℝ in 0..2 * π, circleTransform R z w f θ) =
      (2 * ↑π * I)⁻¹ • ∮ z in C(z, R), (z - w)⁻¹ • f z
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [circleTransform, circleIntegral, deriv_circleMap, circleMap]
  simp

name: continuous_circleTransform
proof:
:= by
  apply_rules [Continuous.smul, continuous_const]
  · rw [funext <| deriv_circleMap _ _]
    fun_prop
  · exact continuous_circleMap_inv hw
  · apply ContinuousOn.comp_continuous hf (continuous_circleMap z R)
    exact fun _ => (circleMap_mem_sphere _ hR.le) _

name: continuous_circleTransformDeriv
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleTransformDeriv_eq]
  exact (continuous_circleMap_inv hw).smul (continuous_circleTransform hR hf hw)

name: continuousOn_prod_circle_transform_function
statement:
theorem continuousOn_prod_circle_transform_function {R r : ℝ} (hr : r < R) {z : ℂ} :
    ContinuousOn (fun w : ℂ × ℝ => (circleMap z R w.snd - w.fst)⁻¹ ^ 2)
      (closedBall z r ×ˢ univ)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← one_div]
  apply_rules [ContinuousOn.pow, ContinuousOn.div, continuousOn_const]
  · exact ((continuous_circleMap z R).comp_continuousOn continuousOn_snd).sub continuousOn_fst
  · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨ha, -⟩
    have ha2 : a ∈ ball z R := closedBall_subset_ball hr ha
    exact sub_ne_zero.2 (circleMap_ne_mem_ball ha2 b)

name: continuousOn_norm_circleTransformBoundingFunction
statement:
theorem continuousOn_norm_circleTransformBoundingFunction {R r : ℝ} (hr : r < R) (z : ℂ) :
    ContinuousOn ((‖·‖) ∘ circleTransformBoundingFunction R z) (closedBall z r ×ˢ univ)
proof:
:= by
  have : ContinuousOn (circleTransformBoundingFunction R z) (closedBall z r ×ˢ univ) := by
    apply_rules [ContinuousOn.fun_smul, continuousOn_const]
    · simp only [deriv_circleMap]
      apply_rules [ContinuousOn.mul, (continuous_circleMap 0 R).comp_continuousOn continuousOn_snd,
        continuousOn_const]
    · simpa only [inv_pow] using continuousOn_prod_circle_transform_function hr
  exact this.norm

name: norm_circleTransformBoundingFunction_le
statement:
theorem norm_circleTransformBoundingFunction_le {R r : ℝ} (hr : r < R) (hr' : 0 ≤ r) (z : ℂ) :
    ∃ x : closedBall z r ×ˢ [[0, 2 * π]], ∀ y : closedBall z r ×ˢ [[0, 2 * π]],
    ‖circleTransformBoundingFunction R z y‖ ≤ ‖circleTransformBoundingFunction R z x‖
proof:
:= by
  have cts := continuousOn_norm_circleTransformBoundingFunction hr z
  have comp : IsCompact (closedBall z r ×ˢ [[0, 2 * π]]) := by
    apply_rules [IsCompact.prod, ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall z r, isCompact_uIcc]
  have none : (closedBall z r ×ˢ [[0, 2 * π]]).Nonempty :=
    (nonempty_closedBall.2 hr').prod nonempty_uIcc
  have := IsCompact.exists_isMaxOn comp none (cts.mono <| prod_mono_right (subset_univ _))
  simpa [isMaxOn_iff] using this

name: circleTransformDeriv_bound
statement:
theorem circleTransformDeriv_bound {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) {z x : ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hx : x ∈ ball z R)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (sphere z R)) : ∃ B ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ball x ε ⊆ ball z R ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ), ∀ y ∈ ball x ε, ‖circleTransformDeriv R z y f t‖ ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrx⟩ := exists_lt_mem_ball_of_mem_ball hx
  obtain ⟨ε', hε', H⟩ := exists_ball_subset_ball hrx
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨ha, hb⟩⟩, hab⟩ :=
    norm_circleTransformBoundingFunction_le hr (pos_of_mem_ball hrx).le z
  let V : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun θ w => circleTransformDeriv R z w (fun _ => 1) θ
  obtain ⟨X, -, HX2⟩ := (isCompact_sphere z R).exists_isMaxOn
    (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.2 hR.le) hf.norm
  refine ⟨‖V b a‖ * ‖f X‖, ε', hε', H.trans (ball_subset_ball hr.le), fun y v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y1, hy1, hfun⟩ :=
    Periodic.exists_mem_Ico₀ (circleTransformDeriv_periodic R z v f) Real.two_pi_pos y
  have hy2 : y1 ∈ [[0, 2 * π]] := Icc_subset_uIcc <| Ico_subset_Icc_self hy1
  simp only [isMaxOn_iff, mem_sphere_iff_norm] at HX2
  have := mul_le_mul (hab ⟨⟨v, y1⟩, ⟨ball_subset_closedBall (H hv), hy2⟩⟩)
    (HX2 (circleMap z R y1) (mem_sphere_iff_norm.1 (circleMap_mem_sphere z hR.le y1)))
    (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  rw [hfun]
  simpa [V, circleTransformBoundingFunction, circleTransformDeriv, mul_assoc] using this

name: laverage_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laverage_zero : ⨍⁻ _x, (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ = 0
proof: := by rw [laverage, lintegral_zero]

name: laverage_zero_measure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laverage_zero_measure (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂(0 : Measure α) = 0
proof: := by simp [laverage]

name: laverage_eq'
statement: theorem laverage_eq' (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, f x ∂(μ univ)⁻¹ • μ
proof: := rfl

name: laverage_eq
statement: theorem laverage_eq (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ = (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) / μ univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [laverage_eq', lintegral_smul_measure, ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul, smul_eq_mul]

name: laverage_eq_lintegral
statement:
theorem laverage_eq_lintegral [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ
proof: := by rw [laverage, measure_univ, inv_one, one_smul]

name: measure_mul_laverage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem measure_mul_laverage [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    μ univ * ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne μ 0 with hμ | hμ
  · rw [hμ, lintegral_zero_measure, laverage_zero_measure, mul_zero]
  · rw [laverage_eq, ENNReal.mul_div_cancel (measure_univ_ne_zero.2 hμ) (measure_ne_top _ _)]

name: setLAverage_eq
statement:
theorem setLAverage_eq (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (s : Set α) :
    ⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ = (∫⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ) / μ s
proof: := by rw [laverage_eq, restrict_apply_univ]

name: setLAverage_eq'
statement:
theorem setLAverage_eq' (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (s : Set α) :
    ⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, f x ∂(μ s)⁻¹ • μ.restrict s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laverage_eq', restrict_apply_univ]

name: laverage_congr
statement: theorem laverage_congr {f g : α → ℝ≥0∞} (h : f =ᵐ[μ] g) : ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ = ⨍⁻ x, g x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laverage_eq, lintegral_congr_ae h]

name: setLAverage_congr
statement: theorem setLAverage_congr (h : s =ᵐ[μ] t) : ⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ = ⨍⁻ x in t, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [setLAverage_eq, setLIntegral_congr h, measure_congr h]

name: setLAverage_congr_fun_ae
statement:
theorem setLAverage_congr_fun_ae (hs : MeasurableSet s) (h : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → f x = g x) :
    ⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ = ⨍⁻ x in s, g x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laverage_eq, setLIntegral_congr_fun_ae hs h]

name: setLAverage_congr_fun
statement:
theorem setLAverage_congr_fun (hs : MeasurableSet s) (h : EqOn f g s) :
    ⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ = ⨍⁻ x in s, g x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laverage_eq, setLIntegral_congr_fun hs h]

name: laverage_lt_top
statement: theorem laverage_lt_top (hf : ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ ≠ ∞) : ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ < ∞
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hμ := eq_or_ne μ 0
  · simp
  · rw [laverage_eq]
    finiteness [measure_univ_ne_zero.2 hμ]

name: setLAverage_lt_top
statement: theorem setLAverage_lt_top : ∫⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ ≠ ∞ → ⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ < ∞
proof:
:=
  laverage_lt_top

name: laverage_add_measure
statement:
theorem laverage_add_measure :
    ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂(μ + ν) =
      μ univ / (μ univ + ν univ) * ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ + ν univ / (μ univ + ν univ) * ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : IsFiniteMeasure μ; swap
  · rw [not_isFiniteMeasure_iff] at hμ
    simp [laverage_eq, hμ]
  by_cases hν : IsFiniteMeasure ν; swap
  · rw [not_isFiniteMeasure_iff] at hν
    simp [laverage_eq, hν]
  simp only [← ENNReal.mul_div_right_comm, measure_mul_laverage, ← ENNReal.add_div,
    ← lintegral_add_measure, ← Measure.add_apply, ← laverage_eq]

name: measure_mul_setLAverage
statement:
theorem measure_mul_setLAverage (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (h : μ s ≠ ∞) :
    μ s * ⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have := Fact.mk h.lt_top
  rw [← measure_mul_laverage, restrict_apply_univ]

name: laverage_union
statement:
theorem laverage_union (hd : AEDisjoint μ s t) (ht : NullMeasurableSet t μ) :
    ⨍⁻ x in s ∪ t, f x ∂μ =
      μ s / (μ s + μ t) * ⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ + μ t / (μ s + μ t) * ⨍⁻ x in t, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrict_union₀ hd ht, laverage_add_measure, restrict_apply_univ, restrict_apply_univ]

name: laverage_union_mem_openSegment
statement:
theorem laverage_union_mem_openSegment (hd : AEDisjoint μ s t) (ht : NullMeasurableSet t μ)
    (hs₀ : μ s ≠ 0) (ht₀ : μ t ≠ 0) (hsμ : μ s ≠ ∞) (htμ : μ t ≠ ∞) :
    ⨍⁻ x in s ∪ t, f x ∂μ ∈ openSegment ℝ≥0∞ (⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ) (⨍⁻ x in t, f x ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨μ s / (μ s + μ t), μ t / (μ s + μ t), ENNReal.div_pos hs₀ <| add_ne_top.2 ⟨hsμ, htμ⟩,
      ENNReal.div_pos ht₀ <| add_ne_top.2 ⟨hsμ, htμ⟩, ?_, (laverage_union hd ht).symm⟩
  rw [← ENNReal.add_div,
    ENNReal.div_self (add_eq_zero.not.2 fun h => hs₀ h.1) (add_ne_top.2 ⟨hsμ, htμ⟩)]

name: laverage_union_mem_segment
statement:
theorem laverage_union_mem_segment (hd : AEDisjoint μ s t) (ht : NullMeasurableSet t μ)
    (hsμ : μ s ≠ ∞) (htμ : μ t ≠ ∞) :
    ⨍⁻ x in s ∪ t, f x ∂μ ∈ [⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ -[ℝ≥0∞] ⨍⁻ x in t, f x ∂μ]
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs₀ : μ s = 0
  · rw [← ae_eq_empty] at hs₀
    rw [restrict_congr_set (hs₀.union EventuallyEq.rfl), empty_union]
    exact right_mem_segment _ _ _
  · refine
      ⟨μ s / (μ s + μ t), μ t / (μ s + μ t), zero_le, zero_le, ?_, (laverage_union hd ht).symm⟩
    rw [← ENNReal.add_div,
      ENNReal.div_self (add_eq_zero.not.2 fun h => hs₀ h.1) (add_ne_top.2 ⟨hsμ, htμ⟩)]

name: laverage_mem_openSegment_compl_self
statement:
theorem laverage_mem_openSegment_compl_self [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (hs₀ : μ s ≠ 0) (hsc₀ : μ sᶜ ≠ 0) :
    ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ ∈ openSegment ℝ≥0∞ (⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ) (⨍⁻ x in sᶜ, f x ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [union_compl_self, restrict_univ] using
    laverage_union_mem_openSegment aedisjoint_compl_right hs.compl hs₀ hsc₀ (measure_ne_top _ _)
      (measure_ne_top _ _)

name: laverage_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laverage_const (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [h : NeZero μ] (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    ⨍⁻ _x, c ∂μ = c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [laverage, lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]

name: setLAverage_const
statement: theorem setLAverage_const (hs₀ : μ s ≠ 0) (hs : μ s ≠ ∞) (c : ℝ≥0∞) : ⨍⁻ _x in s, c ∂μ = c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [setLAverage_eq, lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply, MeasurableSet.univ,
    univ_inter, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hs₀ hs, mul_one]

name: laverage_one
statement: theorem laverage_one [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [NeZero μ] : ⨍⁻ _x, (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ = 1
proof:
:=
  laverage_const _ _

name: setLAverage_one
statement: theorem setLAverage_one (hs₀ : μ s ≠ 0) (hs : μ s ≠ ∞) : ⨍⁻ _x in s, (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ = 1
proof:
:=
  setLAverage_const hs₀ hs _

name: laverage_mul_measure_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laverage_mul_measure_univ (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (⨍⁻ (a : α), f a ∂μ) * μ univ = ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hμ := eq_or_ne μ 0
  · simp
  · rw [laverage_eq, ENNReal.div_mul_cancel (measure_univ_ne_zero.2 hμ) (measure_ne_top _ _)]

name: lintegral_laverage
statement:
theorem lintegral_laverage (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∫⁻ _x, ⨍⁻ a, f a ∂μ ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: setLIntegral_setLAverage
statement:
theorem setLIntegral_setLAverage (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (s : Set α) :
    ∫⁻ _x in s, ⨍⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ
proof:
:=
  lintegral_laverage _ _

name: laverage_mono_ae
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem laverage_mono_ae (h : f ≤ᶠ[ae μ] g) :
    ⨍⁻ a, f a ∂μ ≤ ⨍⁻ a, g a ∂μ
proof:
:=
  lintegral_mono_ae <| h.filter_mono <| Measure.ae_mono' Measure.smul_absolutelyContinuous

name: setLAverage_mono_ae
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem setLAverage_mono_ae (s : Set α) (h : f ≤ᶠ[ae μ] g) :
    ⨍⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ ≤ ⨍⁻ a in s, g a ∂μ
proof:
:=
  laverage_mono_ae <| h.filter_mono <| ae_mono Measure.restrict_le_self

name: setLAverage_le_essSup
statement: theorem setLAverage_le_essSup (s : Set α) (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ ≤ essSup f μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict s); swap
  · simp [laverage, not_isFiniteMeasure_iff.mp hμ]
  by_cases hμ0 : μ s = 0
  · rw [laverage, ← setLIntegral_univ]
    exact le_of_eq_of_le (setLIntegral_measure_zero univ f <| by simp [hμ0]) zero_le
  apply le_of_le_of_eq (laverage_mono_ae <| Eventually.filter_mono ae_restrict_le ae_le_essSup)
  have : NeZero (μ.restrict s) :=
    have : NeZero (μ s) := { out := hμ0 }
    restrict.neZero
  exact laverage_const (μ.restrict s) _

name: laverage_le_essSup
statement: theorem laverage_le_essSup (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ ≤ essSup f μ
proof:
:= by
  simpa using setLAverage_le_essSup univ f

name: average_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem average_zero : ⨍ _, (0 : E) ∂μ = 0
proof: := by rw [average, integral_zero]

name: average_zero_measure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem average_zero_measure (f : α → E) : ⨍ x, f x ∂(0 : Measure α) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [average, smul_zero, integral_zero_measure]

name: average_add
statement:
@[to_fun average_fun_add]
lemma average_add (hf : Integrable f μ) (hg : Integrable g μ) :
    ⨍ a, (f + g) a ∂μ = ⨍ a, f a ∂μ + ⨍ a, g a ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hμ := eq_or_ne μ 0
  · simp
  · exact integral_add (hf.smul_measure <| by simpa) (hg.smul_measure <| by simpa)

name: setAverage_add
statement:
@[to_fun setAverage_fun_add]
lemma setAverage_add (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ) (hg : IntegrableOn g s μ) :
    ⨍ a in s, (f + g) a ∂μ = ⨍ a in s, f a ∂μ + ⨍ a in s, g a ∂μ
proof: := average_add hf hg

name: average_finsetSum
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hμ := eq_or_ne μ 0
  · simp
  · simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    exact integral_finsetSum _ fun i hi ↦ (hf _ hi).smul_measure <| by simpa

name: setAverage_finsetSum
statement:
@[to_fun setAverage_fun_finsetSum]
lemma setAverage_finsetSum {ι : Type*} {t : Finset ι} {f : ι → α → E}
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, IntegrableOn (f i) s μ) :
    ⨍ a in s, (∑ i ∈ t, f i) a ∂μ = ∑ i ∈ t, ⨍ a in s, f i a ∂μ
proof: := average_finsetSum hf

name: average_neg
statement:
@[to_fun average_fun_neg]
lemma average_neg : ⨍ x, (-f) x ∂μ = -⨍ x, f x ∂μ
proof: := integral_neg f

name: average_sub
statement:
@[to_fun average_fun_sub]
lemma average_sub (hf : Integrable f μ) (hg : Integrable g μ) :
    ⨍ a, (f - g) a ∂μ = ⨍ a, f a ∂μ - ⨍ a, g a ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, average_add hf hg.neg, average_neg]

name: setAverage_sub
statement:
@[to_fun setAverage_fun_sub]
lemma setAverage_sub (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ) (hg : IntegrableOn g s μ) :
    ⨍ a in s, (f - g) a ∂μ = ⨍ a in s, f a ∂μ - ⨍ a in s, g a ∂μ
proof: := average_sub hf hg

name: average_const_mul
statement:
lemma average_const_mul {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (r : 𝕜) (f : α → 𝕜) :
    ⨍ a, r * f a ∂μ = r * ⨍ a, f a ∂μ
proof: := integral_const_mul ..

name: average_mul_const
statement:
lemma average_mul_const {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (f : α → 𝕜) (r : 𝕜) :
    ⨍ a, f a * r ∂μ = (⨍ a, f a ∂μ) * r
proof: := integral_mul_const ..

name: average_const_smul
statement:
lemma average_const_smul {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (r : 𝕜) (f : α → E) :
    ⨍ a, r • f a ∂μ = r • ⨍ a, f a ∂μ
proof: := integral_smul ..

name: average_smul_const
statement:
lemma average_smul_const {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (f : α → 𝕜) (c : E) : ⨍ a, f a • c ∂μ = (⨍ a, f a ∂μ) • c
proof: := integral_smul_const ..

name: average_eq'
statement: theorem average_eq' : ⨍ x, f x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂(μ univ)⁻¹ • μ
proof: := rfl

name: average_eq
statement: theorem average_eq : ⨍ x, f x ∂μ = (μ.real univ)⁻¹ • ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [average_eq', integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_inv, measureReal_def]

name: average_eq_integral
statement: theorem average_eq_integral [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] : ⨍ x, f x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [average, measure_univ, inv_one, one_smul]

name: measure_smul_average
statement:
@[simp]
theorem measure_smul_average [IsFiniteMeasure μ] : μ.real univ • ⨍ x, f x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne μ 0 with hμ | hμ
  · rw [hμ, integral_zero_measure, average_zero_measure, smul_zero]
  · rw [average_eq, smul_inv_smul₀]
    refine (ENNReal.toReal_pos ?_ <| measure_ne_top _ _).ne'
    rwa [Ne, measure_univ_eq_zero]

name: setAverage_eq
statement: theorem setAverage_eq (s : Set α) : ⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ = (μ.real s)⁻¹ • ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [average_eq, measureReal_restrict_apply_univ]

name: setAverage_eq'
statement: theorem setAverage_eq' (s : Set α) : ⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂(μ s)⁻¹ • μ.restrict s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [average_eq', restrict_apply_univ]

name: average_congr
statement: theorem average_congr (h : f =ᵐ[μ] g) : ⨍ x, f x ∂μ = ⨍ x, g x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [average_eq, integral_congr_ae h]

name: setAverage_congr
statement: theorem setAverage_congr (h : s =ᵐ[μ] t) : ⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ = ⨍ x in t, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [setAverage_eq, setIntegral_congr_set h, measureReal_congr h]

name: setAverage_congr_fun
statement:
theorem setAverage_congr_fun (hs : MeasurableSet s) (h : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → f x = g x) :
    ⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ = ⨍ x in s, g x ∂μ
proof: := by simp only [average_eq, setIntegral_congr_ae hs h]

name: average_add_measure
statement:
theorem average_add_measure [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {f : α → E}
    (hμ : Integrable f μ) (hν : Integrable f ν) :
    ⨍ x, f x ∂(μ + ν) =
      (μ.real univ / (μ.real univ + ν.real univ)) • ⨍ x, f x ∂μ +
        (ν.real univ / (μ.real univ + ν.real univ)) • ⨍ x, f x ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  simp only [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, measure_smul_average, ← smul_add,
    ← integral_add_measure hμ hν]
  rw [average_eq, measureReal_add_apply]

name: average_pair
statement:
theorem average_pair [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : α → E} {g : α → F} (hfi : Integrable f μ) (hgi : Integrable g μ) :
    ⨍ x, (f x, g x) ∂μ = (⨍ x, f x ∂μ, ⨍ x, g x ∂μ)
proof:
:=
  integral_pair hfi.to_average hgi.to_average

name: measure_smul_setAverage
statement:
theorem measure_smul_setAverage (f : α → E) {s : Set α} (h : μ s ≠ ∞) :
    μ.real s • ⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ = ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have := Fact.mk h.lt_top
  rw [← measure_smul_average, measureReal_restrict_apply_univ]

name: average_union
statement:
theorem average_union {f : α → E} {s t : Set α} (hd : AEDisjoint μ s t) (ht : NullMeasurableSet t μ)
    (hsμ : μ s ≠ ∞) (htμ : μ t ≠ ∞) (hfs : IntegrableOn f s μ) (hft : IntegrableOn f t μ) :
    ⨍ x in s ∪ t, f x ∂μ =
      (μ.real s / (μ.real s + μ.real t)) • ⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ +
        (μ.real t / (μ.real s + μ.real t)) • ⨍ x in t, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have := Fact.mk hsμ.lt_top; have := Fact.mk htμ.lt_top
  rw [restrict_union₀ hd ht, average_add_measure hfs hft, measureReal_restrict_apply_univ,
    measureReal_restrict_apply_univ]

name: average_union_mem_openSegment
statement:
theorem average_union_mem_openSegment {f : α → E} {s t : Set α} (hd : AEDisjoint μ s t)
    (ht : NullMeasurableSet t μ) (hs₀ : μ s ≠ 0) (ht₀ : μ t ≠ 0) (hsμ : μ s ≠ ∞) (htμ : μ t ≠ ∞)
    (hfs : IntegrableOn f s μ) (hft : IntegrableOn f t μ) :
    ⨍ x in s ∪ t, f x ∂μ ∈ openSegment ℝ (⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ) (⨍ x in t, f x ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  replace hs₀ : 0 < μ.real s := ENNReal.toReal_pos hs₀ hsμ
  replace ht₀ : 0 < μ.real t := ENNReal.toReal_pos ht₀ htμ
  exact mem_openSegment_iff_div.mpr
    ⟨μ.real s, μ.real t, hs₀, ht₀, (average_union hd ht hsμ htμ hfs hft).symm⟩

name: average_union_mem_segment
statement:
theorem average_union_mem_segment {f : α → E} {s t : Set α} (hd : AEDisjoint μ s t)
    (ht : NullMeasurableSet t μ) (hsμ : μ s ≠ ∞) (htμ : μ t ≠ ∞) (hfs : IntegrableOn f s μ)
    (hft : IntegrableOn f t μ) :
    ⨍ x in s ∪ t, f x ∂μ ∈ [⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ -[ℝ] ⨍ x in t, f x ∂μ]
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hse : μ s = 0
  · rw [← ae_eq_empty] at hse
    rw [restrict_congr_set (hse.union EventuallyEq.rfl), empty_union]
    exact right_mem_segment _ _ _
  · refine
      mem_segment_iff_div.mpr
        ⟨μ.real s, μ.real t, ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ?_,
          (average_union hd ht hsμ htμ hfs hft).symm⟩
    calc
      0 < μ.real s := ENNReal.toReal_pos hse hsμ
      _ ≤ _ := le_add_of_nonneg_right ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: average_mem_openSegment_compl_self
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [union_compl_self, restrict_univ] using
    average_union_mem_openSegment aedisjoint_compl_right hs.compl hs₀ hsc₀ (measure_ne_top _ _)
      (measure_ne_top _ _) hfi.integrableOn hfi.integrableOn

name: average_count
statement:
@[simp] lemma average_count [Module ℚ≥0 E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    [Fintype α] (f : α → E) : ⨍ a, f a ∂.count = 𝔼 a, f a
proof:
:= by
  simp [average, Finset.expect, ← NNRat.cast_smul_eq_nnqsmul ℝ]

name: average_nonneg_of_ae
statement: lemma average_nonneg_of_ae (hf : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) : 0 ≤ ⨍ a, f a ∂μ
proof:
:=
  integral_nonneg_of_ae <| hf.filter_mono <| Measure.ae_smul_measure_le _

name: average_nonneg
statement: lemma average_nonneg (hf : 0 ≤ f) : 0 ≤ ⨍ a, f a ∂μ
proof: := integral_nonneg hf

name: average_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem average_const (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [h : NeZero μ] (c : E) :
    ⨍ _x, c ∂μ = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [average, integral_const, measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul]

name: setAverage_const
statement:
theorem setAverage_const {s : Set α} (hs₀ : μ s ≠ 0) (hs : μ s ≠ ∞) (c : E) :
    ⨍ _ in s, c ∂μ = c
proof:
:=
  have := NeZero.mk hs₀; have := Fact.mk hs.lt_top; average_const _ _

name: integral_average
statement:
theorem integral_average (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → E) :
    ∫ _, ⨍ a, f a ∂μ ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof: := by simp

name: setIntegral_setAverage
statement:
theorem setIntegral_setAverage (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → E) (s : Set α) :
    ∫ _ in s, ⨍ a in s, f a ∂μ ∂μ = ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ
proof:
:=
  integral_average _ _

name: integral_sub_average
statement:
theorem integral_sub_average (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : α → E) :
    ∫ x, f x - ⨍ a, f a ∂μ ∂μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Integrable f μ
  · rw [integral_sub hf (integrable_const _), integral_average, sub_self]
  refine integral_undef fun h => hf ?_
  convert! h.add (integrable_const (⨍ a, f a ∂μ))
  exact (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm

name: setAverage_sub_setAverage
statement:
theorem setAverage_sub_setAverage (hs : μ s ≠ ∞) (f : α → E) :
    ∫ x in s, f x - ⨍ a in s, f a ∂μ ∂μ = 0
proof:
:=
  haveI : Fact (μ s < ∞) := ⟨lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hs⟩
  integral_sub_average _ _

name: integral_average_sub
statement:
theorem integral_average_sub [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    ∫ x, ⨍ a, f a ∂μ - f x ∂μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) hf, integral_average, sub_self]

name: setIntegral_setAverage_sub
statement:
theorem setIntegral_setAverage_sub (hs : μ s ≠ ∞) (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ) :
    ∫ x in s, ⨍ a in s, f a ∂μ - f x ∂μ = 0
proof:
:=
  haveI : Fact (μ s < ∞) := ⟨lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hs⟩
  integral_average_sub hf

name: ofReal_average
statement:
theorem ofReal_average {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) (hf₀ : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (⨍ x, f x ∂μ) = (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂μ) / μ univ
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hμ := eq_or_ne μ 0
  · simp
  · rw [average_eq, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def, ← toReal_inv, ofReal_mul toReal_nonneg,
      ofReal_toReal (inv_ne_top.2 <| measure_univ_ne_zero.2 hμ),
      ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hf hf₀, ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul]

name: ofReal_setAverage
statement:
theorem ofReal_setAverage {f : α → ℝ} (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ) (hf₀ : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ.restrict s] f) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (⨍ x in s, f x ∂μ) = (∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂μ) / μ s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using ofReal_average hf hf₀

name: toReal_laverage
statement:
theorem toReal_laverage {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (hf' : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ≠ ∞) :
    (⨍⁻ x, f x ∂μ).toReal = ⨍ x, (f x).toReal ∂μ
proof:
:= by
    rw [average_eq, laverage_eq, smul_eq_mul, toReal_div, div_eq_inv_mul, ←
      integral_toReal hf (hf'.mono fun _ => lt_top_iff_ne_top.2), measureReal_def]

name: toReal_setLAverage
statement:
theorem toReal_setLAverage {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f (μ.restrict s))
    (hf' : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s, f x ≠ ∞) :
    (⨍⁻ x in s, f x ∂μ).toReal = ⨍ x in s, (f x).toReal ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [laverage_eq] using toReal_laverage hf hf'

name: measure_le_setAverage_pos
statement:
theorem measure_le_setAverage_pos (hμ : μ s ≠ 0) (hμ₁ : μ s ≠ ∞) (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ) :
    0 < μ ({x ∈ s | f x ≤ ⨍ a in s, f a ∂μ})
proof:
:= by
  refine pos_iff_ne_zero.2 fun H => ?_
  replace H : (μ.restrict s) {x | f x ≤ ⨍ a in s, f a ∂μ} = 0 := by
    rwa [restrict_apply₀, inter_comm]
    exact AEStronglyMeasurable.nullMeasurableSet_le hf.1 aestronglyMeasurable_const
  have := Fact.mk hμ₁.lt_top
  refine (integral_sub_average (μ.restrict s) f).not_gt ?_
  refine (setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae ?_ ?_).2 ?_
  · refine measure_mono_null (fun x hx ↦ ?_) H
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, sub_nonneg, mem_compl_iff, mem_ofPred_eq, not_le] at hx
    exact hx.le
  · exact hf.sub (integrableOn_const hμ₁)
  · rwa [pos_iff_ne_zero, inter_comm, ← sdiff_compl, ← sdiff_inter_self_eq_sdiff,
      measure_sdiff_null]
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_inter_eq_zero_of_restrict H)
    exact inter_subset_inter_left _ fun a ha => (sub_eq_zero.1 <| of_not_not ha).le

name: measure_setAverage_le_pos
statement:
theorem measure_setAverage_le_pos (hμ : μ s ≠ 0) (hμ₁ : μ s ≠ ∞) (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ) :
    0 < μ ({x ∈ s | ⨍ a in s, f a ∂μ ≤ f x})
proof:
:= by
  simpa [integral_neg, neg_div] using measure_le_setAverage_pos hμ hμ₁ hf.neg

name: exists_le_setAverage
statement:
theorem exists_le_setAverage (hμ : μ s ≠ 0) (hμ₁ : μ s ≠ ∞) (hf : IntegrableOn f s μ) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, f x ≤ ⨍ a in s, f a ∂μ
proof:
:=
  let ⟨x, hx, h⟩ := nonempty_of_measure_ne_zero (measure_le_setAverage_pos hμ hμ₁ hf).ne'
  ⟨x, hx, h⟩

name: exists_setAverage_le
statement:

name: measure_le_setLAverage_pos
statement:
theorem measure_le_setLAverage_pos (hμ : μ s ≠ 0) (hμ₁ : μ s ≠ ∞)
    (hf : AEMeasurable f (μ.restrict s)) : 0 < μ {x ∈ s | f x ≤ ⨍⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ}
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := eq_or_ne (∫⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ) ∞
  · simpa [mul_top, hμ₁, laverage, h, top_div_of_ne_top hμ₁, pos_iff_ne_zero] using hμ
  have := measure_le_setAverage_pos hμ hμ₁ (integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top hf h)
  rw [← ofPred_inter_eq_sep, ← Measure.restrict_apply₀
    (hf.aestronglyMeasurable.nullMeasurableSet_le aestronglyMeasurable_const)]
  rw [← ofPred_inter_eq_sep, ← Measure.restrict_apply₀
    (hf.ennreal_toReal.aestronglyMeasurable.nullMeasurableSet_le aestronglyMeasurable_const),
    ← measure_sdiff_null (measure_eq_top_of_lintegral_ne_top hf h)] at this
  refine this.trans_le (measure_mono ?_)
  rintro x ⟨hfx, hx⟩
  dsimp at hfx
  rwa [← toReal_laverage hf, toReal_le_toReal hx (setLAverage_lt_top h).ne] at hfx
  simp_rw [ae_iff, not_ne_iff]
  exact measure_eq_top_of_lintegral_ne_top hf h

name: measure_setLAverage_le_pos
statement:
theorem measure_setLAverage_le_pos (hμ : μ s ≠ 0) (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ)
    (hint : ∫⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ ≠ ∞) : 0 < μ {x ∈ s | ⨍⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ ≤ f x}
proof:
:= by
  obtain hμ₁ | hμ₁ := eq_or_ne (μ s) ∞
  · simp [setLAverage_eq, hμ₁]
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgf, hfg⟩ := exists_measurable_le_lintegral_eq (μ.restrict s) f
  have hfg' : ⨍⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ = ⨍⁻ a in s, g a ∂μ := by simp_rw [laverage_eq, hfg]
  rw [hfg] at hint
  have :=
    measure_setAverage_le_pos hμ hμ₁ (integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top hg.aemeasurable hint)
  simp_rw [← ofPred_inter_eq_sep, ← Measure.restrict_apply₀' hs, hfg']
  rw [← ofPred_inter_eq_sep, ← Measure.restrict_apply₀' hs, ←
    measure_sdiff_null (measure_eq_top_of_lintegral_ne_top hg.aemeasurable hint)] at this
  refine this.trans_le (measure_mono ?_)
  rintro x ⟨hfx, hx⟩
  dsimp at hfx
  rw [← toReal_laverage hg.aemeasurable, toReal_le_toReal (setLAverage_lt_top hint).ne hx] at hfx
  · exact hfx.trans (hgf _)
  · simp_rw [ae_iff, not_ne_iff]
    exact measure_eq_top_of_lintegral_ne_top hg.aemeasurable hint
