name: charFun_eq_integral_innerProbChar
statement: lemma charFun_eq_integral_innerProbChar : charFun μ t = ∫ v, innerProbChar t v ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [charFun_apply, innerProbChar_apply]

name: charFun_eq_integral_probChar
statement: lemma charFun_eq_integral_probChar (t : E) : charFun μ t = ∫ x, (probChar ⟪x, t⟫ : ℂ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [charFun_apply, probChar_apply]

name: charFun_eq_fourierIntegral
statement:
lemma charFun_eq_fourierIntegral (t : E) :
    charFun μ t = VectorFourier.fourierIntegral probChar μ (innerₗ E) 1 (-t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [charFun_apply, VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_probChar]

name: charFun_eq_fourierIntegral'
statement:
lemma charFun_eq_fourierIntegral' (t : E) :
    charFun μ t
      = VectorFourier.fourierIntegral fourierChar μ (innerₗ E) 1 (-(2 * π)⁻¹ • t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [charFun_apply, VectorFourier.fourierIntegral, neg_smul,
    innerₗ_apply_apply, inner_neg_right, inner_smul_right, neg_neg,
    fourierChar_apply', Pi.ofNat_apply, Circle.smul_def, Circle.coe_exp, ofReal_mul, ofReal_ofNat,
    ofReal_inv, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  congr with x
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by simp [pi_ne_zero]), one_mul]

name: norm_charFun_le
statement: lemma norm_charFun_le (t : E) : ‖charFun μ t‖ ≤ μ.real Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_eq_fourierIntegral]
  exact (VectorFourier.norm_fourierIntegral_le_integral_norm _ _ _ _ _).trans_eq (by simp)

name: norm_charFun_le_one
statement: lemma norm_charFun_le_one [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (t : E) : ‖charFun μ t‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (norm_charFun_le _).trans_eq (by simp)

name: norm_one_sub_charFun_le_two
statement: lemma norm_one_sub_charFun_le_two [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] : ‖1 - charFun μ t‖ ≤ 2
proof:
:=
  calc ‖1 - charFun μ t‖
  _ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖charFun μ t‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
  _ ≤ 1 + 1 := by simp [norm_charFun_le_one]
  _ = 2 := by norm_num

name: stronglyMeasurable_charFun
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma stronglyMeasurable_charFun [OpensMeasurableSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] [SFinite μ] :
    StronglyMeasurable (charFun μ)
proof:
:=
  (Measurable.stronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop)).integral_prod_left

name: measurable_charFun
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_charFun [OpensMeasurableSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] [SFinite μ] :
    Measurable (charFun μ)
proof:
:=
  stronglyMeasurable_charFun.measurable

name: intervalIntegrable_charFun
statement:
lemma intervalIntegrable_charFun {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} :
    IntervalIntegrable (charFun μ) volume a b
proof:
:=
  IntervalIntegrable.mono_fun' (g := fun _ ↦ μ.real Set.univ) (by simp)
    stronglyMeasurable_charFun.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ norm_charFun_le)

name: charFun_map_eq_charFun_map_inner_one
statement:
lemma charFun_map_eq_charFun_map_inner_one {α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [BorelSpace E]
  {μ : Measure α} {Y : α → E} (hY : AEMeasurable Y μ) (t : E) :
  charFun (μ.map Y) t = charFun (μ.map (⟪Y ·, t⟫)) (1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_apply, charFun_apply_real, integral_map, integral_map]
  · simp
  all_goals fun_prop

name: charFun_map_smul
statement:
lemma charFun_map_smul [BorelSpace E] (r : ℝ) (t : E) :
    charFun (μ.map (r • ·)) t = charFun μ (r • t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_apply, charFun_apply,
    integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  simp_rw [inner_smul_right, ← real_inner_smul_left]

name: charFun_map_smul_comp
statement:
lemma charFun_map_smul_comp {X : Type*} {mX : MeasurableSpace X} {μ : Measure X} [BorelSpace E]
    {f : X → E} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (r : ℝ) (t : E) :
    charFun (μ.map (fun x ↦ r • (f x))) t = charFun (μ.map f) (r • t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (fun x ↦ r • (f x)) = (r • ·) ∘ f from rfl, ← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable,
    charFun_map_smul]
  all_goals fun_prop

name: charFun_map_mul
statement:
lemma charFun_map_mul {μ : Measure ℝ} (r t : ℝ) :
    charFun (μ.map (r * ·)) t = charFun μ (r * t)
proof: := charFun_map_smul r t

name: charFun_map_mul_comp
proof:
:=
  charFun_map_smul_comp hf r t

name: charFun_dirac
statement:
@[simp]
lemma charFun_dirac [OpensMeasurableSpace E] {x : E} (t : E) :
    charFun (Measure.dirac x) t = cexp (⟪x, t⟫ * I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_apply, integral_dirac]

name: charFun_map_add_const
statement:
lemma charFun_map_add_const [BorelSpace E] (r t : E) :
    charFun (μ.map (· + r)) t = charFun μ t * cexp (⟪r, t⟫ * I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_apply, charFun_apply, integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
    ← integral_mul_const]
  congr with a
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  congr
  rw [inner_add_left]
  simp only [ofReal_add]
  ring

name: charFun_map_const_add
statement:
lemma charFun_map_const_add [BorelSpace E] (r t : E) :
    charFun (μ.map (r + ·)) t = charFun μ t * cexp (⟪r, t⟫ * I)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [add_comm r]
  exact charFun_map_add_const _ _

name: Measure.ext_of_charFun
statement:
theorem Measure.ext_of_charFun [CompleteSpace E]
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (h : charFun μ = charFun ν) :
    μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [funext_iff, charFun_eq_integral_innerProbChar] at h
  refine ext_of_integral_char_eq continuous_probChar probChar_ne_one (L := innerₗ E)
    ?_ ?_ h
  · exact fun v hv ↦ DFunLike.ne_iff.mpr ⟨v, inner_self_ne_zero.mpr hv⟩
  · exact continuous_inner

name: charFun_conv
statement:
lemma charFun_conv [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (t : E) :
    charFun (μ ∗ ν) t = charFun μ t * charFun ν t
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [charFun_apply]
  rw [integral_conv]
  · simp [inner_add_left, add_mul, Complex.exp_add, integral_const_mul, integral_mul_const]
  · exact (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono (by fun_prop) (by simp)

name: charFun_prod
statement:
lemma charFun_prod {μ : Measure E} {ν : Measure F} [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    (t : WithLp 2 (E × F)) :
    charFun ((μ.prod ν).map (toLp 2)) t =
      charFun μ (ofLp t).1 * charFun ν (ofLp t).2
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [charFun, prod_inner_apply, ← MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp, ← integral_prod_mul,
    integral_map_equiv]
  simp [ofReal_add, add_mul, Complex.exp_add]

name: charFun_eq_prod_iff
statement:
lemma charFun_eq_prod_iff {μ : Measure E} {ν : Measure F} {ξ : Measure (E × F)}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure ξ] :
    (∀ t, charFun (ξ.map (toLp 2)) t = charFun μ (ofLp t).1 * charFun ν (ofLp t).2) ↔
    ξ = μ.prod ν where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    refine (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (E × F)).map_measurableEquiv_injective
      <| Measure.ext_of_charFun <| funext fun t ↦ ?_
    rw [MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp, h, charFun_prod]
  mpr h := by rw [h]; exact charFun_prod

name: charFun_pi
statement:
lemma charFun_pi {μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)} [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)] (t : PiLp 2 E) :
    charFun ((Measure.pi μ).map (toLp 2)) t = ∏ i, charFun (μ i) (t i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [charFun, PiLp.inner_apply, ← MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp, ← integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod,
    integral_map_equiv]
  simp [ofReal_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Complex.exp_sum]

name: charFun_eq_pi_iff
statement:
lemma charFun_eq_pi_iff {μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)} {ν : Measure (Π i, E i)}
    [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    (∀ t, charFun (ν.map (toLp 2)) t = ∏ i, charFun (μ i) (t i)) ↔ ν = Measure.pi μ where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    refine (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Π i, E i)).map_measurableEquiv_injective
      <| Measure.ext_of_charFun <| funext fun t ↦ ?_
    rw [MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp, h, charFun_pi]
  mpr h := by rw [h]; exact charFun_pi

name: charFunDual_apply
statement: lemma charFunDual_apply (L : StrongDual ℝ E) : charFunDual μ L = ∫ v, exp (L v * I) ∂μ
proof: := rfl

name: charFunDual_eq_charFun_map_one
statement:
lemma charFunDual_eq_charFun_map_one [OpensMeasurableSpace E] (L : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    charFunDual μ L = charFun (μ.map L) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFunDual_apply]
  have : ∫ x, cexp (L x * I) ∂μ = ∫ x, cexp (x * I) ∂(μ.map L) := by
    rw [integral_map]
    · fun_prop
    · exact Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable <| by fun_prop
  rw [this, charFun_apply]
  simp

name: charFun_map_eq_charFunDual_smul
statement:
lemma charFun_map_eq_charFunDual_smul [OpensMeasurableSpace E] (L : StrongDual ℝ E) (u : ℝ) :
    charFun (μ.map L) u = charFunDual μ (u • L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFunDual_apply]
  have : ∫ x, cexp ((u • L) x * I) ∂μ = ∫ x, cexp (u * x * I) ∂(μ.map L) := by
    rw [integral_map]
    · simp
    · fun_prop
    · exact Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable <| by fun_prop
  rw [this, charFun_apply]
  simp

name: charFun_eq_charFunDual_toDualMap
statement:
lemma charFun_eq_charFunDual_toDualMap {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    {mE : MeasurableSpace E} {μ : Measure E} (t : E) :
    charFun μ t = charFunDual μ (InnerProductSpace.toDualMap ℝ E t)
proof:
:= by
  simp [charFunDual_apply, charFun_apply, real_inner_comm]

name: charFun_toDual_symm_eq_charFunDual
statement:
@[simp]
lemma charFun_toDual_symm_eq_charFunDual {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {mE : MeasurableSpace E} {μ : Measure E} (L : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    charFun μ ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E).symm L) = charFunDual μ L
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_eq_charFunDual_toDualMap, ← InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_eq_toDualMap_apply]
  simp

name: charFunDual_map
statement:
lemma charFunDual_map [OpensMeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace F] (L : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (L' : StrongDual ℝ F) : charFunDual (μ.map L) L' = charFunDual μ (L'.comp L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFunDual_eq_charFun_map_one, charFunDual_eq_charFun_map_one,
    Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp]

name: charFunDual_dirac
statement:
@[simp]
lemma charFunDual_dirac [OpensMeasurableSpace E] {x : E} (L : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    charFunDual (Measure.dirac x) L = cexp (L x * I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFunDual_apply, integral_dirac]

name: charFunDual_map_add_const
statement:
lemma charFunDual_map_add_const [BorelSpace E] (r : E) (L : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    charFunDual (μ.map (· + r)) L = charFunDual μ L * cexp (L r * I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFunDual_apply, charFunDual_apply, integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
    ← integral_mul_const]
  congr with a
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  congr
  simp only [map_add, ofReal_add]
  ring

name: charFunDual_map_const_add
statement:
lemma charFunDual_map_const_add [BorelSpace E] (r : E) (L : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    charFunDual (μ.map (r + ·)) L = charFunDual μ L * cexp (L r * I)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [add_comm r]
  exact charFunDual_map_add_const _ _

name: charFunDual_prod
statement:
lemma charFunDual_prod [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] (L : StrongDual ℝ (E × F)) :
    charFunDual (μ.prod ν) L
      = charFunDual μ (L.comp (.inl ℝ E F)) * charFunDual ν (L.comp (.inr ℝ E F))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [charFunDual_apply, ← L.comp_inl_add_comp_inr, ofReal_add, add_mul,
    Complex.exp_add, ← integral_prod_mul]

name: charFunDual_prod'
statement:
lemma charFunDual_prod' (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    (L : StrongDual ℝ (WithLp p (E × F))) :
    charFunDual ((μ.prod ν).map (toLp p)) L =
      charFunDual μ (L.comp
        ((prodContinuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E F).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
          (.inl ℝ E F))) *
      charFunDual ν (L.comp
        ((prodContinuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E F).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
          (.inr ℝ E F)))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [charFunDual_apply, ← integral_prod_mul, ← Complex.exp_add, ← add_mul, ← ofReal_add,
    L.comp_apply, ← map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_inl_add_comp_inr]
  rw [← MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp, integral_map_equiv]
  simp

name: charFunDual_pi
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [charFunDual_apply, ← L.sum_comp_single, ofReal_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Complex.exp_sum,
    ← integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod]

name: charFunDual_pi'
statement:
lemma charFunDual_pi' (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {E : ι → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (E i)]
    {mE : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)} {μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)} [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)]
    (L : StrongDual ℝ (PiLp p E)) :
    charFunDual ((Measure.pi μ).map (toLp p)) L =
      ∏ i, charFunDual (μ i) (L.comp
        ((PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (.single ℝ E i)))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [charFunDual_apply, ← integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod, ← Complex.exp_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul,
    ← ofReal_sum, L.comp_apply, ← map_sum, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_comp_single]
  rw [← MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp, integral_map_equiv]
  simp

name: Measure.ext_of_charFunDual
statement:
theorem Measure.ext_of_charFunDual [CompleteSpace E]
    {μ ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h : charFunDual μ = charFunDual ν) :
    μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of_integral_char_eq continuous_probChar probChar_ne_one
    ?_ ?_ (fun L ↦ funext_iff.mp h L)
  · exact fun v hv ↦ DFunLike.ne_iff.mpr <| SeparatingDual.exists_ne_zero hv
  · exact isBoundedBilinearMap_apply.symm.continuous

name: charFunDual_eq_prod_iff
statement:
lemma charFunDual_eq_prod_iff [BorelSpace F] [SecondCountableTopology F] [CompleteSpace E]
    [CompleteSpace F] {ξ : Measure (E × F)} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    [IsFiniteMeasure ξ] :
    (∀ L, charFunDual ξ L =
      charFunDual μ (L.comp (.inl ℝ E F)) * charFunDual ν (L.comp (.inr ℝ E F))) ↔
    ξ = μ.prod ν where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    refine Measure.ext_of_charFunDual <| funext fun t ↦ ?_
    rw [h, charFunDual_prod]
  mpr h := by rw [h]; exact charFunDual_prod

name: charFunDual_eq_prod_iff'
statement:
lemma charFunDual_eq_prod_iff' (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] [BorelSpace F]
    [SecondCountableTopology F] [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] {ξ : Measure (E × F)}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure ξ] :
    (∀ L, charFunDual (ξ.map (toLp p)) L =
      charFunDual μ (L.comp
        ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E F).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
          (.inl ℝ E F))) *
      charFunDual ν (L.comp
        ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E F).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
          (.inr ℝ E F)))) ↔
    ξ = μ.prod ν where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    refine (MeasurableEquiv.toLp p (E × F)).map_measurableEquiv_injective
      <| Measure.ext_of_charFunDual <| funext fun L ↦ ?_
    rw [MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp, h, charFunDual_prod']
  mpr h := by rw [h]; exact charFunDual_prod' p

name: charFunDual_eq_pi_iff
statement:
lemma charFunDual_eq_pi_iff {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {E : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (E i)] {mE : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)}
    [∀ i, BorelSpace (E i)] [∀ i, SecondCountableTopology (E i)] [∀ i, CompleteSpace (E i)]
    {μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)} {ν : Measure (Π i, E i)} [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)]
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    (∀ L, charFunDual ν L = ∏ i, charFunDual (μ i) (L.comp (.single ℝ E i))) ↔
    ν = Measure.pi μ where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    refine Measure.ext_of_charFunDual <| funext fun t ↦ ?_
    rw [h, charFunDual_pi]
  mpr h := by rw [h]; exact charFunDual_pi

name: charFunDual_eq_pi_iff'
statement:
lemma charFunDual_eq_pi_iff' (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {E : ι → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (E i)]
    {mE : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)} [∀ i, BorelSpace (E i)] [∀ i, SecondCountableTopology (E i)]
    [∀ i, CompleteSpace (E i)] {μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)} {ν : Measure (Π i, E i)}
    [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    (∀ L, charFunDual (ν.map (toLp p)) L =
      ∏ i, charFunDual (μ i) (L.comp
        ((PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv p ℝ E).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (.single ℝ E i)))) ↔
    ν = Measure.pi μ where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    refine (MeasurableEquiv.toLp p (Π i, E i)).map_measurableEquiv_injective
      <| Measure.ext_of_charFunDual <| funext fun L ↦ ?_
    rw [MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp, h, charFunDual_pi']
  mpr h := by rw [h]; exact charFunDual_pi' p

name: charFunDual_conv
statement:
lemma charFunDual_conv {μ ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (L : StrongDual ℝ E) : charFunDual (μ ∗ ν) L = charFunDual μ L * charFunDual ν L
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [charFunDual_apply]
  rw [integral_conv]
  · simp [add_mul, Complex.exp_add, integral_const_mul, integral_mul_const]
  · exact (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono (by fun_prop) (by simp)

name: not_isFiniteMeasure_iff
statement: lemma not_isFiniteMeasure_iff : ¬IsFiniteMeasure μ ↔ μ univ = ∞
proof: := by simp [isFiniteMeasure_iff]

name: isFiniteMeasure_restrict
statement: lemma isFiniteMeasure_restrict : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.restrict s) ↔ μ s ≠ ∞
proof:
:= by
  simp [isFiniteMeasure_iff, lt_top_iff_ne_top]

name: measure_lt_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem measure_lt_top (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (s : Set α) : μ s < ∞
proof:
:=
  (measure_mono (subset_univ s)).trans_lt IsFiniteMeasure.measure_univ_lt_top

name: measure_ne_top
statement: theorem measure_ne_top (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (s : Set α) : μ s ≠ ∞
proof:
:=
  ne_of_lt (measure_lt_top μ s)

name: measure_compl_le_add_of_le_add
statement:
theorem measure_compl_le_add_of_le_add [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (ht : MeasurableSet t) {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (h : μ s ≤ μ t + ε) : μ tᶜ ≤ μ sᶜ + ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [measure_compl ht (by finiteness), measure_compl hs (by finiteness), tsub_le_iff_right]
  calc
    μ univ = μ univ - μ s + μ s := (tsub_add_cancel_of_le <| measure_mono s.subset_univ).symm
    _ ≤ μ univ - μ s + (μ t + ε) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by rw [add_right_comm, add_assoc]

name: measure_compl_le_add_iff
statement:
theorem measure_compl_le_add_iff [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} : μ sᶜ ≤ μ tᶜ + ε ↔ μ t ≤ μ s + ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => compl_compl s ▸ compl_compl t ▸ measure_compl_le_add_of_le_add hs.compl ht.compl h,
    measure_compl_le_add_of_le_add ht hs⟩

name: cofinite_eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem cofinite_eq_bot_iff : μ.cofinite = ⊥ ↔ IsFiniteMeasure μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [← empty_mem_iff_bot, μ.mem_cofinite, isFiniteMeasure_iff]

name: cofinite_eq_bot
statement:
@[nontriviality, simp]
theorem cofinite_eq_bot [IsFiniteMeasure μ] : μ.cofinite = ⊥
proof: := cofinite_eq_bot_iff.2 ‹_›

name: Measure.isFiniteMeasure_map
statement:
@[instance]
theorem Measure.isFiniteMeasure_map {m : MeasurableSpace α} (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : α → β) : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.map f)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : AEMeasurable f μ
  · constructor
    rw [map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf MeasurableSet.univ]
    exact measure_lt_top μ _
  · obtain rfl | hμ := eq_or_ne μ 0
    · rw [Measure.map_zero]; infer_instance
    rw [map_of_not_aemeasurable_of_ne_zero hf hμ]
    exact isFiniteMeasure_dirac

name: Measure.isFiniteMeasure_of_map
proof:

    rw [← Set.preimage_univ (f := f), ← map_apply_of_aemeasurable hf .univ]

name: Measure.eq_of_le_of_measure_univ_eq
statement:
lemma Measure.eq_of_le_of_measure_univ_eq [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμν : μ ≤ ν) (h_univ : μ univ = ν univ) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm hμν (le_intro fun s hs _ ↦ ?_)
  by_contra! h_lt
  have h_disj : Disjoint s sᶜ := disjoint_compl_right_iff_subset.mpr subset_rfl
  rw [← union_compl_self s, measure_union h_disj hs.compl, measure_union h_disj hs.compl] at h_univ
  exact ENNReal.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (by finiteness) h_lt (hμν sᶜ) |>.not_ge h_univ.symm.le

name: summable_measure_toReal

name: tendsto_measure_biUnion_Ici_zero_of_pairwise_disjoint
statement:
lemma tendsto_measure_biUnion_Ici_zero_of_pairwise_disjoint
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {Es : ℕ → Set X} (Es_mble : ∀ i, NullMeasurableSet (Es i) μ)
    (Es_disj : Pairwise fun n m ↦ Disjoint (Es n) (Es m)) :
    Tendsto (μ ∘ fun n ↦ ⋃ i ≥ n, Es i) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have decr : Antitone fun n ↦ ⋃ i ≥ n, Es i :=
    fun n m hnm ↦ biUnion_mono (fun _ hi ↦ le_trans hnm hi) (fun _ _ ↦ subset_rfl)
  have nothing : ⋂ n, ⋃ i ≥ n, Es i = ∅ := by
    apply subset_antisymm _ (empty_subset _)
    intro x hx
    simp only [mem_iInter, mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hx
    obtain ⟨j, _, x_in_Es_j⟩ := hx 0
    obtain ⟨k, k_gt_j, x_in_Es_k⟩ := hx (j + 1)
    have oops := (Es_disj (Nat.ne_of_lt k_gt_j)).ne_of_mem x_in_Es_j x_in_Es_k
    contradiction
  have key := tendsto_measure_iInter_atTop (μ := μ) (fun n ↦ by measurability)
    decr ⟨0, measure_ne_top _ _⟩
  simp only [nothing, measure_empty] at key
  convert! key

name: abs_measureReal_sub_le_measureReal_symmDiff'
statement:
theorem abs_measureReal_sub_le_measureReal_symmDiff'
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (ht : NullMeasurableSet t μ) (hs' : μ s ≠ ∞) (ht' : μ t ≠ ∞) :
    |μ.real s - μ.real t| ≤ μ.real (s ∆ t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Measure.real]
  have hst : μ (s \ t) ≠ ∞ := (measure_lt_top_of_subset sdiff_subset hs').ne
  have hts : μ (t \ s) ≠ ∞ := (measure_lt_top_of_subset sdiff_subset ht').ne
  suffices (μ s).toReal - (μ t).toReal = (μ (s \ t)).toReal - (μ (t \ s)).toReal by
    rw [this, measure_symmDiff_eq hs ht, ENNReal.toReal_add hst hts]
    convert! abs_sub (μ (s \ t)).toReal (μ (t \ s)).toReal <;> simp
  rw [measure_sdiff' s ht ht', measure_sdiff' t hs hs',
    ENNReal.toReal_sub_of_le measure_le_measure_union_right (by finiteness),
    ENNReal.toReal_sub_of_le measure_le_measure_union_right (by finiteness),
    union_comm t s]
  abel

name: abs_measureReal_sub_le_measureReal_symmDiff
statement:
theorem abs_measureReal_sub_le_measureReal_symmDiff [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hs : NullMeasurableSet s μ) (ht : NullMeasurableSet t μ) :
    |μ.real s - μ.real t| ≤ μ.real (s ∆ t)
proof:
:=
  abs_measureReal_sub_le_measureReal_symmDiff' hs ht (by finiteness) (by finiteness)

name: ite_ae_eq_of_measure_zero
statement:
theorem ite_ae_eq_of_measure_zero {γ} (f : α → γ) (g : α → γ) (s : Set α) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)]
    (hs_zero : μ s = 0) :
    (fun x => ite (x ∈ s) (f x) (g x)) =ᵐ[μ] g
proof:
:= by
  have h_ss : sᶜ ⊆ { a : α | ite (a ∈ s) (f a) (g a) = g a } := fun x hx => by
    simp [(Set.mem_compl_iff _ _).mp hx]
  refine measure_mono_null ?_ hs_zero
  conv_rhs => rw [← compl_compl s]
  rwa [Set.compl_subset_compl]

name: ite_ae_eq_of_measure_compl_zero
statement:
theorem ite_ae_eq_of_measure_compl_zero {γ} (f : α → γ) (g : α → γ)
    (s : Set α) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (hs_zero : μ sᶜ = 0) :
    (fun x => ite (x ∈ s) (f x) (g x)) =ᵐ[μ] f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_ae_iff] at hs_zero
  filter_upwards [hs_zero]
  intros
  split_ifs
  rfl

name: exists_ne_forall_mem_nhds_pos_measure_preimage
statement:
theorem exists_ne_forall_mem_nhds_pos_measure_preimage {β} [TopologicalSpace β] [T1Space β]
    [SecondCountableTopology β] [Nonempty β] {f : α → β} (h : ∀ b, ∃ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ≠ b) :
    ∃ a b : β, a ≠ b ∧ (∀ s ∈ 𝓝 a, 0 < μ (f ⁻¹' s)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ 𝓝 b, 0 < μ (f ⁻¹' t)
proof:
:= by
  
  set m : OuterMeasure β := OuterMeasure.map f μ.toOuterMeasure
  replace h : ∀ b : β, m {b}ᶜ ≠ 0 := fun b => not_eventually.mpr (h b)
  inhabit β
  have : m univ ≠ 0 := ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot (h default) (measure_mono <| subset_univ _)
  rcases exists_mem_forall_mem_nhdsWithin_pos_measure this with ⟨b, -, hb⟩
  simp only [nhdsWithin_univ] at hb
  rcases exists_mem_forall_mem_nhdsWithin_pos_measure (h b) with ⟨a, hab : a ≠ b, ha⟩
  simp only [isOpen_compl_singleton.nhdsWithin_eq hab] at ha
  exact ⟨a, b, hab, ha, hb⟩

name: ext_on_measurableSpace_of_generate_finite
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure ν := by
    constructor
    rw [← h_univ]
    apply IsFiniteMeasure.measure_univ_lt_top
  induction s, hs using induction_on_inter hA hC with
  | empty => simp
  | basic t ht => exact hμν t ht
  | compl t htm iht =>
    rw [measure_compl (h t htm) (by finiteness), measure_compl (h t htm) (by finiteness), iht,
      h_univ]
  | iUnion f hfd hfm ihf =>
    simp [measure_iUnion, hfd, h _ (hfm _), ihf]

theorem ext_of_generate_finite (C : Set (Set α)) (hA : m0 = generateFrom C) (hC : IsPiSystem C)

proof:

  Measure.ext fun _s hs =>
    ext_on_measurableSpace_of_generate_finite m0 C hμν le_rfl hA hC h_univ hs

name: inf_ae_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inf_ae_iff : μ.FiniteAtFilter (f ⊓ ae μ) ↔ μ.FiniteAtFilter f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => h.filter_mono inf_le_left⟩
  rintro ⟨s, ⟨t, ht, u, hu, rfl⟩, hμ⟩
  suffices μ t ≤ μ (t ∩ u) from ⟨t, ht, this.trans_lt hμ⟩
  exact measure_mono_ae (mem_of_superset hu fun x hu ht => ⟨ht, hu⟩)

  let F := H.finiteAtNhds

name: exists_open_superset_measure_lt_top'
statement:
theorem exists_open_superset_measure_lt_top' (h : IsCompact s)
    (hμ : ∀ x ∈ s, μ.FiniteAtFilter (𝓝 x)) : ∃ U ⊇ s, IsOpen U ∧ μ U < ∞
proof:
:= by
  refine IsCompact.induction_on h ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · use ∅
    simp
  · rintro s t hst ⟨U, htU, hUo, hU⟩
    exact ⟨U, hst.trans htU, hUo, hU⟩
  · rintro s t ⟨U, hsU, hUo, hU⟩ ⟨V, htV, hVo, hV⟩
    refine
      ⟨U ∪ V, union_subset_union hsU htV, hUo.union hVo,
        (measure_union_le _ _).trans_lt <| ENNReal.add_lt_top.2 ⟨hU, hV⟩⟩
  · intro x hx
    rcases (hμ x hx).exists_mem_basis (nhds_basis_opens _) with ⟨U, ⟨hx, hUo⟩, hU⟩
    exact ⟨U, nhdsWithin_le_nhds (hUo.mem_nhds hx), U, Subset.rfl, hUo, hU⟩

name: exists_open_superset_measure_lt_top
statement:
theorem exists_open_superset_measure_lt_top (h : IsCompact s) (μ : Measure α)
    [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] : ∃ U ⊇ s, IsOpen U ∧ μ U < ∞
proof:
:=
  h.exists_open_superset_measure_lt_top' fun x _ => μ.finiteAt_nhds x

name: measure_lt_top_of_nhdsWithin
statement:
theorem measure_lt_top_of_nhdsWithin (h : IsCompact s) (hμ : ∀ x ∈ s, μ.FiniteAtFilter (𝓝[s] x)) :
    μ s < ∞
proof:
:=
  IsCompact.induction_on h (by simp) (fun _ _ hst ht => (measure_mono hst).trans_lt ht)
    (fun s t hs ht => (measure_union_le s t).trans_lt (ENNReal.add_lt_top.2 ⟨hs, ht⟩)) hμ

name: measure_zero_of_nhdsWithin

:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, h⟩
    rcases μ.zero_one univ with (h₀ | h₁)
    · have := measure_mono (μ := μ) <| subset_univ s
      rw [h] at this

    · exact h₁

name: measure_inter_eq_one
statement:
lemma measure_inter_eq_one {s t : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t)
    (hμs : μ s = 1) (hμt : μ t = 1) : μ (s ∩ t) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : μ (s ∩ t) ≤ μ s := measure_mono inter_subset_left
  have : μ (s ∩ t) ≤ μ t := measure_mono inter_subset_right
  rcases μ.zero_one s with (_ | hμs)
    <;> rcases μ.zero_one t with (_ | hμt)
    <;> rcases μ.zero_one (s ∩ t)
  all_goals try simp_all only [zero_le, zero_ne_one]
  suffices μ (s ∩ t)ᶜ ≤ 0 by
    rw [measure_compl (hs.inter ht) (by simp), measure_univ ‹_›] at this
    simp_all
  calc
  _ = μ (sᶜ ∪ tᶜ) := by simp [compl_inter]
  _ ≤ μ sᶜ + μ tᶜ := measure_union_le _ _
  _ ≤ 0 := by
    rw [measure_compl hs (by simp), measure_univ hμs, hμs, tsub_self,
      measure_compl ht (by simp), measure_univ hμt, hμt, tsub_self]
    simp

name: measure_inter_eq_prod
statement:
lemma measure_inter_eq_prod {s t : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    μ (s ∩ t) = μ s * μ t
proof:
:= by
  have : μ (s ∩ t) ≤ μ s := measure_mono inter_subset_left
  have : μ (s ∩ t) ≤ μ t := measure_mono inter_subset_right
  cases μ.zero_one s <;> cases μ.zero_one t <;> cases μ.zero_one (s ∩ t)
  all_goals try simp_all [measure_inter_eq_one]

name: exists_eq_dirac
statement: theorem exists_eq_dirac [StandardBorelSpace α] [NeZero μ] : ∃ x₀, μ = Measure.dirac x₀
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := by
    rcases IsZeroOrProbabilityMeasure.measure_univ (μ := μ) with (h | h)
    · simp_all
    · exact ⟨h⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hAm, hAsep⟩ := exists_seq_separating (α := α) MeasurableSet.univ univ
  let B := fun n => if h : μ (A n) = 1 then A n else (A n)ᶜ
  have mBn : MeasurableSet (⋂ n, B n) := by
    refine MeasurableSet.iInter fun n ↦ ?_
    simp only [dite_eq_ite, B]
    split_ifs
    · exact hAm n
    · exact (hAm n).compl
  have hBn : μ (⋂ n, B n) = 1 := by
    refine (prob_compl_eq_zero_iff mBn).mp ?_
    simp only [dite_eq_ite, compl_iInter, measure_iUnion_null_iff, B]
    intro n
    split_ifs with h
    · simp_all
    · rw [compl_compl]
      rcases μ.zero_one (A n) with (h₀ | h₁)
      · exact h₀
      · simp_all
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ : ∃ x₀, ⋂ n, B n = {x₀} := by
    simp_rw [eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem]
    have neBn : (⋂ n, B n).Nonempty := by
      by_contra! h
      rw [h] at hBn
      simp_all
    refine ⟨neBn.some, neBn.some_mem, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
    refine hAsep y (by trivial) neBn.some (by trivial) fun n ↦ ?_
    have hsome := neBn.some_mem
    simp only [dite_eq_ite, mem_iInter, B] at hsome hy
    specialize hsome n
    specialize hy n
    constructor
    · intro h
      split_ifs at hy with hμAn
      · simpa [hμAn] using! hsome
      · contradiction
    · intro h
      split_ifs at hsome with hμAn
      · simpa [hμAn] using! hy
      · contradiction
  use x₀
  ext s hs
  by_cases h : x₀ ∈ s
  · simp [h]
    have : μ {x₀} ≤ μ s := measure_mono (μ := μ) (by grind)
    rw [← hx₀, hBn] at this
    simp_all
  · simp [h]
    have : μ s ≤ μ {x₀}ᶜ := measure_mono (μ := μ) (by grind)
    rw [← hx₀, measure_compl mBn (by simp), MeasureTheory.measure_univ, hBn] at this
    simp_all

name: exists_isFiniteMeasure_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
theorem exists_isFiniteMeasure_absolutelyContinuous [SFinite μ] :
    ∃ ν : Measure α, IsFiniteMeasure ν ∧ μ ≪ ν ∧ ν ≪ μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases ENNReal.exists_pos_tsum_mul_lt_of_countable top_ne_zero (sfiniteSeq μ · univ)
    fun _ ↦ measure_ne_top _ _ with ⟨c, hc₀, hc⟩
  have {s : Set α} : sum (fun n ↦ c n • sfiniteSeq μ n) s = 0 ↔ μ s = 0 := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← sum_sfiniteSeq μ, sum_apply_of_countable]
    simp [(hc₀ _).ne']
  refine ⟨.sum fun n ↦ c n • sfiniteSeq μ n, ⟨?_⟩, fun _ ↦ this.1, fun _ ↦ this.2⟩
  simpa [mul_comm] using hc

name: sigmaFinite_iff

name: iUnion_spanningSets

theorem iUnion_spanningSets (μ : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] : ⋃ i : ℕ, spanningSets μ i = univ

name: isCountablySpanning_spanningSets

name: measurableSet_spanningSetsIndex

theorem preimage_spanningSetsIndex_singleton (μ : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] (n : ℕ) :

name: spanningSetsIndex_eq_iff

name: mem_spanningSetsIndex

theorem mem_spanningSets_of_index_le (μ : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] (x : α) {n : ℕ}

name: measure_singleton_lt_top

name: sum_restrict_disjointed_spanningSets

theorem sum_restrict_disjointed_spanningSets (μ ν : Measure α) [SigmaFinite ν] :

name: forall_measure_inter_spanningSets_eq_zero

name: exists_measure_inter_spanningSets_pos

theorem exists_measure_inter_spanningSets_pos [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} [SigmaFinite μ]

name: finite_const_le_meas_of_disjoint_iUnion
statement:
theorem finite_const_le_meas_of_disjoint_iUnion₀ {ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (ε_pos : 0 < ε) {As : ι → Set α} (As_mble : ∀ i : ι, NullMeasurableSet (As i) μ)
    (As_disj : Pairwise (AEDisjoint μ on As)) (Union_As_finite : μ (⋃ i, As i) ≠ ∞) :
    Set.Finite { i : ι | ε ≤ μ (As i) }
proof:
:=
  ENNReal.finite_const_le_of_tsum_ne_top
    (ne_top_of_le_ne_top Union_As_finite (tsum_meas_le_meas_iUnion_of_disjoint₀ μ As_mble As_disj))
    ε_pos.ne'

name: finite_const_le_meas_of_disjoint_iUnion
statement:
theorem finite_const_le_meas_of_disjoint_iUnion {ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (ε_pos : 0 < ε) {As : ι → Set α} (As_mble : ∀ i : ι, MeasurableSet (As i))
    (As_disj : Pairwise (Disjoint on As)) (Union_As_finite : μ (⋃ i, As i) ≠ ∞) :
    Set.Finite { i : ι | ε ≤ μ (As i) }
proof:
:=
  finite_const_le_meas_of_disjoint_iUnion₀ μ ε_pos (fun i ↦ (As_mble i).nullMeasurableSet)
    (fun _ _ h ↦ Disjoint.aedisjoint (As_disj h)) Union_As_finite

name: _root_.Set.Infinite.meas_eq_top
statement:
theorem _root_.Set.Infinite.meas_eq_top [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    {s : Set α} (hs : s.Infinite) (h' : ∃ ε, ε ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, ε ≤ μ {x}) : μ s = ∞
proof:
:= top_unique <|
  let ⟨ε, hne, hε⟩ := h'; have := hs.to_subtype
  calc
    ∞ = ∑' _ : s, ε := (ENNReal.tsum_const_eq_top_of_ne_zero hne).symm
    _ ≤ ∑' x : s, μ {x.1} := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x ↦ hε x x.2
    _ ≤ μ (⋃ x : s, {x.1}) := tsum_meas_le_meas_iUnion_of_disjoint _
      (fun _ ↦ MeasurableSet.singleton _) fun x y hne ↦ by simpa [Subtype.val_inj]
    _ = μ s := by simp

name: countable_meas_pos_of_disjoint_of_meas_iUnion_ne_top
proof:
:= by
  set posmeas := { i : ι | 0 < μ (As i) } with posmeas_def
  rcases exists_seq_strictAnti_tendsto' (zero_lt_one : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < 1) with
    ⟨as, _, as_mem, as_lim⟩
  set fairmeas := fun n : ℕ => { i : ι | as n ≤ μ (As i) }
  have countable_union : posmeas = ⋃ n, fairmeas n := by
    have fairmeas_eq : ∀ n, fairmeas n = (fun i => μ (As i)) ⁻¹' Ici (as n) := fun n => by
      simp only [fairmeas]
      rfl
    simpa only [fairmeas_eq, posmeas_def, ← preimage_iUnion,
      iUnion_Ici_eq_Ioi_of_lt_of_tendsto (fun n => (as_mem n).1) as_lim]
  rw [countable_union]
  refine countable_iUnion fun n => Finite.countable ?_
  exact finite_const_le_meas_of_disjoint_iUnion₀ μ (as_mem n).1 As_mble As_disj Union_As_finite

name: countable_meas_pos_of_disjoint_of_meas_iUnion_ne_top
proof:
:=
  countable_meas_pos_of_disjoint_of_meas_iUnion_ne_top₀ μ (fun i ↦ (As_mble i).nullMeasurableSet)
    ((fun _ _ h ↦ Disjoint.aedisjoint (As_disj h))) Union_As_finite

name: countable_meas_pos_of_disjoint_iUnion
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_sfiniteSeq μ] at As_disj As_mble ⊢
  have obs : { i : ι | 0 < sum (sfiniteSeq μ) (As i) }
      ⊆ ⋃ n, { i : ι | 0 < sfiniteSeq μ n (As i) } := by
    intro i hi
    by_contra con
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_ofPred_eq, not_exists, not_lt, nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at *
    rw [sum_apply₀] at hi
    · simp_rw [con] at hi
      simp at hi
    · exact As_mble i
  apply Countable.mono obs
  refine countable_iUnion fun n ↦ ?_
  apply countable_meas_pos_of_disjoint_of_meas_iUnion_ne_top₀
  · exact fun i ↦ (As_mble i).mono (le_sum _ _)
  · exact fun i j hij ↦ AEDisjoint.of_le (As_disj hij) (le_sum _ _)
  · exact measure_ne_top _ (⋃ i, As i)

name: countable_meas_pos_of_disjoint_iUnion
proof:
:=
  countable_meas_pos_of_disjoint_iUnion₀ (fun i ↦ (As_mble i).nullMeasurableSet)
    ((fun _ _ h ↦ Disjoint.aedisjoint (As_disj h)))

name: countable_meas_level_set_pos
proof:

  have level_sets_disjoint : Pairwise (Disjoint on fun t : β => { a : α | g a = t }) :=
    fun s t hst => Disjoint.preimage g (disjoint_singleton.mpr hst)
  exact Measure.countable_meas_pos_of_disjoint_iUnion₀
    (fun b => g_mble (‹MeasurableSingletonClass β›.measurableSet_singleton b))
    ((fun _ _ h ↦ Disjoint.aedisjoint (level_sets_disjoint h)))
